summary.en: The smaller jobs offered by contacts: security codes, disruptions, extractions, smuggling and the like.
summary.zh: 接触人提供的中小任务：安全码、破坏行动、营救、走私等等。

briefing.en: You've acquired ground-forces security codes for %s. Having these allows for much better raid planning and will reduce marine casualties by %s.
briefing.zh: 你已获得 %s 地面部队的安全码，这意味着你可更好地制定劫掠计划，从而降低 %s 陆战队员的伤亡。
是规模为 %s 的殖民地，其目前的控制方为

briefing.en: The authorities are aware the shipment is incoming and patrols are on high alert.

briefing.zh: 进行一次战术轰炸，而此处位于
的附近部署间谍卫星，而此处位于
一个似乎已经无法运作的数据芯片

briefing.en: marines to ensure the job goes smoothly.
briefing.zh: 遗迹内的数据核心。此地
，使用识别码绕过其防御系统以劫掠并夺取
你的殖民地需至少生产 %s 单位的

briefing.en: This order will not be completed because %s has decivilized.
This bounty is no longer on offer.
briefing.zh: 适用于所有的 %s 舰队

briefing.en: for the lost group of Luddic heretics.
briefing.zh: 以寻找卢德异端的踪迹。

texts.en: "I've acquired the latest $seco_faction facility defense security codes. They could provide a significant edge in a ground operation."
texts.zh: "我这里有最新的 $seco_faction 设施安全码。这些代码可以在进行地面行动时为你带来巨大优势。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods $hisOrHer head conspiratorially, "You see, a 'friend' acquired some $seco_faction security codes that'll give you the upper hand in any one ground operation - obviously they'll change the codes once they're used. I could let them go for $seco_price credits. Have to cover my 'friend's risks and of course include a reasonable resellers fee." The codes will be good for $seco_days days.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe阴森森地点了点$hisOrHer的头："你看，我的一个 '朋友' 获得了一些 $seco_faction 的安全码，它们可以让你在任何一次地面行动中占据上风 —— 当然，只要用了一次，对方就会立即改掉密码。我打算用 $seco_price 星币卖掉它们。毕竟总得为我 '朋友' 承担的风险提供补偿，当然也包括合理的转售费。" 安全码的有效期为 $seco_days 天。

texts.en:
"Great! You won't regret it."
OR
$HeOrShe claps $hisOrHer hands together, "Excellent!"
OR
"I always enjoy doing business with you."
OR
$HeOrShe smiles, "I knew you'd say yes."
OR
"A wise choice," $heOrShe says, giving a smile that you suppose is meant to be mysterious.
OR
"Lovely! I'm sure you'll get the results I- ah, we are hoping for."
OR
$HeOrShe simply nods, then says "Good, good."
texts.zh:
"好极了，你不会后悔的。"
OR
$HeOrShe双手一拍，说道："干得好！"
OR
"我就知道，和你的合作总是令人愉悦。"
OR
$HeOrShe笑了笑，"我就知道你会同意的。"
OR
"明智的决定。" $HeOrShe说道，一边向你投出一个很神秘的微笑。
OR
"真是令人愉悦！我想你会得到我...们所期望的东西。"
OR
$HeOrShe只是点了点头，然后说道："很好，很好。"

texts.en:
"Aye, a good dealing," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods, "That'll do."
OR
"Green across the board," $heOrShe says.
OR
"That's an aye," $heOrShe says with a nod.
OR
"Good dealing," $heOrShe says.
OR
"Burn bright," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe looks pleased. "Burn bright, captain."
OR
$HeOrShe nods. "All systems go."
texts.zh:
"嗯，一笔好买卖。" $HeOrShe说。
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头，"行吧"
OR
"祝你顺利！" $HeOrShe说道。
OR
"不错。" $HeOrShe点了点头。
OR
"干得好。" $HeOrShe说道。
OR
"祝航行无阻。" $HeOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe看起来很高兴。"航行无阻，舰长。"
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头说道，"一切就绪。"

texts.en:
At that, $heOrShe gives a small salute, "Captain."
OR
"Then that's affirmative," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods, "Then the operation is a go."
OR
"Then the mission is a go," $heOrShe says with a nod.
OR
"Acknowledged, captain," $heOrShe says with a nod. "I'll await your confirm."
texts.zh:
听到这话，$HeOrShe微微敬了个礼，说道："舰长。"
OR
"那么，确认无误，" $heOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe点头致意，"那么，行动按计划进行。"
OR
"那么，任务开始，" $heOrShe点了点头，说道。
OR
"收到，舰长，" $heOrShe点头致意，"我等待你的确认。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe smiles, "Blessings of Ludd be upon you, captain."
OR
"May this agreement be blessed," $heOrShe says softly.
OR
$HeOrShe smiles, then clasps $hisOrHer hands together. "May this labor bear sweet fruit."
OR
"Let our works bear the fruit of harmony," $heOrShe says, then bows $hisOrHer head for a moment.
OR
"Ludd bless," $heOrShe says.
OR
$HeOrShe nods, and says "Blessings."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe微笑着，"舰长，愿卢德与你同在。"
OR
"愿这份协议蒙福，" $HeOrShe轻声说道。
OR
$HeOrShe微笑着，然后双手合十。"愿这次付出结出甜美的果实。"
OR
"愿我们的工作结出和谐的果实，" $HeOrShe说道，然后低头片刻。
OR
"愿卢德赐福，" $HeOrShe说道。
OR
$HeOrShe点头致意，说道："愿你蒙福。"

texts.en:
"What a delightful exchange. I'm sure it'll serve well, captain."
OR
"My thanks to you, captain," $heOrShe smiles. "This will make for a splendid anecdote."
OR
"Wonderful," $heOrShe says. "Providing you with opportunity has been most diverting."
texts.zh:
"多么令人愉悦的小买卖，舰长。"
OR
"谢谢你，舰长。" $HeOrShe微笑着说，"这将成为一段绝佳的趣闻。"
OR
"多么令人愉悦！这大概就是为生计奔波的感觉吧。"
OR
"噔噔！我干的怎么样？" $HeOrShe自问自答，"就像我叔叔说的一样有趣。"
OR
"噢，太棒了！我想我们的天父会同意的。"
OR
"那就对了！" $HeOrShe说道，"妈妈一定会为我感到骄傲。"

texts.en:
"Good. I should get back to filling out these forms."
OR
"Resolved. Can I help you with anything else?"
OR
"Then it is agreed and done," $heOrShe nods.
OR
"Good," $heOrShe says, "All parties confirmed."
texts.zh:
"好的，我该回去完成这些表格了。"
OR
"搞定！还需要帮忙吗？"
OR
"那就这么定了。" $HeOrShe点了点头。
OR
"好！" $HeOrShe说，"各方确认。"

texts.en:
"A profitable exchange for both of us, captain," $heOrShe says.
OR
"A good deal," $HeOrShe smiles, "Done and sealed."
OR
"Always a pleasure doing business," $heOrShe says.
OR
"I consider working with you an investment in both our futures," $heOrShe says, smiling.
texts.zh:
"我想这对于我们是双赢的，舰长。" $HeOrShe说道。
OR
"好买卖！" $HeOrShe笑了笑，"就这么定了。"
OR
$HeOrShe说："合作愉快！"
OR
"我认为与你合作是对我们双方未来的投资。" $HeOrShe微笑着说。

texts.en:
"I applaud your intelligent choice, captain."
OR
"A most rational decision."
OR
"You're smarter than you look, captain," $heOrShe says as if it were a compliment.
OR
"I knew you'd make the logical choice," $heOrShe says.
OR
"Good. Now I just need to calculate... " $personName starts tapping away at a datapad.

$HeOrShe looks up, "Oh, are we done?"
OR
"Hah! I knew you'd say yes. Statistically speaking, assent was all but inevitable sooner or later."
texts.zh:
"我欣赏你的明智选择，舰长。"
OR
"很理智的决定。"
OR
"你比你看起来的明智多了，舰长。" $HeOrShe故作恭敬地说道。
OR
$HeOrShe说："我知道，你会做出理智的选择。"
OR
"好，我现在只要稍微地计算一下..." $personName 开始在数据平板上敲击。

$HeOrShe抬头说道："哦，我们搞定了？"
OR
"啊哈，从统计学上讲，我知道你迟早会同意的。"

texts.en:
A slow smile grows on $hisOrHer face. "A most delectable agreement, captain."
OR
"The pleasure is all mine, I'm sure," $heOrShe says darkly.
OR
"Good, good," $heOrShe says quietly, then in almost a whisper, "You will be so very useful to me."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer的脸上逐渐浮现出微笑，"非常令人愉悦的决定，舰长。"
OR
"我深知这是我的荣幸。" $heOrShe阴沉地说。
OR
"好好好。" $heOrShe轻声地耳语道，"万分感谢。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods reverently, "By Ludd's will we do this."
OR
$HeOrShe makes a sign of supplication, "We walk the Path together."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe虔诚地点头致意，"我们奉卢德旨意，而行此事。"
OR
$HeOrShe做出祈求的手势，"我们携手，共循此径。"

texts.en: You have your purser make arrangements, with instructions to keep the pilgrims from interfering in $shipOrFleet operations.
texts.zh: 你让你的事务长去安排了，同时也指示他别让朝圣者打扰$shipOrFleet的运行。

texts.en:
"Well, let me know if you change your mind."
OR
$HeOrShe seems to think things over. "Perhaps next time."
OR
"Oh well." $HeOrShe shrugs.
OR
"Right," $heOrShe says, "I'm sure I can figure out some alternative."
OR
$HeOrShe nods, brow furrowed, and says "I understand."
OR
A look of disappointment crosses $hisOrHer face, but $heOrShe simply shrugs.
OR
$HeOrShe looks thoughtful, "I see, captain. Your loss I suppose."
OR
"It's a missed opportunity, captain, but it's your decision."
texts.zh:
"好吧，如果你改变主意了，务必告诉我。"
OR
$HeOrShe似乎正在沉思，"或许...下次吧"
OR
"噢，好吧。" $HeOrShe耸了耸肩。
OR
"好吧。" $HeOrShe说，"我想我一定有办法搞定的。"
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头，皱着眉头说："我明白了。"
OR
$HeOrShe的脸上闪过一丝失望的表情，但$HeOrShe只是耸了耸肩。
OR
$HeOrShe若有所思地说："我想...这是你的损失，舰长。"
OR
"很遗憾，舰长，但这是你的决定。"

texts.en: At the bar, a shifty $seco_manOrWoman fiddling with a cybermod jack gives you a grim but significant look before turning away.
texts.zh: 酒吧里，一个鬼鬼祟祟的$seco_manOrWoman正在摆弄着一个电子设备，对方在转身离开前给了你一个严肃但意味深长的眼神。

options.en: Strike up a conversation with the shifty $seco_manOrWoman fiddling with a cybermod jack
options.zh: 去和摆弄电子设备的鬼鬼祟祟$seco_manOrWoman聊聊

texts.en:
You pretend to read the menu as the $seco_manOrWoman puts the jack down and explains that $seco_heOrShe saw your $shipOrFleet come in. "You look like someone who might find a use for the latest $seco_faction facility security codes," $seco_heOrShe says with a wink.

"They'd change all the codes once you pulled this trick, of course but breaching the security system at the right moment... " $HeOrShe trails off, leaving you to complete the thought: it would give you a significant one-time advantage in a ground operation. "And you'd have to use them soon," $heOrShe says with a shrug, "These codes get rotated, oh, maybe once a month. Depending."

The $seco_manOrWoman explains that the price is $seco_price credits, significantly more than the drink you were eying.
texts.zh:
你假装在看菜单，而那个$seco_manOrWoman放下电子设备，并解释说自己看见你的$shipOrFleet了。"你看起来像是会用到最新的 $seco_faction 设施安全码的人，" $seco_heOrShe眨了眨眼。

"一旦你用过了这玩意儿，他们就肯定会更改所有密码。不过在适当的时候让安全系统瘫痪..." $HeOrShe停了下来，让你自己体会下半句：它会为你在一次地面行动中提供显著优势。"你必须得尽快使用，" $heOrShe耸了耸肩，"这些代码定期更换，哦，应该一个月更换一次吧。具体得看情况。"

$seco_manOrWoman给出的价格是 $seco_price 星币，这可比你刚从菜单上看到的饮料要贵多了。

texts.en: You have your purser make arrangements, with instructions to keep the pilgrims from interfering in $shipOrFleet operations.
texts.zh: 你让你的事务长去安排了，同时也指示他别让朝圣者打扰$shipOrFleet的运行。

texts.en:
"I trust you, captain," $heOrShe says carefully, "There's a sensitive matter regarding the facilities of a long-time competitor of mine..."
OR
"We've built up a good rapport, I think," $heOrShe says, watching you carefully. "I have a sensitive matter to discuss regarding the facilities of a... competitor."
texts.zh:
"我相信你，舰长。" $heOrShe小心地说，"我有一个敏感问题...是关于我的长期竞争对手的设施的..."
OR
"我想我们已经建立了良好的关系。" $heOrShe说道，诚惶诚恐地看着你，"我有一件敏感的事情要讨论...关于一位竞争对手的设施。"

texts.en:
"If my competitor's warehouse $dcom_marketOnOrAt $dcom_marketName was raided by some third party," $heOrShe nods at you, $hisOrHer meaning clear "I would arrange for $dcom_reward credits to be transferred to your account."

"My tacticians' analysis suggests that $dcom_marines marines would be sufficient." $HeOrShe pauses a moment, then adds "And I would suggest going in quietly; this is $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction logistics zone and my intent is to send a message, not a broadcast."
texts.zh:
"如果我对头在 $dcom_marketName 的仓库被哪个第三方势力袭击了..." $heOrShe向你缓慢地点着头，$heOrShe的意思很明白了，"我会把 $dcom_reward 星币的资金打到你的账户上。"

"我的战术官们分析指出 $dcom_marines 名陆战队员就足够了。" $HeOrShe停顿了一下，然后补充说道，"我还是要建议你别弄得太张扬了。这毕竟是 $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction 的后方，而我只想要捎个信而已，不是要大张旗鼓地广播一通。"

texts.en: A $dcom_manOrWoman in an expensive business suit is clutching a TriPad with what seems like barely-restrained rage. Just staring into space.
texts.zh: 一个身着昂贵西装的$dcom_manOrWoman抓着 TriPad，似乎正在强忍愤怒，呆呆地盯着空气。

options.en: Carefully approach the angry $dcom_manOrWoman in the expensive suit
options.zh: 小心地接近那名身着昂贵西装的$dcom_manOrWoman

texts.en:
You exude understanding. If someone needed to vent a little flux, why, you'd be the perfect audience. It takes only halfway through a light drink before you have the angry $manOrWoman opening up about $hisOrHer problems.

You murmur vague agreement at the injustice done to honest folk, the irony of laws used as a shield by dishonest actors. Someone could do something, maybe.
texts.zh:
你展现出了自己善解人意的一面，成为了某人需要倾倒苦水时完美的倾诉对象。只用了喝掉半杯低度酒的功夫，你就轻松地撬开了这个$manOrWoman的话匣子。

老实人倾诉着自己所遭受的不公，你轻声附和，感叹法律居然会屡屡成为骗子们的挡箭牌。也许总得有人站出来做点什么。

options.zh: 也许的确需要有人做些什么了。

texts.en:
"It'd be a rational response. Proportional, even," $heOrShe says intensely, $hisOrHer rage now the deathly cold of a cryovolcano. "If their warehouse $dcom_marketOnOrAt $dcom_marketName was raided by an unassociated third party," $heOrShe smiles vengefully, lifting a drink in a salute to you, "I could arrange $dcom_reward credits to find their way into your account if that happened. I'll provide all the necessary tactical details, of course."

A quick review of $hisOrHer TriPad suggests that you'd need around $dcom_marines marines to carry off the operation. You note that it lies within $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction logistics zone, so performing such a raid may anger the local authorities. Even taking stealth measures may not entirely avert suspicion.
texts.zh:
"这将是个合理的回应。甚至是，必要的。" $heOrShe言辞激烈地说道，此刻$hisOrHer的怒火已然冻结，只剩冰火山一般致命的冷酷。"假设他们在 $dcom_marketName 的仓库被哪个第三方势力劫掠了..." $heOrShe露出了仇恨的微笑，向着你举杯致意，"我就会把 $dcom_reward 星币的资金送到你的账户上。当然，我会提供所有必需的战略细节。"

你快速地扫了一遍$hisOrHer的 TriPad，看起来要完成这项行动你会需要大约 $dcom_marines 名陆战队员。你意识到那座仓库位于 $dcom_marketFactionArticle $dcom_marketFaction 的后方，这样的劫掠可能会激怒地方当局。即使做好保密措施也不一定能完全避免被怀疑。

texts.en: "Command has assigned me a somewhat atypical extraction mission. Due to, ah, public-political implications, it is best performed by a mixed-capability independent unit such as yours."
texts.zh: "指挥部给我分配了一个特殊的撤离任务。由于...嗯，公共政治影响，这种任务最好由你们这样的复合独立舰队来执行。"

texts.en: "Command has given me an unconventional extraction mission; a mixed-capability unit with experience interacting with, ah, non-aligned militants may be most appropriate for the situation."
texts.zh: "指挥部分配给我了一个非常规的撤离任务，具备多样化的作战能力，同时和那些，呃，所谓的无所属武装分子经常打交道的小型部队最适合这种情况。"

texts.en: "Command has given me a sensitive mission. Your independent, mixed-capability unit would be best suited to carrying it out due to... religious elements."
texts.zh: "指挥部给了我一个高度敏感的任务。由于...宗教因素，你这种具备多样化的作战能力的独立小型部队最适合执行它。"

options.en: Ask about the 'atypical extraction' mission involving a major faction
options.zh: 询问涉及主要势力的 "特殊撤离" 任务

options.en: Ask about the 'unconventional extraction' mission involving pirates
options.zh: 询问涉及海盗的"非常规撤离"任务

options.en: Ask about the 'unconventional extraction' mission involving Pathers
options.zh: 询问涉及左径的 "非常规撤离" 任务

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "As I said, we need the agent extracted from $extr_marketName. Command has authorized a payment of $extr_reward credits for a successful mission."

"The oppo may be expecting you. I suggest you go in quiet because, as you know, it's $extr_marketFactionArticle $extr_marketFaction colony. The situation is enough of a mess as it is."

$HeOrShe pauses a moment. Some hidden frustration? "We do, however, have a fair piece of intel on their defensive capabilities," $personLastName says, fingers moving rapidly to transfer a datafile for your inspection - a detailed tactical report.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off the operation.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，" $HeOrShe说，"如我所说，我们需要从 $extr_marketName 撤离一名特工。指挥中心已经授权为完成此次任务支付 $extr_reward 星币。"

"对方可能对袭击有所防备，我建议你保持低调。毕竟，你知道的，那可是 $extr_marketFactionArticle $extr_marketFaction 的殖民地。光是有特工在那落网，就已经够糟了。"

$HeOrShe说着说着，话语一顿，或许是在强压心底的沮丧？"不过，我们掌握了关于对方防御能力的情报，内容还算详实。" $personLastName 说到这里，指尖连点几下，将一份详细的战术报告传了过来，供你参考。

你快速审了一遍内容并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 名陆战队员来执行这项任务。

texts.en:
"One of our agents infiltrated the retinue of a pirate warlord $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. We know that they have been apprehended. Extraction by any means necessary is now our mission objective, and I believe you are best suited to carry out this mission." $HeOrShe sighs, "We cannot use the flagged navy in this operation due to... politics. So we come to you. Retrieve the agent and we will pay you $extr_reward credits."

With a few taps at $hisOrHer console you receive an incoming data stream, "Intel on the pirates' defenses. We won't be sending you in blind, at least."

You quickly review the intel and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off this operation.
texts.zh:
"我方的一名高级特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的一名海盗军阀。此人已经被发现并且被监禁了。当前的任务目标是以任何可行手段将其撤离 $extr_marketName，我相信你最适合执行这个任务。" $HeOrShe叹气到，"如果我们让海军大张旗鼓地参与这项行动的话会带来一些政治上的...不便。所以我们找到了你。我们提供 $extr_reward 星币，作为我方特工安全返回的奖励。"

$hisOrHer在控制面板上轻触几下，你收到一个数据流传入，"这是海盗的防御布局。至少我们不会让你盲目地冲进去。"

你快速审了一遍内容并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 陆战队员来执行这项任务。

texts.en:
"One of our agents infiltrated a militant Luddic sect $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName." $HeOrShe meets your eyes, "Yes, Pathers. We know our agent was apprehended. Extraction by any means necessary is now our mission objective, and I believe you are best suited to carry out this mission." $HeOrShe sighs, "We cannot use the flagged navy in this operation due to... religious considerations. So we come to you. Retrieve the agent and we will pay you $extr_reward credits."

With a few taps at $hisOrHer console you receive an incoming data stream, "Intel on the Pathers' defenses. We won't be sending you in blind, at least."

You quickly review the intel and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off this operation.
texts.zh:
"我方的一名特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的一个卢德武装教派。" $HeOrShe和你交换了一下眼色。"对，就是 卢德左径。我们得知这名特工已经被扣押了。当前的任务目标是不择手段将其救回，而我相信你是执行这个任务的最佳人选。" $HeOrShe叹气到。"毕竟出于...宗教上的考虑，我们不能让海军打着自己的旗号去执行这一行动。因此我们必须拜托你。救回我们的特工，我们将支付你 $extr_reward 星币作为报酬。"

$hisOrHer在控制面板上轻触几下，随即你收到了一份数据，"这是左径分子的防御布局。我们至少不会让你盲目地冲进去。"

你快速浏览了一遍情报，估计你需要至少大约 $extr_marines 名陆战队员来执行这项任务。

texts.en: A nervous cadet holding a drink approaches you, "Um, captain. My uh- I mean, the $extr_manOrWoman over there wants a word." The cadet glances at a dark corner of the bar.
texts.zh: 一个紧张的学员拿着酒靠近你，"呃，舰长。我的...呃我是说那边的$extr_manOrWoman想要和您说句话。" 学员往酒吧阴暗角落瞥了一眼。

texts.en: A nervous cadet holding a drink approaches you, "Um, captain. My uh- I mean, the $extr_manOrWoman over there wants a word." The cadet glances at a dark corner of the bar.
texts.zh: 一个紧张的学员拿着酒靠近你，"呃，舰长。我的...呃我是说那边的$extr_manOrWoman想要和您说句话。" 学员往酒吧阴暗角落瞥了一眼。

texts.zh: 一个紧张的学员拿着酒靠近你，"呃，舰长。我的...呃我是说那边的$extr_manOrWoman想要和您说句话。" 学员往酒吧阴暗角落瞥了一眼。

options.en: Talk to the $extr_manOrWoman who ordered the cadet to apprehend you
Talk to the $extr_manOrWoman who ordered the cadet to apprehend you
Talk to the $extr_manOrWoman who ordered the cadet to apprehend you

texts.en:
The $manOrWoman sits in the dark. $HeOrShe is dressed as a common tech, but speaks as though $heOrShe holds, or has held, command.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "My superiors recognize that your unique talents could serve our faction." There is no drink on the table, and no invitation to sit. "We need an agent extracted from $extr_marketFactionArticle $extr_marketFaction colony $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. A flagged taskforce cannot do this due to... political considerations. Our offer is $extr_reward credits."

"The oppo may be expecting you. We have intel on their defenses," the $manOrWoman places a datapad on the table for your inspection.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that you'd need around $extr_marines marines to carry off the operation.
texts.zh:
只见一个$manOrWoman坐在黑暗的角落里。虽然穿得和普通的技术官差不多，但从话语间能听出$heOrShe才是这儿负责发号施令的人，就是不知道是以前还是最近才上任的。

"$playerName 舰长，" $heOrShe说，"我的上级意识到你出众的才干能为我们势力效力。" 桌子上没有酒，对方也没有邀请你坐下。"我们需要从 $extr_marketName 撤离一名特工，那里属于 $extr_marketFaction 的势力范围。由于某些... 政治上的考量，我们无法动用正规编制的特遣队执行这项任务。当然，我们将会提供 $extr_reward 星币作为报酬。"

"对方很可能对你的到来有所提防，我这里有些目标周边防御布置的情报。" $manOrWoman把数据平板放在桌上供你检查。

你快速浏览了一遍内容，估计需要大约 $extr_marines 名陆战队员来执行这项任务。

texts.en:
The $manOrWoman sits in the dark at a table with no drink. $HeOrShe is dressed as a common tech, but speaks as though $heOrShe holds, or has held, command.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "One of our top agents infiltrated the retinue of a pirate warlord $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. They have been apprehended. Extraction by any means is now our mission objective, though political considerations make use of the flagged navy in this operation... awkward. Our offer to you is $extr_reward credits for successful return of our agent."

"The pirates will be expecting you, but we have intel on their defenses," the $manOrWoman places a datapad on the table.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that around $extr_marines marines are needed to execute the operation.
texts.zh:
这个$manOrWoman坐在桌旁的昏暗处，桌上并没有摆酒。虽穿得和普通技术官差不多，但从话语间能听出$heOrShe才是这儿负责发号施令的人，就是不知道是以前还是最近才上任的。

"$playerName 舰长，" $heOrShe说，"我方的一名高级特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的一名{海盗}军阀。他已经暴露并且受到监禁。当前的任务目标是以任何可行手段将其撤离 $extr_marketName，但如果我们动用正规编制的海军将会造成政治上的... 不便。对此，我们提供 $extr_reward 星币，作为让我方特工安全返回的报酬。"

"{海盗}可能会预料到你的袭击。但我们有关于他们防御系统的情报。" 这个$manOrWoman把数据平板放在桌上供你检查。

你快速审了一遍内容，并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 陆战队员来执行这项任务。

texts.en:
The $manOrWoman sits in the dark at a table with no drink. $HeOrShe is dressed as a common tech, but speaks as though $heOrShe holds, or has held, command.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says. "One of our top agents infiltrated a militant Luddic sect $extr_marketOnOrAt $extr_marketName. They have been apprehended. Extraction by any means is now our mission objective, though religious considerations make use of the flagged navy in this operation... awkward. Our offer to you is $extr_reward credits for successful return of our agent."

"The Pathers will be expecting you, but we have intel on their defenses," the $manOrWoman places a datapad on the table.

You quickly review the contents and estimate that around $extr_marines marines are needed to execute the operation.
texts.zh:
这个$manOrWoman坐在角落的暗处，桌上没摆酒。虽然打扮和普通的技官差不多，但从话语间能听出$heOrShe才是这儿负责发号施令的人，就不知道是以前还是最近才上任的。

"$playerName 舰长。" $HeOrShe说，"我方的一名顶级特工渗透了在 $extr_marketName 的激进的卢德教派。他已经被发现并且被监禁了。当前的任务目标是以任何可行手段将其撤离 $extr_marketName，但如果我们打着海军的旗号去的话会造成宗教文化上的...不便。对此，我们提供 $extr_reward 星币，作为我方特工安全返回的奖励。"

"左径可能预料到你的到来。但我们有他们防线的情报。" $manOrWoman把一个数据信息板放在桌上供你检查。

你快速审了一遍内容并预计你需要大约 $extr_marines 陆战队员来执行这项任务。

texts.en:
You feel a twitch through the agrav plates as the assault shuttle docks. You nod your approval to the medic and marines escorting the rescued agent - they return a salute. The agent is too dazed to recognize you as their savior.

No matter.
texts.zh:
当突击穿梭机在码头上停靠时，你感受到了着陆的震动。你向护送获救特工的军医和陆战队员致意，他们向你敬礼，获救的特工因为意识过于模糊，没有认出你就是他们的救星。

无所谓了。

texts.en:
The extracted agent, bloodied but alive, is escorted to secure quarters by a medic and two guards.

Curses and impotent oaths of vengeance come in over the comms. You nod to your comms officer, who terminates the open channel.
texts.zh:
被解救的特工浑身是血，但还活着，他被一名医护人员和两名警卫护送到了安全的地方。

通讯频道中传来咒骂与无力的复仇誓言。你向你的通讯军官点头，接着对方关闭了公用频道。

texts.en:
The extracted agent, exhausted, alive, and in need of a long shower is escorted to secure quarters by a medic and two guards.

Curses and impotent oaths of vengeance come in over the comms. You nod to your comms officer, who terminates the open channel.
texts.zh:
被解救出来的特工筋疲力尽，虽然还活着，但看起来需要好好地休整一阵子了，他被一名医护人员和两名警卫护送到了安全的地方。

通讯频道中传来咒骂与无力的复仇誓言。你向你的通讯军官点头，接着对方关闭了公用频道。

texts.en:
You order the cargo of $smug_commodityName dropped off at an abandoned spacedock, far from prying eyes. Your flagship soon receives acknowledgement of the delivery from a disposable commsat.
OR
A converted surface-to-orbit passenger transport pulls alongside your $shipOrFleet's orbit after you give the planned signal. The cargo of $smug_commodityName is quickly transferred by robot drones running without nav transponders, then the transport pulls away.
texts.zh:
你下令将那批 $smug_commodityName 的货箱卸在一座废弃的太空船坞，确保无人察觉。你的旗舰很快就收到了来自一次性通讯基站的确认。
OR
在你发出事先说好的信号后，一辆改装过的地对轨客运货船很快与你$shipOrFleet的轨道进行了同步。在装着 $smug_commodityName 的货箱由没有导航应答器的无人机迅速转移完毕后，那艘运输载具便快速离开了。

texts.en: Making the $smug_commodityName delivery requires coming in with your transponder turned off, and without attracting the attention of patrols.
texts.zh: 运送 $smug_commodityName 时{需要关闭应答器}，并且{避开巡逻队的注意}。

texts.en: You do not have enough $smug_commodityName to complete the delivery.
texts.zh: 你没有足够的 $smug_commodityName 来完成交付。

texts.en:
"I need some $smug_commodityName moved to $smug_marketName. Discreetly."
OR
"I need to move some $smug_commodityName to $smug_marketName- without the involvement of the authorities."
texts.zh:
"我需要将 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName。必须谨慎行事。"
OR
"我需要在不惊扰当局的情况下，将 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName。"

options.en: Ask about the discreet smuggling operation
options.zh: 打探关于秘密走私行动的消息

texts.en: "I need $smug_quantity units of $smug_commodityName moved to $smug_marketName, which is $smug_dist light-years away. Your discretion is key; the local authorities cannot know about the shipment. You'll be paid $smug_reward credits on delivery."
texts.zh: "我需要将 $smug_quantity 单位的 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName，离这儿 $smug_dist 光年外。务必保密；不能让当局知道货物的事。送完后你就能收到 $smug_reward 星币。"

texts.en: At the bar a shady $smug_manOrWoman bothers disinterested starship captains with an off-brand datapad.
texts.zh: 酒吧里，一个可疑的$smug_manOrWoman正拿着一部杂牌数据平板烦扰着那些兴致寥寥的星舰舰长。

options.en: Find out what the shady $smug_manOrWoman with the off-brand datapad is bothering people about
options.zh: 看看那个带着杂牌数据平板的可疑$smug_manOrWoman在为了什么而问东问西

texts.en:
As you approach, the $smug_manOrWoman leaves $hisOrHer current prospect mid-pitch, shifting $hisOrHer attention to you.

"You there, captain. Yes, you know an honest face when you see one!" $HeOrShe gives a crooked smile, "Just look here," $heOrShe shoves the flickering display of the datapad into your hands: a cargo manifest consisting mostly of low-grade construction materials stored in a warehouse in a completely different system.

$HeOrShe leans in, and speaks quietly, motioning as if explaining the datapad's contents, "You help me move $smug_quantity units of $smug_commodityName to $smug_marketName, a quick hop of $smug_dist light-years. Then I pay you $smug_reward credits. No need to involve the authorities, no inspections, no tariffs. Easy money, right?"
texts.zh:
当你走近时，那个$smug_manOrWoman暂时停止了和他人的攀谈，把$hisOrHer的注意力转移到了你身上。

"那边那位，舰长。果然，诚实的人一眼就能看出来！" $HeOrShe歪嘴笑了笑，"你看看这个。" $heOrShe把闪烁的数据平板递到了你的手中：上面显示的货物清单记录着存储在另一个星系的仓库里的低档建筑材料。

$HeOrShe靠了过来，轻声解释着数据平板上的内容，"你帮我把 $smug_quantity 单位的 $smug_commodityName 运送到 $smug_marketName，仅在 $smug_dist 光年外，很近。然后我会付你 $smug_reward 星币。不用惊动当局，没有检查，没有关税。很容易到手的一笔钱，对吧？"

texts.en: "STRATCOM needs an irregular force to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName; I thought you might make a good candidate to run this op."
texts.zh: "STRATCOM 需要一支非常规部队对 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸，我认为你应该是干这事的合适人选。"

options.en: Ask about the tactical bombardment mission
options.zh: 询问战术轰炸任务的细节

texts.en:
"I've been ordered to contract an irregular fleet to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName, $tabo_dist light-years away. I've seen your work captain, and I believe you could perform this mission admirably," $heOrShe says, "And we've allocated $tabo_reward credits to cover your expenses."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer datapad and a shared intel briefing appears in your display. You briefly review maps and intel together and come to estimate that you would need around $tabo_fuel fuel to carry out the bombardment according to mission parameters.

$rank $personLastName swipes away the last of the tactical breakdowns and looks to you, "So, what do you say?"
texts.zh:
"我奉命雇佣一支非正规舰队，对 $tabo_dist 光年外的 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸。我们知道你以前的工作都完成得很出色，也因此相信你能出色地完成这项任务。" $heOrShe说道，"我们还拨出了 $tabo_reward 星币来作为你的酬劳。"

$HeOrShe敲击着自己的数据平板，共享的情报信息随即出现在了你的显示器上。你简要地浏览着情报，根据任务参数，你估计自己需要大约 $tabo_fuel 燃料来执行轰炸任务。

$personLastName $rank 划掉最后一部分战术分析，随后看向你，"那么，你的决定是？"

texts.en: A high-ranking officer in crisp uniform meets your eyes from a private booth. Their adjutant approaches you, "My superior would consult with you on a matter of some discretion. $PlayerSirOrMadam. At your leisure."
texts.zh: 一位身着笔挺制服的高级官员从私人隔间和你对上了目光。对方的副官走向了你，"我的上司想和您商讨一件需要谨慎保密的事情，$PlayerSirOrMadam。静候您方便的时候。"

options.en: Join the crisply uniformed officer who wishes to 'consult' with you
options.zh: 过去看看那个身着笔挺制服的高级官员想和你 "商讨" 什么

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says with a cool nod as you approach. "Your reputation precedes you."

$HeOrShe sips something transparent from a small crystal glass then taps $hisOrHer datapad; a privacy field blurs and muffles the surroundings.

"I require a well-led but irregular force willing to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName, $tabo_dist light-years away. If this operation were performed to mission parameters, $tabo_reward credits could be routed to your account."

Glass in one hand, the $faction $rank taps $hisOrHer datapad again and slides it toward you. The display shows garrison numbers, defense parameters, and detailed intelligence. You politely survey the report and estimate that you'd need around $tabo_fuel fuel to carry out the proposed bombardment. The $rank is watching you, and as you look up raises an eyebrow. "Are you in?"
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，" 在你走近时，$heOrShe严肃地点了点头，"你可是名声在外。"

$HeOrShe抿了一口水晶杯里的无色液体，随后点了几下$hisOrHer的数据平板，隐私场隔绝了声音，领域外的景象也变得模糊了起来。

"我需要一支精锐但不在编制内的舰队，以对 $tabo_dist 光年外的 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸。如果你能按照相关指示执行任务，$tabo_reward 星币将会汇到你的账户内。"

一只手拿着杯子，$faction $rank 又操作了几下数据平板，然后将它滑向了你。屏幕上显示着驻军人数，布防状况之类的详细情报。在礼貌地浏览了报告后，你估计自己需要大约 $tabo_fuel 燃料来进行轰炸。$rank 注视着你，当你抬头时，对方扬起眉毛。"接这任务吗？"

texts.en:
"Fleet intel has requested discreet deployment of an observation package to $ssat_marketName orbit. You could fulfill the mission parameters."
OR
"Strategic observation assets are imperative; we need a small observation package deployed directly to $ssat_marketName orbit."
texts.zh:
"舰队情报部申请向 $ssat_marketName 轨道秘密部署一个观测设备。你应该能满足任务的要求。"
OR
"战略观测非常重要。我们需要将一个小型观测设备直接部署在 $ssat_marketName 的轨道上。"

texts.en:
"I would like a small satellite deployed to orbit around $ssat_marketName. Just to keep an eye on things."
OR
"I am in need of watchful eyes on $ssat_marketName - deploying a small spy satellite should be sufficient."
texts.zh:
"我需要在 $ssat_marketName 轨道上部署一颗小型卫星，用于观察。"
OR
"我需要密切关注 $ssat_marketName —— 只需要部署一颗小型间谍卫星。"

options.en: Ask about deploying the observation package
options.zh: 询问关于部署观察包的事宜
询问关于部署间谍卫星的事宜

texts.en:
"The mission: enter a standard orbit of $ssat_marketName in the $ssat_systemName. Then deploy the spy satellite package while unobserved. I repeat, it is critical that no patrols be tracking your fleet at this stage. Once deployed, the spysat has stealth capabilities which make detection unlikely."

"Simple. Your reward for mission completion would be $ssat_reward credits. Of course my organization could not risk carrying out this mission with flagged vessels. That is why we have come to you. Do you accept?"
texts.zh:
"任务内容：进入 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName 的标准轨道。确保不被发现的情况下部署间谍卫星。再重复一遍，这个阶段要确保没有巡逻队在追踪你。一旦部署完成，间谍卫星可以隐形，其他人不太可能检测到它。"

"这是一项非常简单的任务。任务完成之后你将会收到 $ssat_reward 作为任务奖励。当然我们不能冒险用悬挂着我们旗帜的舰船来执行这项任务 —— 这也是我们找你的原因。你接受这个任务吗？"

texts.en:
"Like I said, I need eyes on $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. I'd do it myself, but it'd be inconvenient to be caught there, even in orbit. Got a bit of a record."

$personName smiles like a predator, a little too proud. Probably best not to inquire.

"I'll provide the spysat package. Make sure no patrols are on your tail when you deploy it in orbit. Easy as robbing a Luddie pilgrimage. Pay is $ssat_reward credits. You in?"
texts.zh:
"如我所说，我需要监视 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName。虽然我很想亲自动手，但我有案底，所以如果在轨道上被逮了个现形的话，那就麻烦了。

$personName 忽然露出了捕食者一样自豪的微笑。"至于什么案底，最好别问。"

"我会提供间谍卫星的，而你得确保不被巡逻队跟踪的情况下把它部署到轨道上。就跟抢个卢德朝圣者一样简单，不是吗？报酬是 $ssat_reward 星币。怎么样？"

texts.en: From a shadowy booth a conspicuously nondescript $ssat_manOrWoman sitting with perfect posture catches your eye and gives what might be a small nod.
texts.zh: 在一个阴影笼罩的隔间里，一个不起眼的$ssat_manOrWoman以一种完美的坐姿成功地吸引了你的眼球。目光对上的一瞬间，$ssat_manOrWoman朝你微微点头。

texts.en: From a shadowy booth a conspicuously nondescript $ssat_manOrWoman nursing a drink in a booth catches your eye and gives what might be a small nod.
texts.zh: 在一个阴影笼罩的隔间里，一个不起眼的、正小口啜饮着杯中的酒的$ssat_manOrWoman成功地吸引了你的眼球。目光对上的一瞬间，$ssat_manOrWoman朝你微微点头。

options.en: Walk over to the shadowy booth to join the $ssat_manOrWoman with perfect posture
options.zh: 走过去，用同样完美的姿势坐在$ssat_manOrWoman身边

options.en: Join the nondescript $ssat_manOrWoman in the shadowy booth
options.zh: 坐到那个不起眼的$ssat_manOrWoman身边

texts.en:
Although without insignia or uniform you instantly tag the $manOrWoman as military. It's the boots. They can never give up the mil-spec boots.

"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says, "You are known to my organization as a capable and discreet operative. I am authorized to propose a simple mission for you to carry out. Payment would consist of $ssat_reward credits upon completion."
texts.zh:
尽管并没佩戴徽章或身着制服，你还是立即给这个$manOrWoman打上了军人的标签。是靴子，这些人永远都脱不下军靴。

"啊，$playerName舰长。" $heOrShe说，"我的组织知道你为政府做事的时候精干且谨慎。上面授权我提议给你一个简单的任务。完成后将会有 $ssat_reward 星币的报酬。

texts.en:
Despite the anonymous work-suit, you note the fine tracery of unnatural scars and insolent swagger that suggest this $manOrWoman is connected to organized crime.

$HeOrShe flicks some ash from a smoldering stim-stick onto the table, then offers a seat with the same hand, the smoke tracing an arc in the air.

"I need eyes on $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. Word is you're quiet and can get jobs done." A drag from the stim-stick. "I can't afford being caught there, even in orbit. Got a bit of a record." You see a smile by the glint off $hisOrHer teeth.

"I'll provide the spysat package. Make sure no patrols are on your tail when you deploy it in orbit. Easy as robbing a Luddie pilgrim, yeah? Pay is $ssat_reward credits. You in?"
texts.zh:
虽然只是穿着没什么个性的业务西装，但你留意到了这个$manOrWoman身上用精美的彩色纹身都掩盖不住的严重伤疤，和$heOrShe傲慢无礼的态度。这应该是个和犯罪团伙有些关系的家伙。

$HeOrShe把提神烟的烟灰弹到了桌面上，用夹着烟的手对你做了个请坐的手势，任由烟雾在空中画了条弧线。

"我需要监视 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName。有消息说你废话不多做事利索。" $heOrShe飞了一口提神烟，"我可不能在轨道那块儿被抓。毕竟之前在那儿留了点案底。"你看到金牙闪耀，才注意到$hisOrHer应该是笑了一下。

"放心，我会提供间谍卫星的。你只要负责把卫星弄到轨道上就好，记得别让巡逻队跟着你。这就跟抢个卢德朝圣者一样简单，不是吗？一笔就能赚 $ssat_reward 星币。搞不？"

texts.en:
"As for the operation," $heOrShe continues, as if briefing a cadet, "Enter a standard orbit of $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. Then deploy the spy satellite package; it is critical that no patrols be tracking your fleet at this stage. Once deployed, the spysat has stealth capabilities which make detection unlikely."

"Simple. Of course my organization could not risk carrying out this mission with flagged vessels. That is why we have come to you. Do you accept?"
texts.zh:
"关于行动内容..." $heOrShe如同跟新入伍的学员一样介绍情况，"进入 $ssat_systemName $ssat_marketName 行星的标准轨道。然后部署这颗间谍卫星；这个阶段确保没有巡逻队在追踪你。一旦部署完成，间谍卫星可以隐形，其他人不太可能检测到它。"

"这是一项非常简单的任务。当然我们不能冒险用悬挂着我们旗帜的舰船来执行这项任务 —— 这也是你为什么在这里的原因。你接受这个任务吗？"

texts.en: "Some new targets have come up on the docket," $heOrShe says with a sigh. "If you took a contract to handle one of these bounties, it might just get the brass off my case."
texts.zh: "赏金清单上又有了一些新目标。" $heOrShe叹了口气，"如果你能从里边挑一份，我负责处理的事可能会少些麻烦。"

texts.en: "New targets have come up from intel," $heOrShe says. "I would like them handled with more initiative and discretion than my subordinates are accustomed to."
texts.zh: "情报那边报上来几个新目标，\" $heOrShe说道。\"我希望办得比我那些手下惯常的更主动、也更不着痕迹。"

texts.en: "Some new targets have come up on the docket," $heOrShe says with a sigh. "If you took a contract to handle one of these bounties, it might just get a senior VP off my case."
texts.zh: "单子上新挂了几个目标，\" $heOrShe叹了口气。\"你要是接下一桩赏金合同去办了，说不定能让某位高级副总裁别再盯着我。"

texts.en: "New targets have come up from intel" $heOrShe says. "I would like them handled with more initiative and discretion than my subordinates are accustomed to."
texts.zh: "情报那边报上来几个新目标，\" $heOrShe说道。\"我希望办得比我那些手下惯常的更主动、也更不着痕迹。"

options.en: Ask about what's available on the bounty docket
options.zh: 问问赏金清单里有什么

texts.en:
"We've got a few options here," $personLastName says, pulling up a shared display with a table of intel reports.

"We've got an op timeslot coming up for an HK squadron that'll handle whatever you don't, so it's really your pick of the bunch. What sort of job do you think you can handle?"
texts.zh:
"这里有几个目标。" $personLastName $post 推送过来一个共享显示界面，上边显示着一系列的情报。

"我们有个猎杀小队也马上就要出动了。它们会处理掉你不接的单子，所以你可以随便挑。你认为你能胜任什么样的工作？"

texts.en:
"We have several options," $personLastName says, pulling up a shared display with a table of intel reports.

"An operation timeslot for a realiable HK squadron, another merc, is coming up and they'll handle whatever you don't. You may pick any target you consider appropriate."
texts.zh:
"咱们有几个选择，" $personLastName说着，调出一幅共享显示屏，上面列着一张情报报告表。

"另有一支靠得住的 HK 中队，也是雇来的，行动窗口就要开了，你没接的那些都归他们收拾。目标随你挑，看着哪个合适就定哪个。"

options.en: I'd prefer a more manageable target.
options.zh: 我想要个更容易拿捏的目标。

options.en: Whatever you've got works for me.
options.zh: 随便什么你觉得适合我的都行。

options.en: I can handle a more challenging target.
options.zh: 我觉得可以来个更难搞的目标。

options.en: Ask about one of the other targets
Ask about one of the other targets
I'd prefer a more manageable target.
options.zh: 我想要个更容易拿捏的目标。

options.en: Whatever you've got works for me.
options.zh: 随便什么你觉得适合我的都行。

options.en: I can handle a more challenging target.
options.zh: 我觉得可以来个更难搞的目标。

texts.en: A military officer is holding court at one of the nicer tables; you watch a merc captain approach for a perfunctory exchange of words and mutual tap of datapads. They appear to be acting as some kind of system patrol liaison contracting out bounties.
texts.zh: 一位军官正在一张看起来不错的桌子上接待着来者。你看到一个雇佣舰长走了过去，双方简单地说了几句话，还敲了敲数据平板。对方似乎是某种星系巡逻队的联络人，负责将赏金任务外包出去。

options.en: Talk to the $mcb_manOrWoman from the military offering bounties
options.zh: 和负责军方悬赏任务的$mcb_manOrWoman谈谈

texts.en:
You approach and $Rank $personLastName gives you a perfunctory nod. "Captain," $heOrShe says, all business.

"I have several assignments on the docket," $heOrShe looks down, scrolling $hisOrHer datapad. A coffee, black, certainly no sugar, is cooling on the table beside $hisOrHer hand. "What sort of job can you handle?"
texts.zh:
你走过去，$personLastName $rank 敷衍地点了点头。"舰长。" $heOrShe带着公事公办的语气说。

"这里有几项任务要处理。" $heOrShe低下头，用手在$hisOrHer的数据平板上划动着。一杯肯定没加糖的黑咖啡正放在$hisOrHer手边的桌子上晾着，"你能胜任怎么样的工作？"

texts.en: "I've got a list of targets that need killing," $personName says nonchalantly. "You could earn yourself some good credits with one of these jobs."
texts.zh: "我有一张清单，上边都是需要被处理掉的人，" $personName 若无其事地说着。" 你可以在这些工作中赚到不少星币。"

options.en: Ask about taking on one of the bounty jobs

texts.en: "Would you like to get your hands dirty?" $HeOrShe bares $hisOrHer teeth in an expression that's too bloodthirsty to be called a smile. "I've got a few jobs here that might fit your talents."
texts.zh: "你不介意把手弄脏吗？" $HeOrShe露出了$hisOrHer的牙齿，那样的表情说是微笑来也太过血腥了，"我这儿有几份工作可能适合你的才能。"

options.en: I'd prefer a more manageable target.
options.zh: 我比较倾向于更容易拿捏的目标。

options.en: Whatever you've got works for me.
I can handle a more challenging target.
options.zh: 我可以处理更难搞定的目标。

Ask about one of the other targets
I'd prefer a more manageable target.
options.zh: 我比较倾向于更容易拿捏的目标。

options.en: Whatever you've got works for me.
I can handle a more challenging target.
options.zh: 我可以处理更难搞定的目标。

texts.en: A $ucb_manOrWoman occupies a booth on the back wall, a pair of goons hidden in shadow but for the glow of their augmented eyes. You watch an obvious merc-slash-pirate approach for an exchange of words and tap of datapads. Farming out underworld hits?
texts.zh: 有个$ucb_manOrWoman包了个靠后墙的包厢。跟着的两个打手藏在暗处，只能看清他们的生化眼里有微光在闪烁。从他们相互交谈和敲击数据平板的方式中，你看得出这些人明显是佣兵或者海盗。这似乎是个提供脏活的地方？

options.en: Approach the $ucb_manOrWoman contracting out underworld bounties
options.zh: 走向正在商谈黑道赏金的$ucb_manOrWoman。

texts.en:
As you approach, $heOrShe inspects you with professional detachment, subtle cybernetics flickering on the edge of IR. "An operator, are you? Like getting your hands dirty?"

$HeOrShe doesn't smile. The expression is closer to a predator baring its teeth.

"I might be able to arrange a job which matches your... talents," $heOrShe says, implants flickering in $hisOrHer eyes.
texts.zh:
当你走近时，$heOrShe以专业的目光审视着你，精密植入体闪烁着接近红外线的微光。"你是特工吗？喜欢干脏活的那种？"

$HeOrShe与其说是笑容绽放，不如说是猛兽在龇牙咧嘴。

"我也许能安排一份工作...适合你的才能的工作。" $heOrShe说，同时眼窝里的植入物不断闪烁着。

texts.en: "I built a foolproof plan to steal a military ship from a hangar in local orbit. The buyer fell through, so I could sell you the info you'd need to pull the job off yourself."
texts.zh: "我制定了份万无一失的计划，可以从当地轨道的仓库中偷走一艘军用舰船。但先前谈好的买家放弃了交易。因此我可以把这些信息转卖给你，让你自己完成这项计划。"

options.en: Ask about the plan to steal a military ship
options.zh: 询问关于偷取军用舰船的计划

texts.en:
"This $hijack_hull $hijack_designation is just collecting space-dust in a lightly guarded orbital hangar. Probably some kind of requisitions mixup. I've got a schematic of the hangar, the security codes, the guards' schedule, and I'll even come along on the operation so you know it's on the up-and-up."

"My price is $hijack_price credits, non-negotiable. And you'll need to provide at least $hijack_marines marines for the plan to work. I don't expect much active resistance, but all of the guards will need to be covered to ensure that no one gets any ideas. What do you think?"
texts.zh:
"有一艘 $hijack_hull $hijack_designation 在一个没什么守卫的轨道船坞里吃灰。可能是什么征用单据搞错了之类的原因吧。所有的资料我都有，机库的结构图、安全码、警卫轮值表之类。我甚至会亲自参加行动，省得你觉得我在耍花样。"

"我的开价是 $hijack_price 星币，没有商量的余地。你要准备至少 $hijack_marines 名陆战队员来搞定这个计划。我觉得不会有什么像样的抵抗，但所有守卫都必须被控制住，免得被某些想逞英雄的人搞出乱子。你怎么想？"

options.en: Ask for detailed info on the military vessel

texts.en: $personName taps a few buttons to pull up a shared holodisplay of the ship schematics. "Have a look," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh: $personName 点了几下手中的电子设备，将目标舰船的相关数据分享给你。"看看吧。" $heOrShe说。

texts.en: You don't have sufficient marines to carry out this operation.
texts.zh: 你没有足够的陆战队员来执行这次任务。

texts.en:
It is simple enough to sneak two teams into the orbital hangar on shuttles disguised as civilian logistics drones. An unlucky micrometeorite impact ensures that the rudimentary comms module is out of commission, then an input error by 'someone' with full security access resets the hangar power systems, disabling internal sensors and the centuries-outdated door locks.

Your team of hand-picked marines catches the guards completely by surprise.
texts.zh:
让两支队伍乘坐伪装成民用后勤无人机的穿梭机溜进轨道船坞非常简单。一颗出现得很不是时候的小陨石的撞击导致船坞里的基础通讯系统失灵了，然后一位拥有完整安全权限的 "某人" 的失误重置了机库的电力系统，使内部传感器和过时了几个世纪的门锁失去了作用。

你精心挑选的陆战队员们打了警卫一个措手不及。

texts.en: You watch on the holofeed as $personName grins through $hisOrHer faceplate and pulls the manual docking release $himOrHerself. Your new ship floats free from the hangar clamps, its new skeleton crew stowing sidearms and taking bridge consoles as main power comes online.
texts.zh: 你在全息影像上看到 $personName 正透过$hisOrHer的面罩咧嘴笑着，同时拉动了手动的停靠闸。你的新船从机库夹具中挣脱了出来，它全副武装的新船员们在主能源系统上线后开始操作舰桥控制台。

texts.en:
You return to the bar and share a glass of that noxious spirit that $personName is so fond of to celebrate.

"That was fun, captain! I'd steal another ship with you any day you like," $heOrShe says loud enough for everyone nearby to hear, though they're wise enough to pretend they didn't.
texts.zh:
你回到酒吧，与 $personName 畅饮着对方喜欢那种的烈酒以进行庆祝。

"真有趣，舰长！只要你愿意，我随时都可以和你一起再偷一艘船。" $heOrShe的声音大得周围的人都能听见，但他们还是识趣地装出没听见的样子。

texts.en:
After the newly-liberated ship joins your fleet, you review the after-action report with $personName.

"All according to plan." $HeOrShe smiles like an old pirate, "We'll have to do this again someday."
texts.zh:
在新船加入你的舰队后，你和 $personName 一起看着行动报告。

"一切按计划进行。" $HeOrShe笑得像个老海盗，"总有一天我们会再一起干一票的。"

texts.en: You have your purser make arrangements, with instructions to keep the pilgrims from interfering in $shipOrFleet operations.
texts.zh: 你让你的事务长去安排了，同时也指示他别让朝圣者打扰$shipOrFleet的运行。

texts.en: You have your purser make arrangements, with instructions to keep the pilgrims from interfering in $shipOrFleet operations.
texts.zh: 你让你的事务长去安排了，同时也指示他别让朝圣者打扰$shipOrFleet的运行。

texts.en: A tough-looking $hijack_manOrWoman in a powered armor undersuit downs acrid liquor, intimidating anyone who comes too close with a feral stare.
texts.zh: 一个身着动力盔甲内衬，长相彪悍的$hijack_manOrWoman正喝着刺鼻的酒，一边用凶狠的眼神恐吓任何试图靠近的人。

options.en: Chat with the tough-looking $hijack_manOrWoman wearing the powered armor undersuit
options.zh: 和穿着动力装甲内衬长相彪悍的$hijack_manOrWoman谈谈

texts.en:
You approach, maintaining your cool despite the withering stare. The $hijack_manOrWoman laughs at your composure and welcomes you to sit with a gust of eye-watering liquor fumes. "I like you," $heOrShe exclaims to the entire bar, which ignores the shout, "You're not a scared little dirtworm!"

Your new best friend is full of boasts and brags, and you're surprised to discover that $heOrShe is sharper than $heOrShe looks as $heOrShe slips pointed questions about your background and capabilities into $hisOrHer braggadocio.

Adopting a lower voice, but keeping $hisOrHer eyes scanning the room, $heOrShe says, "I'll level, captain. You can handle your flux, I respect that. I'm wondering if you want to get in on a job with me." $HeOrShe smiles, showing off a full set of titanium teeth. "Wanna know more?"
texts.zh:
你走了过去，冷静地面对着对方那令人生畏的目光。那个$hijack_manOrWoman对你的冷静报以大笑，带着一股呛眼睛的酒味邀请你坐在$heOrShe身边。"我喜欢你，" $heOrShe对着全酒吧大喊，但被无视了，"你不是个孬种！"

你这位新交的好朋友一直在满嘴跑火车，但你惊讶地发现$heOrShe实际上比$heOrShe看上去的样子要聪明得多，因为$heOrShe在吹牛的时候旁敲侧击地刺探了你的背景和能力。

$heOrShe放轻了嗓门，但始终用双眼警戒着四周："我坦率地说吧，舰长。你进退有度，这我很欣赏。不知道你想不想和我一起干一票。" $HeOrShe咧开嘴微笑，露出了满嘴的钛合金牙。"要细说吗？"

texts.en:
"There's a $hijack_hull $hijack_designation collecting space dust in a lightly guarded orbital hangar. I made a plan to jack the ship. My original sponsor got cold feet. Dirtworm, like I said. It'd be a waste not to do the job after all that work, yeah? I just don't got any use for a starship."

"I've got schematics of the hangar, the security codes, the guards' schedule, everything. I'll even come along on the operation so you know it's on the up-and-up."

"My price is $hijack_price credits, non-negotiable. And you'll need to provide at least $hijack_marines marines for this to work cleanly. I don't expect active resistance, but all the guards gotta be covered to ensure no one tries to be a hero. You in?"
texts.zh:
"在一个守卫薄弱的轨道船坞里，有一艘 $hijack_hull $hijack_designation 正在吃灰。我制定了一个偷船的计划，但最初的合伙人临阵退缩了。就像我之前说的，胆小鬼。做了这么多准备，不去干就太浪费了，对吧？但一艘星舰对我没有任何用处。"

"机库的结构图、安全码、警卫轮值表，应有尽有。我甚至会亲自参加行动，这样你或许能放心一些。"

"我的开价是 $hijack_price 星币，没有商量的余地。你将需要准备至少 $hijack_marines 名陆战队员来让这任务顺利执行。我觉得不会有什么像样的抵抗，但所有守卫都必须被控制住，免得被某些想逞英雄的人搞出乱子。你干不干？"

options.en: Ask for detailed info on the target vessel

texts.en: The $hijack_manOrWoman taps a few buttons on $hijack_hisOrHer battered TriPad so you can see the schematics. "A real burner, aye?"
texts.zh: 这个$hijack_manOrWoman在$hijack_hisOrHer的破旧 TriPad 上点了几下，目标舰船的相关数据就出现在了上面。"是个炙手可热的家伙，不是吗？"

texts.en: You don't have sufficient marines to carry out this operation.
texts.zh: 你没有足够的陆战队员来执行这次任务。

texts.en: "I would like to discuss the unnecessary incarceration of a certain individual and what might be done to resolve the situation."
texts.zh: "我想讨论对某个人的非必要监禁，以及可能采取什么措施来解决这个问题。"

options.zh: 询问具体要怎么解决 "监禁" 问题

texts.en:
"I would simply like you to extract the subject from confinement on $jabr_marketOnOrAt $jabr_marketName, located $jabr_dist light-years away. Doing it quietly would be preferable, but sometimes these matters escape our control. Try not to offend the $jabr_marketFaction too much; it would draw unwanted attention. Once you liberate the subject, you will receive $jabr_reward credits to your accounts."

"I suspect that they're expecting a break attempt, so I acquired this." $HeOrShe taps at a TriPad and your corresponding system receives detailed reports on the troop deployments and infiltration defenses of $jabr_marketName. A quick review suggests that you'd need around $jabr_marines marines to carry off the operation.
texts.zh:
"任务是从 $jabr_dist 光年外的 $jabr_marketName 上解救目标。最好能不留痕迹，但这种情况有时我们也没法掌控。尽量不要太得罪了 $jabr_marketFaction}，否则就可能引起不必要的关注。任务目标获释后，{$jabr_reward 星币会被打进你的账户。"

"我怀疑他们正在为应对突袭做准备，所以我想办法搞到了这个。" $HeOrShe按了按 TriPad，你的数据平板上收到了驻军部署以及反渗透措施的详细报告。快速浏览之后你觉得需要 $jabr_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这次任务。

texts.en: From a shadowy corner, a $jabr_manOrWoman smoking a burning narcotic stick catches your eye.
texts.zh: 在一个阴暗的角落里，一个抽着大烟的$jabr_manOrWoman引起了你的注意。

options.en: Approach the $jabr_manOrWoman smoking in the dark corner

texts.en:
The $jabr_manOrWoman looks you over as you approach. After a moment, $jabr_heOrShe seems satisfied and slides a cheap datapad across the table. It displays a personnel file and the schematics of a secure facility.

In a quiet voice $jabr_heOrShe explains, "I need an extract of the subject from, ah, unjust confinement $jabr_marketOnOrAt $jabr_marketName, $jabr_dist light-years away. My benefactor offers a payment of $jabr_reward credits to secure the subject's liberation." The $jabr_manOrWoman awaits your reply, eyes visible only as two constellations of reflected light.

You skim the schematics; they're thorough. You estimate that around $jabr_marines marines would be required to carry off this operation. Assaulting $jabr_marketFactionArticle $jabr_marketFaction prison could also have an impact on your reputation; measures can be taken to reduce identifiability, but they can't completely avert official suspicion.
texts.zh:
当你走近时，这个$jabr_manOrWoman一言不发地打量着你。片刻之后，$jabr_heOrShe似乎觉得你够格了，便把一个廉价的数据平板从桌子那边滑了过来。上面显示着一份个人资料和一个安全设施的结构图。

$jabr_heOrShe轻声解释道："我需要一次解救行动，任务对象正被...呃...非法监禁在 $jabr_dist 光年之外的 $jabr_marketName。我的赞助人可以为此提供 $jabr_reward 星币。" $jabr_manOrWoman等待你的答复，双眼反射出依稀可见的光芒，犹如星宿。

你扫视了资料，他们调查得很彻底。你估计大约需要 $jabr_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这次任务。袭击 $jabr_marketFactionArticle $jabr_marketFaction 的监狱设施可能会对你的声望造成影响。你可以采取一些措施来避免暴露身份，但这些手段无法完全摆脱官方的怀疑。

texts.en: "I need a package delivered. The destination must be kept a secret. Simple."
texts.zh: "我需要递送一个包裹，目的地必须保密。很简单的任务。"

options.en: Ask about the secret package delivery
options.zh: 询问秘密运输任务的细节

texts.en:
$PersonName looks you over silently for a moment, then nods, seemingly satisfied.

"I don't want any questions, it's a simple task. Deliver this item to the specified location in $ddro_systemName, $ddro_dist light-years away. Don't be seen making the drop, and don't tell anyone about it. The reward is $ddro_reward credits." $HeOrShe taps at $hisOrHer datapad and your display is overlaid with $ddro_aOrAnThing.

"That is all there is to it. Do you accept my terms?"
texts.zh:
$PersonName 沉默着看了你一会儿，然后点了点头，似乎很满意。

"别问我任何问题，这个任务已经很简单了。把这玩意儿递送到 $ddro_dist 光年外 $ddro_systemName 的指定位置。交货的时候别让人看见，也别走漏风声。奖励是 $ddro_reward 星币。" $HeOrShe按了按数据平板，你的显示器上显示出了那 $ddro_aOrAnThing 的信息。

"就是这么回事，你接受这些条件吗？"

texts.en: At the end of the bar, a rakish $ddro_manOrWoman is met by a variety of low-life characters who scurry away again almost immediately. Giving orders, perhaps.
texts.zh: 在吧台的尽头，不少看起来生活水平不高的人在和一个潇洒的$ddro_manOrWoman碰头后几乎立刻就跑开了。对方似乎在发号施令。

options.en: Find out what the rakish $ddro_manOrWoman at the end of the bar is up to
options.zh: 看看吧台尽头的那个潇洒的$ddro_manOrWoman在做什么

texts.en:
The $ddro_manOrWoman watches your approach. "You want in on the business, that right?" $heOrShe says, amused at your audacity.

"Let me give you a job so easy that any rad-addled spacer could manage it. But," $heOrShe shrugs regretfully, "It's a real shame how many of 'em just can't follow instructions and end up getting tossed out an airlock." $HeOrShe laughs like this is a good joke.

"Deliver the item to the specified location in $ddro_systemName, $ddro_dist light-years away." $HeOrShe flips a TriPad out of $hisOrHer coat. The display shows $ddro_aOrAnThing. "This is it. The reward is $ddro_reward credits. Don't be seen making the drop, and don't tell anyone about it."
texts.zh:
$ddro_manOrWoman注意到了你的接近。"你也想参与这桩生意，对吗？" $heOrShe刚说完，就被你的大胆给逗乐了。

"先来个简单的活吧，就算你脑袋被辐射烤焦了也能办到。不过..." $heOrShe遗憾地耸了耸肩，"很多人就是因为不能遵守指示，才落得个被丢出气闸的下场，想起来还挺可惜的。" $HeOrShe突然哈哈大笑，如同这是个很棒的笑话那般。

"将东西送到 $ddro_dist 光年外的 $ddro_systemName。" $HeOrShe麻利地从外套里翻出了一个 TriPad，而上面正显示着 $ddro_aOrAnThing。"就这玩意儿。报酬是 $ddro_reward 星币。记住交货的时候不要被人看见，更不要走漏风声。"

texts.en: "One of my informants has relayed to me the location of $sitm_aOrAnItem. I would share this information with you for a reasonable price."
texts.zh: "我的一个线人告诉了我 $sitm_aOrAnItem 的位置。我愿意在价格合适的前提下与你分享这个信息。"

texts.en: "One of my infiltrators has relayed to me the location of $sitm_aOrAnItem. I have no need of this in my current plans, so I have magnanimously decided to share this opportunity for a very reasonable price."
texts.zh: "我的一个线人告诉了我 $sitm_aOrAnItem 的位置。但目前我不需要它，所以我愿意在价格合适的情况下与你分享得到它的机会。"

options.en: Ask about the location of the $sitm_item

texts.en:
$HeOrShe considers something for a moment, then relents, "I should also warn you that this informant, they are not completely reliable. Don't take me wrong, I am confident in the validity of the information provided - it is more that they have a way of selling the same data to multiple interested parties. So if you accept, be prepared to deal with other treasure-hunters."

"So let's call it $sitm_price credits for the location data. Very reasonable. What do you say?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe思考了一会儿，然后冷冷地说，"有件事我得告诉你，这种线人，他们不是完全可靠的。不要误解我的意思，我对所提供的信息的有效性很有信心 —— 我想说的是他们可能会把相同的数据卖给多个利益相关方。所以如果你要接受，你得准备好和其他寻宝者打交道。"

"目标所在位置的价格是 $sitm_price，十分合理。你觉得呢？"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe considers something for a moment, then relents, "I do wish for you to continue being useful to me in the future, so I will give you a warning - heed it well. I have already sold this information to several other interested parties in order to maximize my profits. If you accept, be prepared to deal with these other treasure-seekers." $HeOrShe smiles in anticipation, "It will be far from the core worlds; you could burn their fleets from the sky, plunder their supplies, and none would be the wiser."

"$sitm_price credits for the location data. Very reasonable. Will you choose to participate in this most dangerous game?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe似乎在思考着什么，不一会后对方语气冰冷地开口了，"我希望我们之后能继续合作，所以我得给你个警告 —— 不要忽视它。为了将利益最大化，我已经把相同的数据卖给了多个利益相关方。所以如果你要接受，你得准备好和其他寻宝者打交道。" $HeOrShe露出了期待的微笑，"那地方离核心星区很远；你可以直接干掉他们的舰队，掠夺他们的补给，没人会知道。"

"$sitm_price 星币换位置信息，很合理。你要参加这个危险的游戏吗？"

texts.en: A flashily-dressed $manOrWoman wearing a partial salvor's rig festooned with shining trophies pushes past you and buys a round for the entire bar.
texts.zh: 一个衣着浮夸的$manOrWoman从你身边挤了过去，请了整个酒吧一轮酒。那家伙在自己没披挂整齐的拾荒套装上摆显着各种搜刮来的小玩意儿。

options.en: Thank the flashily-dressed $manOrWoman for the drink
options.zh: 感谢那个衣着浮夸的$manOrWoman请的酒

texts.en:
"I'm celebrating!" $HeOrShe leans close, "A new find." $HeOrShe lifts $hisOrHer drink and turns, grinning, "Drink, drink! To my good fortune!" Enthusiasm for this self-toast is only moderate, though a crew of spacers well into their off-shift shouts encouragement.

$HeOrShe downs the drink while the spacers hoot, then turns back to you. "You look like you know your way through a jump-point," $heOrShe says, lowering $hisOrHer voice once more. "I know the location of $sitm_aOrAnItem, and so could you for the price of $sitm_price credits. Just need to hop over with your $shipOrFleet and take it. I'd go myself, but I have too much love for civilization."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer empty drink, looking for the bartender. "Interested?" $heOrShe asks casually.
texts.zh:
"我在庆祝！" $HeOrShe靠了过来，"那是个新发现。" $HeOrShe举起自己的饮品，转过身笑嘻嘻地说，"继续喝吧，庆祝我的好运！"人们对这种自我祝酒的热情并不高，但依然有一群下班了的宇宙民大呼小叫着。

$HeOrShe在宇宙民们尖叫时喝下了饮料，然后看向你。"你看起来像是航行经验丰富的人。" $heOrShe又一次压低了$hisOrHer的声音，"我知道 $sitm_aOrAnItem 的位置，付我 $sitm_price 星币就告诉你。只要带着你的$shipOrFleet过去，你就能拿走它。我也想去，但我舍不得离开文明世界。"

$HeOrShe轻敲着$hisOrHer的空饮料杯，目光寻找着酒保。"感兴趣吗？" $heOrShe漫不经心地问道。

texts.en: You pay, and the $manOrWoman makes some excuse to leave. As you examine the coordinates, the bartender arrives with the second drink, and sighs. "Word of advice friend, this isn't the first time $heOrShe has pulled that display. I reckon you're not the only one with a treasure map."
texts.zh: 你付了钱后，那个$manOrWoman就找借口离开了。当你查看对方提供的目标所在位置时，酒保端着第二杯酒过来了，还叹了口气。"提醒你一下，朋友，这不是$heOrShe第一次这么干了。我想你不是唯一一个有藏宝图的人。"

texts.en: You have your purser make arrangements, with instructions to keep the pilgrims from interfering in $shipOrFleet operations.
texts.zh: 你让你的事务长去安排了，同时也指示他别让朝圣者打扰$shipOrFleet的运行。

options.en: I have the $rdsm_megacorpName datacore for you.
options.zh: 我拿到了你要的 $rdsm_megacorpName 数据核心。

texts.en:
$PersonName's eyes light up. "Excellent work, captain!"

You give orders for delivery of the core while $heOrShe transfers you your reward.
texts.zh:
$PersonName 眼神一亮。"干得漂亮，舰长！"

在$heOrShe支付报酬的同时，你下令移交核心。

texts.en: "I need a datacore swapped with one from some ruins on a planet out on the Fringe, an easy job."
texts.zh: "我需要用数据核心掉包另一个在边缘星区遗迹里的其他数据核心。这活很简单。"

options.en: Ask about the 'easy' datacore swap job
options.zh: 问问这个 '简单' 的数据核心掉包任务

texts.en:
"Our partnership has been productive," $heOrShe says, "I trust you can handle the simple requirements of this task."

$HeOrShe taps at a datapad, summoning a starmap. "There is an abandoned $rdsm_target on $rdsm_planetName in the $rdsm_systemName, $rdsm_dist light-years away. It was once property of the $rdsm_megacorpName megacorporation, not that it's mattered for 200 cycles."

"I will provide you with a datacore and a precise diagram of the $rdsm_target. Exchange my datacore for the one you will find per my specifications. Make it look natural, like it's been untouched since the Collapse."

"If there's anything else around to plunder in the colony, have at it. My only concern is that the datacore is in place and the one you find is returned here to me. You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return to me with the datacore."
texts.zh:
"我们的合作一直很高效，" $heOrShe说，"我相信你能完成这个简单的任务。"

$HeOrShe滑动数据平板，召唤出一张星图。"在距离这里 $rdsm_dist 光年处，$rdsm_systemName 中的 $rdsm_planetName 上，有一座废弃的 $rdsm_target。它曾属于 $rdsm_megacorpName 集团，但那已经是 200 星历年以前的事情了。"

"我会给你提供一个数据核心和一份关于 $rdsm_target 的准确示意图。找到我需要的数据核心，用我给你的数据核心替换原有那个。做的自然点，让它看起来就像大崩塌以来一直未被触碰过。"

"如果殖民地周围还有其它有价值的东西，尽管带走。我唯一关心的是，我的数据核心要放在原位，而你找到的那个要拿回来给我。等你带着数据核心回来时，我会付你 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

texts.en:
"Our partnership has been productive," $heOrShe says, "I trust you can handle the simply requirements of this task."

$HeOrShe taps at a datapad, summoning a starmap. "There is an abandoned $rdsm_target on $rdsm_planetName in $rdsm_systemName, $rdsm_dist light-years away. It was once property of the $rdsm_megacorpName megacorporation, not that it's mattered for 200 cycles."

"I will provide you with a datacore and a precise diagram of the $rdsm_target. Exchange my datacore for the one you will find per my specifications. Make it look natural, like it's been untouched since the Collapse."

"If there's anything else around to plunder in the colony, have at it. My only concern is that the my datacore is in place and the one you find is returned here to me. And one more thing..."
texts.zh:
"我们的合作一直很高效，" $heOrShe说，"我相信你能完成这个简单的任务。"

$HeOrShe滑动数据平板，召唤出一张星图。"在距离这里 $rdsm_dist 光年处，$rdsm_systemName 中的 $rdsm_planetName 上，有一座废弃的 $rdsm_target。它曾属于 $rdsm_megacorpName 集团，但那已经是 200 星历年以前的事情了。"

"我会给你提供一个数据核心和一份关于 $rdsm_target 的准确示意图。找到我需要的数据核心，用我给你的数据核心替换原有那个。做的自然点，让它看起来就像大崩塌以来一直未被触碰过。"

"如果殖民地周围还有其它有价值的东西，尽管带走。我唯一关心的是，我的数据核心要放在原位，而你找到的那个要拿回来给我。另外，还有一件事..."

options.en: "What's on this datacore that's so important?
options.zh: 这个数据核心为什么如此重要？

texts.en:
"I should think you'd know better than to ask," $heOrShe produces a thin smile. "Perhaps you fear some risk to your $shipOrFleet and reputation? I didn't take you for a coward, but I'll indulge you this once."

"I have intel which suggests that the datacore contains specifications for an obscure industrial process which is marginally more effective than common methods. Without specialized knowledge, its value is difficult to recognize. Equally difficult is finding a buyer who is in a position to make good use of this alternative process. The stars have aligned for me, however, and I am willing to share a portion of my anticipated profits for your service."

"Satisfied?"
texts.zh:
"我想你应该知道，这种事最好别问，" $heOrShe露出一丝浅笑，"或许你是担心你的$shipOrFleet和名声会受到什么风险？我还以为你没那么懦夫，但这次我就迁就一下你吧。"

"我收到的情报显示，那个数据核心中包含了一种鲜为人知的生产工艺的使用说明，它比常见的工艺稍微有效一些。没有专业知识的话，很难认识到它的价值。同样困难的是找到一个能够充分利用这种替代工艺的买家。不过，这次幸运女神站在我这边，我愿意分享一部分未来收益来换取你的服务。"

"满意了？"

options.en: Why do a swap, why not just take the datacore?
options.zh: 为什么还要再放个核心上去，直接拿走东西不就完事了？

texts.en:
$HeOrShe rolls $hisOrHer eyes. "So that the process contained therein appears to be a new invention," $heOrShe says slowly, as if to a simple child.

"The swapped core will soon be discovered by a scavenger who will find that it contains the common-knowledge process rather than the unique one actually developed by $rdsm_megacorpName. This will create substantial evidence to 'prove' that the process is a unique discovery, which will make it much more profitable to patent in the polities across the Sector that bother with that sort of thing."

"It comes down to credits, $playerName. From your perspective, $rdsm_reward credits. And that's all that should concern you. Understand?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe翻了个白眼。"因为，这种做法会让核心里的独特工艺显得像是一项新发明，" $heOrShe像哄小孩那样慢悠悠的说到。

"很快，拾荒者就会找到这枚掉包过的核心，但这枚核心里面只有常见的工艺，没有 $rdsm_megacorpName 开发的独特工艺。由此，便能实实在在的 '证明' 这项工艺如何独一无二，进而在星域中那些关心专利的公司里多捞出点油水。"

"归根结底是星币，$playerName。对你来说，就是 $rdsm_reward 星币。这才是你应该关心的。明白了吗？"

options.en: But what if someone finds another copy of $rdsm_megacorpName's process?
options.zh: 但是，如果有人再找到另一份 $rdsm_megacorpName 工艺的备份，又该怎么办？

texts.en:
"You don't quit, do you?"

$HeOrShe sighs. "My buyer will simply declare that they faked this hypothetical second discovery to undermine the patent."
texts.zh:
"还真是执着啊你，是不是？"

$HeOrShe叹了口气。"那我的买家就会宣布他们这次发现是伪造的，是对于买家专利权的蓄意破坏。"

options.en: And that hypothetical second copy of the process was recovered before the fake datacore was found...
options.zh: 万一，在有人找到我们掉包的数据核心之前，就有别人找到了另一份备份的话...

texts.en:
"I will arrange for the prompt discovery of the datacore you leave behind by an unknowing scavenger," $heOrShe snaps, patience nearly at an end. "Obviously."

"Enough chatter. Are you in or out?"
texts.zh:
"我会引导不知情的拾荒者去 '发现' 你掉包的数据核心的。" $heOrShe语气渐渐严厉，看来$heOrShe的耐心已经快要耗尽了，"很明显的事。"

"聊得够多了，你到底是干还是不干？"

texts.en:
"You should be aware, however, that there have been reports of decivs on $rdsm_marketName. They may be... hostile." $HeOrShe smiles rather carnivorously, then says "I recommend bringing at least $rdsm_marinesReq to ensure the safety of your operation."

"You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return to me with the datacore."
texts.zh:
"不过，你应该知道，有报告称在 $rdsm_marketName 上有些蛮荒人，他们可能会... 具有敌意。" $HeOrShe露出肉食动物般的微笑，然后说道，"为了确保行动安全，我建议至少带上 $rdsm_marinesReq 名陆战队员。"

"你回来并交付数据核心后，将会获得 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

options.en: "What's on this datacore that's so important?
options.zh: 这个数据核心为什么如此重要？

texts.en:
$HeOrShe smiles carnivorously, "Yes, of course. You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return and deliver the datacore."

"You should be aware, however, that there have been reports of decivs on $rdsm_marketName. They may be... hostile. I recommend bringing at least $rdsm_marinesReq to ensure the safety of your operation."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe露出了肉食动物般的微笑，"好吧，当然。你回来并交付数据核心后，将会获得 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

"不过，你应该知道，有报告称在 $rdsm_marketName 上出现了蛮荒人，他们可能会... 具有敌意。为了确保行动安全，我建议至少带上 $rdsm_marinesReq 名陆战队员。"

options.en: Why do a swap, why not just take the datacore?
options.zh: 为什么还要再放个核心上去，直接拿走东西不就完事了？

texts.en: Your marines provide security while a small salvage team carefully accesses the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target and swaps out the specified data core.
texts.zh: 在你陆战队员的保护下，一小支打捞小组小心地进入了 $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target，替换了指定的数据核心。

texts.en: "A rival has established a secret outpost to move a large quantity of $rsom_product. I'd like you to ruin their plans for me."
texts.zh: "有一位竞争对手已经建立了一座秘密据点，意图转运大批量的 $rsom_product 。我希望你能破坏那个人的计划。"

options.en: Ask about ruining $hisOrHer rival's secret outpost
options.zh: 询问摧毁$hisOrHer竞争对手秘密据点任务的细节

texts.en:
"You've earned a degree of my trust," $heOrShe says. "I would ask you to help me send a," $heOrShe chuckles, "very important message."

"One of my rivals has established a staging point, a secret outpost, on the planet $rsom_planetName in the $rsom_systemName, which is $rsom_dist light-years away. They've stashed a lot of $rsom_product there, awaiting transport. I'm not sure where they got it all, maybe an old cache, or it's a transit point from some other supplier. What I do know," $heOrShe growls, "is that they're severely undercutting the prices we've all worked so hard to keep at sustainable levels."

"Raid the outpost. Plunder the $rsom_product. Sell the loot at whatever black market you like - at market rate. It will be your payment."

"My source suggests that the outpost will be lightly defended. $rsom_marinesReq marines should be sufficient to neutralize the protection."
texts.zh:
"你已经赢得了我部分信任，" $heOrShe说道，"我想请你帮我传递一个，嗯..." $heOrShe轻笑一声，"非常重要的消息。"

"我的一个竞争对手在 $rsom_systemName 中的 $rsom_planetName 上建立了一个秘密据点，距离这里 $rsom_dist 光年。那个人在那里囤积了大量的 $rsom_product，正等待转运。我不清楚那家伙是从哪里弄来的这些货物，可能是某个旧仓库的存货，或者是从其他经销商那里转运过来的。但有一点我非常清楚，" $heOrShe开始咆哮，"那个逼正在以远低于我们辛苦维持的、保证长久发展的价格进行倾销！"

"劫掠那个据点。带走那些 $rsom_product。你可以在任何你喜欢的黑市上以市场价出售这些战利品。这就是你的报酬。"

"我的线人透露，那个据点的防御力量相当薄弱。派遣 $rsom_marinesReq 陆战队员应该就足以摧毁它的安保力量了。"

options.en: Any hostile fleets to look out for? Ground batteries?
options.zh: 有需要注意的敌对舰队或者地面炮台吗？

texts.en:
"My rival only dabbles in starships, so little to worry about there. But, yes, there are concealed batteries. They may not stop a proper warfleet, but they're an inconvenience."

"My, ah, source on this intel was 'convinced' to provide codes you will use to bypass their IFF." A slow, toothy smile builds on $hisOrHer face. "Use their codes. They'll think you're doing a pickup as you drop the shuttle cargo doors and marines pour fire into the unsuspecting fools."

$HeOrShe gets a distant, pleased look as $heOrShe imagines the slaughter.
texts.zh:
"我的竞争对手缺乏星舰，所以不用太担心这个。但是，没错，那里确实有隐蔽的地面炮台。它们或许无法阻挡一支真正的舰队，但确实会造成一些麻烦。"

"我那个...呃...提供情报的线人已经被 '说服'，并交出了用来绕过对方 IFF 的代码以供你们使用。" $hisOrHer的脸上缓慢地浮现出带着狡黠的笑容，"只要用了他们的密钥。当你的陆战队员打开穿梭机的货舱门向那些毫无防备的笨蛋倾泻火力时，他们都只会以为你们是来取货的。"

$HeOrShe走神了片刻，想象着那场即将到来的屠杀，$HeOrShe的脸上浮现出一种满足的神情。

options.en: And you trust this, ah, source?

texts.en:
$HisOrHer expression cools. "I trust my methods, captain," $heOrShe says.

"You can trust me, as you have in the past. You will be rewarded. Just as you have in the past."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer的表情变得冷淡。"舰长，我相信的是我的手段。" $heOrShe说道。

"你可以像过去一样相信我，你会得到报酬的。就像过去一样。"

options.en: It's not about trust, it's about the lies a 'source' might provide. It could be a trap.
options.zh: 这无关信任，而是关于一个'线人'可能会提供的虚假情报。这可能是个陷阱。

texts.en:
"Then decline my generous offer," the $post says testily.

"If you're afraid of a little risk, I'll find someone who is up for the job."
texts.zh:
"那就拒绝我这慷慨的提议吧，" $post 不耐烦的说。

"如果你连这点风险都害怕，我可以去找其他人来完成这个任务。"

texts.en:
"I'd like to set up an economic arrangement with a reliable colonial producer of $cpm_commodityName covering a period of several cycles."
OR
"I'm looking to invest in a colony which can produce $cpm_commodityName reliably for several cycles."
texts.zh:
"我想与一位可靠的殖民地生产商签订一项经济协议，生产 $cpm_commodityName，交付周期涵盖几个星历年。"
OR
"我想投资一个能可靠生产 $cpm_commodityName 的殖民地，交付周期几个星历年左右。"

texts.en: "I need someone I can count on to arrange for a colonial producer of $cpm_commodityName over a period of several cycles."
texts.zh: "我需要一个信得过的殖民地生产商，在未来几个星历年里能稳定提供 $cpm_commodityName。"

options.en: Ask about becoming a supplier of $cpm_commodityName
options.zh: 询问有关成为 $cpm_commodityName 的供应商的相关事宜

options.en: Ask about becoming a supplier of $cpm_commodityName
options.zh: 询问关于供应 $cpm_commodityName 的事

texts.en:
"I need a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a reliable colonial administrator. I would expect full production brought online within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would arrange for monthly payments of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits over $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

"This could prove quite lucrative if you could guarantee the stable supply chain our operation requires," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
"我需要一个能稳定提供 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName 的殖民地供应商。我的公司预计第一批货物需要在 $cpm_missionCycles 个星历年内完成交付。一旦协议达成，我会每个月付款 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，协议持续 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年，总计是 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

"如果你能保证我司所需的稳定供货，这可是相当有利可图的。" $heOrShe说道。

texts.en:
"I require a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a colonial administrator who is willing to ensure reliability by any means necessary. My organization would expect your operation to be set up within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would make monthly payments to you of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits. These would continue for $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

"If you agree, I will accept you on your word," $heOrShe says. "We make a good team, $playerName. Who would dare stand against such a partnership?" $HeOrShe produces a chilling smile.
texts.zh:
"我需要一位殖民地管理员稳定供应 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName，不惜一切代价。我的组织希望能在 $cpm_missionCycles 星历年内完成第一次交付。一旦合同成立，我会每月向你支付 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，我们的合同将持续 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年，你将得到总计 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

"合同成立只需要你的口头同意。" $HeOrShe说道，"我们可以成为很好的合作伙伴，$playerName，谁敢对抗如此坚固的联合呢？" $HeOrShe露出了令人不寒而栗的微笑。

texts.en: A $cpm_manOrWoman in a business suit sits in a private booth thoughtfully perusing a top-line TriPad alongside a bottle of something expensive.
texts.zh: 一个身着西装的$cpm_manOrWoman坐在一个专属座位上，一边若有所思地阅读着$HeOrShe的顶配 TriPad，一边喝着一瓶高档饮品。

texts.en: A $cpm_manOrWoman in a private booth thoughtfully peruses a top-line TriPad alongside a bottle of something expensive. Definitely a rich smuggler.
texts.zh: 一个$cpm_manOrWoman坐在私人隔间里仔细盯着一台顶配 TriPad，旁边还放着一瓶昂贵的酒。这肯定是个有钱的走私者。

texts.en: A $cpm_manOrWoman in a private booth thoughtfully peruses a top-line TriPad alongside a bottle of something expensive. Definitely a rich smuggler.
texts.zh: 一个$cpm_manOrWoman坐在私人隔间里仔细盯着一台顶配 TriPad，旁边还放着一瓶昂贵的酒。这肯定是个有钱的走私者。

texts.en: A $cpm_manOrWoman sits alone in a private booth, flanked by discreet bodyguards. There is a sinister vibe to their bearing.
texts.zh: 一个$cpm_manOrWoman独自坐在私人隔间里，隔间旁站着神经紧绷的保镖。他们的姿态让隔间蒙上了不祥的氛围。

options.en: Approach the thoughtful-looking business$cpm_manOrWoman in the private booth
options.zh: 靠近这名坐在专属座位上的若有所思的$cpm_manOrWoman

options.en: Approach the thoughtful-looking smuggler in the private booth
options.zh: 接近这位坐在隔间里深思熟虑的走私者。

options.en: Approach the thoughtful-looking smuggler in the private booth
options.zh: 接近这位坐在隔间里深思熟虑的走私者。

options.en: Approach the sinister $cpm_manOrWoman in the private booth

texts.en:
You approach the private booth, doing your best to look both important and well-connected. It seems to work; the $cpm_manOrWoman looks up from $hisOrHer TriPad and motions for you to join $himOrHer.

"Captain $playerName. Please, sit." $heOrShe gives a small smile at catching you off-guard, and pours a tiny glass of something decadent from the bottle. "I've heard so much about your accomplishments. It's all very enterprising. Bravo."

$HeOrShe raises the tiny glass, "To opportunity," sips, then places the glass down beside $hisOrHer TriPad. "I have a proposal for you. An opportunity."
texts.zh:
你走近这个专属座位，尽量让自己看起来像个有影响的大人物。你的伪装奏效了，这个$cpm_manOrWoman从$HeOrShe的 TriPad 上移开了目光，一边向你示意，请你过去和$HeOrShe聊聊。

"请坐，$playerName 舰长。" $heOrShe在你不知所措的时候露出一丝微笑，然后从瓶子里倒了一小杯纨绔子弟才会享用的琼浆，"我听说过你的很多成就，你是个很有事业心的人，我很欣赏。"

$HeOrShe举起小酒杯，"敬机遇！" 抿了一口后，对方将酒杯放在了$HeOrShe的 TriPad 旁边。"我有个提议给你，一个机遇。"

texts.en:
You approach the private booth, doing your best to look both important and well-connected. It seems to work; the $cpm_manOrWoman waves back $hisOrHer bodyguards and motions for you to join $himOrHer.

"Is it Captain $playerName? Of course it is." $HeOrShe pours $himOrHerself something from the fabulously expensive bottle at the center of the table. "My informants have told me so much about you. Your accomplishments," $hisOrHer eyebrows lift, "Your exploits. I admire your pursuit of power. No, don't deny it," $heOrShe says, swirling $hisOrHer glass, "You do it well, and that is why we are speaking."

$HeOrShe empties $hisOrHer glass, then says "I would very much like us to work together."
texts.zh:
你走近私人隔间，尽力通过姿态展示自己既重要又有人脉。这似乎奏效了；$cpm_manOrWoman向$hisOrHer的保镖挥了挥手，以示可以让你与$himOrHer进行会谈。

"你就是 $playerName 舰长？没错，当然是。" $HeOrShe拿起桌子中央的某种昂贵饮料，给自己倒了一杯。"我的线人告诉了我很多关于你的事。" $hisOrHer扬了扬眉毛，"你的成就，你的功绩。我钦佩你对力量的追求。别急着否认。" $heOrShe边说边摇晃着杯子，"你做得很好，这就是我愿意与你谈话的原因。"

$heOrShe喝光了$hisOrHer杯中的饮料，然后说："我非常希望有能与你共事的机会。"

texts.en:
"I need a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a reliable colonial administrator. My organization would expect first delivery within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would arrange for monthly payments of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits over $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

$HeOrShe slides $hisOrHer TriPad across the table for your review. It states the terms of the contract as described. "I believe this arrangement could benefit both of us for a long time."
texts.zh:
"我需要一个能稳定提供 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName 的殖民地供应商。我的公司预计第一批货物需要在 $cpm_missionCycles 个星历年内完成交付。一旦协议达成，我会每个月付款 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，协议持续 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年，总计是 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

$HeOrShe将 TriPad 从桌面上滑过来请你过目，它显示了刚才所述的合同条款。"我相信这次合作对我们双方都有好处。"

texts.en:
"I require a steady supply of $cpm_needed units of $cpm_commodityName from a colonial administrator who is willing to ensure reliability by any means necessary."

"Any." $HeOrShe pounds $hisOrHer glass on the table to emphasize the point.

"My organization would expect a first delivery within $cpm_missionCycles cycles. Once established, I would arrange for monthly payments of $cpm_monthlyPayment credits over $cpm_contractCycles cycles, for a total of $cpm_totalPayment credits."

$HeOrShe pours two glasses from the bottle. "If you agree, I will accept you on your word." $HeOrShe produces a chilling smile and motions toward the glasses. "This partnership could prove to be very profitable, $playerName."
texts.zh:
"我需要一位殖民地管理员稳定供给 $cpm_needed 单位的 $cpm_commodityName，不惜任何代价。"

"任何。" $HeOrShe把$hisOrHer的杯子砸在桌子上以强调这一点。

"我的组织希望能在 $cpm_missionCycles 星历年内实现第一次交付。一旦合同成立，我会在 $cpm_contractCycles 星历年内每月向你支付 $cpm_monthlyPayment 星币，总计 $cpm_totalPayment 星币。"

$HeOrShe倒满了两杯饮料。"合同成立只需要你的口头答应。" $HeOrShe露出了令人不寒而栗的微笑，一边推了推眼镜，"这次合作将为我们双方带来巨大的利润，$playerName。"

texts.en: "I have a few nanoforge slots opening up due to a canceled order. You could arrange for a custom production job; ships, weapons, you name it."
texts.zh: "由于有人取消订单，我这边的纳米锻炉空出了几个生产档期。我可以为你安排一些生产订单；舰船，武器，有什么要求你尽管说。"

texts.en: "Due to a shift in strategic outlook, the navy has been left with some canceled nanoforge production slots- and a hole to fill in the budget. We could arrange a custom order of military-grade products, provided you cover the fees."
texts.zh: "由于战略前景的转变，海军取消了一些纳米锻炉的生产订单 —— 还留下了需要填补的预算缺口。我们可以为你安排生产军用级的产品，只要你支付费用。"

texts.en: "Some, ah, friends of mine have procured access to a supply of military-grade ships and weapons. I could cut you in on a deal."
texts.zh: "我的一些，呃，朋友获得了军用级舰船和武器的供应机会。我可以把你也算进去。"

options.en: Ask about the surplus nanoforge production opportunity.
options.zh: 询问有关纳米锻炉订单的事

options.en: Ask about the surplus military-grade nanoforge production opportunity
options.zh: 询问有关军用级纳米锻炉生产订单的事。

options.en: Ask about the military-grade arms procurement opportunity
options.zh: 询问有关军需品供应的事

texts.en:
"The slots are valid for up to $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of industrial production capacity, and I'll let you use them for a very reasonable $cpc_costPercent of base cost. You would have to provide your own blueprints, of course."

$HeOrShe gives you a million-credit smile and says, "It's a good opportunity, captain."
texts.zh:
"空闲部分可以负担价值为至多 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的生产需求，我可以让你以 $cpc_costPercent 的基础成本使用它们，十分合理。当然，蓝图需要由你自己提供。"

$HeOrShe露出了一个放贷人似的笑容："机不可失，舰长。"

texts.en: "I'm not here to make a sales pitch, captain, so I shall simply state the terms then let you decide. $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of military-grade nanoforge production at $cpc_costPercent of base cost with delivery of product within $cpc_days days. You can take the slots and provide your own blueprints, or we can input the order under my authority, in which case you would use mine. One or the other."
texts.zh: "舰长，我不是来搞推销的，所以我只会简单地说明条款，决定权在你。价值为至多 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的生产订单，使用金额为 $cpc_costPercent 的基础成本，交货会在 $cpc_days 天内完成。你买下使用权后，可以提供自己的蓝图，或者以我的名义下单，也就是使用我的蓝图。二者选一"

texts.en:
"My supplier can provide access to custom production of up to $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of rare ships and weapons of great interest to a collector such as yourself. Discretion doesn't come cheap of course, and there's the matter of finders' fees and certain bureaucrats to... " $heOrShe pauses, considering, "...encourage to mind their other duties, let's say. Oh, and delivery of product is guaranteed within $cpc_days days."

"I can get you a good deal here - let's call it a mere $cpc_costPercent of base cost. Just say the word and I can give you a little manifest we've put together."
texts.zh:
"我的供应者可以提供价值至多 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的稀有舰船或武器的生产机会，你这样的收藏家不会想错过的。当然，定制生产的成本不低，还有中间商费用以及给官僚的..." $heOrShe顿了顿，思考着说辞，"...让他们把精力放在别的事情上的费用，这么说你能懂吧。对了，交货预计会在 $cpc_days 天内完成。"

"这是笔不错的交易 —— 费用仅为 $cpc_costPercent 的生产成本。只要你开口，我就可以立刻给你一份我们整理好的清单。"
