texts.en: A well-dressed $cpc_manOrWoman seems to be arguing with a TriPad about a canceled nanoforge order and the need to fill some production slots as soon as possible.
texts.zh: 一个衣着考究的$cpc_manOrWoman看起来正在 TriPad 上进行争论，内容涉及一笔被取消的纳米锻炉生产订单，以及尽快填补生产订单空窗期的必要性。

texts.en: At a private table, a $cpc_manOrWoman in uniform complains to another patron about how the ordnance department left them with unfilled nanoforge production slots- and a hole in the budget.
texts.zh: 在一张私人餐桌上，穿着制服的$cpc_manOrWoman正在向另一位顾客抱怨，说军械部门取消了一些纳米锻炉生产订单 —— 还留下了需要填补的预算缺口。

texts.en: In a smoky booth flanked by bodyguards sits a $cpc_manOrWoman who you recognize as a notorious black market arms dealer.
texts.zh: 在一个烟雾缭绕的隔间里坐着一个$cpc_manOrWoman，隔间外保镖环伺，你认出此人是个臭名昭著的黑市军火商。

options.en: Talk to the well-dressed $cpc_manOrWoman who needs to sell production slots
options.zh: 和那个需要出售生产机会的$cpc_manOrWoman谈谈

options.en: Talk to the $cpc_manOrWoman in uniform about selling you those military nanoforge production slots
options.zh: 向穿着制服的$cpc_manOrWoman提出可以将空余的军用纳米锻炉生产订单卖给你

options.en: Talk to the arms dealer about buying illegal weapons
options.zh: 和军火商谈谈购买非法武器的事

texts.en:
As you approach, the well-dressed $manOrWoman abruptly concludes their comms-call, and sensing your approach, looks you over with an assessor's eye.

"Captain, I presume," $heOrShe says, offering the next seat. "And I presume you overheard my conversation so let me waste no time in laying out terms."

"You have needs; starships, weapons, and so on. I can provide access to $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of nanoforge production and I'm willing to input your orders at $cpc_costPercent of base cost. You would have to provide your own blueprints, of course."
texts.zh:
当你走近时，那个衣着光鲜的$manOrWoman突然终止了通讯，察觉到你接近后，对方用审视的目光看着你。

"我猜你是个舰长吧，" $heOrShe说着，让出了一个空位。"你应该已经听到了我的会话内容，我就不浪费时间来陈述条件了。"

"如果你有战舰，武器之类的需求。我可以提供至多 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的纳米锻炉生产订单，并且以 $cpc_costPercent 的基础成本来提交你的订单。当然，你必须提供你自己的蓝图。"

texts.en:
"The other patron shakes their head and stands as you approach, making a civilian attempt at a salute as they leave.

The $personRank rolls $hisOrHer eyes then offers you a place at the table. "You're interested in the production slots, captain" $heOrShe says without greeting.

"It's beneath my dignity to make a sales pitch, so I shall simply state the terms. $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of military-grade nanoforge production at $cpc_costPercent of base cost. Delivery of product within $cpc_days days. You can take the slots and provide your own blueprints, or we can input the order under my authority, in which case you would use mine. One or the other."
texts.zh:
当你接近时，另一个人摇了摇头，起身站起，离开前试着敬了个军礼，但动作里却透出了平民的举止。

$personRank 朝着对方的背影翻了个白眼，然后示意你就坐。"看起来你对我们的生产空余有兴趣，舰长。" $heOrShe开门见山。

"推销东西有损我的尊严，所以我就直接开条件好了。价值为至多 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的军用纳米锻炉产能，收费为基础成本的 $cpc_costPercent，产品交付会在 $cpc_days 天内完成。你买下使用权后，可以自己提供蓝图，也能以我的名义下单，用我的蓝图。二选一。"

texts.en:
As you approach, the bodyguards' attention focuses like the sweep of a capship targeting array- the arms dealer stands them down with a flick of $hisOrHer hand.

"You must know who I am, and I know why you're here," $heOrShe says. "Let us talk, like friends." The arms dealer leans in, and a privacy field blurs around the booth, muffling outside sound. The smoke of a trendy drug-stick starts to fill the bubble due to dampened atmospheric motion.

"I can supply custom construction of up to $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of rare ships and weapons, at a very reasonable $cpc_costPercent of base cost. I guarantee delivery of product within $cpc_days days, and absolute discretion."

$HeOrShe slides a battered TriPad over the table, "It never hurt to look."
texts.zh:
当你走近时，保镖们的目光就像战舰上的目标锁定阵列一样集中在你身上 —— 军火商则用一个响指制止了他们。

"你一定知道我是谁，我也知道你为什么会来这儿，" $heOrShe说道，"让我们像朋友一样谈谈吧。" 军火商靠了过来，同时用隐私场笼罩了隔间，大幅降低了外界声音的传入。由于空气流动变缓，时髦毒品棒上释放的烟雾开始逐步充满隐私场内的区域。

"我可以提供价值为至多 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的舰船和武器生产需求，仅收取基准成本 $cpc_costPercent 的非常合理的费用。我保证交货会在 $cpc_days 天内完成，绝对保密。"

$HeOrShe把一个看上去就久经沙场的 TriPad 沿桌子滑了过来，"先看看也无妨。"

texts.en:
As you approach, the  $manOrWoman slams down a datapad just a bit too abruptly and produces a long, drawn-out sigh of frustration.

"Idiots," $heOrShe mutters.
texts.zh:
当你走近时，那个$manOrWoman猛然砰地一声撂下数据平板，长长的叹息中透露出沮丧。

"白痴。" $heOrShe咕哝着说了一句。

options.zh: 看看 TriPad 里有什么
我来的时机看来不太好？
白痴？嘛，我也受不了那种家伙。

options.en: Have a moment to discuss business?
Take a step back, and look around again
options.zh: 后退一步，再四处随意看看

texts.en: $HeOrShe looks up. "Always, with these people."
texts.zh: $HeOrShe抬起头来接话道："常有的事，这些家伙就这样。"

texts.en:
A deep breath, and then the rant comes out.

"It's a coilgun! You can see the coils! Some absolute idiot Domain procurement committee asked for a magnetically-accelerated slug cannon and slapped the name 'railgun' on the thing when they were delivered a coilgun. It's a simple fix, but now we're stuck with this... scientifically, physically, totally inaccurate name. Forever!"

"I swear, this is why the Gate System failed. Know-nothing bureaucrats who wouldn't correct a simple error because they don't think it's important. But. This. Is. Important."

These last words are punctuated by $hisOrHer finger striking the table like metallic slugs accelerated by a series of magnetic coils.
texts.zh:
深吸一口气之后，愤怒咆哮喷涌而出。

"这是一门线圈炮！你都看得到线圈！就是有几个 人之领 采购委员的纯白痴开价要采购射金属块的电磁加速加农炮，然后随手把 '轨道炮' 这名字往送过来的线圈炮上一拍就不管了。本来很容易纠正的，但现在我们永远都摆脱不了这个... 从科学上和物理上都大错特错的名字了，永远！"

"我发誓这就是星门网络崩溃的原因。官僚都懂个屁！他们根本没心思去纠正这样一个简单的错误，就因为他们觉得这不重要。但是，这、很、重、要。"

$hisOrHer的手指犹如被电磁线圈加速出膛的金属块一样砸在了桌面上，把话里的最后几个字敲得一字一顿的。

texts.en:
"Coil!" one hand slaps down on the table, "Rail!" the other, on the other side. "Circle! Line! It's not difficult!" $HeOrShe is shouting now, earning looks from across the bar.

"Apart from, yes yes, certain classes of hybrid, alternative and exotic design-classes, it is as clear as night and day! Am I not right?!" $HeOrShe fixes you with $hisOrHer eyes bright with righteous anger.
texts.zh:
"线圈！" 一巴掌拍在了桌子上，"轨道！" 另一巴掌，拍在另外一边。"圆圈！直线！有什么分不清的！" $HeOrShe现在吼得嘶声力竭，惹来了全酒吧的注目。

"除了一些，好...对，有特定的一些混合式的，另类的，奇异的设计类型，这区别就像白天和黑夜一样清楚！我说的不对吗？！" $HeOrShe用饱含怒火的双眼瞪着你。

options.en: Sure. So are you selling any ra- coilguns?
options.zh: 当然。那么你有卖轨...线圈炮吗？

options.en: Absolutely! It's vital to correct people about these things.
options.zh: 毫无疑问！纠正人们对于这些名称的误解是大有必要的。

options.en: I, uh, prefer to let the experts sort it out.
options.zh: 我，呃，觉得还是要交给专家来区分吧。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you a look, then retrieves and unlocks $hisOrHer datapad. It seems undamaged.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe无语地摆了个臭脸给你，然后拿出$hisOrHer的数据平板解了锁。看来它还没坏掉。

texts.en:
The arms dealer taps a command and a privacy field blurs the rest of the bar, muffling its murmur.

"Right. I can supply custom construction of up to $cpc_maxCapacity credits worth of rare ships and weapons, at a very reasonable $cpc_costPercent of base cost. I guarantee delivery of product within $cpc_days days, and absolute discretion." $HeOrShe glances up to give you a hard look, "I'm also very exacting about technical details."

$HeOrShe sighs one more time, some degree of tension leaving $hisOrHer body, then slides the battered datapad over, "See if there is anything to your taste."
texts.zh:
军火商按了个指令，然后一个隐私场就把酒吧的其余部分变得模糊了起来，也遮掩了细语声。

"好吧。我能提供不超过 $cpc_maxCapacity 星币的定制稀有舰船和武器，价格定在非常合理的成本价的 $cpc_costPercent。我可以保证在 $cpc_days 天以内送达产品，绝对保密，" $HeOrShe对着你冷冷一瞥，"另外，我对技术细节的要求也很苛刻。"

$HeOrShe又叹了口气，身体放松下了一些，然后把破旧不堪的数据平板滑了过来，"看看你喜欢什么吧。"

options.zh: 看看 TriPad 里有什么

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods heartily to a fellow appreciator of the important things in life then retrieves $hisOrHer datapad. It seems undamaged.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe向面前这位在人生大事的观点上志同道合的人重重地点了个头。然后拿出$hisOrHer的数据平板解了锁。看来它还没坏掉。

texts.en: $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head at the ignorance of the world, then retrieves and unlocks $hisOrHer datapad. It seems undamaged.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe摇了摇头，仿佛是厌倦了世间的无知。然后拿出$hisOrHer的数据平板解了锁。看来它还没坏掉。

texts.en: $HeOrShe manages an insincere smile at your remark.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe客套地笑了一下就算是回应了你话。

texts.en:
"The local pirates have been getting out of hand and it's cutting into profits. We're willing to offer special incentives if you could hunt some down."
OR
"There's been an increase in local pirate activity and I'm unsatisfied with the official response. I've decided to offer a special bounty to trusted individuals who can assist with this problem."
OR
"The pirates have established a base nearby and their raids are simply bad for business. I could extend special bounty terms if you help us contain them."
texts.zh:
"当地的海盗活动猖獗，严重影响了商业活动的利润。如果你能干掉一些，我们愿意提供奖励。"
OR
"当地海盗活动有所增加，我对官方的无所作为十分不满。我决定向那些值得信赖的人提供一笔赏金，只要他们能帮助解决这个问题。"
OR
"海盗在附近建立了一个基地，他们的袭击对生意很不利。如果你帮我们处理他们，我可以支付赏金。"

options.en: Ask about the special pirate fleet bounty
options.zh: 问问关于海盗舰队的特别赏金

texts.en:
"The terms are this," $heOrShe says, "A bounty shall be paid for destruction of pirate fleets in or near $psb_systemName, $psb_dist light-years away. The base rate is $psb_baseBounty credits per frigate destroyed or disabled, on an increasing scale for larger hulls - please review addendum A in the terms I've forwarded. The period of the bounty shall last for $psb_days days."

$HeOrShe pauses, some dark emotion crossing $hisOrHer face before $heOrShe re-asserts the usual professional bearing, "I would be pleased to see you stamp them out, captain."
texts.zh:
"条款是这样的，" $heOrShe说，"在 $psb_dist 光年外的 $psb_systemName 摧毁海盗舰船将能得到奖金。每摧毁或停机一艘护卫舰就有 $psb_baseBounty 星币，击毁更大的船体将提供更多奖金 —— 请查阅我转发的附录 A。赏金将会持续 $psb_days 天。"

$HeOrShe停顿了片刻，脸上掠过一丝阴沉，然后重新摆出了平常的职业姿态："我会很乐意看到你把他们消灭，舰长。"

texts.en: A $psb_manOrWoman is motioning to a news feed, haranguing an officer in the local navy patrol uniform about the increased pirate raids.
texts.zh: 一个$psb_manOrWoman对着新闻直播指指点点，向一名身穿当地巡逻队制服的军官就海盗袭击增加的事滔滔不绝。

options.en: Talk to the $psb_manOrWoman haranguing the official about the increased pirate raids
options.zh: 和那个滔滔不绝的$psb_manOrWoman谈谈

texts.en:
You catch the attention of the $psb_manOrWoman so angered by pirate activity- a notable figure in intra-system commerce, a simple $personRank, $heOrShe explains, who is "-disappointed by the lack of decisive action. It makes one think these patrols are more interested in tariff-enforcement than fighting pirates!"

You nod and put on an appearance of shared concern as the rant winds down, the $manOrWoman's attention fully focused on you now.

The patrol officer gives you a thankful look and, taking their drink, scurries toward a quiet end of the bar.
texts.zh:
你吸引了被猖獗的海盗活动激怒的$psb_manOrWoman的注意 —— 那是星系内商贸的大人物，$heOrShe则自称是个小小的 $personRank，只是对 "让人觉得巡逻队相较于海盗作战更热衷于收税" 的官方的不作为而感到十分失望。

你一边听对方的滔滔不绝，一边点头并表现出关切的神色，这$manOrWoman的注意力就完全转移到你身上了。

巡逻队的军官感激地看了你一眼，拿起了自己的酒，快步走向酒吧僻静的角落里。

texts.en:
"You're a starship captain, yes? I'll tell you what we've been thinking," $personName says, sitting you down.

"Along with a few concerned associates, I've put together a fund for a bounty on all pirate fleets in or near the $psb_systemName, $psb_dist light-years away. It'd start at $psb_baseBounty credits per frigate with more payout for larger hulls. Running this bounty for $psb_days days should send a strong message to these pirates, and," $heOrShe tries to see where the patrol officer went, speaking louder, "-Teach those tariff-grabbers how to deal with pirates!"

"What do you say, captain?"
texts.zh:
"你是个星舰舰长，对吧？我来告诉你我在想什么。" $personName 说着，示意你坐下。

"我和几个关心此事的同行一起筹集了一笔资金，对 $psb_dist 光年之外 $psb_systemName 里和 附近的海盗发起悬赏。赏金为每艘护卫舰 $psb_baseBounty 星币，摧毁更大的舰船将获得更多奖金。这持续 $psb_days 天的赏金应该能给海盗足够有力的警告，并且..." $heOrShe四处张望，似乎要找出巡逻队员去了哪，大声嚷嚷道，"—— 还能指点指点那些关税掠夺者如何对付海盗！"

"你怎么看，舰长？"

texts.en: "STRATCOM wants to call in a favor. Seems they want $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName disrupted as part of some bigger operation."
texts.zh: "STRATCOM 想找人帮忙。他们似乎想要瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry，以此为某些更进一步的计划做准备。"

options.zh: 询问瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry 这一计划的细节

texts.en:
$HeOrShe pulls up a shared display. The intel is comprehensive: estimated garrison stats and a deployment disposition report. "We require an irregular force to disrupt $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName for at least $dhi_disruptDays days." A flick of the display and a map is overlaid. "Target $dhi_dist light-years away. Special operations has allocated $dhi_reward credits as payment upon mission completion."

You examine the intel report and estimate that roughly $dhi_marines marines would be required to carry off this operation. The $faction $rank watches you make your calculation, patiently awaiting your response.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe打开了显示器，上边的情报十分全面，囊括预估的驻军规模和防御布置。"我们需要一支非常规部队来瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry，至少持续 $dhi_disruptDays 天。" 对方在数据平板上轻敲了几下，一张地图覆盖了之前的信息。"目标距离这里 $dhi_dist 光年。特别行动办公室对该任务的奖励是 $dhi_reward 星币。"

你检查着情报，估算出大约需要 $dhi_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这项任务。在你进行评估时，$faction $rank 在一旁注视着你，耐心地等待着你的回复。

texts.en: You recognize a high ranking officer of $TheFaction in a private booth- and it looks like they recognized you, because an adjutant is sent over to invite you over for 'a word'.
texts.zh: 你在一个私人隔间里认出了 $TheFaction 的一个高级军官 —— 而且看起来对方也认出了你，因为一位副官被派过来邀请你过去 "聊聊"。

options.en: Join the high-ranking officer for 'a word'

texts.en:
You follow the adjutant to the private booth; they give a salute and redeploy toward the bar.

"Captain." $Rank $personName greets you without flourish. "Please, do sit. Make yourself comfortable." $HeOrShe motions toward a pitcher of cool, clear water. $HeOrShe is always on-duty from the looks of it.

"STRATCOM requires an irregular force to disrupt the $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName for at least $dhi_disruptDays days." A few flicks on a datapad and a holo-map floats above the table. The intel is comprehensive: estimated garrison stats and deployment disposition. "The target is $dhi_dist light-years away. The special operations office has agreed to pay $dhi_reward credits if you can complete this mission."

You examine the data and estimate that roughly $dhi_marines marines would be required to pull off this operation. The $faction $rank watches you make your calculations, patiently awaiting your response.
texts.zh:
你跟着副官走进了包间；对方敬了个礼，然后再度朝吧台走去。

"舰长。" $personName $Rank 以一种质朴的方式欢迎着你，"请坐吧，不必拘谨。" $HeOrShe指了指桌上那壶清凉的净水，看上去$HeOrShe似乎总是处于随时待命的状态。

"STRATCOM 需要一支非常规部队来瘫痪 $dhi_marketName 上的 $dhi_industry，至少持续 $dhi_disruptDays 天。" 对方在数据平板上轻敲了几下，接着一张全息图浮现了出来。情报十分全面，囊括预估的驻军规模和防御布置。"目标距离这里 $dhi_dist 光年。特别行动办公室已经同意，如果你能完成任务，你将能得到 $dhi_reward 星币。"

你检查着那些数据，估算出大约需要 $dhi_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这项任务。在你进行评估时，$faction $rank 在一旁注视着你，耐心地等待着你的回复。

texts.en:
You follow the adjutant to the private booth; they salute awkwardly and retreat to the bar.

"Captain." $personName greets you without flourish. "Please, sit. Make yourself comfortable." $HeOrShe is more formal and sober than most pirates you've encountered. There's a current of barely-suppressed rage beneath the polite words; this one is driven by some abstract notion. Ideology, perhaps. Or vengeance.

"The Warlord requires disruption of the $dhi_industry $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName for at least $dhi_disruptDays days." A flicks on the datapad summons a map, and specifications. The intel is comprehensive: estimated garrison stats and deployment disposition. "The target is $dhi_dist light-years away. I have arranged payment of $dhi_reward credits if you complete this mission."

You examine the data and estimate that roughly $dhi_marines marines would be required to pull off this operation. The $faction $rank watches you make your calculations, awaiting your response.
texts.zh:
你跟着副官走进了包间；对方敬了个礼，然后再度朝吧台走去。

"舰长，" $personName 没有过多寒暄，直接向你打招呼，"请坐吧，不必拘谨。" $HeOrShe比你遇到的大多数海盗都要正式且严肃。礼貌的话语之下，隐藏着一股难以抑制的怒火；这个人被某种抽象的概念所驱使。某种理念，又或者是仇恨。

"军阀要求你瘫痪在 $dhi_marketOnOrAt $dhi_marketName 运营的 $dhi_industry 至少 $dhi_disruptDays 天。" 对方在数据平板上轻触一下，调出了一幅地图和详细资料。情报十分全面，囊括预估的驻军规模和防御布置。"目标距离这里 $dhi_dist 光年。如果你完成这项任务，我将安排支付 $dhi_reward 星币作为报酬。"

你检查着那些数据，估算出大约需要 $dhi_marines 名陆战队员才能完成这项任务。在你进行评估时，$faction $rank 在一旁注视着你，等待着你的回复。

texts.en: "I propose a large task, and for it I offer a suitably large reward: I require disruption of the $dsp_industry $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName."
texts.zh: "这有一项重大任务，并且我愿意为此提供相当丰厚的报酬：我需要有人去瘫痪 $dsp_marketName 上的 $dsp_industry。"

texts.en: "Now that we trust one another, it would serve my plans to sew chaos $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName. Would you be so kind as to disrupt the $dsp_industry there for me? I will reward you handsomely."
texts.zh: "鉴于我们已经互相信任，我就直说了：在 $dsp_marketName 上搞出一些麻烦会对我的计划有帮助，你能帮我瘫痪那里的 $dsp_industry 吗？酬劳是不会少的。"

options.zh: 询问瘫痪 $dsp_industry 一事的细节

texts.en:
"Like I said," $heOrShe says, "I require operation of the $dsp_industry $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName, $dsp_dist light-years away, disrupted for at least-" $heOrShe furrows $hisOrHer brow, considering. Then, with cold indifference, says "$dsp_disruptDays days. That should do it. If you carry out this task for me, I would reward you with $dsp_reward credits."

"So you can make an informed decision, here's tac-intel." $HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer datapad and soon you have a very competent recon overview on $dsp_marketName. You estimate that you'd need around $dsp_marines marines to carry off this raid.
texts.zh:
"总之，" $heOrShe说，"我需要你去瘫痪 $dsp_marketName 上的 $dsp_industry，那地方在 $dsp_dist 光年外，确保它被瘫痪至少 —— " $heOrShe皱起$hisOrHer的眉毛思考着，然后冷冷地说，" $dsp_disruptDays 天。这应该足够了。帮我完成这个任务，我将奖励你 $dsp_reward 星币。"

"这是目标的资料，能让你做出明智一些的决定。" $HeOrShe戳了戳$hisOrHer的数据平板，很快你就得到了关于 $dsp_marketName 的十分详尽的情报。你估计你需要大约 $dsp_marines 陆战队员来完成这次劫掠。

texts.en: Some kind of underworld boss lounges in a booth, judging by their motley cordon of augjacks staring down any that dare stray near. No good can come of this.
texts.zh: 一个黑道大佬模样的人懒洋洋地躺在隔间里，旁边那些保镖死死盯着任何胆敢靠近的人。看来能在这儿接到的恐怕不会是什么好工作。

options.en: See what kind of trouble you can get into with the underworld boss in the booth
options.zh: 看看隔间里的黑道大佬会让你搅什么浑水

texts.en:
As you approach, one of the cybermodded thugs steps in your way, a big metal smile at finally having a challenger to beat down. One of your bodyguards, subtly shadowing you just for such an occasion, steps up.

Yours has better augs and training. Theirs, the brash scars of black-market mod infections and a fatal desire to prove that they can't be faced down.

From the booth, a soft clapping begins. "A good show, very well done. Though I adore bloodsport, I've only barely touched my first drink." Then, to the thug, "You! Stand down- and you, captain. Join me."
texts.zh:
当你靠近时，一个接受过生化改装的暴徒拦住了你，脸上挂着无机感十足的笑容，透露出终于找到痛殴对象的喜悦。而你的一位保镖也默默走上前，此人正是为了应对这类场合而暗中随行着你。

你的保镖拥有更好的改造与训练，至于那黑道老大的手下，不过是个接受了黑市渠道的生化改装后徒有凶相的暴徒罢了。

隔间里响起了一阵轻快的掌声。"精彩的表演，干得漂亮。尽管这种血腥斗殴我已经见多了，但这次我还是连酒都差点忘了喝一口。" 对方随即对暴徒呵斥道，"你！退下 —— 而你，舰长，到我这儿来吧。"

texts.en:
$personName loves talking about $himOrHerself, and is quite content to do so without input from another party, be they one of the attendant thugs or yourself.

The conversation, such as it is, eventually comes around to the stand-off between your respective bodyguards. "I see you run a tight operation, captain," $heOrShe says, barely sipping $hisOrHer potent drink.

A second glass of it sits before you, politely sipped and otherwise ignored. "Good guards, admirably professional. Well paid?" $HeOrShe lifts an eyebrow, and proceeds before you can respond. "I could use some of that. You see- most freebooters, brigands, pirates if you like; they're sloppy. They make a mess of things, it's all bang and noise and no follow-through."

"Now you," $heOrShe says, "Could do something for me."
texts.zh:
$personName 热衷于谈论自己的事，并且相当满足于在没有他人参与的情况下自顾自地说下去，这个 "他人" 可以是其他随行的暴徒，也可以是你。

这场所谓的谈话，最终还是绕到了双方保镖对峙的一事上。"似乎你很有你自己的一套，舰长。" $heOrShe说道，一边浅浅地抿了一口$hisOrHer的那杯烈酒。

第二杯同样的酒摆在你面前，你出于礼貌抿了几口，之后就再没动过。"不错的保镖，专业得令人钦佩。薪水很高吧？" $HeOrShe挑起了一侧眉毛，在你能做出回应之前继续说道，"我正需要这些。你看 —— 大部分的强盗、土匪以及海盗，如果你喜欢这么叫，他们过于草率。他们总把事情搞得一团糟，在弄出一阵砰砰的噪音后虎头蛇尾。"

"而你..." $heOrShe说，"可以为我做点什么。"

texts.en:
"I could use your ground game. Bring the $dsp_industry $dsp_marketOnOrAt $dsp_marketName offline for at least $dsp_disruptDays days. That's $dsp_dist light-years away - you know the one. No massacres, no terror bombing, just business. Keep it clean. More profit had when the target sees the wisdom of peaceable cooperation, right?"

$HeOrShe makes a face, as if deeply considering $hisOrHer offer. "$dsp_reward credits for the job."

You estimate that you'd need around $dsp_marines marines to carry off this operation.
texts.zh:
"我需要你的陆战队。瘫痪 $dsp_marketName 上的 $dsp_industry 至少 $dsp_disruptDays 天。那里离这儿 $dsp_dist 光年 —— 你知道那是什么地方。这不是屠杀任务，也不是恐怖行动，只是生意相关，做的利索点。当行动目标意识到和平合作更为明智的时候，更多的利润就来了，不是吗？"

$HeOrShe摆出了一副认真的模样，好像在细细斟酌自己该为这个任务给出怎样的报酬好。" $dsp_reward 星币。"

你估计你需要大约 $dsp_marines 名陆战队员来完成这个任务。

texts.en: "I have an old freighter that's just taking up hangar space. Perhaps you could use it."
texts.zh: "我正好有一个占我船位的旧货船，或许你用得上它。"

texts.en: "I've an old freighter taking up precious volume in the family hangar which I'd much rather fill with a new purchase. Perhaps you'd like it?"
texts.zh: "神父要求我抛弃那艘需要维护的旧货船，说它占用了他的轨道船坞的宝贵空间。我觉得他太不公平了。或许你可以帮我带走这艘船？"

options.zh: 询问这艘旧货船的情况

texts.en:
"It's a vintage $hmdf_hullClass freighter, and I was told by the seller that it'd seen some real adventures. Terribly exciting, I feel, and would have made a fabulous conversation piece had I got around to fixing it up. With my schedule, however..."

"I suppose I ought to charge a fair price - I understand you have your pride, captain, and you would hardly accept charity. $hmdf_price credits, perhaps?"
texts.zh:
"这是一艘成色不错的 $hmdf_hullClass -级 货船，它曾经的主人告诉我说它经历了一些真正的冒险。非常令人激动，不是吗？我想我一旦把它修好了，它一定会成为一个传奇。然而事情总是会变得出乎意料。"

"我想我得让你帮我 '培养我的商业意识'，正如我父亲所要求的那样。你觉得一艘货船能值多少钱？大概 $hmdf_price 星币？"

texts.en: "This $hmdf_hullClass freighter has seen some light-years, but it'll fly. Would be a waste to simply scrap it. I can sell it to you for $hmdf_price credits."
texts.zh: "这艘 $hmdf_hullClass 货船的航行里程已经有好几光年了，不过还能飞，直接拆掉未免太浪费。我可以把它以 $hmdf_price 星币卖给你。"

options.en: Ask for detailed info on the freighter
options.zh: 询问这艘旧货船的详细信息

options.en: Ask for detailed info on the freighter
options.zh: 询问这艘旧货船的详细信息

texts.en:
$personName taps a few buttons to pull up the freighter schematics for your examination.

"I was thinking to augment the engines and install black market safety overrides to achieve a truly impressive burn. What do you make of it?"
texts.zh:
$personName 点击了几下 TriPad，调出这艘货船的示意图给你看。

"我正考虑升级一下引擎，再装个黑市来源的安全协议超驰，那样航速就很令人愉悦。别把我的计划告诉父亲，他肯定会生气的。"

texts.en: $personName taps a few buttons to pull up the freighter schematics for your examination. "For me, it's just taking up space, which is why I'm offering a reasonable price."
texts.zh: $personName 点击了几下 TriPad，调出这艘货船的示意图给你看。"对我来说，留着它只会占用空间，这也是我为什么提供这样合理的价格。"

options.zh: 以 $hmdf_price 星币买下这艘货船
用 $hmdf_price 星币买下这艘货船

texts.en: At a corner table a spacer in a dirty uniform is quietly drowning $hmdf_hisOrHer sorrows.
texts.zh: 在一个角落的桌子上，一名衣冠不整的宇宙民正试图将自己的悲伤悄悄地淹没在酒精饮料里。

options.zh: 和这名醉酒的宇宙民交谈。

texts.en:
"I've got a $hmdf_hullClass freighter. I won't... I won't be needing it any more." $HeOrShe looks at you with reddened eyes that suggest sorrows which require quite a lot of drowning.

"I can sell it to you for $hmdf_price credits," $heOrShe says, then looks down at $hisOrHer half-empty drink. "It was good to me, once."
texts.zh:
"我有一艘蛮久以前入手的 $hmdf_hullClass 货船。我也许...恐怕以后再也用不上它了。" $HeOrShe用泛红的双眼看着你，那眼神中透出的悲伤需要大量的酒精才能淹没。

"我能把它以 $hmdf_price 星币卖给你。" $heOrShe说道，低头看着$heOrShe喝了一半的酒，"它和我处得很好，一直都是。"

options.en: Ask for detailed info on the freighter
options.zh: 询问这艘货船的详细信息

texts.en:
The spacer taps a few buttons on a greasy TriPad so you can see the freighter's schematics.

"Got a few light-years on 'er, for sure. But it'll burn bright and true," $heOrShe says wistfully.
texts.zh:
该船员在满是油污的 TriPad 上点了几下，以便你能看到这艘货船的构造图。

"它确实跑过不少光年了。但它依然能航行无阻，可靠得很。" $heOrShe略带忧伤地说。

options.zh: 以 $hmdf_price 星币买下这艘货船

texts.en: You've arrived at a colony controlled by the Church of Galactic Redemption suitable for offloading the Luddic heretics you rescued from the fringe.
texts.zh: 你们来到了一个由 银河救赎教会 控制的殖民地，这里{适合卸下你从边缘星系救出的卢德异端}。

options.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的异端送到 $name

texts.en:
As promised, you allow the heretics to disembark. Their shuttles are met by a serene curate backed by a pair of frowning Knights of Ludd.

The curate welcomes the refugees with prayer and blessings as they bow, hands clasped, and fall to their knees in repentance.

What was lost is now found, as if returned from death and born again to be embraced by the merciful Faith.
texts.zh:
按照约定，你让那些异端登岸。迎接他们穿梭机的是一位安详的祭司，身后跟着一对皱着眉头的卢德骑士。

祭司用祈祷和祝福欢迎这些难民，难民们先是鞠躬，再双手合十，最后跪地忏悔。

他们感到失而复得，仿佛在仁慈信仰的拥抱下死而复生。

texts.en: You've arrived at a colony controlled by the Church of Galactic Redemption suitable for offloading the Luddic heretics you rescued from the fringe.
texts.zh: 你们来到了一个由 银河救赎教会 控制的殖民地，这里{适合卸下你从边缘星系救出的卢德异端}。

options.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的异端送到 $name

texts.en:
As promised, you allow the lost heretics to disembark. Their shuttles are met by a serene curate backed by a pair of frowning Knights of Ludd. The curate welcomes the refugees as they bow, hands clasped, or fall to their knees in repentance.

Though the Church now shows a face of reconciliation, the Knight-Inquisitors will surely come later for a full accounting of their sins.
texts.zh:
按照约定，你让那些异端登岸。迎接他们穿梭机的是一位安详的祭司，身后跟着一对皱着眉头的卢德骑士。祭司用祈祷和祝福欢迎这些难民，难民们先是鞠躬，再双手合十，最后跪地忏悔。

虽然教会现在表现出了和善的一面，但骑士审判官们日后一定会来彻底清算他们的罪孽。

texts.en: You've arrived at a colony controlled by the Luddic Path suitable for offloading the heretics you rescued from the fringe.
texts.zh: 你们来到了一个由 卢德左径 控制的殖民地，这里{适合卸下你从边缘星系救出的卢德异端}。

options.zh: 用穿梭机把救出的异端送到 $name

texts.en:
The somewhat unconventional body that passes for the port authority has some pointed questions as you arrange for the offloading of nearly two hundred heretics from the fringe.

You iterate rapidly up the chain of authority and find yourself speaking to the equivalent of the top civilian administrator.
texts.zh:
你安排卸下近两百名来自边缘星系的异端的时候，那个行事颇为另类、勉强算得上港口管理局的机构，对你的行为有些尖锐的问题。

你迅速逐级向上交涉，最后你发现正坐在自己对面的是最高民事管理员。

texts.en:
"Heretics?" $Post $personLastName sits up as you explain, intent upon the challenge of bringing more of the Faithful to the true Path of Ludd.

"They have been so very lost," $heOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head as $heOrShe speaks, "First by the corruption and weakness of the Church, then by the demonic rantings of a madman."

"You have done the right thing, $playerBrotherOrSister, to bring them to us. Their first few steps on the Path will be painful, but we shall be at their side to guide them and provide spiritual strength."
texts.zh:
"异端？" 当你解释时，$Post $personLastName 坐了起来，急切地想要把更多的信徒带向正确的卢德之径。

"他们已经如此迷失，" $heOrShe边说边摇头，"这首先归咎于教会的腐败和软弱，当然还有那个疯子的妖言惑众。"

"你做得对，$playerBrotherOrSister，把他们带到我们这里来。他们踏上卢德之径的最初几步，必然痛苦万分，但我们会在他们身边指引他们，给予他们心灵的支柱。"

options.en: I'll have them loaded on shuttles immediately.
options.zh: 我会马上把他们装上穿梭机。

options.en: Show mercy, $brotherOrSister. They were good-intentioned but misled.
options.zh: 发发慈悲吧，$brotherOrSister。他们初心向善，但却误入歧途。

texts.en: The Pather nods. "This step is best done quickly."
texts.zh: 左径分子点了点头。"最好快点完成。"

texts.en:
The matter resolves to a simple business of logistics.

Some of your subordinates are awkward in dealing with Pathers but soon discover that when it comes to practical need the Path knows there are times to set high-minded spiritual demands aside in the interest of expedience.
texts.zh:
这件事最终变成了一个简单的后勤问题。

你的部分下属在与左径分子打交道时感到有些别扭。但他们很快发现，在涉及到实际问题时，这些左径分子也知道为了权益之计，有时需要将崇高的精神需求放在一边。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
The Pather doesn't quite sigh. "Let the compassion you feel now fuel your dedication to an ultimate Good, greater than the small pains they - and we - must carry."

$HisOrHer voice fills with conviction. "In the end, Ludd's promise awaits us all."
texts.zh:
左径分子轻叹了口气。"把你现在所持的同情，化作对至善的献身吧，这会比他们 —— 还有我们 —— 所必须承受的那微不足道的痛苦更伟大。"

$HisOrHer的声音充满信念。"最终，卢德的应许，等候着我们所有人。"

texts.en: "An archcurate of the Church approached me. It seems that they require the services of a space captain with experience travelling outside the core worlds..."
texts.zh: "教会的一个大祭司找到我。看上去他需要一个有在核心世界之外探险经验的太空舰长来帮他的忙..."

options.en: What does the Church need done outside the core worlds?
options.zh: 教会要在核心世界之外干什么？

texts.en:
"As I said, I was approached by an archcurate. I shall not name them, by their request, but it was made known to me that a flock of believers has been led astray by a false and heretical self-proclaimed prophet."

"I know," $heOrShe sighs. "I too would imagine this the business of the Knights of Ludd, and I would be pleased to let their inquisitors deal with heretics as is their wont. But for some reason the Church wants to handle this on their own and it is not my place to speculate why that may be."
texts.zh:
"我说过，有个大祭司找到了我 —— 应大祭司本人要求，姓名不便透露。但我从大祭司那里得知，有位异端妄称先知，将一群信徒带上了歧途。"

"我知道。" $heOrShe叹了口气，"我也想过，这件事本该卢德骑士团出手，我也愿意让他们的审判官按照惯例处置异端。但不知为啥教会想自己处理这件事，具体什么原因就轮不到我来猜了。"

texts.en:
"These false-believers, heretics, pooled money and bought an old transport, then left for some fringe system to 'begin anew', whatever that means. Possibly they're all dead - forgive me, or with Ludd for all that I know. Nonetheless, a non-believing scavenger was the last to spot them burning toward a particular system."

"Will you find them? For the Church?"

"Discover what came of them. Bring news back to me, and then I will report to the archcurate. I've been provided with funds for the operation, $locrlf_rewardAmount credits. It's yours after you bring back news of the heretics."
texts.zh:
"这帮伪信徒，异端，花了笔钱买了艘旧运输船，启程去某个边缘星系 '重新开始'，也不知他们这么说到底是什么意思。他们多半都死了。噢对不起，卢德在上，我就只知道这些。不管如何，他们最后的目击者是一位不信教的拾荒者，他们似乎正向着个特定星系一头扎过去。"

"你能找到他们吗？就当是为了教会？"

 "弄明白他们最后怎么样了，把消息带给我，然后我会转告给大祭司。我手头有批给这次行动的资金，$locrlf_rewardAmount 星币 。只要你带来这帮异端的消息，这笔钱就是你的了。"

options.en: The Church is giving you more than $locrlf_rewardAmount credits for the job, aren't they.
options.zh: “教会批给你的钱不止 $locrlf_rewardAmount 星币，对吧？”

texts.en:
A wave of guilt, quickly suppressed, crosses $hisOrHer face.

"Y-yes, well. It is my place to take a perfectly reasonable broker's fee. Currying talent is honest work, despite what the Ruralist hardliners preach."

$HeOrShe taps $hisOrHer fingers on $hisOrHer comms unit impatiently. "But yes, it's just as well. You've made your point, captain. Let's make the payment $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher credits, if that's what it takes."
texts.zh:
一股负罪感突然涌上$hisOrHer的脸，然后又被$hisOrHer快速压了下去。

"对...对，没错，我当然有权收笔中介费了，又不是啥没理由的事。不管那帮子农村强硬派怎么念经，讨好人才终究还是个正当工作。"

$locrlf_HeOrShe不耐心的敲击着通讯器。"不过也没差，我也懂你什么意思，舰长。你非得多要钱的话，就提到 $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher 星币吧。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you the nav coordinates of $locrlf_systemName and hull ID for the heretics' transport, the 'CGR Light of Exultation'.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe给了你 $locrlf_systemName 的导航坐标，以及异端们所乘运输船的舰船 ID，'CGR Light of Exultation'。

texts.en: A $locrlf_manOrWoman seems to be examining incoming spacer captains and taking notes on a TriPad poorly hidden in a handweave scarf.
texts.zh: 一个$locrlf_manOrWoman似乎正在评估前来的太空舰长，并用在手织围巾里那个藏得不是很好的 TriPad 记笔记。

options.en: Ask if the $locrlf_manOrWoman trying to take secret notes could use some help
options.zh: 询问那个在偷偷做秘密笔记的$locrlf_manOrWoman是否需要帮助

texts.en:
"Oh!" $locrlf_HeOrShe jumps a bit as you speak. "You again. Have you reconsidered?"

$locrlf_HeOrShe lowers $locrlf_hisOrHer voice, "It is a delicate matter, of course. This archcurate wants this stray flock of heretics found, and for some reason is not relying upon the Knight Inquisitors." $locrlf_HeOrShe sighs, "It is not my business to speculate on the doings of the Church, of course."

"Regardless, the heretics bought a transport and burned out into the fringe. They were last seen by a scavenger who reported the sighting to... well, one of the Faithful, anyway. Now if you find them and return to me with conclusive data on what happened to them, I shall give you the Church's reward of $locrlf_rewardAmount credits."
texts.zh:
"哦！" 听到你的话，$locrlf_HeOrShe吓了一跳，"又是你。你重新考虑过了吗？"

$locrlf_HeOrShe压低声音，"当然，这是个棘手的问题。大祭司希望找到这群迷失的异端，而且，出于某种原因，大祭司不希望骑士审判官出手。" $locrlf_HeOrShe叹了口气，"当然，教会的行动也轮不到我去猜。"

"不管怎样，异端们买了一艘运输船，一头扎进了边缘星区。最后看到他们的是某个拾荒者，拾荒者向...好吧，反正是一个信徒报告了此事。现在，如果你找到他们，并带给我关于他们遭遇的确凿证据，我会给你教会提供的 $locrlf_rewardAmount 星币。"

texts.en:
"Oh!" $locrlf_HeOrShe jumps a bit as you speak. "You again. Have you reconsidered?"

$locrlf_HeOrShe lowers $locrlf_hisOrHer voice, "It is a delicate matter, of course. This archcurate wants this stray flock of heretics found, and for some reason is not relying upon the Knight Inquisitors." $locrlf_HeOrShe sighs, "It is not my business to speculate on the doings of the Church, of course."

"Regardless, the heretics bought a transport and burned out into the fringe. They were last seen by a scavenger who reported the sighting to... well, one of the Faithful, anyway. Now if you find them and return to me with conclusive data on what happened to them, I shall give you the Church's reward of $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher credits."
