$locrlf_HeOrShe压低声音，"当然，这是个棘手的问题。大祭司希望找到这群迷失的异端，而且，出于某种原因，大祭司不希望骑士审判官出手。" $locrlf_HeOrShe叹了口气，"当然，教会 的行动也轮不到我去猜。"

"不管怎样，异端们买了一艘运输船，一头扎进了边缘星区。最后看到他们的是某个拾荒者，拾荒者向...好吧，反正是一个信徒报告了此事。现在，如果你找到他们，并带给我关于他们遭遇的确凿证据，我会给你教会提供的 $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher 星币。"

texts.en:
"Oh!" $locrlf_HeOrShe jumps a bit as you speak, then looks you up and down. "Yes, you seem like you would be quite fitting."

"I have," $locrlf_heOrShe drops $locrlf_hisOrHer voice, "a delicate matter to discuss. An archcurate - who I shall not name - made it known to me that a flock of believers was led astray by a heretical self-proclaimed prophet."

$locrlf_HisOrHer eyes are wide with alarm.

"Of course I would imagine this the business of the Knights, and I should be pleased to let their inquisitors deal with heretics as is their wont. But... well, it is not my place to speculate."
texts.zh:
"哦！" $locrlf_HeOrShe听到你的话先是吓了一跳，然后上下打量了你一番。"嗯，你看上去会很适合。"

"我有，"$locrlf_HeOrShe压低声音，"一件微妙的事情想要讨论。一位我不方便透露姓名的大祭司告诉我，有一群信徒被一个妄称先知的异端带上了歧途。"

$locrlf_HisOrHer警觉的瞪大眼睛，"我当然会认为这是骑士团的事，我很乐意让他们的审判官按照惯例处异端。但...好吧，不是我该猜测的事。"

texts.en: $locrlf_personName gives you nav coordinates to $locrlf_systemName, $locrlf_hisOrHer comms ID, and the hull ID of the heretics' transport, the 'CGR Light of Exultation'.
texts.zh: $locrlf_personName 给了你 $locrlf_systemName 的导航坐标，$locrlf_hisOrHer的通信 ID，还有异端们所乘运输船的舰船 ID，'CGR Light of Exultation'。

texts.en:
"Well, let me know if you change your mind."
OR
$HeOrShe seems to think things over. "Perhaps next time."
OR
"Oh well." $HeOrShe shrugs.
OR
"Right," $heOrShe says, "I'm sure I can figure out some alternative."
OR
$HeOrShe nods, brow furrowed, and says "I understand."
OR
A look of disappointment crosses $hisOrHer face, but $heOrShe simply shrugs.
OR
$HeOrShe looks thoughtful, "I see, captain. Your loss I suppose."
OR
"It's a missed opportunity, captain, but it's your decision."
texts.zh:
"好吧，如果你改变主意了，务必告诉我。"
OR
$HeOrShe似乎正在沉思，"或许...下次吧"
OR
"噢，好吧。" $HeOrShe耸了耸肩。
OR
"好吧。" $HeOrShe说，"我想我一定有办法搞定的。"
OR
$HeOrShe点了点头，皱着眉头说："我明白了。"
OR
$HeOrShe的脸上闪过一丝失望的表情，但$HeOrShe只是耸了耸肩。
OR
$HeOrShe若有所思地说："我想...这是你的损失，舰长。"
OR
"很遗憾，舰长，但这是你的决定。"

texts.en:
"These heretics pooled money and bought an old transport, then they left for some fringe system to 'begin anew'. Possibly they're all dead. Forgive me; with Ludd, for all that I know. Nonetheless, a non-believing scavenger was the last to spot them, apparently burning toward... a particular system."

$locrlf_HeOrShe reveals $locrlf_hisOrHer cheap datapad.

"Will you find them? For the Church? Find out what came of them. Bring news back to me, and then I will report to, to the archcurate. I've been provided with funds for the operation, $locrlf_rewardAmount credits. They are yours after you bring back conclusive data on the fate of the heretics."
texts.zh:
"这帮异端花了笔钱买了艘旧运输船，启程去某个边缘星系 '重新开始' 。他们多半都死了。噢对不起，卢德在上，我就只知道这些。不管如何，最后目击他们的是一位不信教的拾荒者，他们似乎正向着个特定星系一头扎过去。"

$locrlf_HeOrShe掏出$locrlf_hisOrHer的廉价数据平板。

"你能帮我找到他们不？就当是为了教会？弄明白他们最后怎么样了，把消息带给我，然后我会转告给大祭司 。我手头有批给这次行动的资金，$locrlf_rewardAmount 星币。只要你给我带来这帮异端下场的确凿证据，这笔钱就是你的。"

options.en: The Church is paying more than $locrlf_rewardAmount credits for the job, aren't they.
options.zh: “教会批给你的钱不止 $locrlf_rewardAmount 星币，对吧？”

texts.en:
A wave of guilt, quickly suppressed, crosses $hisOrHer face.

"Y-yes, well. It is my place to take a perfectly reasonable broker's fee. Currying talent is honest work, despite what the Ruralist hardliners preach."

$locrlf_HeOrShe taps $locrlf_hisOrHer hand on the bartop impatiently.

"It's just as well, then. You've made your point. Let's make the payment $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher credits, if that's what it takes."
texts.zh:
一股负罪感突然涌上$hisOrHer的脸，然后又被$hisOrHer快速压了下去。

"对...对，没错，我当然有权收笔中介费了，又不是啥没理由的事。不管那帮子农村强硬派怎么念经，讨好人才终究还是个正当工作。"

$locrlf_HeOrShe不耐心的敲击着吧台。

"不过也没差，我也懂你什么意思。你非得多要钱的话，就提到 $locrlf_rewardAmountHigher 星币吧。"

texts.en:
You review a ground-level feed from a marine's suit cam. Flashbulbs of demolition charges stutter then after half a breath a heavy roll of thunder catches up with the photons.

With the raid completed and proof uploaded to a secure darknet address, your datapad pings softly to indicate that an anonymous payment has been received.
texts.zh:
你通过陆战队员的随身摄像机获得了实时地面图像传输。爆破的闪光和爆炸声断断续续，随后爆发出一声伴随着耀眼闪光的巨响。

劫掠完成后，相关证明被上传到一个安全的暗网地址，数据平板柔和地 "叮" 了一声，表明你收到了匿名付款。

texts.en: Your $shipOrFleet was recently detected - or is currently being tracked by - a nearby fleet, making a covert spysat deployment impossible.
texts.zh: 周遭舰队最近或者正在跟踪你的$shipOrFleet，目前无法隐秘部署间谍卫星。

texts.en:
Your nav officer reports that your $shipOrFleet has arrived at the coordinates provided by $ssat_personName. The spysat is ready for deployment.

The go-button flashes softly on your command interface.
texts.zh:
你的领航军官表示你的$shipOrFleet已经抵达 $ssat_personName 提供的坐标位置。间谍卫星随时可以部署。

指令界面上，部署按钮轻柔地闪烁着。

texts.en:
The bay doors open, and the spysat is released from its cradle. You watch the display feed as built-in maneuvering thrusters puff softly, guiding it away from your flagship. The image flickers.

Your sensors officer looks up in alarm, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, I don't have a track on the sat. It's just... gone."
texts.zh:
按钮按下，舱门开启。间谍卫星被从固定支架中释放出来。内置的机动推进器带着卫星缓缓地向前离开旗舰，你通过摄像头传回的影像注释着这一过程，屏幕上的图像突然一阵闪烁。

你的传感器技官警觉的抬起头，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我无法追踪到卫星。它就这么... 消失了。"

texts.en:
The bay doors open, and the spysat is released from its cradle. You watch the display feed as built-in maneuvering thrusters puff softly, guiding it away from your flagship. The image flickers.

Your sensors officer looks up in alarm, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, I don't have a track on the sat. It's just... gone."
texts.zh:
按钮按下，舱门开启。间谍卫星被从固定支架中释放出来。内置的机动推进器带着卫星缓缓地向前离开旗舰，你通过摄像头传回的影像注释着这一过程，屏幕上的图像突然一阵闪烁。

你的传感器技官警觉的抬起头，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我无法追踪到卫星。它就这么... 消失了。"

texts.en:
The shuttle makes its final approach to the port district, the pilot overseeing small pings of attitude thrusters.

Your comm link chimes. An incoming request appears - an encrypted voice-only connection from source unknown.
texts.zh:
穿梭机准备在港口区域降落，驾驶员盯着姿态控制推进器的脉冲信号。

你收到了通讯请求，那是一个传入请求 —— 未知来源的加密语音连接。

options.en: Ignore it and head to the bar
options.zh: 忽略它并直接前往酒吧

texts.en:
You accept the comm request. A voice crackles from the staticy display of your TriPad.

"Captain $playerName. I know why you're really here. I believe you and I can resolve this situation personally, though I must remain anonymous due to political considerations."

"I recognize that your capability to employ deadly force is not insignificant. I wish to propose a path of least bloodshed."

"You will have to trust me, captain. And, naturally, I cannot simply give you what you want; it will come at the price of $extr_storyCost credits. I hope you find this an acceptable compromise, given the alternative."
texts.zh:
你接受了通讯请求，TriPad 上充满静电干扰的图像里传出了声音。

"$playerName 舰长。我知道你来这里的真正原因，我相信我们可以私下解决这个问题，但出于政治考虑，我必须保持匿名。"

"我很清楚你动用致命武力的能力不容小觑。因此我想给出一些建议，能避免不必要的流血牺牲。"

"舰长，您一定要相信我。当然，我不能就这么把你想要的送给你；它的价格是 $extr_storyCost 星币。我希望对你来说这是笔合算的交易。"

options.en: Cooperate with the voice and pay the credits
Close the connection and head to the bar

texts.en:
The voice provides you with a numbered burner account for the credits transfer.

"Excellent, captain," the anonymized  voice says, "I confirm receipt of your payment. From this point it'll take only a short time for the arrangements to be made."

The voice gives you instructions to head to a particular bar, $extr_barName, near the concourse. "Goodbye, Captain $playerName," it says one last time.

With the sinking feeling that your target - and credits -might be further away from you with each passing minute, you enter the bar.
texts.zh:
对方为你提供了一个一次性账户用于转账。

"太好了，舰长，" 那个声音说，"我确认已经收到了你的付款。现在我需要一点时间来做些安排。"

这个声音指示你去一个特定的酒吧，名为 $extr_barName，它在广场附近。"再见，$playerName 舰长，" 声音最后这么说到。

时间一分一秒地过去，你的目标 —— 以及星币 —— 可能都会离你而去，带着这种消沉的感觉，你走进了酒吧。

texts.en:
The proprietor looks up as soon as you step into the dim tube-lit interior. "Hey!" You tense, at the tone. "You can't just let your friend sleep here, I'm not running a hotel yeah?" This must be $extr_barOwner.

$extr_barOwner pulls you toward a dark end of the bar where a figure appears to be passed out drunk; a rad-reflective hood has fallen over their face. You pull it back, and it is indeed your extraction target. Looking a little pale, unconscious, and drooling, but the face matches your intel.

"I don't want any trouble, maybe your friend's on chems, I don't ask questions. But see, I took care of 'em right? No call to municipal. Now you take your friend and go now. Go, get out!" He tries to shoo you toward the door as you lift the slack body.
texts.zh:
你一走进昏暗的灯管照明的室内，店主就抬起头来。"嘿！" 你被这语气吓了一跳。"你不能就这么让你的朋友睡在这里，我这可不是开旅馆的，明白吗？" 这个人一定就是 $extr_barOwner 了。

$extr_barOwner 把你拉到酒吧的一个角落里，那里有一个似乎喝醉了的人，一个防辐射面具一样的东西罩住了他的脸。你把那东西拿开，发现这人果然就是你的营救目标。对方的脸色有些苍白，失去了知觉，还流着口水，但你知道这张脸和你的情报相符。

"也许你的朋友在磕药，但我不想惹麻烦，我不会问不该问的。你看，我把他照顾得很好吧？我没打市政电话。所以现在你带着你的朋友走吧。走，出去！" 当你抬起那松弛的身体时，他试图把你推出酒吧。

options.en: Wait, how did you recognize me?
options.zh: 等等，你怎么认出我来的？
我的 '朋友' 是怎么来的？

texts.en:
Outside the bar you pass the unconscious form to one of your bodyguards, whose subtle augments make carrying the limp form a matter of casual ease.

The automedic on the shuttle back reports that the agent was heavily and expertly sedated.

Returned to consciousness in secure quarters on your flagship, the agent is suspicious and uncooperative until you give the confirmation phrase you were provided. Calmer now, they have no explanation for how they ended up in $extr_barName.

Maybe it doesn't matter; you just have to get them back, get your pay, and the job is done.
texts.zh:
离开酒吧后，你把这个失去知觉的家伙递给了你的一个保镖，对方使用了一些巧妙的技巧，让搬人看起来变得轻松了不少。

在穿梭机上，检查报告显示特工被人用熟练的手法注射了大量镇静剂。

在你旗舰上的安全区域恢复意识后，特工一开始满腹狐疑，完全没有展现出合作的态度 —— 直到你对上了暗号。冷静下来后，他也无法解释自己为什么会在 $extr_barName。

也许这无关紧要，你只需要把他找回来，拿到工资，任务就完成了。

texts.en:
$extr_barOwner rolls his eyes, "Your other friend showed me your holo, said look, my other friend the space captain is coming to pick this one up."

"Now you get going, I don't want people thinking my drinks are bad or maybe $extr_barOwner runs a place with no class. Go, go!"
texts.zh:
$extr_barOwner 翻了翻白眼："你的另一个朋友给我看了你的全息照，说：看，我的另一位朋友，这位舰长会来接这个人。"

"现在快走吧，我不想让人们认为我的酒不好，或者 $extr_barOwner 经营的餐厅没有档次。走，走！"

texts.en:
$extr_barOwner sighs loudly, "I tell you, then you go right? Now here's what I tell you: I didn't see anything. I'm running a spacer bar, not a children's creche. People come in, people go out. I don't look too close, I don't ask important questions, it's 'good run?', or 'price of fuel ain't what it was eh?'. That's the business."

"We made a deal, now you're leaving. Out, out!"
texts.zh:
$extr_barOwner 大声叹了口气："我告诉你，然后你马上就会走的对吧？现在我告诉你：我什么都没看见。我开的是太空佬酒吧，不是托儿所。人来人往。我不会多管闲事，也不会问重要的问题，只会问 '近况如何？' 或者 '燃料又涨价了不是吗？'，这就是本分。"

"我们说好了的，现在你快走。出去，出去！"

texts.en:
The concourse is in chaos. A crowd of protestors in Luddic greens has formed a human barrier across the main entrance. Surrounding them are angry spacers, officers and crew alike, waiting to enter the commercial promenade or return to their ships.

A small contingent of local MuniSec holds the shouting crowds apart - barely.
texts.zh:
港区陷入了一片混乱，一群身着卢德绿袍的抗议者在主要出入口形成了人墙。周遭堵满了想要进入商业街或返回舰船的宇宙民、军官与船员，他们现在怒气冲天。

一支地方安全部的小分队勉强把喧闹的人群隔开。

texts.en: You take a shuttle down to the main concourse and quickly find a likely-looking establishment.
texts.zh: 你搭乘穿梭机来到主港区内，很快就找到了一家看起来还不错的店。

texts.en: As you enter the bar you are buffeted by the human white-noise of conversation and revelry. Ad-holos buzz softly from ceiling-mounted units, shining garish highlights through glasses and bottles as spacer crews mingle with merchants and locals trading drinks for rumor, jobs, and opportunities.
texts.zh: 刚踏入酒吧，人群的嘈杂与喧嚣立即扑面而来。天花板上的全息广告装置发出柔和的嗡嗡声，将艳俗的广告铺撒在杯盏交错之间。宇宙民们混杂在生意人和本地人当中，用酒水换取流言、工作和机遇。

texts.en:
As you enter the bar you are buffeted by the white-noise of conversation. A spacer at a cheap table looks at you and shock crosses their face. They nudge the merchant on the seat beside, and point. A hush falls over the bar. The ad-holos buzz softly, shining garish highlights through glasses.

Several groups rise and leave, glaring acidly; one spacer spits at your feet, muttering curses. Your guards' hands find their weapons, but nothing more is necessary. You enter the bar, quieter than you found it; most drinkers do their best to pretend they didn't see you.
texts.zh:
刚踏入酒吧，谈话的喧嚣立即扑面而来。一个坐在廉价吧台后的宇宙民看到了你，脸上不由自主地掠过一丝震惊。他和同伴推了推坐在一旁的商人，还指了指你。一片寂静开始在酒吧里蔓延开来，只有全息广告装置依旧轻声作响，在杯盏之间投射着艳俗的广告。

有几群人起身离开了，临走前不忘酸溜溜地瞪了你一眼。一个宇宙民向你的脚下吐了口唾沫，低声咒骂了一句什么。你的卫兵把手放到了武器上，但暂时没有拔出来的必要。你找到了明显比之前安静了许多的吧台，在你走向那边时，大部分的酒客都尽力假装没看到你。

texts.en:
As you enter the bar you are buffeted by the white-noise of conversation. A spacer at a cheap table looks at you with a double-take of recognition. They elbow their drinking companions, stand, and aggressively - unsteadily - approach you. At three meters they halt as they just now spot your guards, who have made themselves less inconspicuous.

"You! You can't go doing what you're doing," the spacer finds words are preferable now to a physical altercation. "Throwing i-pulses at the hyperspace beasties and the ghosties. It's bad luck. Bad, bad luck going shoutin' at things yer not meant to!" They've begun shouting at you, which you feel violates the generalized principle. "-'ll be the death of us all!"

The spacer's comrades, eyeing you, pull their loud companion back toward a quiet corner. A few onlookers make corrupted motions of Luddic blessing; spacer signs against ill-omen.
texts.zh:
刚踏入酒吧，谈话的喧嚣扑面而来。一个坐在廉价吧台后的宇宙民看到了你，脸上不由自主地掠过一丝震惊。他们用手肘顶了顶喝得醉醺醺的同伴，站起身，不怀好意地靠过来。注意到你身边乔装打扮过的警卫后，他们在三米开外的地方停了下来。

"你！你做那些事情是会遭报应的！" 那个宇宙民没法动手，就转而寻找些适合当下的言语开骂了过来，"朝那些超空间野兽和幽灵丢阻断脉冲是会倒大霉的。晦气！太晦气了！干这一行的都知道不该朝这些东西大吼的！" 对方的言辞逐渐激烈，让你觉得自己好比犯下了基本原则方面的大错一样。"这会害我们所有人送命的！"

这个宇宙民的同伴一边盯着你，一边把他们的大嗓门同伴拉回安静的角落。一些围观的人做着各种有些走样的卢德教派祈福动作，这是宇宙民驱邪的动作。

texts.en: The lounge is adorned on all surfaces in richly gilt geometrics; black marble columns underlit by cool light-tubes seem to hang effortlessly in the air. Corporate climbers, either slick Tri-Tachyon careerists or wannabes in crisp suits, negotiate deals while buying one another increasingly unlikely cocktails. A few spacers engage in subdued drinking in the low seats, glancing uneasily at what is either abstract art or some kind of holo-projection rig looming from the ceiling.
texts.zh: 酒座里的各个墙面都装饰着富丽堂皇的镀金几何图形。黑色大理石柱沐浴在冷光管的柔光之下，雍容华贵地悬在空中。在速子科技名利场里打拼的家伙们全都西装革履，在谈生意的同时不断买来价格越来越离谱的鸡尾酒请客。一些宇宙民则在矮靠背椅上低调地喝着酒，有些局促地瞥着那些若隐若现地从天花板上投影下来的不知是抽象艺术还是全息投影的东西。

texts.en: The space is dark and filled with shouts, sweat, and pulsing music. Every wall and surface is pitted and stained by rough spacers banging their mugs and laughing as a couple of pirate crews posture for a fight. You can only assume that one of the heavily augmented bouncers will spoil the fun before weapons are drawn. Gangers and pirate captains watch the scene smugly from smoke-filled booths at the back.
texts.zh: 昏暗的空间里塞满了呐喊、汗臭和律动着的音乐。正好有两拨海盗船员摆出了要干上一架的样子，惹得酒吧里这群粗野的太空佬们大笑起哄，抄起他们手中的杯子给所有的墙和桌面又敲上了一层坑洼和污渍。看来你只能指望在有人拔枪干起来之前，那群全身堆满生化改造的看场保安里会出来个人扫一扫大家的兴头。在后面烟雾缭绕的隔间里，帮派分子和海盗舰长们看着这场面有些满意地笑了起来。

texts.en: You enter the crowded, well-lit space and take in the rows of taps adorning the wall under bottles from every one of the Core Worlds - and a few from elsewhere. Merchant-captains mingle with off-duty officers at the bar, served efficiently by the uniformed staff. In one corner, a pack of navy cadets shout and sing, desperately enjoying their last work-shift of freedom.
texts.zh: 刚踏入这明亮而拥挤的地方，你的目光就被缀满墙上的一排排酒水龙头吸引过去。龙头上的瓶装酒产地遍布核心世界的每个星球，甚至还有几种出自边缘地带的酒水。商船舰长和休班军官在酒吧里打成一片，穿着制服的工作人员麻利地穿梭其间。在一个角落里，一群海军学员正高唱呐喊，拼命地享受着他们最后一班的自由。

texts.en: You enter the bar, leaving the noisome propaganda broadcasts of the throughway behind. Off-duty laborers drink away their ration credits dutifully at benches set beneath Diktat insignia. In one corner a cadre of finely dressed officer-bureaucrats calls for another round. Even here, a larger-than-life holo of the Lion of Sindria looks down on you as you decide what to do.
texts.zh: 你进入酒吧，把宣传政治大方向的嘈杂广播抛在了身后。下班的劳动者们聚在 辛达强权 标志下方的长凳上，尽职尽责地喝掉他们的粮票。角落里，一群衣着光鲜的军官和文职人员叫嚣着要再来一轮。就算在这种地方，也有个比真人更伟岸的辛达瑞亚之狮全息投影俯视着你，等着你做出下一步的决定。

texts.en: You enter the bar, leaving the noisome propaganda broadcasts of the throughway behind. Off-duty laborers drink away their ration credits dutifully at benches set beneath the new Diktat insignia. In one corner a cadre of finely dressed officer-bureaucrats calls for another round.
texts.zh: 你走进酒吧，把通道里那吵人的宣传广播关在了身后。歇了工的劳工坐在新换的强权徽记下的长凳上，本分地把配给信用点喝个精光。角落里，一伙衣冠考究的军官官僚又招呼着再来一轮。

texts.en: As you enter the bar, you sense a lively tension between the crews from across the League worlds. Dour Kazeronians in fine uniforms drink spirits while proud but poor Mayasurans down pints of rice-beer. A crew of Tylians trade rounds and boasts with a couple Zaganian bridge officers who are making a poor example of Luddic temperance. Glowing displays show media feeds from all the worlds of the League, and their speakers contribute to a dull roar of human white noise.
texts.zh: 从进入酒吧的那一刻起，你就感受到了来自联盟世界各地的船员之间求同存异的氛围。不苟言笑的 Kazeron 人身着光鲜的制服喝着烈酒，旁边高傲但落魄的 Mayasura 人则一扎又一扎地灌着稻啤酒。一群 Tyle 船员与几名 Zagan 舰桥军官边吹牛边拼酒，为卢德教规提倡的节制立了个坏榜样。众多显示屏五光十色地展示着来自联盟各个行星的媒体资讯，而它们的扬声器也为这众人的喧哗平添了一分吵闹。

texts.en: You duck past notices encouraging temperance and restraint as you enter the bar. Someone is playing a stringed instrument in an alcove. A row of handworked samovars suggests that tea is served as often as the weak grain-brew favored by the crew of rough-looking laborers at the bar. Many of the patrons at tables or booths seem to be off-worlders or local unbelievers huddling in the closest analog to a den of sin that can be found.
texts.zh: 你低头避开了鼓励节欲与克制的告示牌，走入酒吧。角落的凹室里有人在演奏着某种弦乐器。吧台旁边一排手工制作的茶炊，提醒你这里经常供应茶水，销量可能和吧台上那些劳工大老粗们爱喝的淡啤酒差不多。不少看起来像是外星访客的人和不信教的当地人聚集几张桌台附近，交流买卖着情报，构成了这里最像罪恶巢穴的地方。

texts.en: A weathered brute from the local vice squad stares rudely as you pass, but does not stop you as you enter the door. They want you to know that they could shut the place down at any time - but an illicit teahouse-bar is a useful conduit with the commerce required to carry out holy war. Inside it is dim, the ceiling low, and the crowd packed. The stench of drug fumes and cheap liquor competes with bodies that disdain modern enzyme soaps.
texts.zh: 在你经过时，当地惩戒团的一头饱经沧桑的彪形大汉狠狠地瞪了你一眼，但并没有阻止你进门。他们只是想让你知道，要不是能为开展圣战提供有利的交易渠道，这样一个违禁的茶楼酒肆他们随时都可以取缔掉。在这昏暗压抑且拥挤不堪的地方里，因不屑使用现代酶制香皂而产生的独特体臭四处弥漫，与毒品烟雾和廉价烈酒的恶臭争奇斗艳。

texts.en: As you enter the bar you are struck by the lack of conversation and revelry. Ad-holos promoting Mbaye-Gogol cryosanctum packages buzz softly from ceiling-mounted units, shining cool highlights through glasses and bottles as subdued spacer crews mingle. A few merchant-captains hold a low conversation while ignoring the few local employees who seem mostly content to drink alone.
texts.zh: 你一进门便觉出这里既无谈笑，也无喧闹。天花板上装的装置低低嗡鸣，播着 Mbaye-Gogol 低温圣所套餐的广告全息影像，冷光透过杯盏瓶罐洒下，几群神色收敛的太空人船员在其中走动。几位商船船长压低了嗓子交谈，对那几个本地雇员不理不睬，而他们倒也多半乐得独饮。

texts.en: A shift-worker in a utilitarian jumpsuit, a few burns and patches, approaches the bar besides you. They never meet your eye. "Someone would like to talk with you." It's almost a mutter; difficult to make out "Set you on the right... path. If you please, follow me."
texts.zh: A shift-worker in a utilitarian jumpsuit, a few burns and patches, approaches the bar besides you. They never meet your eye. "Someone would like to talk with you." It's almost a mutter; difficult to make out "Set you on the right... path. If you please, follow me."

texts.en: The proprietor catches your eye as you enter the bar, sets down a glass, and nervously approaches you.
texts.zh: The proprietor catches your eye as you enter the bar, sets down a glass, and nervously approaches you.

texts.en: "Hear me, I beg," she says. "I've nothing to do with him or his people. You... you can\'t refuse them here, captain."
texts.zh: "Hear me, I beg," she says. "I've nothing to do with him or his people. You... you can\'t refuse them here, captain."

texts.en: She glances unconsciously toward a table with some heavies wearing the uniform of one of the mining guilds. They're watching you both, very closely. "The back room. He's waiting. I- I saw nothing today."
texts.zh: She glances unconsciously toward a table with some heavies wearing the uniform of one of the mining guilds. They're watching you both, very closely. "The back room. He's waiting. I- I saw nothing today."

texts.en:
The shuttle makes its final approach to the port district, the pilot overseeing small pings of attitude thrusters.

Your comm link chimes. An incoming request appears - an encrypted voice-only connection from source unknown.
texts.zh:
穿梭机准备在港口区域降落，驾驶员盯着姿态控制推进器的脉冲信号。

你收到了通讯请求，那是一个传入请求 —— 未知来源的加密语音连接。

options.en: Don't go to the back room
Ignore it and head to the bar
options.zh: 忽略它并直接前往酒吧

texts.en:
You recognize the Hegemony $post, $name speaking orders into a small comms unit. $HeOrShe notices you, and nods you over.

"Luddics protesting the planet-side burns," $heOrShe explains. "Get these every other week due to the pilgrims. They consider it a sort of rite of passage."

$HeOrShe one-arm shrugs to suggest that $heOrShe doesn't find the matter worth getting too upset over, then speaks another string of tactical jargon into $hisOrHer comms.
texts.zh:
你认出了那个霸主 $post，$name 正通过一个小型通讯器下达着命令。$HeOrShe注意到了你，并向你点头示意。

"卢德教徒正在抗议轨道焚化。" $HeOrShe解释说，"由于朝圣者的原因，这种事情每隔一周就会发生一次。他们都把这当成朝圣之路上的某种仪式了。"

$HeOrShe耸了耸半边肩膀，一副这事也不值得让$HeOrShe太上心的样子。随后$hisOrHer对着通讯器又说了一串战术术语。

options.en: Pilgrims? Is there some kind of shrine here?
options.zh: 朝圣者？这附近有圣地吗？

options.en: Use your commission with the Hegemony to pass
options.zh: 利用你与霸主的雇佣关系来通过这里

options.en: Use your standing with the Church to pass
options.zh: 利用你与教会的关系来通过这里

options.en: Wait for the authorities to clear the protest
options.zh: 等待当局驱散抗议人群

options.en: Join the protestors, help them take a stand
options.zh: 加入抗议者，帮他们表明立场

options.en: Offer your marines to help clear the protest
options.zh: 派遣你的陆战队员辅助当局驱散抗议者

options.en: Use your marines to muscle through right now
options.zh: 派遣你的陆战队员强行开路

texts.en:
"Not here," $heOrShe says, eyes not leaving the protestors. "On the surface. For appreciating the local plant-life. Don't understand why, you wouldn't believe how toxic the stuff is. Detox after exposure is like a week of hangover compressed down into a day or two."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "At least that's what it felt like for me. Guess they like suffering. Luddics for you. Top brass says we gotta humor 'em. Politics, right?"

A burst of coded garble comes through the comms, and the $post gives a short response. "Gendarmerie will be here soon if you want to stay for the show," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
"有，不过不在这里，" $heOrShe说，视线并没有离开抗议者，"是在地表上，朝圣者们喜欢在那欣赏当地的植物。我不理解。你想象不到那些玩意的毒性有多强。人体暴露在那种环境中后，后续的排毒过程十分痛苦，好比是把整整一周的宿醉压缩到一至两天。"

$HeOrShe摇了摇头。"反正我的亲身体验就是这样的。可能这帮人就是喜欢受苦吧。这就是卢德信徒。上面的人说我们必须迁就他们。这就是政治，对吧？"

通讯器中传来一阵噪声，$post给出了一个简短的回答。"如果你想看看接下来会发生什么，宪兵马上就到了。" $heOrShe说。

texts.en: Suddenly the $rank does a double-take. "$playerName? That's you, isn't it? Commissioned Auxiliary, right? Had an alert come through when you entered orbit."
texts.zh: 突然，$rank 愣了一下，然后露出了吃惊的表情。"$playerName？那是你，对不对？现役辅助军，对吧？当你进入轨道的时候，触发了一个警报。"

texts.en: "Look, sorry about all of this," $heOrShe indicates the protest. "Tell you what- I can route you and your crew through secure access so you don't have to wait on the circus."
texts.zh: "听着，我对此感到十分抱歉。" $heOrShe表示抗议，"这么和你说吧，我可以把你和你的人送到安全通道，这样你就不必在这马戏场里等着了。"

options.zh: 谢了，但是我会在这等着。

texts.en: The $rank waves a cadet over, giving them instructions to lead you, your guards, and a few of your crew given shore leave - who are looking increasingly impatient - through an alternate route to the commercial promenade.
texts.zh: $rank 挥手招来一名学员，指示他带着你，你的警卫和一些获准上岸的船员 —— 他们看起来越来越不耐烦 —— 从另一条路线前往商业街。

texts.en: The $rank nods, and returns to the comms with more professional focus now; the gendarmerie can't be far off.
texts.zh: $rank 点了点头，带着更加专业和专注的状态回到了通讯中；宪兵应该不远了。

texts.en:
You wait. The crowd grows, and grows less patient - a minority jeers and shouts, a few spacers start throwing trash. The Luddics perform their chant-prayer, calling for an end to the orbital burns, arms locked. From fights breaking out, it is clear that there is much support for the Luddic cause outside of the overt protestors.

It feels near a boiling point when heads start to turn and you see a dark regiment of lightly armored troopers deploy from columns into a wedge. Security drones hum overhead, targeting lasers and ID-cams flickering.
texts.zh:
你冷眼旁观。聚集的人越来越多，也越来越没有耐心 —— 一小部分人发出嘲笑和叫喊，有些宇宙民开始朝人群丢垃圾。卢德教徒们手拉着手，吟唱祷文，呼吁停止使用轨道射线焚烧地表植被。从打斗中可以看出，除了公开的抗议者，还有许多人支持这项运动。

当局势接近失控时，人们突然转头看向一个方向，你发现一支装备轻武器的秘密部队正从方队改为楔形队列。治安无人机在人群头顶上嗡嗡作响，瞄准激光和 ID 扫描仪不停闪烁着。

texts.en:
A steady advance breaks the protest line apart, shock-prods rise and fall to silence shouts and screams. It is difficult to see through the pacification gas, but you can make out drones deploying restraint foam on struggling forms. The Luddics' fists, signs, and even hammers are useless against the power-armored gendarmerie.

"You may pass safely, citizen," a drone buzzes at you in a pleasant voice.

Stepping toward the main promenade, you turn to find that you've left a diminishing trail of blood-spots. A scuff or two of your heel on the deck plate takes care of the problem.
texts.zh:
军队的稳步推进冲散了抗议者的队列，他们挥舞着手中的电击棒，让所有尖叫和呼喊都归于虚无，透过镇暴气体，你可以模糊的辨认出无人机正在释放抑制泡沫来压制挣扎的人。卢德信徒的拳头，标语牌，甚至是铁锤，在装备动力装甲的宪兵面前显得苍白无力。

"你可以安全通过了，公民。" 一架无人机以悦耳的声音对你嗡嗡作响。

当你大步走向主港区时，你转过身来，发现脚上沾满了抗议者的鲜血，在身后留下一排逐渐模糊的血脚印。你用鞋跟在甲板上猛蹭了两下，摆脱了这点不适。

texts.en:
You calmly approach the Luddic protestors, asking to speak to an organizer. They are reluctant to identify a leader who would make an obvious target for MuniSec guards, but soon enough you are recognized by one of the better-dressed Luddics. It appears that your reputation precedes you.

They enthusiastically vouch for you, "a true friend of the Church", and manage to persuade the protestors to clear a path for you and your landing party.

As you step into the commercial promenade, past merchants and spacers annoyed at your special treatment, you begin to hear amplified orders to disperse from the Hegemony gendarmerie.
texts.zh:
你冷静地走向卢德抗议者们，请求与他们的组织者谈一谈。他们虽然冒着被地方安全部重点关注的风险请出了一位领导者，但看起来很不情愿。不过很快，你就被一名衣冠楚楚的卢德信众认出来了 —— 看起来你已经声名远扬。

他们热情地担保你为 "教会真正的朋友"，并且设法说服抗议者们，为你和你的登陆小队让出一条道路。

在你走过那些被你的特殊待遇惹恼的商人和宇宙民，去往商业街的时候，你开始听到 霸主 宪兵那音量放大的驱散命令。

texts.en:
You step forward, proclaiming that you wish to join the protest. At first the Luddics are disbelieving, but as you turn to face the bewildered MuniSec guards and take up the Luddic chant-prayer, a small cheer erupts.

You see $PersonRank $personLastName shake $hisOrHer head in disbelief.
texts.zh:
你迈步向前，宣称你也希望加入抗议。起初，卢德信众并不相信，但随着你转身面对困惑的地方安全部守卫，并开始颂唱卢德祷文，人群中爆发出一阵小小的欢呼。

你看到 $PersonRank $personLastName 难以置信地摇着头。

texts.en: Later, you compare bruises and cuts with your fellow protestors. Your bodyguards, reacting admirably to the unusual situation, managed to shield you from the worst of the gendarmes' beatings, pacification gas, and restraint foam. But you took your hits and have proven yourself to these Luddic pilgrims. You take the opportunity to explain that-
texts.zh: 不久之后，你和你的抗议者同伴们相互打量着身上的淤青和切口。面对这样异乎寻常的情景，你的保镖做出了绝佳的反应，设法将你从宪兵们最毒辣的殴打，镇静气体，以及拘束泡沫中保了下来。不过你还是挨了几下，向这些卢德朝圣者证明了自己。趁此机会，你解释道 ——

options.en: Despite being a non-believer, you support their rights
options.zh: 尽管身为一名无信者，你还是支持他们的权利

options.en: This shared experience brings you all closer to Ludd
options.zh: 共患难的经历令你们离卢德更近了

options.en: In due time, the heretics will pay for these beatings ten-fold
options.zh: 终有一日，要十倍地将这顿毒打奉还给那些异端

options.en: You just wanted to feel what it was like to lose a fight
options.zh: 你只是想尝尝战败的滋味

texts.en:
The pilgrims welcome you as a respectable outsider, pledging hospitality if you visit their homesteads and congregations.

They tell you of the shrine of Jangala, and of being exposed to the toxic xenolife - far more painful, they claim, than anything MuniSec could do to them.

Your name is called from the commsplate.
texts.zh:
朝圣者们欢迎你的到来，认为你是一位可敬的外乡人。他们承诺，如果你来拜访他们的家宅和会众，那你一定会得到殷勤接待。

他们告诉你 Jangala 圣地的事，并讲述着暴露在剧毒异种生命下的体验 —— 他们声称，这种痛苦甚至远胜于地方安全部最酷烈的暴行。

通信板呼叫了你的名字。

texts.en:
It's $rank $personName again, $hisOrHer demeanor cold and martial.

"The rules are simple, captain," $heOrShe says, ice-cold, "And we've been very, very lenient with you. But there seems to be a failure to communicate, so let me explain in very small words how it works around here."

A guard sets a plastic tray of your personal belongings on the battered table of the processing room. The Hegemony $rank continues, slowly; each word given emphasis. "Pay your tariffs. Don't disrupt business."

$HeOrShe turns and motions at some guards, "Now get out of my sight."
texts.zh:
来者又是 $personName $rank，举止冷峻，金戈铁马。

"规矩很简单，舰长。" $HeOrShe语气冰冷，"我们对你已经极其，极其的宽容了。然而，看起来交涉还是失败了，那我就用最简短的话来把这儿的规矩说清楚。"

一名警卫把装着你个人物品的塑料托盘放在审讯室那破旧的桌子上。与此同时，这名 霸主 $rank 逐字逐句地继续说道："付关税，别碍事。"

$HeOrShe转过身对警卫打了个手势，"现在，你可以滚了。"

texts.en:
You are shoved, squinting, into the bright light of the plaza outside of the municipal security processing center.

Dignity largely unbruised, you secure your sidearm (cellmag confiscated), run a quick check on your personal datapad, and give a nod to your second officer - who has been waiting patiently with two hot drinks.
texts.zh:
你被推到市政安全审核中心外面的广场上，明亮的光芒使你不由得眯起眼睛。

你的尊严被很大程度的保留了，你保护好自己的随身武器 (弹匣已没收)，快速检查了自己的私人数据平板，然后对你的二副点了点头 —— 他带着两杯热饮，一直耐心地等着你。

texts.en:
The pilgrims welcome you as one of their own, pledging their hospitality if you visit their homesteads, and promising a seat for you at the front of their congregation's service to welcome returning pilgrims.

They tell you of the shrine of Jangala, and of being exposed to the toxic xenolife - far more painful, they claim, than anything MuniSec can do to them.

Your name is called from the commsplate.
texts.zh:
朝圣者们像欢迎同道那样欢迎你。他们承诺，如果你来拜访他们的家宅和会众，那你一定会得到殷勤接待，并且保证给你在他们会众服务站的前排留一个座位，以便欢迎那些归来的朝圣者。

他们告诉你 Jangala 圣地的事，并讲述着暴露在剧毒异种生命下的体验 —— 他们声称，这种痛苦甚至远胜于地方安全部最酷烈的暴行。

通信板呼叫了你的名字。

texts.en:
Most of the protestors are alarmed by your rhetoric, glancing nervously toward unseen observation devices and drawing away from your corner of the holding cell. Though a couple younger pilgrims and one much older, with scars to show his commitment, remain near you, eyes daring the others to speak their criticism aloud.

"We hear you, $playerBrotherOrSister. The end of the Path is near," he whispers, and tells you of the Jangala Shrine, of mortification of the flesh through exposure to the xenolife - worse than anything MuniSec could hope to inflict.

Your name is called from the commsplate.
texts.zh:
大多数抗议者被你的激进言论吓到，紧张的瞥了一眼不可视的监视装置，抽身离开了属于你的牢房角落。尽管几个年轻的朝圣者和一位老者 —— 他身上的伤痕记述着他的奉献 —— 留在你身旁，目光盯着其他人，大声批判着。

"我们听说过你，$playerBrotherOrSister，卢德之道的终点已经近在咫尺。" 他轻声耳语，对你讲述着 Jangala 圣地的事，讲述着暴露在异种生命中对肉身所造成的折辱 —— 远远超过地方安全部的任何打压手段。

通信板呼叫了你的名字。

texts.en: The Luddic protestors are confused and even a little alarmed by your explanation - it seems they've been locked in with a crazy person. They physically draw away from your corner of the holding cell until your name is called through the commsplate.
texts.zh: 这些卢德抗议者们对你的解释感到困惑，甚至有点害怕 —— 看起来他们和一个狂人关在一起了。他们挪动身体离开了属于你的牢房角落，直到通信板呼叫了你的名字。

texts.en: The $faction $rank shakes $hisOrHer head. "Appreciate the patriotic gesture, citizen, but we'll handle this. Got to be delicate," $heOrShe says with annoyance, "It's very... political."
texts.zh: $faction $rank摇了摇$hisOrHer的头。"感谢你的爱国情怀，公民，但我们会处理这件事，这事一定要谨慎，" $heOrShe恼怒地说，"这件事...非常有政治影响。"

texts.en: Suddenly the $rank does a double-take. "$playerName? That's you, isn't it? Commissioned Auxiliary, right? Had an alert come through when you entered orbit."
texts.zh: 突然，$rank 愣了一下，然后露出了吃惊的表情。"$playerName？那是你，对不对？现役辅助军，对吧？当你进入轨道的时候，触发了一个警报。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe seems to think it over for a second, then glances at a small datapad.

"Tell you what; get your marines here in three minutes and subsume to my command, here's the comm-code. I want min-force, zero fire and flash; weapons locked to my authorization."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe想了一小会，然后看向了一个小数据平板。

"给我听好了；让你的陆战队员在三分钟之内过来，一切听我的指挥，这是通讯代码。我要以最低限度的武力来镇压叛乱，任何会发光和喷火的玩意都不要；武器必须在我的授权下才准许使用。"

options.en: On second thought, I'll let you handle this.
options.zh: 仔细想想，我还是让你来处理吧。

texts.en:
You coordinate a joint response, a squad of your marines able to quickly deploy on the dock-side and coordinate with the Hegemony gendarmerie on the opposite end of the protest. A steady advance breaks the protest line apart with minimal use of force - the Luddics' fists, hammers, and signs useless against power-armored troops.

$Rank $personName is busy coordinating arrests in the aftermath but manages to catch your eye and give a quick half-salute as you leave toward the commercial promenade.
texts.zh:
你组织了一次联合行动，你的陆战队员迅速部署在码头侧面，和位于抗议者们另一头的 霸主 宪兵展开配合。你们的部队稳步推进，以最低限度的武力镇压了抗议队伍 —— 卢德信众的拳头，铁锤，以及标语牌，面对动力装甲部队显得苍白无力。

$Rank $personName 忙着组织事后的逮捕行动，但当你离开此地去往商业街的时候，他还是在百忙中对你示意，快速地向你敬了一个半礼。

texts.en: The $rank nods, distractedly. "As you will, captain."
texts.zh: $rank 心烦意乱地点了点头，"如你所愿，舰长。"

texts.en:
You order a small squad of your own marines, armaments and munitions removed due to port regulations, on a fast shuttle from your $shipOrFleet.

The marines, in full power armor, form a vanguard before you and simply march into the protesting Luddics.
texts.zh:
你从自己的陆战队里要来一支小队，坐着穿梭机从你的$shipOrFleet高速赶来。鉴于港口规定，没有携带武器弹药。

这些陆战队员身着全套动力装甲，在你身前组成一支先锋，仅仅是简单地朝着抗议的卢德信众展开行军，没有其他多余的举动。

texts.en:
The protestors' line is easily broken by your armored marines, as are not a few limbs. The MuniSec guards manage to exploit the situation and corral the protesters - now crying, screaming, and shouting abuse at you in particular - into ineffective huddles.

The Hegemony officer overseeing the official response looks not simply annoyed, but livid.
texts.zh:
抗议者的队列被你全副武装的陆战队员轻而易举地尽数冲散。地方安全部的守卫们趁势出手，迫使这些抗议者们 —— 他们现在哭喊，尖叫着，甚至对你破口大骂 —— 无能为力地缩成一团。

负责监督官方回应的 霸主 官员看起来对你的意见不小，已经脸色发青了。

texts.en:
"I should have you arrested!" $heOrShe shouts, then, ignoring your armored marines - who dare not touch a Hegemony officer on their own station - gets close to your face, "Your little stunt just gave them a propaganda holo that'll recruit hundreds of Pather terrorists," $heOrShe seethes.

"Get your goons out of my sight before I call in the real marines."
texts.zh:
"我真应该逮捕你！" $heOrShe怒吼着赶到你的面前，无视了你那些全副武装的陆战队员 —— 他们也不敢在 霸主 的地盘上对军官撒野，"你愚蠢的行为会被拍进全息图里，而这会带来几百名左径分子，" $heOrShe咬牙切齿地说。

"在我集结真正的军队之前，让你的暴徒滚出我的视线。"
effects: MarketCMD addUnrest jangala 3 "Strikes and protests due to vigilante anti-Luddic violence"

texts.en: As you step onto the commercial promenade you see both crew and locals pointing and staring. Some hold datapad, recording holos...
texts.zh: 当你走进商业街时，你看到船员和当地居民对着什么东西指手画脚。一些人还拿着数据平板和有记录功能的全息影像设备。

texts.en:
As your gaze begins to skim the crowd for potential jobs, a $manOrWoman in spotless Tri-Tachyon executive attire insinuates themself in front of you.

"Captain $playerName, we are so pleased that you have chosen to visit this franchise. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation values your contribution to the local economy," $heOrShe smiles perfectly as you realize that your hand is being shaken.

"If we may sit over here, I would like to discuss a special matter... Company business."
texts.zh:
当你扫视人群寻找潜在的工作机会时，穿着一尘不染的速子高管服装的$manOrWoman神不知鬼不觉地出现在了你面前。

"$playerName，我们很高兴看到您的到来。三一速子科技公司 十分重视您对当地经济的贡献。" $heOrShe边握着你的手边露出了完美的微笑。

"我们能换个地方吗？我想讨论一件特殊的事...公司业务。"

options.zh: 跟随 速子科技 特工

texts.en:
Somehow the Tri-Tachyon agent's smile grows brighter and more perfect. "We just want to clear up a little confusion, you're not in trouble in the least."

"Please," $heOrShe indicates a spot where a curtain has been withdrawn to reveal a private booth that you did not previously notice was even there, "Let us provide you with a complimentary refreshment."
texts.zh:
不知怎么的，速子特工的笑容变得更加灿烂而完美。"我们只想搞清一些事情，您并没有陷入麻烦中。"

"请。" $heOrShe拉开了窗帘，窗帘下是一个你之前根本没有注意到的私人客座，"我们可以为您提供免费茶点。"

options.en: No, thank you. I was just leaving.
options.zh: 谢谢，但是不用。我这就要走了。

texts.en:
You idly tap a pricey drink from the menu and it appears before you within seconds.

Noticing your surprise, the agent explains "Each customer builds a Tri-Taste profile as they enjoy our products. Correlating purchase history with time of day and certain other physiological signifiers allows- " $heOrShe raises $hisOrHer hands apologetically, "I get carried away sometimes. It's my passion for customer satisfaction."

You understand what is being said: We're watching you.

"But we're here to talk about your business," the agent's hand gently points at you without otherwise moving, "Not mine."
texts.zh:
你漫不经心地从菜单上点了昂贵的饮料，几秒钟内它就出现在了你面前。

特工注意到了你的惊讶，解释说："每个顾客在享受我们的产品时，我们都会建立速子口味档案。将购买饮料的时间和其他特定的生理信号联系起来，并以此 —— " $heOrShe举了举$hisOrHer的手以示歉意，"我可能有点太投入了，毕竟让客户满意是我的追求。"

你明白对方想表达什么：我们正在监视你。

"不过我们在这里要谈的是你的事情。" 特工用手轻轻地指了指你，"而不是我的。"

options.en: I don't appreciate being spied on.

texts.en:
"There was an incident recently. The Aztlan Relay was compromised. Very embarrassing for HEGCOM, what with a, ah, history of such incidents. With embarrassment comes a propensity for overreaction, of conclusion leapt at based on long-held biases against the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. Now, we consider the unpleasantness of the AI Wars water under the bridge. After all, there's business to be done."

The agent's smile disappears, and $hisOrHer tone goes cold, "Our shareholders have much to lose. We cannot allow tensions to be inflamed by... adventurism." $HisOrHer eyes narrow, "Nor do I expect the current provost of Galatia to last long in her post. Give some thought to who you choose to do business with."
texts.zh:
"最近发生了一起事故，Aztlan 中继站被瘫痪了。这对 HEGCOM 来说非常尴尬，他们已经有过类似遭遇了。而随着这种尴尬而来的会是过激反应的倾向 —— 考虑到他们对 三一速子科技公司 的偏见，那对象会是我们。我们认为不愉快的 AI 战争都是过去时了，现在还有生意要做呢。"

特工的笑容消失了，语气变得冰冷起来："我们的股东可能会损失惨重，因此我们不能允许紧张局势被...冒险行动所激化。" $HisOrHer的眼睛眯了起来，"我也没指望 Galatia 的现任院长能在她的岗位上呆多久，考虑一下你应该和谁合作。"

options.en: Are you making me an offer?
I don't appreciate being spied on.
Point taken. Thanks for the drink. (leave)
options.zh: 知道了。谢谢你的饮料。 (离开)

texts.en:
For a long few seconds, no response. Then the agent's smile appears again.

"I am pleased to hear that you are receptive to the suggestion," $heOrShe says, then stands. "The Company will be in contact, I'm sure. Thank you for your time, $playerName. I'm certain you will continue to respect the business-friendly environment we cultivate in Tri-Tachyon space and beyond."

The Tri-Tachyon agent disappears into some shadow. You look back at your untouched drink. A bubble breaks onto the surface.
texts.zh:
在接下来的数秒钟内，对方都没有做出任何回应。随后特工脸上的微笑再度浮现。

"我很高兴您能接受这个建议。" $heOrShe说道，然后站了起来，"我敢肯定公司会和您保持联络的。感谢您抽空交流，$playerName。我相信您会继续尊重我们在 速子科技 疆域内以及其他地方培育的商业友好环境。"

速子特工消失在阴影中。你看着你那杯没碰过的饮料，一个气泡缓缓地上升，并在触及液面时破裂了。

texts.en:
You stand from the table, drink untouched.

You almost feel like there's a tingle on the back of your neck as you leave, but the Tri-Tachyon agent is nowhere to be seen.
texts.zh:
你从桌边站起来，连饮料都没碰一下。

当你离开时，你似乎感觉到脖子后面一阵刺痛，但那位 速子科技 特工已不见踪影。

texts.en:
The agent unleashes $hisOrHer perfect smile once more.

"By entering this establishment you have agreed to certain terms and conditions. By entering Tri-Tachyon space- you understand. Besides," $heOrShe drops the perfect smile. "I think you are well beyond that, considering the company you have been keeping."
texts.zh:
特工又一次露出了$heOrShe那完美的微笑。

"进入本场所的行为表明您已经同意了某些条款和条件，您明白我在说什么。此外..." $heOrShe维持着微笑，"考虑到一直以来的伙伴关系，我认为您了解的远不止于此。"

options.en: Is this about Baird and the Galatia Academy? Or Gargoyle? Arroyo maybe?
options.zh: 这是关于 Baird 和 Galatia 学院的事？还是 Gargoyle？又或者 Arroyo？

options.en: Point taken. Thanks for the drink. (leave)
options.zh: 知道了。谢谢你的饮料。 (离开)

texts.en:
$HeOrShe stands, leveling $hisOrHer eyes down at you "The Tri-Tachyon Corporation thanks you for your business and wishes you safe travels. I'm sure you will continue to respect the business-friendly environment we cultivate in Tri-Tachyon space and beyond."

The Tri-Tachyon agent disappears into some shadow. You look at your untouched drink. A bubble breaks onto the surface.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe站了起来，用$hisOrHer的眼睛俯视着你："三一速子科技公司 感谢您的合作，并祝您一路平安。我相信您会继续尊重我们在 速子科技 疆域内外培育的商业友好环境。"

速子特工消失在阴影中。你看着你那杯没碰过的饮料，一个气泡缓缓地上升，并在触及液面时破裂了。

texts.en:
The agent looks nervous, breaking $hisOrHer facade and looking around as if for eavesdroppers.

"That's quite enough, captain," $heOrShe says somewhat more loudly, cutting you off, "I think we've all said our part." $HeOrShe stands, leveling $hisOrHer eyes down at you "The Tri-Tachyon Corporation thanks you for your business and we wish you safe travels.

The Tri-Tachyon agent disappears into some shadow. You look at your untouched drink. A bubble breaks onto the surface.
texts.zh:
特工看上去很紧张，$hisOrHer的淡定消失无踪，东张西望起来，让你感觉隔墙之耳无处不在。

"够了，舰长。" $heOrShe把声音提高了一些，打断了你的话，"我想我们都说完了。" $HeOrShe站了起来，用$hisOrHer的眼睛俯视着你："三一速子科技公司 感谢您的合作，并祝您一路平安。"

速子特工消失在阴影中。你看着你那杯没碰过的饮料，一个气泡缓缓地上升，并在触及液面时破裂了。

texts.en:
You stand from the table, drink untouched. The Tri-Tachyon agent's eyes track you, no smile now.

You get that tingle on the back of your neck as you leave.
texts.zh:
你从桌边站起来，连饮料都没碰一下。速子特工的视线跟着你，脸上看不到一丝笑意。

当转身想要离开时，你感觉到脖子后面传来了刺痛感。

texts.en:
The perfect smile twitches, then reaffirms itself, stronger than before.

"I'm sure we'll speak again, Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says with plastic cheer. "And on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation I would like to thank you for your visit."
texts.zh:
那完美的微笑抽搐了一下，在稍作调整后变得更灿烂了。

"我相信我们还会再见面的，$playerName 舰长。" $heOrShe带着虚假的兴致说道，"我谨代表 三一速子科技公司 感谢您的来访。"

texts.en:
You begin taking stock of the patrons, looking for leads. As you scan the room, suddenly you lock eyes with a $manOrWoman in Hegemony uniform. $HeOrShe raises a hand, and holding it close to $hisOrHer chest points at you while saying something to the uniformed civil control officer at $hisOrHer side.

Turning to find a path for an inconspicuous exit, you see that more c-cons have appeared - by their posture, you surmise that they are holding small hand weapons on your bodyguards, who have responded in kind.
texts.zh:
你开始扫视人群，寻找线索。当环视房间时，你的目光突然锁定在了一个穿着 霸主 制服的$manOrWoman身上。只见$HeOrShe把手贴在胸前指了指你，同时对身边身着制服的公众管控警官说了些什么。

你立即转身想去找一个不那么显眼的出口，却看到了更多的公控警员。从他们的姿势来看，你推测他们已经用轻武器瞄准了你的保镖，你的保镖也以同样的方式做出回应。

texts.en:
In the main entrance you see a flick of targeting lasers shift through near-IR from the silhouette of a light combat exoskeleton. Conversation in the room dies as patrons realize what is happening, leaving only the holos churning out noise. Time seems to slow as you take in the situation with instincts honed in space combat.

Patrons clear out of the bar in a remarkably casual manner, heads lowered, as if they had simply forgotten an appointment and can't be bothered to finish their drinks.
texts.zh:
轻型战术外骨骼的剪影出现在了正门方向，你望过去，正好看到了近红外瞄准激光束正在扫视目标的闪动。顾客们都意识到了事态不对，房间里的谈话声被一片死寂所取代，唯有全息影像还在发出噪声。在你看清当下的形势的同时，常年太空战斗磨练出来的直觉就不自觉地帮你把时间放缓了。

顾客们都努力地强装出一幅随意的样子，低着头离开了酒吧。这些人全都像是突然想起自己还有约，已经没时间喝完饮料了。

texts.en:
"I apologize for this crude posturing, Captain $playerName," the Hegemony officer says as $heOrShe approaches. $HeOrShe has a smooth Eventide academy accent; cream of the crop.

"Protocol," $heOrShe says with feigned resignation. You feel the silent mass of c-con thugs hovering closer behind you. The Hegemony officer gives a little stand-down wave, then says "Let us sit and have an informal chat. Let the Hegemony buy you a drink. That would be nice, yes?"

It seems you have little choice in the matter. Best play along until you get a read on the situation.
texts.zh:
"我为这失礼的状况表示抱歉，$playerName 舰长。" 那位 霸主 军官一边走过来一边说道。$HeOrShe有一口悦耳的 Eventide 学院口音，应该是位军中翘楚。

"这是规矩。" $heOrShe摆出一副身不由己的样子说到。你感觉到一群沉默的公控警员在你身后靠了过来。霸主 军官挥手示意让他们退下，然后对你说，"我们坐下来谈谈吧。就当是 霸主 请你喝一杯。你应该很乐意，对吧？"

在这件事上你似乎别无选择。在了解情况之前，你最好配合一下。

texts.en:
The bartender, sweating, places two drinks on the table between you and scurries off.

"Now I'm sure you've heard of the recent unpleasantness in the Aztlan system, yes? A terrible thing, this data-breach. Are you a student of history, captain? It's the sort of thing that starts wars, so we very much want to ensure that our investigation is ... conclusive."

"We know your $shipOrFleet was in the vicinity- no," $heOrShe smiles pleasantly, "You're not being accused of anything. I simply want to draw upon your patriotism and report if you... saw anything. As any good citizen would."
texts.zh:
酒保冷汗直冒，把两杯酒放在你们之间的桌子上之后就快步走开了。

"我相信你已经听说 Aztlan 星系最近发生了不愉快的事，对吧？数据泄露，那还真是件可怕的事情。你知道以史为鉴吗，舰长？在历史上这种事件就是所谓的战争的导火索，因此我们非常想确保我们的调查结果是...确凿无误的。"

"我们知道当时你的$shipOrFleet就在附近 —— 不过..." $heOrShe笑了，看上去还挺愉快的，"我并不是在指控你。我只是想唤起你的爱国精神，报告一下你是否有...看到任何东西。就如一名遵纪守法的好公民一样。"

options.en: I'm sure I didn't see anything, officer.
options.zh: 我确定当时没看到任何东西，长官。

options.en: You got me. I hacked the Aztlan Relay.
options.zh: 你逮到我了，正是我黑入了 Aztlan 中继站。

options.en: Patriotism, huh. What's with the goon squad?
options.zh: 爱国精神，是吧？那这群打手是怎么回事？
那这群打手是怎么回事？

options.en: Sounds like Tri-Tachyon beat you again.
options.zh: 看起来 速子科技 又一次打败了你们。

options.en: Am I under arrest, or can I go?
options.zh: 我被逮捕了吗？没有的话我可以走了吗？

texts.en:
"Indeed," $heOrShe frowns, eyes fixed on you. "Perhaps if we examined your sensor logs we would find something that slipped your mind."

But that would require a warrant, which requires very clear evidence of wrongdoing. The Hegemony could override the requirement, or manufacture it, but you know their bureaucracy moves slowly.

"Have you met or heard of an individual by the name of 'Gargoyle'? There is a significant reward for information, you know."
texts.zh:
"的确。" $heOrShe皱起眉头盯着你，"如果我们检查一下你的传感器日志，也许会发现一些你没注意到的东西。"

但这需要搜查令，而搜查令需要非常明确的不法行为证据。霸主 当然可以凌驾于任何条件之上，他们也可以制造条件，但你知道他们的官僚机构行动缓慢。

"你见过或者听说过任何叫 'Gargoyle' 的人吗？你知道，提供信息可是有大量报酬的。"

texts.en: The Hegemony officer frowns. "I am not here to make light of a serious security breach, captain. I understand you have a reputation, and that makes you very interesting. You might be wise to make yourself a great deal less interesting, captain, before the Hegemony starts to take you seriously."
texts.zh: 霸主军官皱了皱眉头，"我可不是来对一场严重的安全破坏开玩笑的，舰长。我知道你名声在外，那让你显得格外引人注目。在霸主开始认真对待你之前，你最好低调一些。"

texts.en:
The Hegemony officer produces a fake smile, then speaks an order into $hisOrHer cuff. You note the c-com covering the room fall away. "You must excuse my department. Some of my... associates suggested a different approach to our meeting. We compromised."

$HeOrShe gives you an open look, "I argued for an informal chat, captain. Make me right. Help me help you help the Hegemony."
texts.zh:
霸主 官员假笑了一下，然后对着$hisOrHer的袖口说了一句什么。你注意到满屋子公控警员都消失了。"还请您原谅我的手下。我的一些...同事们对我们的会议形式曾提出过一些不同的建议。现在我们已经谈妥了。"

$HeOrShe自然地看了看你："我主张的是非正式的聊天，舰长。那样对你我和 霸主 都有好处。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe mutters into $hisOrHer cuff. You catch the phrase "waste of time".

The Hegemony officer stands abruptly, bumping the table and spilling some of the undrunk drinks. "Get out of this bar. If my department finds you anywhere near another 'mysterious incident', I assure you that we will not be so lenient."

$HeOrShe storms out the front door. The bartender's eyes flick back to you, expressionless.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe对着$hisOrHer的袖口说了句什么。你听到了 "浪费时间" 这样的话。

霸主 官员突然站了起来，撞到桌子并让一些没喝过的饮料洒了出来。"滚出这个酒吧。如果我们发现你与其他什么 '神秘事件' 有关，我向你保证，我们不会再这么仁慈了。"

$HeOrShe怒气冲冲地走出了前门，酒保则面无表情地看了你一眼。

texts.en: The bartender slowly shakes their head. Business is ruined for this shift, there's nothing more to say.
texts.zh: 酒保缓缓摇了摇头。今天的生意算是毁了，没什么好说的。

texts.en:
"You are not under arrest, citizen," $heOrShe admits. But the officer's face freezes in slow anger, "I tried to make this easy for you, you know. The security of the Hegemony ensures the security of the entire sector- to trade freely, to live, to survive. These are easy times compared to what the Hegemony has faced in the past. Do not make yourself an enemy here, captain."

The Hegemony officer stands abruptly, bumping the table and spilling some of the undrunk drinks. "If my department finds you anywhere near another 'mysterious incident', I assure you that we will not be so lenient. Consider this an official warning."

$HeOrShe marches out the front door. The bartender's eyes flick back to you, expressionless.
texts.zh:
"你没有被捕，公民。" 官员如此承认道，但$heOrShe的脸随着逐渐涌上的怒火变得僵硬起来，"你知道，我只是想让谈话轻松一点。霸主 的安全确保了整个星域的安全 —— 人们能自由地贸易、生活以及生存。与 霸主 过去所面临的情况相比，现在是个好时代。舰长，别在这里树敌。"

霸主 官员突然站了起来，撞到桌子并让一些没喝的饮料洒了出来。"如果我们发现你与另一起 '神秘事件' 有关，我向你保证，我们不会再这么仁慈了，把这当作官方警告吧。"

$HeOrShe大步走出了前门，酒保则面无表情地看了你一眼。

texts.en:
You are led to a dark place behind the bar.

In the neon twilight of blinking atmo duct monitor status lights you make out at least two large armed guards by the door.

Your guide has disappeared. One of the guards taps at the door, and after a moment, opens it and holds out a hand indicating that you should enter.
texts.zh:
你被带到了酒吧后一处阴暗的角落。

大气管线监视器的状态灯轻柔地闪烁着，用昏暗的霓虹照亮了一扇门旁两名魁梧的武装守卫。

给你带路的那人消失了。其中一名守卫在门上轻敲了一下。片刻之后，他把门打开，并伸手示意你进去。

texts.en:
It is a storage room. A couple folding chairs are set at a drooping table. Bright patterns crawl across an old lighting tube. A pot of tea steams between two simple cups.

You recognize the Pather terrorist sitting in one of the chairs.
texts.zh:
这是一间储藏室，一张矮桌旁摆放着两把折叠椅，老旧的灯管布满了明暗不均的光斑，有两个朴素的茶杯围着一壶还冒着热气的茶放着。

你认识坐在其中一把椅子上的左径恐怖分子。

texts.en:
It is a storage room. A couple folding chairs are set at a drooping table. Bright patterns crawl across an old lighting tube. A pot of tea steams between two simple cups.

A Pather terrorist sits in one of the chairs.
texts.zh:
这是一间储藏室，一张矮桌旁摆放着两把折叠椅，老旧的灯管布满了明暗不均的光斑，有两个朴素的茶杯围着一壶还冒着热气的茶放着。

一名左径分子坐在其中一把椅子上。

texts.en:
"Well if it isn't Captain $playername." Brother Livewell Cotton beams a smile at you, "I am so glad to see you again in good health by the grace of sweet Ludd."

With a small motion he offers you his hand to shake in greeting.
texts.zh:
"这不是 $playername 舰长吗。" Livewell Cotton 修士向你投来一个微笑，"卢德保佑，很高兴见到你身心强健。"

他向你微微致意，并伸出手和你握手。

texts.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We do see there that you operate a truly unholy creation, this 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."
texts.zh:
Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来。

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

texts.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We have seen you operating a truly unholy creation, a 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."

He meets your look, "Now don't look surprised captain, there are many eyes and ears upon the daisy that stands so tall as you do. And you stand tall indeed."
texts.zh:
Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来，

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

他对上了你的目光，"别显得如此意外，舰长，和你一样身居高位的贵人身边不乏我们的耳目。而且你的确身居高位。"

texts.en:
"Brother Livewell Cotton, at your service and pleased to meet you, Captain $playername. With blessings of Ludd and all that naturally."

He winks at this, then offers a hand for you to shake.
texts.zh:
"我是 Livewell Cotton 修士，能和你见面很荣幸，$playername 舰长。愿卢德与一切自然的祝福常伴你左右。"

他眨了眨眼，随后伸手和你握手。

texts.en: His smile widens slightly as you shake his hand, "A pleasure. Call me Livewell if you like, and I'll thank you for the sentiment."
texts.zh: 和你握手时，他的嘴角稍微上扬了一点点，"幸会。方便的话你就称呼我为 Livewell 吧，还请别太过于拘谨。"

texts.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We do see there that you operate a truly unholy creation, this 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."

He meets your look, "Now don't look surprised captain, there are many eyes and ears upon the daisy that stands so tall as you do. And you stand tall indeed."
