Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来，

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

他对上了你的目光，"别显得如此意外，舰长，和你一样身居高位的贵人身边不乏我们的耳目。而且你的确身居高位。"

options.en: Didn't you send some rogue Luddic Knight to attack me?
options.zh: 你不是已经派了些无赖卢德骑士来攻击我了吗？

texts.en:
Cotton looks troubled for a moment, holds a finger up, and says "Now that, it is just what I'm saying. 'Many eyes and ears'. I did speak with this knight-errant about you, and we spoke of... concerns. But I did not tell him to kill you and that is the truth."

He looks over at the table as if he just remembered something.
texts.zh:
Cotton 面露难色，他手指着天说道，"这个嘛，这就是我刚提到过的。'不乏耳目'。我的确跟这位骑士谈到过你的事情，我们对你的事情感到... 担忧。但我从未让他去追杀你，这就是事实。"

他看向桌子，好像想到什么似的。

texts.en: "Oh, captain," he looks apologetic. "I'll return to your question in just a moment, for I've quite entirely forgotten my manners."
texts.zh: "哦，舰长，" 他看上去略带歉意。"我们稍后再谈你的事，你瞧我，完全把待客的礼数都给忘了。"

texts.en:
Brother Cotton stands, and pulls out the other folding chair for you. "I've brought some fine tea, grown by a good friend. Won't you sit and share a cup with me?"

He pauses, noting your hesitation. "Do sit. You're my guest here in this humble place. And it would be rude to poison a guest," he gives a faux-serious look, "And a sin, besides."
texts.zh:
Cotton 修士站起身，为你拉出了另一把折叠椅。"我带来了些不错的茶，一位好友自家种的。不如我们先喝杯茶再聊吧？"

他停了停，注意到了你的犹豫不决。"快请坐吧。你是我在这不起眼的地方的客人。我是不会干对客人下毒这种事的，这太野蛮了，" 他做出了个假正经的表情，"而且，还是一宗罪孽。"

texts.en:
As you raise the cup, Cotton says "Do be careful, it is hot."

He sips tea as well and, looking pleased with himself, asks "Now where was I?"
texts.zh:
你举起手中的茶杯，Cotton 提醒道："小心点，茶还很烫。"

他也品了品茶，看上去很满足，"我们刚刚说到哪来着？"

texts.en: "A warning. Yes, it is a warning.
texts.zh: "警告。对，这的确是一种告诫。

texts.en: "I am asking you to open not only your eyes, but your heart." He lifts a fist to his own chest, "I know, it is a sugary turn of words, but Ludd taught us to be true in our speech in the hope that our soul might shine through the clouds."
texts.zh: "我还请你不光要打开你的双眼，还要打开你的内心。" 他一只手握拳放在胸口，"我知道这听起来有些花言巧语，但卢德教导我们不得妄语，以期我们的灵魂能熠熠生辉，穿透世间阴霾。"

texts.en: "A threat? No, no captain. It is a warning."
texts.zh: "威胁？不，不，舰长，这只是在告诫。"

texts.en:
"I am concerned for your soul, captain. The end-times are upon us, and it is up to each of us where we look for guidance. Is it into the pit of Mammon, a promise of gold and hollow power? You carry the fruit of Moloch's tree in your $shipOrFleet, captain. What will grow from its seed, I wonder. And I fear."

"This is, as foretold by Ludd, another sign of the Apocalypse. I see what you think upon your face- was not the collapse of the Domain's Gates the Apocalypse?"

Cotton seems to balance rhetorical points with himself, "Yes, and no. It was merely the beginning."
texts.zh:
"我为你的灵魂感到担忧，舰长。时间的尽头终将来临，我们将各寻指引。我们是否要跳进玛门的深渊，换取他许诺的财富与虚无的权力？摩洛克之树的果实就在你的$shipOrFleet之中，舰长。它的种子将收获什么？我十分好奇，也十分畏惧。"

"正如卢德曾经预言过的那样，这是世界末日到来的又一信号。我能看出你在想些什么 —— 世界末日不是 人之领 星门崩溃的那天吗？"

Cotton 好像在斟酌字句，"是，但又不全是。那只是世界末日的开始。"

texts.en:
He sets his teacup down, and his voice rises. He once was a street-preacher, you realize, and likely did well at it.

"The ocean shall shatter and hang in the sky, mixed with blood. The locusts will hatch from the temple of the Adversary. The doom-bringer shall step through the empty door. And," he halts the sermon, smiles, almost abashed, "It goes on like that. I do say, the poetry of the Word takes me, but I shan't bore you if it isn't your interest."

He picks his teacup up again, and says "All was foretold by Ludd. It's written, here." He lifts a hand to his heart once again, and you notice now that there's a small book in a pocket there. The holy book of Ludd. "The question for us, poor and flawed children of creation, do we look to the light for guidance?"
texts.zh:
他放下茶杯，提高嗓门。你才重新意识到，他曾是位街头传教士，说不定还深谙其道。

"海洋波涛汹涌，逆流向天，卷走鲜血。吞噬一切的飞蝗将从大敌的神庙中孵化出来。带来毁灭的末日使者马上就要踏出虚无之门。然后，" 他停止了祷告词，似乎是有些害臊地笑了一下，"后面当然还有了。我对这些祷告文非常着迷，但若你对此并无兴趣，那我也不必继续叨扰你。"

他又拿起茶杯，说着 "卢德都预见到了。都白纸黑字地写在这里面。" 他再一次将一只手握拳放在胸口，这次你注意到，他的手中有个口袋，里面是一本书。卢德圣书。"一个我们都要面临的问题，作为造物主的子民，我们微不足道且满身瑕疵，但我们是否应该追寻光明的引导？"

options.en: Are you trying to convert me into a Pather?
options.zh: 你是想把我也变成一名左径分子吗？

options.en: I think there may be something to what you are saying.
options.zh: 我觉得你说的或许有些道理。

texts.en: Brother Cotton grimaces, "I am perhaps not doing so good a job at this as I had prayed. Let me speak with absolute candor, Captain $playerName."
texts.zh: Cotton 修士苦笑了一下，"恐怕我未能如我祷告所愿，把此事处理妥当。还请容我坦诚相告吧，$playerName 舰长。"

texts.en:
"This Ziggurat, what it will bring... it is my greatest fear and, I confess, my greatest hope. It is clear to me that you hold the tool of the Adversary that will end the world."

He pauses now, and stares intently at you, then nods. "I am not asking you to set it down, exactly," he pauses, trying to find the words, "It is the tool of evil, yes, but imagine a smallarm set within reach of a child. I am asking-" he closes his eyes now, "-that when it comes time for you to decide what you will need to do, you follow the Path of light."
texts.zh:
"'通灵塔'，它所预示的...既是我最深的恐惧，也是我最大的希望，坦白来说。但有件事我非常明白，你已经手握着大敌的工具，足以毁灭世界。"

他顿了顿，看向你，目光如炬。然后他点了点头，"我并不是说要你把它丢掉。" 他斟酌着字句，"它是邪恶的工具，勿容置疑。然后你再想象一下把随身枪械放在孩童触手能及的地方会是什么情况。所以我恳请你..." 他闭上了双眼，"...当你不得不为自己的将来做出抉择的时刻到来时，我希望你能选择光之道途。"

options.en: I'll... think about what you've said.
options.zh: 我会... 好好想想你所说的。

options.en: What does 'the Path of light' even mean?
options.zh: 你说的 '光之道途' 又是指什么？

options.en: I'm not sure you're taking into consideration the complexity of the situation.
options.zh: 你或许还没意识到这整件事的复杂性。

texts.en: His eyes open, and his gaze locks on yours. "The word is the Path, and the Path is the light. Once you see the Path, you will have no need to think or question. Just ... take the next step."
texts.zh: 他睁开双眼，目光牢牢地凝在你身上。"圣言即为道途，道途即为光明。待你得见此道之时，便不再会有所思虑，有所质疑。只管... 踏上此道。"

texts.en: He speaks quietly, feverishly, wide-eyed, "They call me a murderer, a terrorist. But no doubt dwells in my soul, captain. None at all."
texts.zh: 他眼神纯洁，平静而不失狂热地说道，"别人叫我杀人凶手，恐怖分子。但我的灵魂里没有半点疑惑，舰长。一点都没有。"

texts.en:
The energy seems to leave Brother Cotton now, and he looks almost sad as he performs a half-bow, "I should probably go now, Captain $playerName, before the local security forces wake up."

"I thank you for your time, until our paths cross once more. Choose the light."

And with that, he slips out the door, leaving you with two cups, a pot of tea, and a set of cheap autofab furniture.
texts.zh:
Cotton 修士身上的能量似乎开始消退了。他半鞠了一躬，神态看起来似乎有几分沮丧，"我得赶快离开了，$playerName 舰长，赶在这里的安保部队有所反应之前。"

"感谢你愿意在我身上花些时间，愿我们的道途再次交会。愿你选择光明。"

说完，他侧身走出了门，留给你的只有两个茶杯，一壶茶和一套自动工厂生产的廉价家具。

options.en: Take his teacup to check the DNA match with local security forces
options.zh: 带走他的茶杯，并交给当地安保部队做 DNA 匹配检测

texts.en:
The domestic security officer - station chief, you read on the placard on the desk in front of you - looks nauseous.

"-the most wanted Pather terrorist mastermind in the entire Persean Sector... in my jurisdiction... drinking a cup of tea?"
texts.zh:
这位内部安全部的官员 —— 空间站主管，你面前桌子上的立牌是这么写着的 —— 对方看起来紧张得想吐。

"—— 整片英仙座星域悬赏最高的左径恐怖分子头目... 在我的辖区里... 喝了杯茶？"

texts.en:
Brother Cotton's teacup sits placidly in a transparent aluminum evidence container on the station chief's desk. The DNA analysis glows accusingly on the TriPad next to it.

"I-", the station chief swallows, holds a moment, then begins to speak again, "Please keep this to yourself. Our... investigation will notify you if we need any clarifications to your statement. Please, um, see yourself out."

The chief focuses on breathing slowly, staring dumbly at the TriPad, then the cup, then back.
texts.zh:
在你面前的桌子上，Cotton 修士的茶杯正安详地躺在一个透明的铝制证物储存箱里。旁边的 TriPad 上，DNA 检测结果如同指控一般地闪着亮光。

"我 ——"，这名空间站主管咽了咽口水，沉默了好一会，才再次开口道，"请不要向旁人透露这次事件。如果我们的... 调查行动需要你澄清任何关于你的证词的细节，我们会通知你的。呃，你可以走了，请便吧。"

主管慢慢地平复着呼吸，呆呆地盯着 TriPad，又看向茶杯，然后又看了回去。

texts.en: You return to the bar.
texts.zh: 你回到了酒吧。

texts.en:
His eyes open, "You must learn, my friend."

He takes his small Book of Ludd and places it deliberately in your hands, and pats it. "The word is the Path, and the Path is the light. Once you see it, you will have no need of questions."
texts.zh:
他睁开眼睛，"你必须自己领悟，我的朋友。"

他把他自己的那一小本卢德之书郑重其事地放到了你的手里，轻抚着它。"圣言即为道途，道途即为光明。待你寻见，你将不再疑惑。"

texts.en: His eyes open, "Faith simplifies such doubts. Your 'complexities' are the whispering demon of... of all of this," his arm reaches out, to take in the Sector in a sweep, "The world Moloch and Mammon have built! It sits on your shoulder, in your TriPad, your cyberlink, and whispers uncertainty in your soul."
texts.zh: 他睁开双眼，"信仰会消解这些疑惧。你所谓的 '复杂性'，不过是那正在向你低语的恶魔，它在... 它无处不在，" 他伸出臂膀，仿佛要横扫整片星域，"在这个由双子恶魔玛门和摩洛克所建造的世界里！它就坐在你的肩头，在你的 TriPad 里，在你的植入体链接里，在你的灵魂中低语着疑虑。"

texts.en: His eyes open, and his gaze locks on yours. "The word is the Path, and the Path is the light. Take the next step. If you have faith, you will know."
texts.zh: 他睁开双眼，目光牢牢地凝在你身上。"圣言即为道途，道途即为光明。踏上道途吧。只要你胸怀信仰，自会领悟。"

texts.en: Brother Cotton grimaces, "I am perhaps not doing so good a job at this as I had prayed. Let me speak with absolute candor, Captain $playerName."
texts.zh: Cotton 修士苦笑了一下，"恐怕我未能如我祷告所愿，把此事处理妥当。还请容我坦诚相告吧，$playerName 舰长。"

texts.en: Brother Cotton looks almost relieved, "Then you are beginning to understand. By Ludd's light..." he looks up, and whispers something to himself. Then looks back at you. "Listen now, please."
texts.zh: Cotton 修士看上去似乎感到了一丝宽慰，"那么你终于开始明白了。卢德之光保佑啊..." 他仰起头，低声自言自语了些什么。然后他重新看向你，"那么，请你听好了。"

texts.en:
"You know what, let us stand. It's a damned poor chair anyway - ah, Creator forgive," he makes a sign of penance for his curse.

He stands behind his chair, and pours himself a steaming cup of tea, which he holds in both hands. "Now where was I?"
texts.zh:
"也好，不如我们就站着吧。这椅子质量也真是差得见鬼。啊，原谅我，造物主。" 他为自己的口无遮拦做了个忏悔的手势。

他站在椅子后，为自己倒了一杯冒着热气的茶，双手捧起茶杯。"我们刚刚说到哪来着？"

texts.en: He maintains his smile as he shrugs, "Have it your way. Whatever blood's between us, never hurt anyone to be kind." He points with his untaken hand, "Ludd said that last bit once, you know, blessings be."
texts.zh: 他耸了耸肩，但还保持着微笑，"那就随你吧。即便我们之间有过什么血海深仇，和善待人永不为过。" 他用落空了的手指了指，"后面那句是卢德说的，你知道吗，愿他保佑我们。"

texts.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We do see there that you operate a truly unholy creation, this 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."
texts.zh:
Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来。

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

texts.en:
A pause, then a dark look crosses Cotton's face.

"Captain, I must declare that it is grim tidings indeed that bring me to begging audience with you. We have seen you operating a truly unholy creation, a 'Ziggurat'-class starship. For it is born of the womb of Tri-Tachyon greed, the product of meddling in places that human hand ought not reach."

He meets your look, "Now don't look surprised captain, there are many eyes and ears upon the daisy that stands so tall as you do. And you stand tall indeed."
texts.zh:
Cotton 顿了顿，脸沉了下来，

"舰长，我就跟你挑明了说吧，我是因为最近收到的严峻的消息才不得不以这种方式与你见一面。我们见识到了你麾下那不洁的造物，就是这艘 '通灵塔'-级。速子科技 的贪婪孕育了它，它是人类不应涉足之领域的产物。"

他对上了你的目光，"别显得如此意外，舰长，和你一样身居高位的贵人身边不乏我们的耳目。而且你的确身居高位。"

texts.en: The private room is austere, dim but for the spot of a paper lantern cast on the figure sitting facing you. He raises his face as you enter and holds a hand out to welcome you to sit. The sparse decor and furniture have the solid hand-made quality of true Luddic crafts and you know the set could be sold for a good price on any number of the core worlds.
texts.zh: 这个私人房间很简陋，昏暗，但有一个纸灯笼照在坐在你对面的人身上。当你进来时，他抬起脸，伸出手欢迎你坐下。稀疏的装饰品和家具是真正的卢德手制工艺品，你知道在很多核心世界星球这些可以卖个好价钱。

texts.en:
Brother Livewell Cotton stands and smiles as you enter. "Captain $playerName," he says, "It was my pleasure to hear that our paths would cross again."

He gives you a knowing look, "I pray you have meditated upon our previous discussion."
texts.zh:
你进来的时候，Livewell Cotton 修士站起来微笑着。" $playerName 舰长，"他说，"听说我们的道途再次相交，这是我的荣幸。"

他给你一个会意的眼神，"我祈祷你思考过我们之前的讨论。"

texts.en: "Captain $playerName. I am Brother Livewell Cotton and I'm pleased to greet you. With the blessings of Ludd's peace and all that, naturally." He winks and offers a hand.
texts.zh: "舰长 $playerName。我是 Livewell Cotton 修士，很高兴见到你。自然是带着卢德和平的祝愿。"他眨了眨眼，伸出一只手。

texts.en: His smile widens slightly as you shake his hand, "A pleasure. Call me Livewell if you like, and I'll thank you for the sentiment."
texts.zh: 和你握手时，他的嘴角稍微上扬了一点点，"幸会。方便的话你就称呼我为 Livewell 吧，还请别太过于拘谨。"

texts.en:
"Won't you join me for tea? I offer it to you, my guest, with the safety and hospitality that I've been blessed to provide."

He notes your hesitation and sits first. "Come along in your own time. I'm no scorpion, I do assure you."
texts.zh:
"你不和我喝一杯茶吗？我的客人，我会尽可能给你提供我有幸可以给予的安全与款待。"

他注意到你的犹豫，首先坐了下来。"随你便吧。我向你保证，茶里面没毒。"

options.en: I know to never turn my back on a Pather.
options.zh: 我知道从来不要把后背对着左径分子。

texts.en: You sit with Brother Cotton, notorious Pather terrorist.
texts.zh: 你和 Cotton 修士，这位臭名昭著的左径恐怖分子面对面坐了下来。

texts.en:
Cotton arranges two plain cups, and tests the temperature of the teapot.

"Now I do know why you are here. It's no great coup of the secret-whisperers-and-listeners why the warlord Jorien Kanta has been sending a most diverse company of ne'er-do-wells to bring myself to an untimely end and, be it convenient, claim back her ungodly creation."

He pauses, then adds, "Though I must offer my apologies; I most assuredly except yourself from the company of those ne'er-do-wells."
texts.zh:
Cotton 排出两个塑料杯，试了试茶壶的温度。

"现在我知道你为什么到这里来了。Jorien Kanta 军阀送来鱼龙混杂的一群饭桶想要早早地结束我的性命，窃听到其原因并不是什么很困难的事。如果方便说的话，他们声称要回收她那邪恶的造物。"

他暂停了一下，补充道，"尽管如此，我必须表示我的歉意，我肯定把你排除在了那群饭桶之外。"

options.en: Did you not send a rogue Luddic Knight to kill me?
options.zh: 你没有派一伙无赖卢德骑士来杀我吗？

options.en: Despite hired killers coming for you, you meet me with tea. Why?
options.zh: 尽管派了杀手，但你还是请我喝茶，为什么？

options.en: What do you even want with the Loke clone, if he's so ungodly?
options.zh: 如果克隆人 Loke 是那么亵渎神灵的存在，你还要他做什么？

options.en: So what are you going to do with the clone?
options.zh: 所以你想用这个克隆人做什么？

options.en: Kanta didn't explicitly ask me to kill you. Nor did Cydonia.
options.zh: Kanta 并没有明确让我杀你，Cydonia 也没有。

options.en: Why is this clone so important to Kanta?
options.zh: 为什么这个克隆人对 Kanta 这么重要？

options.en: You're just going to give me Loke?
I wish to take the Loke clone back to Kanta. As I agreed.
options.zh: 我希望把 Loke 带回给 Kanta，就像我答应的那样。

texts.en: "I did. And you told that knight that you would repent and to prove it you paid them many credits." He looks at you, and asks in an unassuming tone, "Is that why you're really here? To repent?"
texts.zh: "我这么做了。你告诉了那个骑士你会忏悔，且为了证明这一点，你给了他们很多星币。" 他看着你，用谦逊的口吻问道，"这就是你来这里的真正原因吗？来忏悔？"

texts.en: "Indeed I did so," he nods, as this is a mere philosophical point. "And now here you are, your path brought together with mine. The means of Blessed Providence seem so mercurial to the eyes of us mortals, do they not?"
texts.zh: "我确实这样做了，" 他轻轻点头，仿佛这件事根本无足轻重，"可你还是来到了这里，我们的道途于此汇合。看来上天赐福于我们的方式并不唯一，你说呢？"

options.en: Yes. I seek to follow the teachings of the Prophet Ludd.
options.zh: 不错，我正是在追寻先知卢德的教导。

options.en: Credits or not, you sent the knight to kill me.
options.zh: 别扯什么星币了。那些骑士明摆着是你派去杀我的。

options.en: Yes, funny how these things work out.
options.zh: 没错，事情还是蛮有趣的。

options.en: Mercurial or not, you sent someone to kill me.
options.zh: 不管你是反复无常还是怎样，你派人来杀我了。

texts.en: "You may not find satisfaction from that query, captain," Cotton says. "But I shall answer."
texts.zh: "你可能无法从这一询问中获得满意，舰长，" Cotton 说道，"但我会回答的。"

texts.en:
He leans back, meeting your eyes, as if he believes it important to face someone whose death he ordered.

"You did appear then to be an enemy of our righteous cause. In war, we battle our enemies. That is all. I did not then fully understand your significance, which... was revealed to me only recently."
texts.zh:
他向后仰着，看着你的眼睛，似乎他相信面向他要判处死刑的对象时这是很重要的。

"你确实一开始就是我们正义事业的敌人。在战争中，我们与敌人战斗。仅此而已。当时我没有完全理解你的重要性，只有最近这才显露出来。"

texts.en: He pauses, looking almost shy for a moment, then says "That... we will speak of that before we are done here."
texts.zh: 他顿了顿，一时看起来有些害羞，随后说道："那...在我们结束之前，我们会谈到那一点。"

texts.en: "Indeed," Cotton says, drawing out the word, his tone carefully controlled. "I will pray upon the meaning of your words, captain. This I promise."
texts.zh: "当然，" Cotton 说，拉长着语调，仔细控制着自己的声调。"我会为你话语中的意思祈祷的，舰长，我保证。"

texts.en: "Indeed," Cotton says, drawing out the word, his tone carefully controlled. "Mind you, it is not mine to give as-such; absolution is for all humanity who do so chose."
texts.zh: "当然，" Cotton 说，拉长着语调，仔细控制着自己的声调，"请你注意，这并不是以我个人身份给予的建议，救赎属于所有如此选择的人类。"

texts.en: "Do pardon me for contradicting my guest," says Cotton, "But I do not hold lightly my decision then or now."
texts.zh: "还请你原谅我反驳来客的无礼，" Cotton 说道，"但我从来都是三思而后行。"

texts.en:
"Tell true, if I met you with hammer and fiery sword, would you prevail?" Cotton nods generously, "Might be you do. Then what would my brothers and sisters have died for? The clone?"

He takes a moment to sip his tea, and finding it hot, blows on the cup.

"It serves our holy war that Kanta not forget that the Path is all around her, ephemeral and indomitable. Killing is not victory." He smiles wryly, "Not always."
texts.zh:
"说实话，如果我用铁锤和焰剑招待你的话，你还会获胜吗？" Cotton 慷慨地点了点头，"也许你会赢。然后我的修士和修女们是为什么而死的？那个克隆人吗？"

他停了一下抿了一口茶，发现它还很烫，就吹了吹杯子。

"提醒 Kanta 她一直身处左径包围之中，虽可能转瞬即逝却不可完全战胜，这会有利于我们的圣战。杀戮并不是胜利。" 他苦笑着，"并不总是。"

options.zh: 这似乎是难以言说的非暴力。

options.en: Did you realize that you cannot best me in combat?
options.zh: 你发现你不能在战斗中打败我了吗？

options.en: I suppose you have better things for them to die for?
options.zh: 我想，你总该有些更好的东西让他们为之而死吧？

texts.en:
Cotton sets his tea down, smile gone.

"I confess to you that I did not always seek victory over killing. Given battle, I chose to destroy my enemy over defeating them. In time, Ludd's spirit showed me the true Path. I humbly submit and step away from that younger man's rage when it serves our holy war."
texts.zh:
Cotton 放下他的茶，笑容消失了。

"我承认我不总是只寻求胜利而非寻求杀戮。在战斗中，我会选择摧毁我的敌人而不只是击败他们。但最终，卢德精神向我展示了真正的道路。当年轻人的愤怒为我们的圣战服务时，我只对他们敬而远之。"

texts.en:
"Hegemony tacticians and the thinking machines alike make the same mistake: they think that we who walk the Path can be defeated if we are measured, tracked, and numbered. Our beautiful holy war is not a mathematical calculation, but the soul of humanity. What we fight for cannot be held in databanks and logbooks."

He looks at you carefully. "I am certain that now is not our time to do battle," he says. "We walk a path, you and I, and here it crosses but does not end. I know not but that I must have faith."

He sips his tea. "It's good now. You should have some."
texts.zh:
"霸主 的战术家们和会思考的机器都犯了同样的错误：他们认为，只要可以被测量、被追踪、被计数，我们这些走上了卢德之道的人就可以被打败。然而我们美丽的圣战不是数学计算，而是人类的灵魂。我们奋斗的目标不能被数据库和日志里的东西衡量。"

他谨慎地看着你。"我很确定现在不是我们战斗的时候。" 他说道，"我们两人走在自己的道途上，现在它们交汇了，但还没有抵达尽头。我不知道接下来事情会如何发展，可我的信念依然坚定。"

他抿着茶。"现在挺好了。你也喝点。"

texts.en:
Cotton raises an eyebrow at this challenge and sets his tea down with a sad smile.

"A younger man than I once was thought he might nourish his soul if only he could kill every heretic that stood before him."

"What he found was not strength, but pride. And he- he would have killed you before you had spoken those words. On the landing pad, perhaps; a bomb in a cargo container. Or on the street, with his hands, had it come to it. That man was as blind as his enemies."
texts.zh:
Cotton 对这一挑衅挑起了眉毛，伤感地笑着放下茶杯。

"一个如同曾经的我一样的年轻人，觉得只有杀掉他面前的所有异端，才能滋养自己的灵魂。"

"但这个人获得的不是力量，而是傲慢。并且他...他会在你说这些话之前就杀掉你。也许是用着陆台上的货物集装箱中的炸弹，或是铤而走险在大街上亲自动手。这人曾和他的敌人一样盲目。"

texts.en:
"Yes." Cotton sets his tea down, eyes hard.

"Yes I do. I did not don the blood-stained mantle of leadership lightly. It was to be my Path. And I shall walk without averting my eyes from the truth of my deeds. Ludd's revelation is pain!" He slams a hand on the table, rattling the dishware. "Ludd chose the Path not because it was easy, or kind, or without suffering!"

He speaks in almost a whisper, "The prophet chose because it was Good."
texts.zh:
"是的。" Cotton 把茶杯放下，眼神坚定。

"是的。我未轻易领受这染血的领袖之责。这本应是我的道途。并且我行在这道途上时，当不遮掩我之所为。受难乃是卢德的启示！" 他一只手锤在桌子上，震得茶具作响。"卢德选择这条道途，并不因其易行，或是因其平缓，也不是因可免遭了苦难！"

他像是耳语般说道："先知选择它，只因它是正的。"

texts.en:
"You know the histories, of the great and terrible Warlord Onesimos Loke, yes? Once a grand officer of the Domain..." Cotton looks distant, "The Knights of Ludd stood then with the Hegemony. Standing with Pride against Wrath. Was that the Path?"

"This abomination is a sad copy of Onesimos Loke concocted by so-called 'doctor' Cydonia. He is a sick man, and to please Kanta for reasons I do not understand, he made a sick joke of the miracle of life."
texts.zh:
"你了解关于伟大而恐怖的军阀 Onesimos Loke 的历史，不是吗？他曾经是 人之领 的高级军官..." Cotton 看起来有些恍惚，"卢德骑士当时与 霸主 站在一起。与荣耀一起对抗愤怒。那是卢德之道吗？"

"这个令人厌恶的东西是所谓的 '医生' Cydonia 制作的 Onesimos Loke 悲惨的复制体。Cydonia 是一个病态的人，因为我不知道的原因讨好 Kanta，他用生命的奇迹开了个恶心的玩笑。"

texts.en:
"I had thought its death would be a demonstration, just as a healer excises a cancer. But as I held a gun to its head, my hand was stayed. I felt this was not the Path. Did I pity the thing? It is rare indeed that I do not find moral clarity in the execution of a heretic or abomination."

Cotton shakes his head, disturbed that he did not want to execute a man.

"I gave it into the care of some siblings of the faith. They taught it prayer from the Book. It appears to think, and to feel. I wonder if this is a lesson in humility. Imagine, to look upon the Creator's work and then this bloodless thing..."
texts.zh:
"我原以为它的死会是一场示范，就像一个治疗师切除一个肿瘤一样。但是当我拿枪指着它的头时，我的手停了下来。我感到这并不是正确的道路。我可怜这个东西了吗？很稀奇，我在处决这个异端和怪物时并没有得到心灵的纯净。"

Cotton 摇着头，因他未能处决那个人而深感心烦意乱。

"我把它交给一些虔诚的姐妹们照顾。她们用典籍教给它祈祷。它似乎在思考，也在感受。我想知道这是否是一个关于谦逊的教训。想象一下，目睹了造物主的作品后，再看看这毫无生气的东西..."

texts.en:
"Yes, yes. Cydonia. Some mercy. You have met him, I know. Is he not strange? I cannot imagine a more wretched creature - excepting his creation, the Loke-thing. Cydonia is a liar to the end of space, and even the sacred becomes sin when it has left his hands."

"If you find occasion to bring his life to an end, I do believe it would be a good and righteous deed."

Cotton sips tea.
texts.zh:
"是的，是的。Cydonia。上天怜悯。我知道你见过他了。他难道不奇怪吗？除了他的作品，Loke 这样的东西，我想象不出更可悲的造物了。Cydonia 是个彻头彻尾的骗子，即使是圣物到了他的手里也会变成罪恶。"

"如果你有机会结束他的性命，我相信那会是一桩善举，正义之举。"

Cotton 抿着茶。

texts.en:
"If the Loke-thing started less than human, Kanta has lowered herself to that sorry state by her debauched pursuit of wrath and immortality."

Brother Cotton takes another slow sip of tea, "She is a malfunction of the machinery of the Hegemony; an obsolete hazard to be cleared away like the stealth-mines she's wrapped around her fortress."
texts.zh:
"如果说 Loke 这样的东西一开始就贱于人类，那么 Kanta 则是在她放荡追求怒火与不朽的过程中，将自己贬低到了同样可悲的境地。"

Cotton 修士又抿了一口茶，"她是 霸主 体系的故障部分，是应当被扫除的废弃危害品，就如同她堡垒周围的隐形空雷一样。"

texts.en:
"What now sits on Kanta's throne of blood and gold is abject to the teachings of blessed Ludd," he taps his fingers on his teacup. "Though a warrior cannot be ignorant of his enemies, I confess that I am not inclined to gaze too deeply into that monstrous abyss. Shall I debate an AI core, shall I ponder its heart? No, because it has no heart, no soul. It is a thing."

"Kanta wants her abomination. This is all I need to know." Cotton meets your eyes, "And you will be the one to give the abomination back to her."
texts.zh:
"如今端坐于 Kanta 那鲜血与黄金王座上的存在，已彻底背离了圣卢德的教诲。" 他用手指轻敲着茶杯。"虽然一个战士不能不了解他的敌人，但我承认我并不想深入凝视那丑恶的深渊。我需要和一个 AI 核心争论吗，我需要思考它的想法吗？不，因为它没有心，没有灵魂。两者是一样的。"

"Kanta 想要这个丑恶的东西；我只要知道这一点就够了。" Cotton 看着你的眼睛，"你将是把这个丑恶的东西还给她的人。"

texts.en: "Yes," he says, his eyes unblinking. "It has no path here. Its presence is raising questions which ought not be asked. So you will take it from my people and go."
texts.zh: "是的，" 他目不转睛地说，"它在这里无路可走。它的存在引发了不该被问起的问题。所以你会把它从我的人民中带走。"

texts.en:
"By both of us, I tell you true."

"I have prayed long on this matter," he says, bringing his hands together as if in demonstration. "Once, long ago, I was in a prison cell. I heard a music like... like the holy pneuma, from afar. A choir of angels."

"My heart leapt, to be touched so. Eagerly, I listened closer and in not a blink it was gone. For just a moment I was touched by grace. Do you understand? My life turned on that point; I found the Path."
texts.zh:
"只有我们两个，我告诉你事实。"

"我已经在这件事上祈祷很久了，" 他说道，一边双手合十，似乎在向你展示当时的情景。"起先，很久以前，我被囚禁在一个牢房里。我听到了旋律，像是...像是远处的圣灵。是天使的合唱。"

"我的心剧烈地跳动，我被深深地感染了。我渴望靠近去听，但不到一眨眼的工夫它就消失了。仅一刹那我就被这光辉所感动。你能理解吗？我的生活从那时起发生了变化，我寻得了卢德之道。"

texts.en:
"The music did not return. So that was my one moment, I thought. It had confirmed my righteous calling, and that was enough. For years I 'heard' nothing. I expected nothing."

"Then, one day not too long ago," he speaks haltingly, looking troubled. "It, it did visit upon me again."

His voice is soft now, "That was the day I was told you were to come here. What am I to make of that?"
texts.zh:
"旋律并没有再次响起。所以那便是我的神启一刻，我觉得。它验证了正义对我的召唤，那便足够了。这些年来我没有再 '听' 到什么。我也并没有再期待。"

"然后，不久前的一天，" 他犹豫地说道，看起来有些不安。"它，它又找上了我。"

他的声音现在变得柔和了，"那正是我得知你将来到此地的日子。这我该怎么理解呢？"

texts.en:
Brother Cotton stands, "I cannot say whether it is a choir of angels or a host of demons," he says. "I fear not pain, death, or judgment. But I do fear to stray from the Path."

He adjusts his coat; one of his minions opens the door, and the clink and murmur of the teahouse returns.

"My people have already brought the abomination to your shuttle," and as if on cue you feel an urgent buzz from your comms.

"Go there now, with Ludd's peace," he says.
texts.zh:
Cotton 修士站起来，"我不知道那是天使的吟唱还是恶魔的主持，" 他说道，"我并不害怕痛苦，死亡，或是审判。但我害怕偏离了卢德之道。"

他理了一下外套，一个仆人打开了门，茶馆的叮当声和谈话声又回来了。

"我的人已经把那个丑恶的东西送到你的穿梭机去了，" 与此同时，急促的嗡鸣声从你的通讯器中传来。

"现在就去，带着卢德的和平。" 他说。

texts.en:
Once outside the teahouse, you duck into a dark corner where the local vice squad is unlikely to spot you engaging in flagrant use of technology. You confirm via comms that the clone Loke has indeed been handed over to your waiting shuttle crew.

You return to your shuttle, and get the full but short story from your nervous guards: a squad of Pathers appeared, shoved a strange man into their hands, then left.
texts.zh:
一出茶馆，你就躲进一个黑暗的角落，在这里当地惩戒团难以发现你在公然使用科技产品。你通过通讯器验证了克隆人 Loke 确实已经被交给了你正在等待的穿梭机船员。

你回到穿梭机，从你紧张的护卫那里听取了完整但简短的过程报告：一队左径靠近过来，将一个陌生人推到他们的手中，然后离开了。

texts.en:
Inside, a couple confused-looking marines are watching clone Loke eat a simple meal of space rations wrapped in foil.

As you approach, Loke looks at you curiously, dropping the foil packet. With a bland smile he says "Ludd blesses you. Together we will walk on the Path."

You tell the marines to let him finish his lunch before escorting him to the brig for safekeeping.
texts.zh:
在里边，两个看起来很疑惑的陆战队员正看着克隆人 Loke 吃便饭，是箔纸包的太空配给餐。

你靠近后，Loke 丢下了箔纸包装，好奇地看着你。他面带灿烂的笑容对你说 "卢德保佑你。我们会一起走上卢德之道的。"

你告诉陆战队员让他吃完午饭，然后押他去禁闭室安全看管。

options.en: Loke, do you want to go back to Kanta?
Loke, do you want to stay here?
Loke, do you want to be free?

texts.en:
Loke smiles, some green thing from the ration still stuck in his teeth.

"Yes. I will go to Jorien," he says excitedly. "I will tell her about the Path! She will like it."
texts.zh:
Loke 微笑了起来，牙齿还卡着干粮里的什么绿东西。

"好啊。我去找 Jorien。" 他激动地说道，"我去跟她说说卢德之道！她会喜欢的。"

texts.en: Loke looks around, pausing a moment to take in the dusty blast-shields of the landing bay through a window. "No," he says. "It's cold."
texts.zh: Loke 四处张望了一下，花了点时间透过窗户观察登陆台上满是灰尘的防爆盾。"不想。" 他说道，"这儿冷。"

texts.en:
"I..." Loke's brow wrinkles around the grotesque scar on his forehead. "I... want...."

He bites his own lip, and cries out in pain. Anger rises on his face and he stomps the foil wrapper he dropped, as if to punish the thing.

The moment passes, and slowly his breathing returns to normal. His eyes wander over the ground, then back to you. "We will go to space now?" he asks.
texts.zh:
"我..." Loke 的眉毛在他额头上怪诞的伤疤旁皱了起来，"我...想..."

他咬着下唇，痛苦地喊出了声。他脸上露出忿怒的神色，一脚跺向他扔下的箔纸，仿佛是在责罚它。

时间慢慢流逝，他的呼吸也逐渐恢复正常。他的眼神在地上扫过，最后回到了你身上。"我们现在去太空吗？" 他问道。

texts.en: Brother Livewell Cotton nods, and to your surprise simply says, "Then you shall."
texts.zh: Livewell Cotton 修士点了点头，出乎你的意料地简单说道，"可以。"

texts.en: Brother Cotton nods in agreement, and to your surprise says "You are indeed."
texts.zh: Cotton 赞同地点点头，出乎你的意料地说道："你确实该这么做。"

texts.en: "Welcome to it." He slaps one of his legs, "This one'll raise complaint if I stand, so I'll beg your pardon for taking leisure where I can."
texts.zh: "欢迎欢迎。" 他拍了拍自己的一条腿，"如果我站起来的话，这腿就该抱怨了。所以希望你能原谅我待在舒适的地方。"

texts.en: He grins, "Then I shall content myself with the cheer of your face."
texts.zh: 他咧嘴一笑，"这样我就能满足于你脸上的笑容了。"

texts.en:
He maintains his smile. "As you'll do. Whatever blood's between us, it never hurt anyone to be kind in a small way." He points with his untaken hand "Ludd said that last bit once, you know, blessings be."

Then he brings his hands together, an unconscious return to prayer.
texts.zh:
他保持微笑。"就像你要做的那样。即便我们之间有过什么血海深仇，和善待人永不为过。" 他用落空了的手指了指，"后面那句是卢德说的，你知道吗，愿他保佑我们。"

然后他两手合十，不经意地做起了祷告。

texts.en:
A pack of young officers relax, downing a higher tier of drinks amid rolls of laughter at one or another bon mot.

One of them glances at you, his head turning just a degree as recognition crosses his face. He calls out, lifting a drink.

"Ah, you there! $playerName, is it not?"

He puts on a glowing smile and approaches. His friends examine you, elbowing one another as if this is the set-up to some jape.
texts.zh:
一群年轻的军官正在尽情放纵，伴着一两句俏皮话引来阵阵哄笑，大口畅饮着高档酒。

其中一人瞥了你一眼，突然带着一脸认识你的神情转头向你高举酒杯大声呼唤起来。

"啊，那边的！$playerName，对不对？"

他露出灿烂的笑容走了过来。而他的朋友们则打量着你，暗地里用手肘相互推搡着，仿佛打算要戏弄谁。

texts.en: "Of course, captain. You're all the talk amongst the officer corps," his arm makes a languid motion that doesn't quite encompass his drinking-cadre, who find this hilarious.
texts.zh: "当然，舰长。你可是军官圈子里的热门话题，" 他懒洋洋地张开双臂，但没能搂住他全部的酒友们，这似乎让他们觉得很好笑。

texts.en:
"One hears you've won not a few skirmishes with pirate scum and the like. In service to the Hegemony, hear, hear!" He raises his glass in a partial salute.

Then he looks to each side, performatively checking for snoops, before leaning in to speak more quietly, "One even hears that old man Daud himself invited you for a personal meeting. Didn't get any of that mozzie hive-dirt on you did he? Ha-ha."
texts.zh:
"听说你打败了不少海盗渣滓之类的家伙。对 霸主 尽职尽责。佩服，佩服！" 他举起酒杯，随手敬了个礼。

然后，他假装像是要看看有没有人在偷听一样左右环顾了一下，然后靠过来压低声音道："有人甚至听说 Daud 那个老家伙邀请你和他私底下碰了个面。他没把那股臭巢区混混味什么的弄你身上吧？哈哈。"

options.en: I have no comment on such speculation.
options.zh: 我对这种猜测不做评论。

options.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
What do you mean by that?

options.zh: 你在侮辱 霸主 吗？

texts.en:
"Come now," he says with a wounded look. "It's a grand old tradition to grumble about the top brass. I'm simply having a bit of a laugh with a new friend of mine. And-" he speaks louder now, "And a new friend of the Hegemony, from bottom to top!"

His entourage cheers to this.
texts.zh:
"得了吧，" 他做出一副很受伤的表情说到。"抱怨高层可是一个古老的传统。我只是在和一个新朋友开玩笑。而且 —— " 他的声音更大了，"还是 霸主 的新朋友，无人不知无人不晓！"

和他一道的人为此欢呼起来。

texts.en:
"We are all but comrades-in-arms, you and I. But where are my manners? Caspian Sang, reporting for duty." He half-salutes with his drink again, the liquid in the glass approaching but not quite escaping the rim. You catch one of Sang's drinking companions snickering, though it is unclear who the target is.

"Although..." He puts a finger on his chin, pantomiming deep thought, "...perhaps I should count you as, at best, an auxiliary comrade. Does your Hegemony commission pay splendidly well? No need to answer of course, friend. It is the business," this word he emphasizes, "of none but yourself."

"And old man Daud, of course," he adds with a wink.
texts.zh:
"我们彼此几乎就是战友。可看看我，礼节都到哪里去了？Caspian Sang，前来报到。" 他握着酒又随手敬了个礼，差点就把杯子里的烈酒泼出来了。你逮到 Sang 的一个酒友正在窃笑，但搞不清楚是在笑谁。

"不过..." 他用手指托着下巴，假装沉思起来，"...也许我最多只能把你，算作一个辅助军同志，你在 霸主 这里拿到的报酬优厚吗？当然不用回答，朋友。这是属于你自己的 '买卖'，" 他强调着这个词，"与他人无关。"

"当然也和 Daud 老头有点关系。" 他眨眨眼补充道。

options.en: The pleasure is mine, I'm sure.
The pay is irrelevant. I stand for the Hegemony.
options.zh: 报酬无所谓，我拥护 霸主。

options.en: I win battles for you lot. The pay is so you feel like you're helping.
options.zh: 毕竟这么多胜仗都是我帮你们打下来的。你们只能发些报酬来显得自己还算有参与。
Daud 真该找些比你更好的下属。

texts.en: "Hardly, my good captain!" He nods reassuringly to his drinking-partners, putting on a show for them. "Surely it is mine."
texts.zh: "难得一见啊，我的好舰长！" 带着果然不出所料的神情，他向酒友们点着头，好比正在上演一出好戏给他们看一样，"我当然也很荣幸。"

texts.en:
"I tell you what, I have just the notion." He decisively quaffs his drink, then proceeds.

"A most spectacular notion. In light of Daud's declaration that you're as much an officer as us, it would only be proper to provide you an opportunity to share an anecdote or two of your wisdom with the cream of the navy, don't you think?"

"House Rao - surely you know the family - is holding the grand ball of this season on Eventide. I shall place your name upon the guest list by invitation of the humble House Sang. Now does that not sound absolutely first-rate? You'll be the talk of the season, I'm sure of it."
texts.zh:
"你知道吗，我有个主意。" 他果断地一口干了杯中的酒，然后继续说了下去。

"一个再精彩不过了的好主意。考虑到 Daud 宣称你身为军官的统率水平和我们不相上下，正好现在有个机会，能让你来和海军精英们一起分享一两件你的智慧轶事，这再合适不过了，不是吗？"

"Rao 家族，你一定听过这个名字，他们将在 Eventide 举行本季的盛大舞会。而我会以卑微的 Sang 家族的名义，将你的名字列入宾客名单。怎么样，听起来是不是相当一流？我敢肯定，你会成为这个季度的话题人物。"

options.en: I wouldn't miss it for the world.
I must decline your generous invitation.
options.zh: 我不得不拒绝你慷慨的邀请。

texts.en: "Most excellent, auxiliary-captain," Sang says with a smirk.
texts.zh: "棒极了，'辅助军舰长'。" Sang 得意地笑了出来。

texts.en:
"Come to Eventide. And bring that razor wit, for you'll need it."

With an affected bow, Sang returns to his table. The other young officers whisper and continue to cast wayward looks in your direction.
texts.zh:
"来 Eventide，别忘了带上你 '犀利的智慧'，你会用得上的。"

Sang 做作地鞠了一躬，回到了他的桌子旁。其他的年轻军官低声谈论着什么，朝你的方向投来轻蔑的目光。

texts.en: Despite Sang's singular attempts at charm, you consider that this might be a good opportunity to meet some people of real influence in the Hegemony.
texts.zh: Sang 施展魅力的方式可真独特。抛开他不谈，你想，这可能是结识在 霸主 中真正的影响力人物的机会。

texts.en: "Don't think too long, auxiliary-captain," Sang says with a smirk. "It's decisive action that's brought you to these lofty heights."
texts.zh: "别考虑太久，'辅助军舰长'。" Sang 得意地笑着。"别忘记是果断的行动把你带到这个高度的。"

texts.en: "The offer stands until you miss all the fun, auxiliary-captain," Sang says with a smirk.
texts.zh: "直到你错过所有的乐事为止，这个邀请都有效。" Sang 得意地笑着。

texts.en: Sang stands up straight, as if at attention. "And the restoration of the Domain!" he shouts, earning a round of ayes and table-pounding from his drinking companions.
texts.zh: Sang 像是立正一样站直了。"也为了复兴 人之领！" 他喊到，赢得了酒友们的敲桌喝彩。

texts.en:
Sang's face is overcome with shock and delight; he's found one that fights back. He clutches his chest as if stabbed, his drinking companions hooting and calling at your riposte.

"Where did you come from, captain?" he says, flicking spilled drink from his off-hand, "Ludd curse me but the Hegemony can use such talent."
texts.zh:
Sang 脸上洋溢起震惊和愉悦，他总算碰上一个会还嘴的了。他紧紧地捂着自己的胸口，就像被人捅了一样，而他的酒友们则对你机敏的反讽报以嘘声和叫嚷。

"你是什么来头，舰长？" 他一边说着，一边弹掉洒出来的饮料，"我凶起来连卢德都要求饶，而 霸主 要的就是我这种狠人。"

texts.en: "And in you, it seems he found it." Sang speaks lightly, his drinking-partners hooting and calling behind him, but you sense a blade's edge in his words.
texts.zh: "更好的下属不就搁我眼前站着吗。" 在他酒友的大呼小叫中，Sang 的语气很轻松，但你能感觉到他话里藏刀。

texts.en: "Of course, captain. You're all the talk amongst the officer corps," his arm makes a languid motion that doesn't quite encompass his drinking-cadre, who find this hilarious.
texts.zh: "当然，舰长。你可是军官圈子里的热门话题，" 他懒洋洋地张开双臂，但没能搂住他全部的酒友们，这似乎让他们觉得很好笑。

texts.en: "Not yet, dear captain. See, you're all the talk amongst the officer corps," his arm makes a languid motion that doesn't quite encompass his drinking-cadre, who find this hilarious.
texts.zh: "还不认识呢，亲爱的舰长。但是你看，你现在可是军官圈子里的热门话题，" 他懒洋洋地张开双臂，但没能搂住他全部的酒友们，这似乎让他们觉得很好笑。

texts.en:
You seat yourself. A simple, steaming tea is placed before you with a subtle hint from the proprietor that you need but ask and something much stronger will arrive in a teapot.

Before you can make a proper assessment of the colorful figures who tend to populate a spacer bar, a man sits next to you with casual self-assurance, grabs your cup of tea, and downs the entire cup in one go.
texts.zh:
你找地方坐了下来，一杯冒着热气的茶放在了你面前。店主微妙地暗示你，你只需要示意一下，茶壶里就会有更强劲的东西。

在你对这个太空佬酒吧里形形色色的人做出适当的评价前，一个男人自信且放松的坐在了你旁边，拿过你的茶，一口气喝完。

texts.en:
You would have thought the tea to be uncomfortably hot, but the man seems unfazed as he swishes it around his mouth and swallows.

"Been told you've been asking questions," he says with a cheap smile. A tooth is missing, another cracked to a point. He smells of mildew, and sweat.

"I'm Sedge," he says.
texts.zh:
你觉得茶有些太烫了，但是这个男人似乎并不在乎，他咕噜咕噜地把茶喝了下去。

"有人说你一直在问问题。" 男人带着假笑说道。他的一颗牙丢了，另一颗裂了。身上还带着霉味和汗味。

"我是 Sedge。" 他说。

options.en: I'm looking for a man called Jethro Bornanew.
options.zh: 我在找一个名叫 Jethro Bornanew 的男人。

options.en: Show a picture of Jethro Bornanew, "Recognize him?"
options.zh: 展示一张 Jethro Bornanew 的照片，"认识他吗？"

options.en: You can't just drink people's tea.
options.zh: 你不能拿起别人的茶就喝。

options.en: Signal for something stronger from the proprietor.
They're afraid. So might-makes-right and terror rules. You think this is righteous?
options.zh: 他们害怕。所以强者为王，恐怖统治。你觉得这是正义吗？

options.en: They respect you. Because you are willing to do what needs to be done.
options.zh: 他们尊重你。因为你愿意做该做的事。

options.en: How can you murder a man in cold blood and think yourself righteous?
options.zh: 你怎能冷酷无情地谋杀一个人并自诩正义？

options.en: You murder because you feel like its right? That's insane.
options.zh: 因为你觉得这是对的就进行谋杀？这太疯狂了。

options.en: What you say about faith alone, not deeds, it... makes sense.
options.zh: 你说的只存信仰，无关行为，这...有道理。

options.en: You do what you want and think faith makes it good? That's insane.
options.zh: 你想做什么就做什么，然后觉得有信仰一切就会好起来？这是疯了。

options.en: What you say about following faith alone, it... makes sense.
options.zh: 你说的只需追随信仰，这...有道理。

texts.en:
"That?" Sedge looks down, as if at a stone on the ground.

"That got careless. That forgot that one does not speak easily of the Path. The Path is sacred. It does not belong in the mouth of a decadent heathen."

His eyes flick downward again, "Like that."
texts.zh:
"他？" Sedge 垂下眼睛，像在看地上的石块。

"他没有谨言慎行。他忘了他不可妄言圣道。卢德之道如此圣洁，怎可出于堕落异端之口。"

他的眼睛又向下撇了一下，"就像他。"

options.en: That led me to you. Will you shoot me as well?
options.zh: 他带我来的。你也要向我开枪么？

options.en: Yes, you did him a mercy.
options.zh: 是的，你对他算是仁慈了。

texts.en: "No." He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: "不。" 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
texts.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

texts.en: "Yes." He smiles again. "But, $playerBrotherOrSister, you would not find what you're looking for."
texts.zh: "是的。" 他又笑了。"但是，$playerBrotherOrSister，你不会找到你想找的东西的。"

texts.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en: He smiles again. "You are welcome here, with blessed peace and the hospitality of my people."
texts.zh: 他再次笑了。"我们欢迎你，以神圣的和平和我们人民的热情。"

texts.en:
He makes an expression of mock confusion. "I just said. I am Sedge."

He drops the look. "But you want to know who I am to the Path. Who I am to this world, to people who might come here. Who I am to you. Who am I to what you are looking for."

He corrects himself, holding up a finger, "Whom you are looking for."
texts.zh:
他困惑的表情带着点嘲讽。"我刚才已经说过了。我就是 Sedge。"

他收起那副表情。"但你想知道我对于左径来说是谁。对于这个世界，对于将要来到这里的人们来说是谁。对你来说是谁。对你正在找的东西来说是谁。"

他竖起一根手指，自我纠正道，"是你正在寻找的人。"

texts.en:
"Is that what I am?" He pauses a moment, then nods, "It is more, people find me. Those who seek the Path."

The mask of casual ease draws away to show you the ice-cold, self-assured fervor in his eyes. "I judge if their path leads true. If it does," he shrugs; merely the casual business of building an interstellar network of terrorism.
texts.zh:
"这就是我的身份吗？" 他顿了顿，然后点点头，"不止如此，那些希望加入左径的人会来找我。"

他脸上随意轻松的面具被揭下，显露出他眼中冰冷的、自信的狂热。"我负责判断他们的意图是否真实。如果确实如此的话..." 他耸了耸肩，仿佛自己只是在处理组建星际恐怖主义网络这等寻常事务。

texts.en: "Mm." Sedge looks away, making a show of thinking it over, turning your cup - his now - over and over in his hands. "No, I do not recall a Jethro."
texts.zh: "嗯。" Sedge 看向远方，做出努力回想的样子，把你的杯子 —— 现在是他的了 —— 拿在手里翻来覆去。"不，我不记得任何叫 Jethro 的人。"

texts.en:
"Mm." Sedge looks away, making a show of thinking it over. "No, do not recall a Jethro."

The pooling blood is caught by a small stream of run-off and begins to wash a red streak down the alley.
texts.zh:
"嗯。" Sedge 转过头，像是在想这事。"不，没想到哪个叫 Jethro 的。"

血泊汇聚成小股径流，在巷子里流淌出红色的纹路。

texts.en: You draw out your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
texts.zh: 你掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

texts.en: You slowly draw your TriPad and activate the Jethro Bornanew file. There is a holo from before he left.
texts.zh: 你谨慎地掏出 TriPad，打开了 Jethro Bornanew 的档案。里面有一张他离开前的全息影像。

texts.en:
Sedge leans over to examine it.

"Ah." He speaks without hesitation, "Yes, I remember now. He went to Mazalot."
texts.zh:
Sedge 探身过来查看。

"啊。" 他毫不犹疑地说道，"对，我现在想起来了，他去了 Mazalot。"

texts.en:
Sedge considers his words for a moment. Sucking spittle through his tooth-gap.

"That man, his faith is true." Sedge swishes again. "But he... did not know his Path."
texts.zh:
Sedge 斟酌了一会，从牙缝里吸着气。

"那个男人，他的信仰坚定虔诚。" Sedge 低声说道，"但是他...没有领悟到他的道途。"

texts.en:
Sedge stands back suddenly, looking away down the alley.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him he had no place with us."

He speaks without meeting your eyes, "I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot."

"I hope they see what I saw, too. That... he is unfit."
texts.zh:
Sedge 突然后退一步，看向小巷另一边。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

他说话时没有看你的眼睛，"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。"

"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。就是...他不合适。"

texts.en:
Sedge stands, suddenly, a look of concern on his face.

"That a man could believe, truly, and not know his Path? I did not like to see that. I told him, he had no place with us."

"I was told he worked for a time, then bought passage to Mazalot," he says. "I hope they see what I saw, too. That he is unfit."
texts.zh:
Sedge 突然站了起来，脸上多了一丝关切的神色。

"是那个信仰坚定虔诚，但却没领悟到自己道途的男人？那时我不太待见这种人。我和他说过，他和我们不是同路人。"

"我听说他工作了一段时间，然后凑够钱去了 Mazalot。" 他说，"我相信那边的人的看法应该和我的一样。他不合适。"

texts.en:
You would swear that Sedge is upset.

"No more questions," he spits. "We are done."

He walks away.
texts.zh:
你发誓，Sedge 分明是生气了。

"别再问了，" 他啐道，"我们到此为止。"

他转身走开了。

texts.en: You spot your sidearm on the ground, next to the Mammonite's cooling body.
texts.zh: 你瞟到你的随身武器落在地上，旁边就是玛门之仆冰凉的尸体。

options.en: Grab your sidearm and shoot Sedge in the back
options.zh: 拿起你的随身武器并在 Sedge 背后射击他
从背后向 Sedge 射击

options.en: Have one of your guards shoot him in the back
options.zh: 让你的一名警卫在他背后射击他

texts.en:
The proprietor, who was pretending to polish a samovar, releases an audible sigh of relief before giving you an accusing look. You suspect service will not be enthusiastic for you in this establishment in the future.

You have a lead: Mazalot.
texts.zh:
之前一直在假装擦洗茶具的店主这时发出了一声如释重负的叹息，并用责备的眼神瞪了你一眼。你估计以后再也没法在这享受到什么热情的服务了。

不过你有了条线索：Mazalot

texts.en:
Sedge disappears down a side-alley, and his thugs with him. You are left in the dripping alley with a corpse.

And a lead: Mazalot.
texts.zh:
Sedge 消失在小巷另一头，他的手下和他一起走了，留下你和一具尸体。

还有一条线索：Mazalot

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

There are shouts and screams from patrons. Chaos, and flight. The room empties out, the proprietor ducks behind the bar.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

顾客们发出尖叫声。一片混乱，人们纷纷逃离。房间里空荡荡的，老板躲在吧台后面。

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the small space, a sharp crack that rattles ceramicware.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

The proprietor ducks behind the bar and scrabbles out some back door.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。枪声在狭小的空间中回荡，尖锐的声音震得瓷器嗡嗡作响。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

老板翻身躲进吧台，从后门爬了出去。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a paper lantern slowly spinning in the rafters, casting a warm and murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
texts.zh:
他无神的双眼盯着一个在屋檐上慢慢旋转的纸灯笼，倒映着温暖而朦胧的光。

他在笑。他死了。

texts.en:
His sightless eyes stare up at a translucent awning, rain spatter distorting a murky light.

He is smiling. And dead.
texts.zh:
他无神的双眼凝视着半透明的雨篷，雨点扭曲了模糊的光线。

他在笑。他死了。

texts.en:
You leave his body to return to your $shipOrFleet. The Path will know what to do with it.

They are sure to come after you, if they weren't before.
texts.zh:
你丢下了他的尸体，径直返回了你的$shipOrFleet。左径自然知道该怎么处理。

他们肯定会来追寻你的下落了，即便他们此前还没动手的话。

texts.en:
You draw and fire. The shot reverberates in the alley, a sharp crack.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

Silence follows the echoing shot, broken only by retreating footsteps as his thugs flee the scene.
texts.zh:
你拔枪射击。尖锐的枪声在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

回响之后，唯有他手下逃离的脚步声打破了沉默。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
You speak a sharp word into your comms and within seconds an echoing crack shoots down the alley.

Sedge drops like a bag of meat.

His thugs disappear. Tactical chatter from your guards - equipped with the best - tracks their flight from the spot.
texts.zh:
你对着通讯器说了个词，数秒后，一声巨响在小巷中回荡。

Sedge 像一袋肉一样倒下。

他的手下消失了。你装备精良的保镖们说着战术术语，追踪着他们的逃跑路线。

options.en: Check to make sure he is dead
options.zh: 检查尸体来确保他死了

texts.en:
"Why say such a thing? It is done," Sedge says.

"Maybe you want it back?" He smiles.
texts.zh:
"为何说这种话？这事早过去了。" Sedge 说道。

"也许你想我把茶吐出来？" 他露出微笑。

texts.en:
"I can because I do," he says. The smile sublimes away like ice in vacuum.

"I see you don't understand, spacer."

He keeps his gaze pinned on you as he swipes his hand across the table, sending cup and teapot flying to smash against a neighboring drinking-party. They raise a shout of offense.
texts.zh:
"我能，因为我正在这么做，" 他说道，脸上的笑容如同真空中的冰一般升华消散了。

"我看你是不明白，太空佬。"

他一边将目光死死锁在你身上，一边挥手扫过桌面，将茶杯和茶壶扫飞，砸在了邻近的几个酒徒桌上。他们发出愤怒的喊叫声。

texts.en:
A scrape of chairs on floor, and the shouts are quickly hushed by the outraged party's companions. Conversation dies in the room, and everyone at nearby tables takes in the situation. Upon seeing Sedge, they start to quietly file out of the teahouse.

Soon, you are left nearly alone.

Sedge moves his hand through a slow arc, a mockery of blessing, to indicate those who left the room, "They understand."

Another pot of tea and two new cups appear, the proprietor quickly retreating with a crunch of ceramic underfoot.
texts.zh:
在一阵椅子与地板的摩擦声后，那伙怒汉的喊叫声很快就被他们的同伴制止了。房间里顿时没了声音，附近桌子上的每个人都在打量着这一切。在看到 Sedge 后，他们开始一声不吭地涌出了茶馆。

很快，你几乎被独自一人地留在了这里。

Sedge 的手缓缓划过一道弧线，模仿着做出祝福的样子，指向那些离开的人，"而他们明白。"

又一壶茶和两个新杯子被端了上来，店主随即踩着陶瓷碎片迅速退了下去。

texts.en:
You signal the proprietor, who glances at the back of Sedge's head with a questioning look- really? With him right there? You confirm your order with a firm nod.

Soon enough the teapot arrives, smelling of liquor. Two cups are almost dropped and the proprietor retreats.

Sedge watches the whole procedure with his crooked smile, sets the two cups in place, fills them from the pot. He lifts his cup and looks at you expectantly.
texts.zh:
你向老板示意，他用询问的眼神瞥了一眼 Sedge 的后脑勺 —— 真的吗？他就在那里？你肯定地点了点头，确认了要点的东西。

很快，一壶茶就被端上来了，散发着酒香。两只杯子几乎是被扔到了吧台上，老板随即退了下去。

Sedge 歪着头微笑着看着整个过程，他把两个杯子放好，把它们倒满了茶。他举起杯子，期待地看着你。

options.en: Are you allowed to drink this?

texts.en:
"And may we recognize truth on the Path of Providence," he adds, "and not turn away."

Then he downs the spirit.
texts.zh:
"愿我们行在卢德之道，得蒙真理。" 他补充道，"不偏左右。"

然后他一口干掉了那杯烈酒。

texts.en: "God will forgive me," he says, giving the cup a waggle.
texts.zh: "主会恕我的罪。" 他摇晃着杯子说。

texts.en:
"May we recognize truth on the Path of Providence," he says, "and not turn away."

Then he downs the spirit.
texts.zh:
"愿我们行在卢德之道，得蒙真理。" 他补充道，"不偏左右。"

然后他一口干掉了那杯烈酒。

texts.en:
Sedge shakes his head, "You understand nothing. Mammon and Moloch live in your heart and in your mind."

"Righteousness is not a scale to be weighed, good deed against evil. Humanity is a being of sin, cursed by the desecration of the Garden of Earth. Nothing will save you but to follow the Path. It is faith that I follow, it is faith that shows me the way, it is faith alone that is salvation."

"I do as I do because I follow the Path. The true Path ends in Heaven. Faith reveals this."
texts.zh:
Sedge 摇了摇头，"蒙昧无知。恶魔玛门和摩洛克存于你心中，存于你思想之中。"

"公义与否不取决于其施行手段，而取决于行善还是行恶。人是有罪的，因亵渎了地球的神圣花园而担了罪孽。唯有走上圣道才能得救。信此道引领我，信此道启示我，唯此道是我的救主。"

"我行我应行之事，因我谨守卢德之道。这道途真实，通向应许的天堂。信的人便明白。"

texts.en:
Sedge nods. "I have what they do not: faith in the Path. I follow where it leads without fear, without question. Faith alone reveals the righteous Path.

"True faith terrifies the faithless." He leans back, his look softening. He is not boastful, but absolutely earnest. "You see how these little spacers, the Hegemony, the Church-liars, all of them; how they fear us."
texts.zh:
Sedge 点点头。"我有他们没有的东西：对卢德之道的信仰。我遵循此道的指引，既无恐惧，也无疑虑。唯此信仰可揭示正义之道。"

"真正信仰将使不信者惧怕。"他向后靠了靠，神情变得柔和了。他不是在自夸，但却十分真诚。"你看看这些小船员，霸主，教会的骗子们，他们所有人；看他们是多么惧怕我们。"

texts.en: Sedge's eyes narrow at you. "You say, to kill a man is not righteous? You don't know that Mammonite. I do. But," Sedge grunts, "I need not explain my path to you. God will judge."
texts.zh: Sedge 眯起眼睛看着你。"你说，杀人是不正义的？你不了解那个玛门之仆。我了解。但是，" Sedge咕哝道，"我无需向你解释我的道途。神会审判我。"

options.en: I expect some worldly authority will judge you, and not well.
options.zh: 我希望某些世俗权威会审判你，并且不会有好的结果。

options.en: How much blood must you spill to be allowed into Heaven?
options.zh: 你要流多少血才能被允许进入天堂？

options.en: What good deeds of yours outweigh such casual murder?
options.zh: 你有什么善举能抵消这种随意的谋杀？

options.en: You killed an evil man? Then I spoke too soon.
options.zh: 你杀了一个邪恶的人？那我话讲早了。

texts.en: Sedge shrugs. "My path will end. Not today, I think."
texts.zh: Sedge 耸了耸肩。"我的道途将会走到尽头，但不是今天，我想。"

texts.en:
Sedge shakes his head, "You don't understand. You think that way? It shows you worship Mammon and Moloch in your heart and you don't know it."

"Righteousness is not a scale to be weighed, good deed against evil. Humanity is a being of sin, cursed by the desecration of the Garden of Earth. Nothing will save you but to follow the Path. It is faith that I follow, it is faith that shows me the way, it is faith alone that is salvation."

"I do as I do because I follow the Path, not because I think I can buy-," he pauses to spit toward the slumped corpse, "-my way into Heaven."
texts.zh:
Sedge 摇了摇头，"你不明白。你是这样想的吗？这说明你在心中崇尚着恶魔玛门和摩洛克而不自知。"

"公义不可被衡量，行善业可拒邪恶。人是有罪的，因亵渎了地球的神圣花园而担了罪孽。唯有走上圣道才能得救。信此道引领我，信此道启示我，唯此道是我的救主。"

"我行我应行之事，因我谨守卢德之道，而不是我觉得我能买到 ——" 他停顿了一下，向倒在地上的尸体啐了一口，"—— 买到通往天堂的路。"

texts.en: Sedge nods. "My Path crossed his, and his was to end."
texts.zh: Sedge 点点头。"我道途与他的交错，而他的道途走到了尽头。"

texts.en: "It is a good thing you are not God," Sedge cracks a new smile, "Because then I would be in big trouble."
texts.zh: "幸好你不是神。" Sedge 又露出一个微笑，"因为那样我就有大麻烦了。"

texts.en:
"Sense is not faith," Sedge says, correcting you. "But maybe you are still finding the Path."

He pauses, then adds, "Maybe we talk more someday, $playerBrotherOrSister, after your business with me."
texts.zh:
"理性不是信仰。" Sedge 纠正道，"但也许你仍在探寻圣道。"

他停顿了一下，然后补充道，"也许我们下次再聊，$playerBrotherOrSister，在这单生意之后。"

texts.en:
It's the next day. You see the Mammonite as you walk in and he greets you from the bar - a little worse for the wear after a night of drinking, it seems.

"Yes, hello captain! You must come meet my friend!"

He stands - unsteadily - and leads you through a door in the back of the bar.
texts.zh:
现在是第二天。你走进门时看见玛门之仆在吧台后面招呼着你 —— 喝了一夜之后看起来有些糟糕。

"你好啊舰长！你必须来见见我们的朋友！"

他站了起来 —— 晃晃悠悠的 —— 带着你进了吧台后面的门。

texts.en:
You step into a storage room. Broken furniture is stacked in a corner. Dim light from a stick-on glowplate has decayed into a sickly yellow-green gradient.

"He's just through here. Come, come," the Mammonite says, beckoning, and steps through a door to the outside.
texts.zh:
你走进一间储藏室。破损的家具堆放在角落里。贴在墙上的荧光板已经褪色成病态的昏暗黄绿色。

"他就在这儿。来，来。" 玛门之仆招着手，又穿过一扇门走向外面。

texts.en:
As you enter, an impeccably dressed young-appearing man lounging at the bar stands and approaches with an easy, open expression. His eyes literally twinkle - subtle cybernetics - as he greets you.

"Captain $playerName, I cannot express how happy I am to connect." His handshake lingers a moment too long.
texts.zh:
当你进入时，一位衣着考究、容貌年轻的男子从吧台起身，带着随和坦率的神情走近。他在问候时双眼闪烁着微光 —— 那是精密的赛博改造体。

"$playerName 舰长，能与您会面我实在欣喜难言。" 他的握手的时间似乎更长了一些。

options.en: Always pleased to meet a fan. Did you want a holo with me?
options.zh: 见到粉丝总是令人愉快，想和我合张全息照吗？

options.en: Excuse me, I have important business to attend to.
Excuse me, I have important drinking to attend to.
options.zh: 失陪了，我有重要的酒局要赴。

texts.en: His perfect eyebrows lift. "Just this," he says.
texts.zh: 他精致的眉毛微微扬起。"就这些了，" 他说道。

texts.en: It takes a moment for you to realize that you are holding a card. Placed through some sleight-of-hand, no doubt.
texts.zh: 你花了片刻才意识到自己正握着一张卡片，这无疑是通过某种手法悄然放进你手里的。

texts.en:
The subtle, off-white material has a luxurious heft. An embossed Tri-Tachyon crest is just visible through the barely translucent polyply stock.

This is an affectation of the business class dating all the way back to Terran prehistory called a 'business-card', a sort of analog commlink ID data-packet. It reads:
texts.zh:
这张淡米色的精致材质带着奢华的分量。在微微透光的复合纸材上，隐约可见 速子科技 徽标的浮雕。

这是可追溯至地球史前时代的商业阶层习俗，称作 '名片'，一种模拟通讯链接的身份数据包。上面印着：

texts.en: Director of Special Acquisitions Zunya Glamor-Rotanev
texts.zh: Director of Special Acquisitions Zunya Glamor-Rotanev

texts.en: Suite 1000, Skyarco II Executive Annex
texts.zh: Suite 1000, Skyarco II Executive Annex

texts.en: Xanadu Geodivision
texts.zh: Xanadu Geodivision

texts.en: Eochu Bres, Hybrasil system
texts.zh: Eochu Bres, Hybrasil system

texts.en: Persean Sector
texts.zh: Persean Sector

options.en: I take it you're not Director Glamor-Rotanev?
options.zh: 我猜你不是 Glamor-Rotanev 总监？

texts.en:
He laughs beautifully.

"Most welcome. You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime," he says with a wink. "I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."
texts.zh:
他优雅地笑了笑。

"荣幸之至。您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，" 他眨眼示意道，"我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

texts.en:
He laughs beautifully, again.

"Most welcome. You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime," he says with a wink. "I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."
texts.zh:
他又一次优雅地笑了笑。

"荣幸之至。您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，" 他眨眼示意道，"我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

texts.en:
He puts his hands together with a soft clap, and does something not quite like a bow.

"My task here is concluded. Enjoy yourself. Tonight's tab shall be on Mz. Glamor-Rotanev."

He turns, and exits the bar, leaving you with the 'business-card'.
texts.zh:
他双手合十轻轻一拍，做了个近似鞠躬的动作。

"我的任务至此完成。请尽情享受吧，今晚的消费将由 Glamor-Rotanev 女士买单。"

他转身离开酒吧，将那张 '名片' 留给了你。

options.en: Pocket the card and look back to the bar
options.zh: 将名片收进口袋，目光转回吧台

texts.en:
He laughs beautifully.

"Oh, oh no," he says, almost bashful. "You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime. I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."
texts.zh:
他优雅地笑了笑。

"哦，不，" 他近乎腼腆地说道，"您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

"Oh, oh no," he says, almost bashful. "You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime. I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."

"You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime," he says with a wink. "I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."

"You're holding the opportunity of a lifetime," he says with a wink. "I recommend you have a chat with Director Glamor-Rotanev. At your earliest convenience, of course."

"您手中握着千载难逢的机遇，" 他眨眼示意道，"我建议您与 Glamor-Rotanev 总监面谈。当然，在您最方便的时候。"

texts.en: He laughs beautifully, perfect teeth flashing.
texts.zh: 他优雅地笑了笑，精致的牙齿闪闪发光。

texts.en: "Naturally," he says, perfect teeth flashing. "I won't delay you a millisec- here."
texts.zh: "当然，" 他说道，那精致的牙齿闪烁着，"我不会耽误您哪怕毫秒 —— 给您。"

texts.en: "Naturally," he says, perfect teeth flashing. "I won't delay you a millisec- here."
texts.zh: "当然，" 他说道，那精致的牙齿闪烁着，"我不会耽误您哪怕毫秒 —— 给您。"

texts.en: As you start to take in the clientele, the lights flicker. The sundry holos and screens fuzz and go blank as EM interference scrambles their inputs.
texts.zh: 你刚作为顾客落座的一刻，灯光突然闪烁起来。各个全息投影和电子屏幕变得模糊不清，然后直接白屏 —— 明显是电磁干扰影响了输入信号。

texts.en:
With a series of bangs, troopers in light combat frames burst through every entrance, shouting amplified orders, waving vicious little guns.

Random INTSEC raid; you know enough to appear calm and keep your hands away from your sidearm.

Each patron is scanned and, in-turn, their fate is revealed by a subtle movement of the lead INTSEC officer signaling whether they are to be left alone or arrested. Most are spared.
texts.zh:
身穿轻型战斗动力甲的士兵随着一连串的爆音从每个出入口鱼贯而入，口中命令凶狠咆哮、手中武器闪烁凶光。

这是 INTSEC 随机搜查；你很清楚此刻就得表现冷静，同时双手远离随身武器。

所有顾客都要逐一接受扫描，INTSEC 现场总指挥的一个小动作便会决定他们的命运：单独留下，或是当场逮捕。当然，大多数人都幸免于难。

texts.en:
One group of spacers appears to believe they have something to hide. As the officer approaches, they break into action. One manages to half-draw a concealed weapon but is hit with the crack of an electrostun/restraint-foam round. The convulsing body crashes through a table, sending pieces of broken glass up in glittering parabolae.

The rest of the party are restrained and beaten, the drumming of clubs on flesh eventually overtaking the cries of pain and outrage. Outsiders look on in horror; the staff and locals have a glazed, unfocused expression; it is safest to see nothing.
texts.zh:
一群宇宙民似乎是在隐藏些什么。当官员走近时，他们突然开始行动。其中一人刚刚将一把隐藏的武器掏出一半，就被电击/束缚泡沫弹击中。仍在抽搐着的身体撞翻了桌子，使得玻璃碎片在空中划出一条弧线。

剩下的人被制服和殴打，棍棒敲击在肉体上的声音最终盖过了痛苦愤怒的呼喊声。外来者们惊恐地看着这一幕；员工和本地人则表现得呆滞和失神；什么也不看应该是最安全的做法了。

texts.en: The Diktat Internal Security officer walks slowly on a tangent to you, examining each of your bodyguards from their feet to their weapons before shifting his gaze to you. You stare for a moment into dark eyes.
texts.zh: 辛达强权 内安部的军官突然停下手中工作，慢慢走向你，从头到脚再到武器地打量着你的每一个保镖，然后把目光转向了你。你盯着对方漆黑的双眼看了一会。

options.en: Thank you for your service, sir.
Thank you for your service, sir. (sarcastic)
options.zh: 感谢您的工作，长官。 (讽刺)

texts.en: His eyes narrow and flick down to his scanner.
texts.zh: 他眯起眼睛扫视着扫描仪。

texts.en:
The INTSEC officer gives a small nod to the guards, then moves on with arbitrary authority to the next spacer captain, who is given a similar treatment.

Apparently this means you're free to go. There will be no more business to be done at this bar for the rest of the shift. Even the corridors outside are strangely quiet, the populace recognizing the tell of a crackdown.
texts.zh:
这位 INTSEC 军官对着卫兵们轻轻点了下头，然后独断专行地向下一个太空舰长实施了差不多的处置。

显然这意思是你可以走了。整个星历日内这个酒吧里都不会有别的事了。即使是外面的走廊里也格外安静，人们知道什么是杀鸡儆猴。

texts.en: He says nothing, just stares at you for a moment. His off-hand twitches significantly and your world explodes with light and pain.
texts.zh: 他一言不发，只是盯着你看了一会儿。他的手猛地一抽，接着你的世界就在一片光亮和痛苦中炸开了。

options.en: Close your eyes and cover your vitals
options.zh: 闭上眼睛，保护要害部位

texts.en:
You find yourself slumped against a rattling air vent in a minor offshoot of the commercial concourse. One of your guards, bleeding and appallingly bruised, applies a dermal patch to your neck and your consciousness acknowledges the ocean of pain receding like a tide, leaving a loose hollowness in your chest and numbing cold in your limbs.

INTSEC simply wanted to send a message, it appears. Nothing more, nothing less.
texts.zh:
你发现你在商业港区的一个小弄堂里，现在正靠着一个作响的通风口。你的一个保镖 —— 此刻鼻青脸肿，留着鲜血 —— 在你的脖子上贴了个皮肤贴片。潮水一般的疼痛在你的潜意识里退去，只剩下胸口中的空洞感和四肢里发麻的冷意。

看来 INTSEC 只是想给个警告，仅此而已。

options.en: Just get back to your ship
Swear that you will have revenge
Admit that you had it coming

texts.en:
It would almost be more reassuring to feel the pain. Without it, you feel empty. And tired.

With the help of your guards, you slowly make your way back to your ship.
texts.zh:
能感受到疼痛甚至还更让人安心些。没了只会让你觉得空虚。还有疲惫。

在你的保镖的帮助下，你慢慢地回到了舰船上。

texts.en:
You focus on the INTSEC officer's face, using your physical pain to sear it into your memory.

One day, you swear, he will receive justice.
texts.zh:
你紧盯着 INTSEC 军官的脸，用躯体上的疼痛把他烙在你的记忆中。

总有一天，你发誓，他会被正义制裁。

texts.en: You reflect that this is simply how power works. When challenged, it must prove itself or the illusion evaporates.
texts.zh: 你意识到，这就是权力的运作方式。当受到挑战时，它必须证明自己，否则那层幻影就会蒸发。

texts.en: He says nothing, just stares at you for a moment as if a chair tried to start a conversation.
texts.zh: 他一言不发，只是盯着你看了一会儿，仿佛你是一把试图开口交谈的椅子。

texts.en:
He responds with the automatic phrase, "The Movement is its own reward."

If his tone does not contain warmth, at least it holds the comfort that his internal IFF has slotted you into a non-hostile category.
texts.zh: 他用机械般生硬的语调说道："伟大运动本身就是回报。" 就算语气并不温暖，至少他脑子里的敌我识别程序把你归类到了非敌对类里。

texts.en: He says nothing, just stares at you for a moment. His off-hand twitches significantly and your world explodes with light and pain.
texts.zh: 他一言不发，只是盯着你看了一会儿。他的手猛地一抽，接着你的世界就在一片光亮和痛苦中炸开了。

options.en: Close your eyes and cover your vitals
options.zh: 闭上眼睛，保护要害部位

texts.en:
As soon as you step into the light, faces turn toward you and a particularly burly patron stands and stares directly at you.

You're still mid-threat assessment when the cheers break out. "Captain $playerName!" someone shouts, then spills half of a mug of something as their companions raise their arms.

It appears as though you have some admirers.
texts.zh:
你刚一出现，就有几人看向了你，还有一位格外壮实的顾客站起身，直直地盯着你。

正当你评估当前情况有多危险时，大家开始欢呼。" $playerName 舰长！" 有人喊了起来，随后洒掉了半杯什么东西，而其他人也是扬起手臂开始庆祝。

看来有人很仰慕你。

options.en: Join them for a round and bask in adulation
options.zh: 和他们喝几杯，享受一下他们的奉承
优雅地让他们冷静下来

options.en: Sternly nod an acknowledgement and get on with your business
options.zh: 严肃地点点头，表示你知道了，然后继续干正事

options.en: This is altogether too much. Leave immediately.
options.zh: 你可受不了这种事，立刻离开

texts.en: You join the crew at the table to their uproarious delight, patrons shoving over to make room.
texts.zh: 你坐在桌边，加入喧哗的人群，看来你能来让他们很高兴。熟客们纷纷挤到一边，给你留出空间。

options.en: The stage is yours, why not use it? Give a speech!
options.zh: 既然有了舞台，那为什么不开演呢？来段演讲！

texts.en:
You leap up onto a table and are handed a drink, which you raise high to a new round of cheers.

"Speech, speech!" the crowd chants, and you make a show of reluctance before giving in to their demands.
texts.zh:
你跳上桌子，有人给你递了杯酒水，于是你顺势把酒水举了起来，引得大家又开始碰杯庆祝。

"演讲！演讲！" 大家喊了起来，你装作不情愿的样子几度推脱，最后还是按照他们的意思行事。

options.en: Focus on the local VIPs and tell some flattering anecdotes
options.zh: 以本地要员为主题，讲些讨好他们的八卦

options.en: Compliment the crowd and make a connection with the crews
options.zh: 夸奖一下在场的大家，讲讲你和船员们的联系

options.en: You're the star! Talk about yourself
options.zh: 你才是主角！讲讲你自己的事

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent local officials, earning quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent local officials, earning quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments.

You shift the monologue toward a light-hearted review of each of the Luddic shrines you visited, earning tense laughter, but you manage to turn what at first appeared to be subversive implications into a heartfelt conclusion which results in earnest applause from spacer and Faithful alike.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。

说着说着，你停止了自说自话，开始轻轻松松地 "评鉴" 你一路上走过的每个卢德圣地，在引得大家哄堂大笑的同时，你还隐去了你某些初见有些颠覆性的暗示，转而以深切的感受作结，于是太空佬们和虔诚信徒最后都诚挚地鼓起掌来。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent local officials, earning quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments.

You transition into an anecdote about drinking tea with Brother Livewell Cotton and the bar goes quiet indeed - one particular spacer at the front goes pale and makes to look for the closest exit. You pivot, reassuring the spacer with the finer points of tea etiquette, prompting laughter and earning the fearful spacer good-natured ribbing from their drinking companions.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。

说着说着，你开始讲述你与 Livewell Cotton 修士一同喝茶的经历，酒吧当场一片寂静，甚至在前排有个太空佬已经开始面色苍白，望向最近的安全出口。你话锋一转，讲起茶艺的细微之处，安抚刚刚害怕的太空佬，于是大家又开始大笑，那个太空佬也被同桌酒友们善意地嘲弄起来。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent local Tri-Tachyon figures, earning moments of quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments. A joke suggesting that Artemisia Sun is an AI core lands particularly well with the crowd despite earning you a deadly look from a finely-dressed executive sitting alone near the back of the room.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选的很恰当。你中途开了个玩笑，暗指 Artemisia Sun 其实是一个 AI 核心，大家都听得很开心，除了酒馆后排单独坐着的某个西装革履的高官 —— 听到你的这个笑话，那人用想杀人的眼神看了你一眼。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent gens and officials, earning quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments.

Your impression of Reynard Hannon's accent draws particular divisions between his supporters and detractors in the crowd, but you manage to defuse the tension with a well-timed joke, transforming scowls into self-deprecating smiles.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。

中途你模仿 Reynard Hannan 的口音，加深了酒馆人群里他的支持者与批评者之间的分歧，但你又恰到好处地开了个玩笑，于是原本怒目而视的两拨人也只好难为情地一笑而过。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
You share a few flattering quips and a story about some prominent local Hegemony officials, earning quiet, cheers, or laughter at the appropriate moments. A pack of cadets in the corner is especially taken with an aside about meeting High Hegemon Daud.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点带讨好意味的俏皮话，还分享了本地 霸主 高官们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。房间角落里的一帮学员听你讲述自己和至高霸主 Daud 会面的故事，听得尤其出神。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
You share a few off-color quips and a story involving some of the more prominent local pirates, earning quiet or cheers at the appropriate moments.

A hush falls over the bar as you recall your meeting with Kanta herself; you manage to break the tension with an unflattering aside about her 'doctor', Cydonia, prompting laughter and pounding of tables.

Some of the stories might even be true. Or not. What's important is the connections you're making - or pretending you already made - with the local power-players.
texts.zh:
你讲了一点荤段子，俏皮话，还分享了本地大海盗们身上的一个故事，人们时而安静，时而欢呼，时机都选得很恰当。

你开始回忆自己和 Kanta 会面的经历时，酒吧里突然鸦雀无声，见势不妙，你毫无奉承成分地讲了讲 Kanta 的 '医生' Cydonia，于是大家又开始狂笑，笑到直拍桌子。

你讲的故事里，有些甚至可能是真的，但无论真假，故事本身并不重要，重要的是你以此建立了 —— 或者说假装建立了 —— 与本地高官之间的联系。

texts.en:
Some time later, in a quiet corner, the bartender hands you a tall glass of cool water with a nod.

Refreshed, and things having quieted down, you have a chance at last to look around.
texts.zh:
过了有一阵子，在酒吧安静的角落里，服务生为你递上了一大杯冰水用来醒酒，还对着你点了下头。

等你精神恢复了，周围也安静下来了，你终于有机会四处看看了。

texts.en:
You speak about the hard-working spacers that make everything you've done possible, sharing a story of daring, danger, and victory. Moments of quiet, cheers, or laughter come at the appropriate moments as you connect the experiences of your crew with the individuals at the tables around you.

Some time later, in a quiet corner, the bartender hands you a tall glass of cool water with a nod.

Your personnel officer pings your datapad with a surprised message about a number of enthusiastic, and slightly drunk, spacers choosing to sign on to your $shipOrFleet while waiving the usual contract signing bonus.
texts.zh:
你开始讲述勤勤恳恳的宇宙民如何帮助你成就了现如今的一切，顺势分享了一个关于果敢、危险、胜利的故事。你由自己船员的经历又联想到了桌边喝酒的各位，他们时而安静，时而欢呼，时而大笑，时机都选得很恰当。

过了有一阵子，在酒吧安静的角落里，服务生为你递上了一大杯冰水用来醒酒，还对着你点了下头。

在数据平板上，舰队人事官惊讶地呼叫你，表示有不少热情满满还有点微醺的宇宙民决定加入你的$shipOrFleet，他们连通常的签约奖金都拒绝了。

texts.en: Refreshed, and things having quieted down, you have a chance at last to look around.
texts.zh: 等你精神恢复了，周围也安静下来了，你终于有机会四处看看了。

texts.en:
You start slow, and quiet, forcing the crowd to quiet themselves and one another to hear you.

Having caught their attention, you lay it on about the dangers and trials you have faced - how is it possible you're here, alive, to tell the tale? Through laughter, cheers, and hushed moments you speak of your deeds to the rapt audience and, in a roaring conclusion, somehow connect it all to the greater glory of $theMarketFaction, to applause from the entire bar.

Somehow you're the hero of the day, though only a handful here knew it when you first walked in.
texts.zh:
你开始讲话了，声音很低，语速很慢，暗示酒吧的大家要安静，顺带还得让其他人也安静，才能听清你讲的话。

正当大家都注意到你的时候，你开始添油加醋地讲述你一路上遇到的种种危险，经历的种种试炼 —— 你到底是怎样，才能一直活到现在，来到这里，向大家讲述自己的传奇。你讲述着自己一路上的所作所为，台下观众全神贯注，时而大笑，时而欢呼，时而沉默。临近末尾，你情绪愈发高涨，不知怎的就将你的所有成就与 $theMarketFaction 的荣耀联系起来，引得满堂喝彩。

不知为何，你就成了今天的主角，虽然刚刚进入酒吧的时候只有少数几个人知晓。

Having caught their attention, you lay it on about the dangers and trials you have faced - how is it possible you're here, alive, to tell the tale? Through laughter, cheers, and hushed moments you speak of your deeds to the rapt audience and, in a roaring conclusion, somehow connect it all to the proudly independent polities and spacers, to applause from the entire bar.

正当大家都注意到你的时候，你开始添油加醋地讲述你一路上遇到的种种危险，经历的种种试炼 —— 你到底是怎样，才能一直活到现在，来到这里，向大家讲述自己的传奇。你讲述着自己一路上的所作所为，台下观众全神贯注，时而大笑，时而欢呼，时而沉默。临近末尾，你情绪愈发高涨，不知怎的就将你的所有成就与全体独立政体与宇宙民的荣耀联系起来，引得满堂喝彩。

不知为何，你就成了今天的主角，虽然刚刚进入酒吧的时候只有少数几个人知晓。

You start slow, and quiet, forcing the crowd to quiet themselves and one another to hear you.

Having caught their attention, you lay it on about the dangers and trials you have faced - how is it possible you're here, alive, to tell the tale? Through laughter, cheers, and hushed moments you speak of your deeds to the rapt audience and, in a roaring conclusion, somehow connect it all to the fierce and free pirates of the Persean Sector, to applause from the entire bar.

Somehow you're the hero of the day, though only a handful here knew it when you first walked in.

不知为何，你就成了今天的主角，虽然刚刚进入酒吧的时候只有少数几个人知晓。

texts.en:
You quietly inquire about what the group is drinking to, setting off laughter and good cheer. You're handed a drink, and as you sip, hear several versions of your latest exploits, each more unlikely than the last.

You do your best to correct the worst exaggerations, but the consensus has clearly formed that you're playing it down.
texts.zh:
你打听起大家在为什么干杯，顿时引发了一阵欢笑与喝彩。你一边抿着别人递来的酒水，一边听着人们谈论你最近的光荣事迹的好几种说法，一个比一个更离谱。

你极力想纠正那些最离谱的吹嘘，但大伙明显都只当你是在谦虚罢了。

texts.en:
With the round complete, you make your apologies to much good-natured booing, and tactfully make for a dark corner to recover your thoughts and take in the bar- the bartender, with a nod, ensures you have a tall glass of cold water at hand.

Refreshed, and having quieted things down, you have a chance at last to look around.
texts.zh:
你喝完了酒，为你本就没什么恶意的小小玩笑道了个歉，然后委婉推脱着找了个昏暗的角落坐下，开始复盘你在酒吧的所见所想。服务生点了点头，为你盛上了一大杯冰水用来醒酒。

等你精神恢复了，周围也安静下来了，你终于有机会四处看看了。

texts.en:
Smiling, you try to calm this table. Unfortunately, this just feeds their enthusiasm. Crews sitting at more tables turn to look, patrons whispering to one another and pointing, and others raising their voices to call out.

It's going to be very difficult to find any contacts here with all this attention.
texts.zh:
你笑了笑，尝试让桌边的大家安静下来，但结果却是大家变得更加热情了，其他桌边也有人转身看向你，熟客们互相低语，冲着你这边指指点点，甚至有人高声喊了起来。

所有人都注意到你的情况下，再想单独联络某一个人可就相当困难了。

options.en: Might as well join them for a round
options.zh: 不如就和他们一起喝几杯吧

options.en: This is too much; wave politely as you leave
options.zh: 这太过火了，和善地挥手离开吧

texts.en:
You give a sedate wave of acknowledgement, turn right around, and walk out of the bar.

The cheers and shouts, only growing louder, are muffled as you step into the outside corridor.
texts.zh:
你平静地挥了挥手，表示自己知道了，顺势转身走出了酒吧。

酒吧里仍有人欢呼、大喊，声音越来越大，不过当你走出酒吧的时候，酒吧里的声音也就听不清了。

texts.en:
You give a stern nod, the very face of stoicism.

Your example triggers a rush of somewhat tipsy salutes and over-exuberant return nods. More drink is spilled in this process, but at least they've quieted down.
texts.zh:
你摆出一脸沉稳，波澜不惊地微微点头示意。

如此表率引来了一片伴着微醺的回礼和过分热情的点头回应。虽然又洒了些酒水，但好歹所有人都安静下来了。

texts.en:
A patron does a double-take, and with recognition comes a look of intense hatred.

"You!" The shout cuts through the clatter and noise of the bar like a shot. The burly spacer stands, and readies a meaty fist...

Only to be thrown back onto a table with a smash of glassware by one of your bodyguards - generally discreet, but paid well to take initiative at times like these.
texts.zh:
一个顾客再三确认了下你的长相，认出你的身份后，对方的脸被仇恨扭曲。

"你！" 他的吼声如枪声般盖过了酒吧的喧嚣。这个壮硕的太空佬站了起来，举起了他满是横肉的拳头...

结果就是被你的保镖直接扔到了一张桌子上，玻璃碎了一地 —— 你的保镖们平时虽然行事低调，但是这些时候先下手方能为强。

texts.en:
The chaos begins to spread outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing.

You hear your name spoken like a curse, and a makeshift missile shatters on the support column behind you.

Your bodyguards form a human wall to cover your path toward the exit. Stumbling outside, you can hear the alarms which signal the rapid approach of local MuniSec. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the shift, that much is clear.
texts.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，一发临时制成的投掷物在你背后的承重柱上轰然碎裂。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到了警笛声，看来本地的地方安全部正在快速赶来。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

texts.en:
The chaos spreads outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing. One pulls a knife, which prompts a pirate three tables down to draw a gun, at which point your instinct to find cover kicks in.

You hear your name shouted like a curse, and an already broken vidscreen on the support column behind you explodes into burning plastic fragments, the soft-round from a boarding pistol putting it well out of its misery.

Your bodyguards respond with controlled bursts from energy weapons set to low-power, giving cover to your withdrawal. Smoke, screams, and flashes of discharge fill the bar. Stumbling outside, you see passers-by clearing out as fast as they can. A noodle stand cook gives you a frightened look as they duck behind armored shutters. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the shift, that much is clear.
texts.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。有人掏出了刀子，隔着三张桌子的另一名海盗见状掏出了枪，于是你开始本能的找掩体。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，你身后支撑柱上原本就坏掉了的显示屏绽成了无数燃烧着的塑料碎片，看来是谁接舷战配枪中打出的软质子弹结束了这东西的一生。

你的保镖们抬起能量武器，将发射模式调整成低功率模式，节制地开火掩护你撤离。刹那间，酒吧里充满了烟雾、尖叫、还有武器发射的闪光。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就看到街边路人都在快速逃跑，某个面条摊的厨子蹲在装甲卷帘门后面，惶恐地看了你一眼。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

texts.en:
The chaos spreads outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest - clearly, this bar doesn't only serve tea and small-beer - and angriest standing.

You hear your name called like a curse, and a makeshift missile smashes against a samovar behind you. It tips, slowly, and falls to the ground with a crash. A small wave of hot water washes over your boots, and a cloud of steam envelopes you.

Your bodyguards form a human wall to cover your path toward the exit. Stumbling outside, you can hear the bells which signal the rapid approach of Path anti-vice enforcers. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the rest of the shift, that much is clear.
texts.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来，这里明显不是只卖茶水和低度数啤酒的那种卢德酒吧。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，一发临时制成的投掷物击中了你背后的茶炊。茶炊慢慢倾倒，最后砰然落地。一些茶水溅在你的靴子上，水蒸汽瞬间将你包裹起来。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到了警铃声，看来本地的左径涤罪执法队正在快速赶来。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

texts.en:
The chaos begins to spread outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing.

You hear your name spoken like a curse, and a makeshift missile shatters on the support column behind you. A pack of cadets rushes the exit, eager to avoid a potential military discipline for involvement in a bar brawl.

Your bodyguards form a human wall to cover your withdrawal. Stumbling outside, you hear the buzz of riot control drones which signals the rapid approach of gendarmerie. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the rest of the shift, that much is clear.
texts.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，一发临时制成的投掷物在你背后的承重柱上轰然碎裂。一群军校学员慌忙跑向出口，生怕会因为参与酒吧斗殴违反军规。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到了镇暴无人机的嗡嗡声，看来本地的 霸主 宪兵队正在快速赶来。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

texts.en:
The chaos begins to spread outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing. A couple executives in the back roll their eyes and activate a privacy field as their bodyguards step out of the shadows to protect their small pocket of peace.

You hear your name shouted like a curse, and a makeshift missile shatters on the support column behind you, cracking a vidpanel into fractal nonsense.

Your bodyguards form a human shield to cover your path to the exit. Stumbling into the corridor outside, you can hear alarms and the buzz of surveillance drones which signal the rapid approach of one or another of the corpo security franchises. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the shift, that much is clear.
texts.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。后排的几个高管翻了个白眼，启动了隐私场，他们的保镖从阴影中走出，保护着他们小小的安宁之地。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字。同时，一发临时制成的投掷物在你背后的承重柱上轰然碎裂，将一块视频面板砸成了毫无意义的碎片。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到警报声和监视无人机的嗡嗡声，看来公司有一个安保部门正在迅速接近，虽说分不清具体是哪个。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

texts.en:
The chaos spreads outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest - clearly, this bar doesn't only serve tea and small-beer - and angriest standing.

You hear your name called like a curse, and a makeshift missile smashes against a samovar behind you. It tips, slowly, and falls to the ground with a crash. A small wave of hot water washes over your boots, and a cloud of steam envelopes you.

Your bodyguards form a human wall to cover your path toward the exit. Stumbling outside, you can hear the ringing of alarm bells which signal the rapid approach of the local MuniSec squad led by a Knight of Ludd. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the rest of the shift, that much is clear.
texts.zh:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来，这里明显不是只卖茶水和低度数啤酒的那种卢德酒吧。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，一发临时制成的投掷物砸碎了你背后的茶炊。茶炊慢慢倾倒，最后砰然落地。一些茶水溅在你的靴子上，水蒸汽瞬间将你包裹起来。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到了警铃声，看来本地卢德骑士正带着地方安全部的人手快速赶来。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

texts.en:
