Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Inesis 相助——这或许要费些口舌，实在不行还得花钱打点——你就能找到一个突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

With the help of Arroyo - and it might take a little negotiation or, failing that, bribery - you'll be able to identify an opening. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

有 Arroyo 相助——这或许要费些口舌，实在不行还得花钱打点——你就能找到一个突破口。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Hyder in command of the Sindrian Diktat navy, her backing may make all the difference. And she may be willing to leave Macario exposed. There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Hyder 统率辛达强权海军，她的支持或许会起决定作用。而且她也许愿意让 Macario 露出破绽。也许还有别的潜在盟友...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wanted to install herself as Supreme Executor. He may move against her sooner than later.
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想把自己推上最高元首之位。他也许很快就会对她动手。

texts.en: You recall telling Caden that Hyder wants to become Supreme Executor. He dismissed it at the time...
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Hyder 想当最高元首。他当时没当回事...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario that Hyder wants to defect to the Hegemony. He might take action against her.
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 说，Hyder 想叛投霸主。他也许会因此对她采取行动。

texts.en: You recall telling Caden that Macario backs Hyder, surely leading to some resentment on Caden's part...
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Caden 说，Macario 在背后支持 Hyder——这想必让 Caden 生出几分怨恨...

texts.en: You recall telling Macario contradictory 'facts' about Hyder's intentions, which did not endear you to him. but will he act against Hyder nonetheless based on any of it?
texts.zh: 你想起自己曾对 Macario 讲过关于 Hyder 意图的种种自相矛盾的'事实'，这并没让你在他那里讨到好。可他会不会仍然依据其中某一条，对 Hyder 下手？

options.en: But how do I contact Hyder if I am shoot-on-sight?
options.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Hyder？

texts.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Hyder and explain the situation.
texts.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Hyder 通话，向她说明情况。

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly. Hector must make his move, and soon - then Achilles will follow.

With Caden in command of the Lion's Guard fleet and paramilitary forces his backing may make all the difference to Hector's success - and, in turn, Macario's.

There may be other potential allies as well...
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。Hector 必须出手，而且要快——然后 Achilles 才会跟上。

有 Caden 统率狮心卫队舰队与准军事部队，他的支持或许会决定 Hector 的成败——反过来，也会决定 Macario 的成败。

也许还有别的潜在盟友...

options.en: But how do I contact Caden if I am shoot-on-sight?
options.zh: 可我一露面就会遭到攻击，怎么联系 Caden？

texts.en:
There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindrian Diktat military network.

Then you could talk to Caden. Give his fanaticism a push in the right (or wrong) direction.
texts.zh:
Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与辛达强权的军用网络建立通讯链路。

然后你就能和 Caden 通话了。给他那份狂热推一把，推向正确 (或者错误) 的方向。

texts.en:
Events around Askonia are progressing rapidly.

Hector must make his move soon, to say nothing of Achilles.

You'll find your opening.
texts.zh:
Askonia 周围的局势正迅速推进。

Hector 必须尽快出手，更不用说 Achilles 了。

你会找到突破口的。

texts.en:
Are you loyal to the Sindrian Diktat?

Without your commission, declared a terrorist and target of a kill-on-sight order, how can you demonstrate your support for the next Supreme Executor?
texts.zh:
你忠于辛达强权吗？

没了委任状，又被宣布为恐怖分子、成了格杀勿论令的目标，你还怎么向下一任最高元首表明你的支持？

options.en: I am loyal to the Sindrian Diktat! There must be a way.
options.zh: 我忠于辛达强权！总有办法的。

options.en: None of that matters to me.
options.zh: 那些对我来说都无所谓。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power. He never cared for Andrada's vision, however faded it became in those final cycles. A true heir to Philip Andrada must stand and take up the mantle, throw off Macario's web of lies, and usher in a new age.

Not as a puppet. As a leader.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，除了自己的权力，他什么都不信。Andrada 的愿景在最后那些星历年里无论褪色到什么地步，他也从未真正在意过。Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来，接过这份衣钵，挣脱 Macario 的谎言之网，开启一个新的时代。

不是当傀儡。是当领袖。
effects: #SetTooltip sdse_introMacarioSDchooseSelf "Those clones are bloodless copies of a great man. They have not proven themselves through glory, ambition, and battle... as you have."

texts.en:
Hector must lead the Sindrian Diktat - and not as Macario's puppet.

It won't be easy, because Macario has already poisoned Hector's opinion of you, judging by the recordings you experienced at 58966 Elysium.

But, surely, the transcendent philosophy of Philip Andrada will prevail.

The Blood of Andrada MUST prevail.
texts.zh:
Hector 必须领导辛达强权——而且不能做 Macario 的傀儡。

这不会容易，因为从你在 58966 Elysium 经历过的那些录像来看，Macario 已经在 Hector 心里把对你的看法毒化了。

但是，Philip Andrada 那套超凡的哲学终将胜出。

Andrada 的血脉必须胜出。

texts.en:
But how?

If you could smash through the fleets and capture Macario, you'd leave the pride of the Sindrian Diktat scattered and demoralized.

The one polity which embodies Andrada's Transcendent Ideology would be left vulnerable to invasion!

By the Hegemony. Or the Persean League. Or Luddic infiltrators...

Another war, another occupation. Industry razed, ships and stations blazing like short-lived stars; hundreds of thousands, possibly millions, left dead.
texts.zh:
可怎么做？

就算你能一路击穿那些舰队、抓住 Macario，你也会让辛达强权的骄傲四散溃逃、士气尽失。

那个唯一承载着 Andrada 超凡意识形态的政体，将被暴露在入侵之下！

来自霸主。或者英仙座联盟。或者卢德派的渗透者...

又一场战争，又一次占领。工业被夷平，舰船与空间站像短命的星辰一样燃烧；数十万人，也许数百万人，就此死去。

texts.en:
Besides, as soon as your fleet secured an orbit, he'd scurry away by one escape route or another to the safe houses he must have on half the worlds of the Persean Sector.

You have to be more subtle. You consider options and allies. Whoever you speak to first will send a signal about which faction you favor.
texts.zh:
再说，你的舰队一旦进入轨道，他就会从某条退路溜走，躲进他在英仙座星域半数星球上都备着的安全屋。

你得做得更隐蔽些。你权衡着手里的选项与潜在的盟友。你先去找谁，就等于向各方表明你偏向哪一边。

texts.en:
You decide that Achilles must lead the Sindrian Diktat.

He is not a puppet of Macario, and and he's much more than a weak echo of the worst side of Philip Andrada.

There is, of course, the matter of Fortuna Kato.

She intends to manipulate Achilles through her support of his cause. She claims he's a willing partner in the arrangement, but her goals are to recenter of power in the Persean League, perhaps even making Askonia a full League member...
texts.zh:
你决定，辛达强权必须由 Achilles 来领导。

他不是 Macario 的傀儡，也远不只是 Philip Andrada 最坏那一面的软弱回声。

当然，还有 Fortuna Kato 这一桩。

她打算借着支持他的事业来操纵他。她声称他在这桩安排里是自愿的伙伴，可她的目标是把权力重心重新搬回英仙座联盟，甚至可能让 Askonia 成为联盟的正式成员...

options.en: And that's fine, Fortuna's plan for Achilles is the best outcome
options.zh: 那也无妨，Fortuna 为 Achilles 安排的路就是最好的结果

options.en: Fortuna Kato's plans must be thwarted as well
options.zh: Fortuna Kato 的算盘也必须打掉

options.en: Wait and see - first Achilles needs to beat Hector
options.zh: 静观其变——Achilles 得先打赢 Hector

texts.en:
Fortuna Kato will do what is best for her - and for the Sector. She'll do her best to see that Achilles prevails.

The fact remains: Macario must be destroyed.
texts.zh:
Fortuna Kato 会做对她自己、也对星域最有利的事。她会尽力让 Achilles 胜出。

事实不变：Macario 必须被摧毁。

texts.en:
Fortuna Kato must be stopped as well. But how?

Undermine her position within the League through the machinations of the other gens, Hannan and Yaribay? Or by ensuring that Achilles has an independent base of support - enough that he need not answer to Fortuna's beck and call?

A direct approach could undermine Achilles. You'll have to be clever.
texts.zh:
Fortuna Kato 也必须被拦住。可怎么拦？

借另外两个氏族——Hannan 与 Yaribay——的算计来动摇她在联盟里的地位？还是确保 Achilles 有一块独立的支持基础——大到他不必听凭 Fortuna 呼来喝去？

直接动手可能会害了 Achilles。你得聪明些。

options.en: The fact remains - Macario must be destroyed
options.zh: 事实不变——Macario 必须被摧毁

texts.en:
Internal conflicts can and should be set aside; they're a distraction from what's important. Achilles has a war to win.

And Macario must be destroyed.
texts.zh:
内部的纷争可以、也应该先搁到一边；那只会让人从要紧的事上分心。Achilles 还有一场战争要打赢。

而 Macario 必须被摧毁。

texts.en:
What loyalty you had to the Sindrian Diktat is as void and null as your former commission. It is the natural consequence of betrayal.

This brings you to the second problem.
texts.zh:
你对辛达强权曾有过的忠诚，已和你从前的委任状一样归于无效。这是背叛的必然结果。

这就引出了第二个问题。

options.en: Macario is sitting safe behind the combined warfleets of the Sindrian Diktat.
options.zh: Macario 安稳地坐在辛达强权联合舰队的屏障之后。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

They will all thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，所有人都会感谢你。

首先就有一个大问题。

texts.en:
You've told Fortuna Kato you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor. By doing so, he'll tear down the Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from Macario's ruthless manipulation.

They will thank you when he is gone.

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，你会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。这样一来，他就能拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从 Macario 冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

等他倒了，他们会感谢你的。

首先就有一个大问题。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation.

You've even told Fortuna Kato that you'll back Achilles Andrada's bid to become Supreme Executor so long as she makes it worth your time. Her first payment was but a taste.

If Achilles wins, you get paid. If Achilles wins, Macario loses. What's not to like?

There's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。

你甚至已经告诉 Fortuna Kato，只要她出的价对得起你的时间，你就会支持 Achilles Andrada 争夺最高元首之位。她付的第一笔，不过是个开头。

Achilles 赢了，你拿钱。Achilles 赢了，Macario 就输了。有什么不好？

首先就有一个大问题。

texts.en:
You'll tear down his Spider's web and free the Persean Sector from his ruthless manipulation. You did deny Fortuna Kato's request to back Achilles' bid to become Supreme Executor, even if his victory would implicitly remove Macario from power.

You'll just have to ensure it happens by some other means.

And there's one big problem, to begin with.
texts.zh:
你要拆掉他这张蜘蛛网，把英仙座星域从他冷酷的操纵中解放出来。你确实拒绝了 Fortuna Kato 要你支持 Achilles 争夺最高元首之位的请求，尽管他的胜利会顺带让 Macario 失去权力。

你只能另想办法，确保这件事发生。

而首先，就有个大问题。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing but his own power to play games with the lives of those around him. He'll cause more chaos and death before the end, unless someone can truly take charge of the Sindrian Diktat.

Not a puppet - a leader.

The true heir to Philip Andrada must rise.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个毫无信义的操弄者，除了自己那点玩弄他人性命的本事，他什么都不信。除非有人能真正接手辛达强权，否则在一切结束之前，他还会制造更多的混乱与死亡。

不是傀儡——是领袖。

Philip Andrada 真正的继承人必须站出来。

texts.en:
Macario is a faithless manipulator who believes in nothing, who wants nothing but to play cruel games with the lives of those in his power.

He'll cause more chaos and death - unless someone takes charge of the Sindrian Diktat and frees it from his corrupting influence.
texts.zh:
Macario 是个没有信念的操纵者，什么都不信，只想拿那些落到他手里的人的性命，玩残酷的游戏。

他会造出更多的混乱与死亡——除非有人接管辛达强权，把它从他腐蚀性的影响中解救出来。

options.zh: 现在这些都无所谓——必须除掉 Macario

texts.en: You decide that whatever happens, you need to remove Macario. Who will lead the Sindrian Diktat can be decided later.
texts.zh: 你决定，无论之后如何，Macario 都必须先除掉。至于谁来领导辛达强权，可以以后再说。

texts.en:
You are a believer in the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Your bear a commission - or did until Macario declared it away.

Macario must be reminded of the power of loyalty - your own, above all - and his own to Andrada's vision. The pomp and intellectualization of the transcendent ideology is superstructure upon the fundamental fact that power flows to those who possess the will to seize and master it.
texts.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权。你持有它的委任状——至少在 Macario 宣布作废之前还持有。

必须让 Macario 想起忠诚的分量——尤其是你的忠诚——以及他对 Andrada 构想的忠诚。那套超凡意识形态的排场与高谈阔论，不过是上层建筑；底下那个根本事实是：权力归于那些有意志去夺取并驾驭它的人。

texts.en:
You are a believer in the power of the Sindrian Diktat, after all. Macario would wield that power, but he's a fool to try to discard his best ally in attaining power - perhaps even his better.

As satisfying as it would be to prove this to him by smashing down his office doors at the head of a squad of marines, this is a matter that requires opening with a round of negotiation.

Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting does not serve your purpose.
texts.zh:
毕竟，你信仰辛达强权的力量。Macario 想驾驭这份力量，可若他在夺权的路上抛弃自己最好的盟友，那他就是个蠢货——那位盟友或许还比他更胜一筹。

带着一队陆战队砸开他办公室的大门、当面向他证明这一点，固然痛快，但这件事得先以一轮谈判开场。

建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在无谓的厮杀里也达不到你的目的。

texts.en: Establishing a direct line of communication will be difficult, however. You cannot approach Sindria without being attacked, and if you prevailed against the defense fleets, wasting the power of the Diktat in senseless fighting would undermine your cause.
texts.zh: 不过，建立一条直通线路会很困难。你一靠近 Sindria 就会遭到攻击；就算你压过了那些防御舰队，让强权的力量耗在这种无谓的厮杀里，也只会削弱你自己的事业。

texts.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and set everything right.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，把一切拨回正轨。

texts.en:
One comes to mind.

There is a comms relay in the Askonia system. A nimble and stealthy fleet could sneak in, hack into the relay, and establish a comms-link directly with the Sindria network. Then you could explain to Macario the mistake he's made and give him one last chance to correct himself before you show him the true meaning of power.
texts.zh:
有一个办法浮上心头。

Askonia 星系里有一座通讯中继站。一支轻快而隐蔽的舰队可以潜入，黑进中继站，直接与 Sindria 的网络建立通讯链路。然后你就能向 Macario 说明他犯下的错误，在他见识到权力的真正含义之前，给他最后一次改过的机会。

options.en: I must confront Macario and make him recognize his error
options.zh: 我必须当面质问 Macario，让他认清自己的错误

options.en: It must be done. Macario must be shown the error of his ways
options.zh: 必须这么做。必须让 Macario 看清他错在哪里

texts.en:
He's put you in a tough spot and made himself your problem. Perhaps you can avoid Macario and the fallout from his schemes.

But Macario did declare you a psychotic, murderous terrorist in front of the entire Persean Sector, and the number one enemy of the Sindrian Diktat.

It won't be easy to ignore.
texts.zh:
他把你逼进一个难堪的境地，也把自己变成了你的麻烦。也许你可以避开 Macario，避开他那些算计带来的余波。

可 Macario 毕竟当着整个英仙座星域宣布你是个嗜血的疯子恐怖分子，是辛达强权的头号敌人。

想置之不理，没那么容易。

options.en: I'll just have to do my best

texts.en: It takes a moment for the bartender to realize who the shout came from - then they leap to obey, cowering apologetically.
texts.zh: 酒保花了一会儿才意识到喊声来自谁——然后他们连忙照办，畏缩着道歉。

texts.en:
You leave the bar flanked by bodyguards. Most of the patrons know better than to gawk at the executive leader of their present polity.

The corridors are quiet. Nonetheless, a squad of MuniSec joins your party, less from fear of a mob than the desire of the local section enforcer to earn your esteem.
texts.zh:
你在保镖的簇拥下离开酒吧。大多数顾客都知道不该盯着他们当前政体的行政首脑看。

走廊里很安静。尽管如此，一队市政安全兵加入了你的队伍，与其说是怕暴民，不如说是想...

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
texts.zh:
"...还有一名同谋，一个就藏在辛达强权政府内部的高层叛徒，此人的背叛已堕落到向 $playerName 提供一艘神圣的 Executor 级战舰——那是最高元首亲手设计的战列舰。"

他低下头片刻，仿佛在硬扛这桩恶行带来的伤痛与羞辱。

"在调查完成之前，我不会轻率地点出她...或者他的名字，但请放心，正义必将迅速而确凿。接下来还会有..."

随后，隔了两张桌子，又一名太空人转头望向你。

texts.en:
"...with a co-conspirator, a high-level traitor within the very government of the Sindrian Diktat whose treachery sunk to supplying $playerName with one of the sacred Executors, a battleship designed by the Supreme Executor himself."

He looks down for a moment, as if steeling himself against the weight of the hurt and shame of this vile act.

"I shall not recklessly name her... or him, until my investigation is complete, but rest assured that justice shall be swift and sure. There will be..."

Then, from a couple tables over, another spacer turns to look toward you.
texts.zh:
...与一位同谋，辛达强权政府内部的一名高层叛徒——其背叛行径甚至到了向 $playerName 提供一台神圣 “执行者” 战舰的地步，那是一艘由最高执行者本人设计的战列舰。

他低头看着...

options.en: It appears to be time to leave

texts.en: "Shh." A spacer at the next table shushes you without looking away from the projection.
texts.zh: "嘘。"邻桌的一个太空人嘘了你一声，目光始终没离开投影。

texts.en:
The spacer at the next table turns, finally. "Hey, I'm trying to watch..."

They squint at you, then look back at the holo - it's cut away from your face. The spacer gives you one more skeptical look then return their attention to the holo-cast.
texts.zh:
邻桌的太空人终于转过头来。"喂，我正看着呢..."

他眯起眼打量你，随后回头看向全息影像——画面已经从你脸上切走了。那太空人又带着怀疑看了你一眼，便把注意力收回全息直播上。

texts.en: "Shh." A spacer at the next table shushes you without looking away from the projection.
texts.zh: "嘘。"邻桌的一个太空人嘘了你一声，目光始终没离开投影。

texts.en:
Your outcry is covered by another loud, jarring tone meant to contribute to the threatening image of you being constructed in holo-projectors across the Sector.

There's a quick aside about strange experiments being carried out in the Galatia system related to the recent jump-point disruption. A tenuous link is implied via reference to (mostly) redacted port logs which may - or may not - contain your fleet's ident-codes released by the Hegemony recovery and reconciliation committee.
texts.zh:
你的喊声被又一声刺耳的巨响盖过——那声响是刻意加进来的，好让全星域的全息投影共同塑造出的这个凶险的你，更显得可怖。

接着是一段简短的插叙：Galatia 星系正在进行的诡异实验，与最近的跳跃点中断有关。片中引用了一批 (大部分已涂黑的) 港口日志，借此暗示出一条脆弱的关联：那些日志里或许有、或许没有你舰队的识别码，而这些识别码正是霸主恢复与和解委员会放出的。

texts.en:
The holo-stream at the center of the bar catches your eye as you spot a familiar face.

Your own.
texts.zh:
酒吧中央的全息流吸引了你的目光，你在上面看见一张熟面孔。

你自己的。

options.en: Lean back into the shadow a little more, and watch
options.zh: 再往阴影里靠一靠，静静看着

texts.en: The bartender dutifully acknowledges your shout with a gesture, and the volume increases noticeably.
texts.zh: 酒保尽职地抬手应了你的喊声，音量明显调高了。

texts.en:
Your face in the holo is replaced by that of one 'Syzygy Nane', a holo-star out of Westernesse - notable as a striking example of cosmetic modification achieving a mode of avant-garde which doesn't quite dip into outlandishness, but, at least, orbits it.

And they're talking about you.

"-from those official Sindrian holos, then I have a space elevator to sell you!"

Laughter. Audience reaction shot - assembled by software in what must have been real-time from viewers within reasonable lightspeed delay, the crowd demonstrates a peculiar mix of fashion and holo-avatars.
texts.zh:
你在全息影像里的脸被换成了"Syzygy Nane"——一位来自 Westernesse 的全息明星，堪称整容改造的醒目范例：那副前卫做派始终没真滑向怪诞，但至少绕着它打转。

而且他们正在谈论你。

"——这些话要是出自辛达的官方全息片，那我这儿还有台太空电梯要卖给你！"

笑声。观众反应镜头——想必是由软件从光速延迟范围内的观众那里实时汇编而成，人群呈现出时尚与全息化身混杂交错的怪相。

texts.en:
An ominous chord is struck, summoning banners of the Sindrian Diktat. A tiny, dancing Dolos Macario, his head over-large, like a child's puppet appears from between them.

Nane provides his voice, squeaking and whining about the 'degenerate spacer, mass-murderer $playerName!' overtop a small feed of the Sindrian Diktat propaganda - sped up, altered to look cheap and tawdry, somehow, its somber outrage undermined with effects trickery.

"Maybe," says Nane reasonably, setting aside the mini-Dolos voice, "there's something more to the story..."
texts.zh:
一段不祥的和弦响起，辛达强权的旗帜随之浮现。一个小小的、跳着舞的 Dolos Macario，脑袋大得不成比例，像个孩童玩偶，从旗帜之间钻了出来。

Nane 替他配音，尖声尖气地抱怨着那个'堕落太空人、杀人魔 $playerName！'，背景是一小段辛达强权的宣传片——被调了速度、改得廉价粗劣，那股庄重义愤不知怎么就败在了特效把戏之下。

"也许，\" Nane 收起小 Dolos 的嗓音，通情达理地说，\"这故事背后还有别的东西..."

texts.en:
Nane narrates, making you out to be not so much a mass-murderer as a luckless spacer. Well-intentioned on the whole, if a bit naive.

It plays a bit into the unfortunate stereotype of the dazed, undersocialized spacer who is taken advantage of by fast-talking, cosmopolitan dirt-siders.

Your reappearance in the holo breaks your stream of thought away from musing on your self-image.
texts.zh:
Nane 娓娓道来，把你塑造成一个不太像杀人魔、倒更像倒霉太空人的角色。总体上心地不坏，只是有点天真。

这多少迎合了那个不幸的刻板印象：一个懵懂、不善交际的太空人，被油嘴滑舌的都市地面人占了便宜。

你在全息影像里再次露面，打断了你对自我形象的沉思。

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of Hercules' office. You knock, and are let in. Time compression; a moment later Benoit leaves.

Time returns to its normal flow as a figure, blurred by active camo, appears and suddenly fires through the door. They pause a moment to shift their weapon and toss a grenade through the shredded doorway.

More fighting.

It ends showing you stumbling, dazed, from the ruined office, held up by two emergency response technicians. A victim.
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到 Hercules 办公室门外。你敲门，被让了进去。时间被压缩；片刻之后，Benoit 走了出来。

时间恢复常速，一个被主动伪装模糊着的身影现身，突然朝门内开火。他们停顿片刻，调整武器，往支离破碎的门口扔进一枚手雷。

更多交火。

最后是你在两名应急响应技师的搀扶下，恍惚地从残破的办公室走出来。一个受害者。

texts.en:
There you are again, walking across the entry lounge of the Galatia Academy. Cut to outside of an academician's office. You recognize it - presumably the spot where an attack was carried out on Hercules Cyrino.

You reflect that you still have no idea if he survived or not.

Cut to port logs, a quick cross. your $shipOrFleet the date highlights. Other side: surveillance feed of the office, its door caught receiving fire from a frag burst - frozen in time. Timestamped. Nane appears between them, examining one, then the other.

"How odd," Nane says, with a quizzical look. "I may just be a humble drop-out, but it looks like they don't match?"
texts.zh:
又是你，正走过 Galatia 学院的门厅。镜头切到一位院士的办公室外。你认得这里——想必就是 Hercules Cyrino 遇袭的地点。

你回想起来，自己至今不知道他是否活了下来。

镜头切到港口记录，一个快速的对照。你的 $shipOrFleet，日期被高亮标出。另一侧：办公室的监控画面，房门正被一枚破片弹击中——时间凝固。带时间戳。Nane 出现在两者之间，先看一个，再看另一个。

"真奇怪，\" Nane 面露疑惑，\"我可能只是个不值一提的退学生，可这两边看着对不上啊？"

texts.en:
"-more excitement than I ever had in tertiary education, and believe me, we knew how to party!"

This, to mini-Dolos, who nods and begins to dance.

"But" Nane gives mini-Dolos a little shove, and he falls on his bottom. "It's pretty obvious $playerName was the target of-"

Did Provost Baird cooperate to provide this security feed?

A bribe, or a hack?
texts.zh:
"——比我在大学时代经历过的任何刺激都多，相信我，我们那会儿可会玩了！"

这话是对小 Dolos 说的，他点点头，跳起舞来。

"不过——\" Nane 轻轻推了小 Dolos 一把，他一屁股坐倒在地。\"明摆着，$playerName 才是目标——"

是院长 Baird 配合提供了这段监控画面吗？

是贿赂，还是入侵？

texts.en:
"-a good time on Qaras," Nane continues, "believe me, you DON'T want to-"

There you are again, a grainy security sensor feed outside the bar. A huge goon puts a gun in your face...

"-can you believe this?"

Laughter. Audience reaction shots. A gesture and some meaningless words referencing some youth trend that hasn't broken out of the Westernesse system quite yet.
texts.zh:
"——在 Qaras 玩得开心，\" Nane 接着说，\"相信我，你绝对不想——"

又是你，酒吧外一段满是噪点的保安传感器画面。一个彪形大汉把枪口顶到你脸上...

"——你敢信吗？"

笑声。观众反应镜头。一个手势，外加几句没什么意义的词，引用了某种还没传出 Westernesse 星系的青年潮流。

texts.en:
Nane shifts to explaining the logs of a private courier operation to an increasingly uncomfortable mini-Dolos, dates and names highlighted. Low-profile shuttles to an obscure asteroid in the Hybrasil system.

Altered medical reports - a series of deaths, covered up over a period of many cycles before you ever found Elysium.

"Oh, that's awkward isn't it?" Nane exchanges looks with mini-Dolos, who shrugs in faux-innocence.
texts.zh:
Nane 转而向越来越坐立不安的小 Dolos 解说一桩私人信使业务的记录，日期与姓名被逐一高亮。低调的穿梭机飞往 Hybrasil 星系一颗偏僻的小行星。

被篡改的医疗报告——一连串死亡，在你发现 Elysium 之前，已经被掩盖了许多个星历年。

"哦，这可有点尴尬，是吧？" Nane 与小 Dolos 交换了个眼神，后者故作无辜地耸了耸肩。

texts.en:
Next is a clip from the other 'cast, the one from the real Macario. The words ORTHRUS MURDER: FATHER MOURNS SON in glowing blood-red.

The words shrink, as if the air was let out of them, and flop onto the ground under Nane's sardonic expression. Mini-Dolos attempts to lift the words back up, behind him the mockery-edit of real Macario's original propaganda holo, but the words prove too floppy and awkward, and finally he throws up his arms and sulks in frustration.
texts.zh:
接下来是另一档节目的片段，真正 Macario 那一档。血红色的发光大字：ORTHRUS 凶案：父亲哀悼儿子。

那些字缩小了，仿佛被抽干了气，软塌塌地掉到地上，Nane 脸上挂着嘲讽。小 Dolos 试图把字重新举起来，身后是真 Macario 原版宣传全息片的戏仿剪辑版，可那些字软得实在别扭，最后他只能扬起双臂，气恼地生闷气。

texts.en:
"If murder was the goal," says Nane, "why did Maeus Moroz get the last shot?"

From a high angle, a grimy feed. There's you and Maeus Moroz, sharing a drink. He looks gruff, but is nodding his head at your words. The bartender sets two small glasses down, and Moroz immediately empties his.
texts.zh:
"如果目标是谋杀，\" Nane 说，\"那最后一枪为什么是 Maeus Moroz 开的？"

高角度拍摄，一段脏兮兮的画面。你和 Maeus Moroz 在共饮。他脸色阴沉，却对你的话点着头。酒保放下两只小杯，Moroz 立刻一饮而尽。

texts.en:
"Methinks," Nane's head and voice tilt in a signature mid-sentence re-pitch, "a little spider's web of lies is looking a lit...tle convenient when you consider recent events..."

A tiny Hector and Achilles join the mini-Dolos, though child-sized even to him.

Immediately, they begin to fight, and for a moment it looks like Dolos might play the adult before - being the blackguard he is - tries to smack Achilles. With comic irony, little bully Hector sweeps Achilles' legs, allowing Dolos' hand to connect with Hector instead, and...

Meanwhile, a fat little Horacio Caden appears, completely unaware of the conflict, stumbling with a bottle in hand...
texts.zh:
"依我看，\" Nane 的头与声音在句中标志性地一偏，语调随之一变，\"一张小小的谎言蛛网，放到近来这些事里去看，可就显得有那么...点儿太方便了..."

一个小小的 Hector 和 Achilles 加入进来，站在小 Dolos 旁边，个头却连对他都算孩童尺寸。

他们立刻打作一团，有一瞬间，倒像是 Dolos 要扮演一回大人——可紧接着，他这个恶棍就去扇 Achilles 了。讽刺的是，小恶霸 Hector 一记扫腿把 Achilles 绊倒，让 Dolos 的手正好落在 Hector 身上，于是...

与此同时，一个胖乎乎的小 Horacio Caden 出现，完全没察觉那边的冲突，手里拎着酒瓶摇摇晃晃地走过来...

texts.en:
Nane's arms lift, sweeping away the whole comic-bizarre scene. The image dims and desaturates.

"I'm just your lovely everyday holo-friend, fellow Syzygens, but even I didn't have to look too close before the official story started unraveling. But first-"

Nane pivots seamlessly into an ad-read for an esoteric insurance scheme. A few spacers close to the bar grow bored and, at their behest, the bartender adjusts the holo stream.
texts.zh:
Nane 抬起双臂，把整幅滑稽荒诞的场景一扫而空。影像转暗，褪去色彩。

"我不过是你们可爱的日常全息朋友，各位 Syzygen 同胞，可就连我也不用凑得太近，官方的说法就开始崩线了。不过首先——"

Nane 无缝转进一段玄乎保险方案的广告口播。吧台边几个太空人听腻了，应他们要求，酒保调了调全息流。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Faro Inesis to arrange.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Faro Inesis 安排的那一出。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what you paid Arroyo to arrange.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定是你花钱请 Arroyo 安排的那一出。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Orcus Rao arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Hegemony's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Orcus Rao 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到霸主的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Finlay Siyavong arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of the Persean League's black-ops budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Finlay Siyavong 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到英仙座联盟的黑色行动预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it must have been what Fortuna Kato arranged to help with your reputation. You shake your head to think that part of Gens Kato's budget went to pay for it.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，肯定都是 Fortuna Kato 为帮你挽回名声安排的那一出。想到 Kato 氏族的预算有一部分花在了这上面，你不禁摇头。

texts.en: Whatever that was, it seems to have been designed to undermine Macario's efforts to destroy your reputation by making a farce of him and his narrative of somber outrage.
texts.zh: 不管那是什么，看来目的都是要拆 Macario 的台：他本想毁掉你的名声，如今他自己和他那套沉痛义愤的说辞反倒成了笑柄。

texts.en:
Hopefully it works.

As if in answer, a couple of spacers walking by do a double-take in recognition and... it's not fear, or hatred, but awkward acknowledgement. Their look seems to say 'dirt-siders, right? Mistake to trust them'.

You look back to the bar.
texts.zh:
但愿这有用。

像是回应一般，几个路过的太空人认出你来，愣了一下，回头又看——那神情不是恐惧，也不是憎恨，而是尴尬的会意。他们的眼神仿佛在说：'地面人嘛，对吧？信他们就是个错'。

你转回头看向吧台。

texts.en:
You accept the comm request. A voice crackles from the staticy display of your TriPad.

"Captain $playerName. I know why you're really here. I believe you and I can resolve this situation personally, though I must remain anonymous due to political considerations."

"I recognize that your capability to employ deadly force is not insignificant. I wish to propose a path of least bloodshed."

"You will have to trust me, captain. And, naturally, I cannot simply give you what you want; it will come at the price of $extr_storyCost credits. I hope you find this an acceptable compromise, given the alternative."
texts.zh:
你接受了通讯请求，TriPad 上充满静电干扰的图像里传出了声音。

"$playerName 舰长。我知道你来这里的真正原因，我相信我们可以私下解决这个问题，但出于政治考虑，我必须保持匿名。"

"我很清楚你动用致命武力的能力不容小觑。因此我想给出一些建议，能避免不必要的流血牺牲。"

"舰长，您一定要相信我。当然，我不能就这么把你想要的送给你；它的价格是 $extr_storyCost 星币。我希望对你来说这是笔合算的交易。"

options.en: Cooperate with the voice and pay the credits
Close the connection and head to the bar

texts.en:
The voice provides you with a numbered burner account for the credits transfer.

"Excellent, captain," the anonymized  voice says, "I confirm receipt of your payment. From this point it'll take only a short time for the arrangements to be made."

The voice gives you instructions to head to a particular bar, $extr_barName, near the concourse. "Goodbye, Captain $playerName," it says one last time.

With the sinking feeling that your target - and credits -might be further away from you with each passing minute, you enter the bar.
texts.zh:
对方为你提供了一个一次性账户用于转账。

"太好了，舰长，" 那个声音说，"我确认已经收到了你的付款。现在我需要一点时间来做些安排。"

这个声音指示你去一个特定的酒吧，名为 $extr_barName，它在广场附近。"再见，$playerName 舰长，" 声音最后这么说到。

时间一分一秒地过去，你的目标 —— 以及星币 —— 可能都会离你而去，带着这种消沉的感觉，你走进了酒吧。

texts.en:
The proprietor looks up as soon as you step into the dim tube-lit interior. "Hey!" You tense, at the tone. "You can't just let your friend sleep here, I'm not running a hotel yeah?" This must be $extr_barOwner.

$extr_barOwner pulls you toward a dark end of the bar where a figure appears to be passed out drunk; a rad-reflective hood has fallen over their face. You pull it back, and it is indeed your extraction target. Looking a little pale, unconscious, and drooling, but the face matches your intel.

"I don't want any trouble, maybe your friend's on chems, I don't ask questions. But see, I took care of 'em right? No call to municipal. Now you take your friend and go now. Go, get out!" He tries to shoo you toward the door as you lift the slack body.
texts.zh:
你一走进昏暗的灯管照明的室内，店主就抬起头来。"嘿！" 你被这语气吓了一跳。"你不能就这么让你的朋友睡在这里，我这可不是开旅馆的，明白吗？" 这个人一定就是 $extr_barOwner 了。

$extr_barOwner 把你拉到酒吧的一个角落里，那里有一个似乎喝醉了的人，一个防辐射面具一样的东西罩住了他的脸。你把那东西拿开，发现这人果然就是你的营救目标。对方的脸色有些苍白，失去了知觉，还流着口水，但你知道这张脸和你的情报相符。

"也许你的朋友在磕药，但我不想惹麻烦，我不会问不该问的。你看，我把他照顾得很好吧？我没打市政电话。所以现在你带着你的朋友走吧。走，出去！" 当你抬起那松弛的身体时，他试图把你推出酒吧。

texts.en:
$extr_barOwner rolls his eyes, "Your other friend showed me your holo, said look, my other friend the space captain is coming to pick this one up."

"Now you get going, I don't want people thinking my drinks are bad or maybe $extr_barOwner runs a place with no class. Go, go!"
texts.zh:
$extr_barOwner 翻了翻白眼："你的另一个朋友给我看了你的全息照，说：看，我的另一位朋友，这位舰长会来接这个人。"

"现在快走吧，我不想让人们认为我的酒不好，或者 $extr_barOwner 经营的餐厅没有档次。走，走！"

texts.en:
$extr_barOwner sighs loudly, "I tell you, then you go right? Now here's what I tell you: I didn't see anything. I'm running a spacer bar, not a children's creche. People come in, people go out. I don't look too close, I don't ask important questions, it's 'good run?', or 'price of fuel ain't what it was eh?'. That's the business."

"We made a deal, now you're leaving. Out, out!"
texts.zh:
$extr_barOwner 大声叹了口气："我告诉你，然后你马上就会走的对吧？现在我告诉你：我什么都没看见。我开的是太空佬酒吧，不是托儿所。人来人往。我不会多管闲事，也不会问重要的问题，只会问 '近况如何？' 或者 '燃料又涨价了不是吗？'，这就是本分。"

"我们说好了的，现在你快走。出去，出去！"

texts.en:
Outside the bar you pass the unconscious form to one of your bodyguards, whose subtle augments make carrying the limp form a matter of casual ease.

The automedic on the shuttle back reports that the agent was heavily and expertly sedated.

Returned to consciousness in secure quarters on your flagship, the agent is suspicious and uncooperative until you give the confirmation phrase you were provided. Calmer now, they have no explanation for how they ended up in $extr_barName.

Maybe it doesn't matter; you just have to get them back, get your pay, and the job is done.
texts.zh:
离开酒吧后，你把这个失去知觉的家伙递给了你的一个保镖，对方使用了一些巧妙的技巧，让搬人看起来变得轻松了不少。

在穿梭机上，检查报告显示特工被人用熟练的手法注射了大量镇静剂。

在你旗舰上的安全区域恢复意识后，特工一开始满腹狐疑，完全没有展现出合作的态度 —— 直到你对上了暗号。冷静下来后，他也无法解释自己为什么会在 $extr_barName。

也许这无关紧要，你只需要把他找回来，拿到工资，任务就完成了。

texts.en: "Impressive work, captain," the $faction $post says. "I'm told that you've helped us perform quite a coup on the intel front. The analysts are terribly excited."
texts.zh: "令人印象深刻，舰长。" $faction $post 说，"我听说你在帮助我们取得情报一事上取得了巨大成功。分析师们非常兴奋。"

texts.en:
"You've done some good work, captain," the $faction $rank says. "Our agent... will recover."

$HeOrShe leans back, eyes focusing on something abstract. "The pirates on the other hand, with the intel we've gained on their organization, their movements, their patsies in the civil service - we shall bring them the swift justice they've earned."
texts.zh:
"做得不错，舰长。" $faction $rank 说，"我们的特工...会痊愈的。"

$HeOrShe靠在椅背上，眼睛盯着一些说不清道不明的东西。"另一方面，我们获得了有关海盗的组织，行为模式，以及他们在政府部门的替罪羊的情报，我们将迅速给予他们应得的正义。"

texts.en:
"Good work captain," the $faction $rank says, "I must admit that I was not fully convinced that our agent could be safely extracted. The Pathers... it's never a proper stand-up battle with them." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head.

"Intel tells me our agent will provide information that shall let us roll up a great number of Pather infiltrator rings. No details of course, you know how this business is. I need not tell you how many lives you've saved."
texts.zh:
"干得好，舰长。" $faction $rank 说，"我必须承认，我根本没有料到我们的特工能被安全救出。左径分子...跟他们的战斗总是如此残酷。" $HeOrShe摇着$hisOrHer的头。

"情报人员告诉我，我们的特工提供的信息可以让我们找到大量渗透进来的左径分子。我不会透露细节，但你知道这意味着什么。我想我不必强调你救了多少人的命。"

texts.en: It appears that you have found the Church's lost heretics.
texts.zh: It appears that you have found the Church's lost heretics.

options.en: An agent of the Church hired me to find you.
options.zh: 一位教会的特工雇佣我来搜寻你们。

options.en: I shall bring word of you to my contact, to the Church.
options.zh: 我会把你们的消息传达给我的联络人，再带给教会。

options.en: I could bring word of you to my contact, to the Church...
options.zh: 我可以把你们的消息传达给我的联络人，再带给教会...

options.en: What are you doing out on the fringe?
options.zh: 你们到边缘星区干什么？

options.en: How can you crawl back to the Church when there is a Path more righteous?
options.zh: 既然有一条更正确的道途，你为什么要屈身爬回教会？

options.en: You have strayed far, $brotherOrSister, but the Church is rich in mercy
options.zh: 你偏离了正途，$brotherOrSister，但教会充满仁慈

options.en: How many of you need transport?
options.zh: 你们有多少人需要运输？

options.en: Offer to transport them to a Luddic Church world
options.zh: 提议将他们运送到 卢德教会 的星球

options.en: Transport them to a Luddic Church world, for forgiveness
options.zh: 将他们运送到 卢德教会 的星球，以求宽恕

options.en: Transport them to the Luddic Path, to start anew
options.zh: 将他们运送到 卢德左径 的星球，开启新生

options.en: Leave them for the Church to deal with.
options.zh: 让教会来处理他们的问题吧。

options.en: Make an excuse and cut the comms

texts.en:
"Oh, I... I see." $HisOrHer contenance shifts between relief and worry. "The Church, they- we are repentant! I swear it, even before you arrived."

"The false prophet who, who seduced us - his proclamations became bizarre. Unreasonable. Impious. He grew wroth at any questioning, claiming the angels commanded him, and then. Um."

"There was an accident." $PersonRank $PersonName looks aside, avoiding the gaze of the comms, "He is... I pray that his restless spirit might find a peace now which it did not know in life."
texts.zh:
"哦，我...我明白了。" $HisOrHer的表情在宽慰和担忧之间转换。"教会，他们...我们很后悔！我发誓，甚至在你们到来之前就已经在忏悔了。"

"那个伪先知，那个蛊惑了我们的家伙 —— 他的要求变得愈来愈...古怪。不合理。不虔诚。他不容许任何质疑，声称是天使给予了他启示，然后...嗯。"

"发生了一起事故。" $PersonRank $PersonName 看向一边，避开通讯设备的摄像头，"他被...我祈祷他不安的灵魂现在能找到生前从未有过的安宁。"

options.en: I see. That is an unfortunate course of events.
options.zh: 我明白了。事态发展的结果真是不幸。

options.en: I'm afraid that this all sounds like brazen heresy.
options.zh: 这一切听起来都像是一套厚颜无耻的异端邪说。

options.en: So you rubes got tricked until someone did the sensible thing and murdered the conman.
options.zh: 所以你们这些乡巴佬一直被骗着，直到有人终于做件明智的事，把那个骗子给宰了。

options.en: You're far from the true Path. Thank Ludd what had to be done was done.
options.zh: 你们偏离了正确的道途。感谢卢德，应行之事终于尘埃落定。

options.en: I take no pleasure in observing that your faith blinded you.
options.zh: 你的信仰蒙蔽了你的双眼，对此我可是高兴不起来。

options.en: It's a good thing someone finally stood up and murdered the scum, eh?
options.zh: 终于有人站出来杀了这个人渣，这是件好事，是吧？

texts.en: $PersonRank $personLastName bows slightly, hands clasped. "Yes. Our poor fortune is punishment for our foolishness, and faithlessness."
texts.zh: $PersonRank $personLastName 微微鞠躬，双手合十。"是的，我们的不幸是对我们的愚蠢和不虔诚的惩罚。"

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName looks only more defeated by your words.

"It is true," $heOrShe chokes out, not quite a sob. "We have been punished for our faithlessness."
texts.zh:
你的话让 $PersonRank $personLastName 显得更加沮丧。

"你说得对，" $heOrShe哽咽着，几乎要哭了出来。"我们为自己的不虔诚受到了惩罚。"

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName bristles at your words, but represses $hisOrHer instinct to react with anger.

"We were fools, yes," $heOrShe says, eyes downcast. "But it was... it was an accident. A terrible accident, nothing more."

$HisOrHer voice cracks with desperation, clinging to an agreed-upon truth.
texts.zh:
在听到你的话后，$PersonRank $personLastName 感到非常不快，但还是压制住了本能的愤怒。

"我们确实很愚蠢，" $heOrShe垂下眼睛。"但那...那是个意外。一个可怕的意外，仅此而已。"

$HisOrHer的声音带着绝望，坚持着那个认定的事实。

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName shifts uncomfortably at your words.

"It was an accident. A terrible accident, nothing more." $HisOrHer voice cracks with desperation, clinging to an agreed-upon truth. "We're not murderers! We seek only the peace of Ludd. And, and to atone."
texts.zh:
$PersonRank $personLastName 听到你的话后，身体很不自然地动了一下。

"那是一场意外。一场可怕的意外，仅此而已。" $HisOrHer的声音带着绝望，坚持着那个认定的事实。"我们不是凶手！我们只想寻求卢德的和平。还有，还有赎罪。"

texts.en:
"Pride!" The word bursts from $PersonRank $personLastName.

"It was pride that blinded us. A false revelation made us feel above all others, blessed with special knowledge. Had we but kept the true faith..."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head. "We have been punished for straying from the Church and seek now to repent."
texts.zh:
"骄傲！" 这个词从 $PersonRank $personLastName 口中迸发出来。

"正是骄傲蒙蔽了我们的双眼。错误的启示让我们觉得受到独特知识的恩惠，比其他人优越。而如果我们能保持真正的信仰的话..."

$HeOrShe摇摇头。"我们因背离教会而受到惩罚，现在只想寻求忏悔。"

texts.en:
$PersonRank $personLastName looks horrified. "We're not... no... it was an accident! A terrible accident, nothing more."

$HisOrHer voice cracks with desperation, clinging to an agreed-upon truth.

"We seek only the peace of Ludd. And, and to atone."
texts.zh:
$PersonRank $personLastName 看起来非常惊恐。"我们不是...不是...那是个意外！一个可怕的意外，仅此而已。"

$HisOrHer 的声音带着绝望，坚持着那个认定的事实。

"我们只想寻求卢德的安宁。还有，还有赎罪。"

texts.en:
"For that, ah, we would be most blessed and thankful to you. We shall pray for forgiveness," $heOrShe says solemnly, "And await the judgment of the Church."

$PersonName looks like $heOrShe badly wants to ask you something, and is considering if $heOrShe should.
texts.zh:
"那件事的话，呃，我们感谢并祝福您。我们会祈祷宽恕，" $heOrShe郑重地说道。"并等待教会的审判。"

$PersonName 看上去正在欲言又止地想要问你什么，但是却又在三思$heOrShe是否该问。

options.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
options.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

options.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wanted to ask.
options.zh: 如果你想问的是教会有什么打算，那我也不知道。

texts.en: "I... I see, $playerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh: "我... 我明白了，$playerSirOrMadam."

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows with uneasy acceptance, hands held together.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，不安又认命般地鞠了个躬。

texts.en: "Do you know what is intended for us?" $HeOrShe looks at you fearfully, "Will the Knight Inquisitors be sent?"
texts.zh: "您知道我们将会被如何处置吗？" $HeOrShe面露恐惧地看向你。"会有骑士审判官来吗？"

options.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
options.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

options.en: Truly, I don't know what the Church intends.
options.zh: 我真的不知道教会的安排。

options.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I could only assume so. Heresy is a serious crime.
options.zh: 我也只能如此推测了，异端可确实是重罪。

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows in acceptance, hands held together.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，鞠了个躬接受了这一切。

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows with fearful acceptance, hands held together. Not quite shaking.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，恐惧又认命般地鞠了个躬。但至少还没吓得浑身哆嗦。

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows in acceptance, embarrassed that you saw $hisOrHer intent so easily.
texts.zh: 被你轻易看出想法，$HeOrShe羞愧难当，认命般地鞠了个躬。

texts.en:
"The Church! Yes for that, ah, we would be most blessed and thankful to you. We shall pray for forgiveness," $heOrShe says solemnly, "And await the mercy of the Church."

$PersonName looks like $heOrShe badly wants to ask you something, and is considering if $heOrShe should.
texts.zh:
"教会！那件事的话，呃，我们感谢并祝福您。我们会祈祷宽恕，" $heOrShe郑重地说道。"并等待教会的宽恕。"

$PersonName 看上去正在欲言又止地想要问你什么，但是却又在三思$heOrShe是否该问。

options.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
options.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

options.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wish to ask.
options.zh: 如果你想问的是教会有什么打算，那我也不知道。

texts.en:
"We were followers of, a, a..."

Realizing that $heOrShe is falling over $hisOrHer words, $heOrShe takes a moment to collect $himOrHerself, and begins again.

"We believed a new revelation had been given, like that revealed unto Ludd. Our false prophet claimed to hear a choir of angels, and the song told him that a great cleansing would fall upon the Sector. A war between angels and demons to end the world. Any who did not follow our exodus would be destroyed by the wrath of God."
texts.zh:
"我们在追随着他，他..."

意识到自己语无伦次，$heOrShe稍作停顿，整理思绪后继续说道。

"我们相信神已经向我们给予了新的启示，就像卢德那次一样。我们的伪先知声称听到了天使的合唱，歌声告诉他，一场大灭绝将降临这个星域。天使与恶魔之间的战争将摧毁这个世界。任何不追随我们迁移的人都将因神的愤怒而被毁灭。"

texts.en:
"So we followed him, a handful of hundreds, to this place."

"Though this world is rich, it was not... it is no paradise. And the demands of our false prophet became... bizarre. Unreasonable. Impious. He grew wroth at any questioning, claiming the angels commanded him, and then. Um."

"There was an accident." $PersonRank $PersonName looks aside, avoiding the gaze of the comms, "He is... I pray that his restless spirit might find a peace now which it did not know in life."
texts.zh:
"于是我们跟随他，统共几百人来到这个地方。"

"虽然这个新世界很富裕。但它不是...它不是天堂。我们伪先知的要求变得愈来愈...古怪。不合理。不虔诚。他不容许任何质疑，声称是天使给予了他启示，然后...嗯。"

"发生了一起事故。" $PersonRank $PersonName 看向一边，避开通讯设备的摄像头，"他...我祈祷他不安的灵魂现在能找到生前从未有过的安宁。"

texts.en:
"The..." $heOrShe hesitates before saying the words. "The Path."

"You represent the Luddic Path?" $heOrShe blinks, rubbing $hisOrHer eyes. "They have a... strong reputation. Despite what the Church says, it seems like the Path is everywhere."

"Um," $PersonRank $personLastName looks to you nervously. "Do I understand correctly your... offer?"
texts.zh:
"左..." $heOrShe犹豫再三，还是说出了那个词。"左径。"

"你代表卢德左径？" $heOrShe揉了揉他的眼角。"他们的名声... 比较极端。看来不管教会怎么说，左径确实已无处不在。"

"唔，" $PersonRank $personLastName紧张地看着你。"所以我没理解错您的... 提议吧？"

options.en: Yes, I will take you to the Path. There you will discover true faith.
options.zh: 是的，我会带你去见左径。你会在那里发现真正的信仰。

options.en: No, we're just discussing faith. Just words.
options.zh: 不，我们只是在讨论信仰。说说而已。

texts.en:
Grim-faced, $heOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands and bows in submission.

"Anything to free us of this false paradise."
texts.zh:
$heOrShe面色凝重地双手合十，鞠躬臣服。

"只要能把我们从这个虚假的乐园中带走，怎么都可以。"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe sputters, "Of course. Just words. I didn't mean to imply..."

$HeOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat nervously, letting $hisOrHer words trail off.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe语无伦次道。"当然。只是说辞。我不是指..."

$HeOrShe紧张地清了清嗓子，$hisOrHer的声音渐渐缩小。

texts.en:
You explain that although you have no spiritual or secular power within the Church of Galactic Redemption, you could perhaps provide transport to a place where they could atone for their heresy.

"Yes," $heOrShe looks hopefully at you. "We seek to repent, and keep to the true faith."
texts.zh:
你解释道，虽然你在 银河救赎教会 中并没有特别的宗教或世俗权力，但你或许可以安排将信徒们送到一个可以为他们的叛教行为赎罪的地方。

"是，" $heOrShe满是希望地看着你。"我们寻求宽恕，以维持真正的信仰。"

texts.en: "There are 198 of us remaining, captain."
texts.zh: "舰长，我们还剩 198 个人。"

texts.en:
"There are 198 of us remaining, captain."

The $manOrWoman looks up, hopefully. "Some of us have spacefaring experience and, and other useful trades. We could work as crew during the journey back to the core worlds. If it helps."
texts.zh:
"舰长，我们还剩 198 个人。"

这个$manOrWoman充满希望地抬起头。"我们中有些人有太空航行和其他有用技艺的经验。如果能帮得上您，我们可以在返回 核心世界 的路程上作为船员替您工作。"

texts.en: Your $shipOrFleet has $player.crewRoomStr spare crew berths. This would be sufficient to transport this lost sect.
texts.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet有 $player.crewRoomStr 额外船员宿舍空间。这足以运送这一迷途的教派。

texts.en:
Your $shipOrFleet has $player.crewRoomStr spare crew berths. There is not enough room to transport the lost sect.

Seeing your hesitation, $heOrShe adds, "The ship that brought us to this place, it's... we stripped it for supplies, but we've seen the hull in orbit. Or so we believe."
texts.zh:
你的$shipOrFleet有 $player.crewRoomStr 额外船员宿舍空间。这不足以运送这一迷途的教派。

看到你的犹豫，$heOrShe补充道。"送我们来此地的那艘舰船...虽然我们为了寻求补给把它清空了，但是我们相信船体应该还在轨道上。"

texts.en:
"We, um. Our former... the false prophet, he said we must be rid of the sin of Mammon before our exodus." $HeOrShe looks down, abashed, "Perhaps we acted with unreasonable haste when we gave up all of our credits."

The $manOrWoman looks up, hopefully. "Some of us have spacefaring experience and useful trades. We could work as crew during the journey back to the core worlds. If it helps."
texts.zh:
"我们，呃，我们以前的...假先知，他说我们必须在离开前摆脱恶魔玛门的罪孽。" $HeOrShe羞愧地低头说，"也许我们放弃所有星币的举动过于草率了。"

这个$manOrWoman充满希望地抬起头来。"我们中的有人具有航天和其他派得上用场的行业经验。我们可以在返回核心世界的旅程中担任船员。如果您用得上的话。"

texts.en:
"We, um. Our former... the false prophet, he said we must be rid of the sin of Mammon before our exodus." $HeOrShe looks down, abashed, "Perhaps we acted with unreasonable haste when we gave up all of our credits."

The $manOrWoman looks up, hopefully. "Some of us have spacefaring experience and useful trades. We could work as crew during the journey back to the core worlds. If it helps."
texts.zh:
"我们，呃，我们以前的...假先知，他说我们必须在离开前摆脱恶魔玛门的罪孽。" $HeOrShe羞愧地低头说，"也许我们放弃所有星币的举动过于草率了。"

这个$manOrWoman充满希望地抬起头来。"我们中的有人具有航天和其他派得上用场的行业经验。我们可以在返回核心世界的旅程中担任船员。如果您用得上的话。"

texts.en:
"Blessings of Ludd upon you, $playerSirOrMadam!" the Luddic $personRank says, effusing about redemption and the like. You manage to offload $himOrHer to an adjutant 'to make arrangements'.

Ops gruffly coordinates shuttles with the planetside heretics. They are a thin and subdued group, nearly starving despite the lush landscape of $entity.name due to their former prophet's lack of preparation.

If nothing else, perhaps the Church will appreciate the return of a lost flock.
texts.zh:
"愿卢德降福于您，$playerSirOrMadam！"卢德 $personRank 滔滔不绝地谈论着救赎之类的东西。你设法把$himOrHer交给副官 "安排"。

行动长官粗暴地用穿梭机与地面上的卢德异端们对接。他们虚弱不堪、毫无活力，尽管 $entity.name 的植被郁郁葱葱，但由于他们的前先知缺乏准备，他们快要饿死了。

如果不出意外的话，也许教会为迷失羔羊们的回归而感激。

texts.en:
"Blessings of Ludd upon you, $playerSirOrMadam!" the Luddic $personRank cries out, and wipes away tears of relief.

You have your officers make the arrangements, coordinating with the planetside heretics. They are a thin and subdued group, nearly starving despite the lush landscape of $entity.name due to their former prophet's lack of preparation.

The Church will surely take in these refugees, with mercy and love, provided they repent.
texts.zh:
"愿卢德降福于您，$playerSirOrMadam！" 卢德 $personRank 失声高呼，拭去如释重负的泪水。

你让你的副官做好了和星球上卢德异端对接的相关安排。他们虚弱不堪、毫无活力，尽管 $entity.name 的植被郁郁葱葱，但由于他们的前先知缺乏准备，他们快要饿死了。

教会必将以仁慈与爱心接纳这些难民，只要他们迷途知返。

texts.en:
"Blessings of Ludd upon you, $playerSirOrMadam," the Luddic $personRank says grimly, perhaps anticipating the new path upon which $heOrShe has set $hisOrHer very first step.

You have your officers make the arrangements, coordinating with the planetside heretics. They are a thin and subdued group, nearly starving despite the lush landscape of $entity.name due to their former prophet's lack of preparation.

The Path will take them. The Path knows well of faith betrayed.
texts.zh:
"愿卢德降福于您，$playerSirOrMadam，" 卢德 $personRank 阴沉地说道，也许$heOrShe正在期待$hisOrHer那踏上全新道途的第一步。

你让你的副官做好了和星球上卢德异端对接的相关安排。他们虚弱不堪、毫无活力，尽管 $entity.name 的植被郁郁葱葱，但由于他们的前先知缺乏准备，他们快要饿死了。

左径会接纳他们。左径深知被背弃的信仰。

texts.en:
"Oh, I... I see." $HisOrHer contenance shifts between relief and worry. "The Church, they- we are repentant! I swear it, even before you arrived."

"The false prophet who, who seduced us - his proclamations became bizarre. Unreasonable. Impious. He grew wroth at any questioning, claiming the angels commanded him, and then. Um."

"There was an accident." $PersonRank $PersonName looks aside, avoiding the gaze of the comms, "He is... I pray that his restless spirit might find a peace now which it did not know in life."
texts.zh:
"哦，我...我明白了。" $HisOrHer的表情在宽慰和担忧之间转换。"教会，他们...我们很后悔！我发誓，甚至在你们到来之前就已经在忏悔了。"

"那个伪先知，那个蛊惑了我们的家伙 —— 他的要求变得愈来愈...古怪。不合理。不虔诚。他不容许任何质疑，声称是天使给予了他启示，然后...嗯。"

"发生了一起事故。" $PersonRank $PersonName 看向一边，避开通讯设备的摄像头，"他被...我祈祷他不安的灵魂现在能找到生前从未有过的安宁。"

texts.en:
"For that, ah, we would be most blessed and thankful to you. We shall pray for forgiveness," $heOrShe says solemnly, "And await the judgment of the Church."

$PersonName looks like $heOrShe badly wants to ask you something, and is considering if $heOrShe should.
texts.zh:
"那件事的话，呃，我们感谢并祝福您。我们会祈祷宽恕，" $heOrShe郑重地说道。"并等待教会的审判。"

$PersonName 看上去正在欲言又止地想要问你什么，但是却又在三思$heOrShe是否该问。

options.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
options.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

options.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wanted to ask.
options.zh: 如果你想问的是教会有什么打算，那我也不知道。

texts.en:
"The Church! Yes for that, ah, we would be most blessed and thankful to you. We shall pray for forgiveness," $heOrShe says solemnly, "And await the mercy of the Church."

$PersonName looks like $heOrShe badly wants to ask you something, and is considering if $heOrShe should.
texts.zh:
"教会！那件事的话，呃，我们感谢并祝福您。我们会祈祷宽恕，" $heOrShe郑重地说道。"并等待教会的宽恕。"

$PersonName 看上去正在欲言又止地想要问你什么，但是却又在三思$heOrShe是否该问。

options.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
options.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

options.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I don't know what the Church intends, if that is what you wish to ask.
options.zh: 如果你想问的是教会有什么打算，那我也不知道。

texts.en: "Do you know what is intended for us?" $HeOrShe looks at you fearfully, "Will the Knight Inquisitors be sent?"
texts.zh: "您知道我们将会被如何处置吗？" $HeOrShe面露恐惧地看向你。"会有骑士审判官来吗？"

options.en: Know that I follow the Path. It may well lead not where the Church preaches.
options.zh: 我虽行卢德之径，而这条路径所及之处却并不一定如教会所教那般。

options.en: Truly, I don't know what the Church intends.
options.zh: 我真的不知道教会的安排。

options.en: The Church will tend to its flock.
I could only assume so. Heresy is a serious crime.
options.zh: 我也只能如此推测了，异端可确实是重罪。

texts.en: "I... I see, $playerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh: "我... 我明白了，$playerSirOrMadam."

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows with uneasy acceptance, hands held together.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，不安又认命般地鞠了个躬。

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows with fearful acceptance, hands held together. Not quite shaking.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，恐惧又认命般地鞠了个躬。但至少还没吓得浑身哆嗦。

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows in acceptance, hands held together.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe双手合十，鞠了个躬接受了这一切。

texts.en: $HeOrShe bows in acceptance, embarrassed that you saw $hisOrHer intent so easily.
texts.zh: 被你轻易看出想法，$HeOrShe羞愧难当，认命般地鞠了个躬。

texts.en: $HeOrShe gives you the nav coordinates of $locrlf_systemName and hull ID for the heretics' transport, the 'CGR Light of Exultation'.
texts.zh: $HeOrShe给了你 $locrlf_systemName 的导航坐标，以及异端们所乘运输船的舰船 ID，'CGR Light of Exultation'。

texts.en: $PersonName nods along as you explain how you found the heretics, not looking particularly interested.
texts.zh: 你向 $PersonName 解释着你找到这帮异端的过程，$HeOrShe一边听着一边点着头，看来也没有多感兴趣。

texts.en: "Thank you, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says. "I shall bring the archcurate your report posthaste. Please accept your reward, as promised."
texts.zh: "谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam。" $heOrShe感谢道："我会尽快把你的报告传达给大祭司，请收下先前承诺的奖励。"

texts.en:
"Thank you, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says. "I shall bring the archcurate your report posthaste. Please accept your generous reward."

"I shall tell the archcurate that your fee was higher than expected," $personName mumbles to $himOrHerself.
texts.zh:
"谢谢你，$playerSirOrMadam。" $heOrShe感谢道："我会尽快把你的报告传达给大祭司，请收下这一大笔奖励。"

"还得跟大祭司说说，你收的钱比预想的多。" $personName 小声自言自语。

texts.en: Now, of course, there's the matter of the heretics.
texts.zh: 当然，现在就轮到异端的问题了。

texts.en: Now, of course, there's the matter of the heretics.
texts.zh: 当然，现在就轮到异端的问题了。

texts.en: Now, of course, there's the matter of the former heretics.
texts.zh: 当然，现在就轮到前异端的问题了。

options.en: Also, the heretics are on board my $shipOrFleet. I intend to return them to the Church.
options.zh: 还有就是，我的$shipOrFleet也把异端载回来了，我准备把他们送回教会。

options.en: Also, the heretics are on board my $shipOrFleet. I intend to take them to a world of the Luddic Path.
options.zh: 还有就是，我的$shipOrFleet也把异端载回来了，我准备把他们送去 卢德左径 治下的世界。

options.en: The repentant heretics are on board my $shipOrFleet. I intend to return them to the Church.
options.zh: 我的$shipOrFleet把忏悔过的异端载回来了，我准备把他们送回教会。

texts.en:
$personName's eyes go wide.

"What!? You brought them here?" $HeOrShe covers $hisOrHer face with $hisOrHer hands and makes a noise too pained to be a sigh.

"By Ludd's hammer, that wasn't the job! I... I didn't know anything about this. I'll specifically say I told you to report back with just confirmation of their position and status."
texts.zh:
$personName突然瞪圆了双眼。

"啥？你把他们带回来了？" $HeOrShe双手捂脸，似乎要叹气，但痛苦到声音都不对了。

"看在卢德之锤的份上，那可不是工作的内容！我...我也不知道怎么办了，我得跟大祭司说清楚了，我只要你确认一下他们的位置和情况的。"

texts.en:
"As for you- take those heretics somewhere else! Or at least wait until I've made my report to offload them. I want nothing to do with them, this isn't my fault!"

The signal cuts, leaving you with an ancient comms software fallback-pattern.
texts.zh:
"至于你 —— 把这帮异端带到别处去吧！再或者等到我做完报告了，再把他们放下船。我可没让你去安置他们，不是我的错！"

信号断开，你眼前只剩下一款古老通讯软件的退出界面。

texts.en:
$personName sighs, deeply, as if you've brought $hisOrHer rather more trouble than the signed up for. Because you have.

"I cannot imagine what, by Ludd's hammer, compelled you to bring the heretics here. So here's what we're going to do."

"I," $heOrShe pauses, giving you a stern look, "I know nothing about them. You delivered your news to me, now I shall tell the archcurate that's all you told me. You will dispose of those faithless ingrates however you see fit, and I'll have had nothing to do with it, good-day."

The comms cut out.
texts.zh:
$personName 长叹一口气，仿佛你帮$hisOrHer干活反倒是添乱了 —— 确实是添乱了。

"看在卢德之锤的份上，我都不敢想你是中了什么邪，才把异端带到我这里了。那我就这么办..."

"我..." $heOrShe突然停下，严厉的看着你："我不知道你带来了异端，你只带来了异端的消息，至少我只能跟大祭司这么讲。这帮信仰不坚定的白眼狼就随你处置了，不管怎么干都不关我事，再见。"

通讯断开了。

texts.en:
$personName's eyes go wide.

"What? The... Path? And you brought them here!? What by Ludd's hammer possessed you to do such a thing?"
texts.zh:
$personName突然瞪圆了双眼。

"啥？左... 左径？你还把他们带来这里了！？卢德的铁锤在上，你是中了什么邪，才能整出这种事！"

options.en: I found the missing heretics. They're all dead. (lie)
options.zh: 我找到迷失的异端了，他们都死了。 (说谎)

texts.en:
$HeOrShe nods along as you explain how you found the heretics dead in their 'promised land', led astray and to their doom, if not damnation. $PersonName doesn't look particularly upset.

"Such is the fate of those who would spit on the Church of Galactic Redemption," $heOrShe says, then goes quiet. Perhaps pondering the fate of heretics who managed to avoid the Knight Inquisitors.
texts.zh:
你向 $PersonName 解释着你发现这群异端死在自己 '应许之地' 上的过程，这帮异端踏上歧途，最后也就自我毁灭了，或许算得上天谴。$HeOrShe一边听着一边点着头，看来也没有多伤心。

"对 银河救赎教会 不敬的人，就该有这种下场。" $heOrShe冷不丁说出这么一句，然后又一言不发，或许是在仔细思考这群避开了骑士审判官的异端的命运。

options.en: That's all there is to it.

texts.zh:
$personName突然瞪圆了双眼。

"啥？左... 左径？你还把他们带来这里了！？卢德的铁锤在上，你是中了什么邪，才能整出这种事！"

texts.en:
$HeOrShe waves $hisOrHer hands as if this might make the situation go away. "No. No, you didn't tell me this. I know nothing; I'll report to the archcurate that you found the heretics, and what happens from there is your - their - business. Good-day!"

The signal cuts, leaving you with an ancient comms software fallback-pattern.
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe自欺欺人的挥挥手，仿佛这么做就能让情况好起来。"不。不，这话不是你跟我说的，我什么都不知道。我只会跟大祭司汇报，说你找到异端了，再往后出什么事就看你 —— 看他们怎么折腾了。再！见！"

信号断开，你眼前只剩下一款古老通讯软件的退出界面。

texts.en:
$personName sighs, deeply, as if you've brought $hisOrHer rather more trouble than the signed up for. Because you have.

"I cannot imagine what, by Ludd's hammer, compelled you to bring the heretics here. So here's what we're going to do."

"I," $heOrShe pauses, giving you a stern look, "I know nothing about them. You delivered your news to me, now I shall tell the archcurate that's all you told me. You will dispose of those faithless ingrates however you see fit, and I'll have had nothing to do with it, good-day."

The comms cut out.
texts.zh:
$personName 长叹一口气，仿佛你帮$hisOrHer干活反倒是添乱了 —— 确实是添乱了。

"看在卢德之锤的份上，我都不敢想你是中了什么邪，才把异端带到我这里了。那我就这么办..."

"我..." $heOrShe突然停下，严厉的看着你："我不知道你带来了异端，你只带来了异端的消息，至少我只能跟大祭司这么讲。这帮信仰不坚定的白眼狼就随你处置了，不管怎么干都不关我事，再见。"

通讯断开了。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

texts.en: Your sensors officer reports that a high-powered scan of the coordinates provided shows the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target is long abandoned, but appears to be in relatively good shape.
texts.zh: 在对提供的坐标进行高能扫描之后，传感器技官报告说 $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target 虽然废弃了很久，但状况相对还算好。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

texts.en:
Your sensors officer reports that a high-powered scan of the coordinates provided shows the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target is long abandoned, but appears relatively intact.

However, there is also a fresh burnt-out shuttle in a nearby landing complex. On the obvious approach path is the scar of a debris field, apparently created by the low-velocity impact of a second shuttle. Nearby ruins show signs of some light orbital bombardment, likely retaliatory.

It appears as though a lightly-equipped scavenger attempted this operation once before and was caught off guard by the local decivs. Your sensors officer coordinates targeted scans with Tactical to estimate hostile combat capabilities.
texts.zh:
在对提供的坐标进行高能扫描之后，传感器技官报告说 $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target 虽然废弃了很久，但还算是完整。

然而，在附近的降落设施上，也发现了一艘刚刚耗尽燃料没多久的穿梭机，在降落轨迹上还留下了一片明显的残骸区，看来是另一艘穿梭机遭到低速碰撞造成的。附近的建筑遗迹似乎也受到了小规模轨道轰炸，可能是出于报复。

看来在你之前，就有过一群装备不足的拾荒者来执行任务，并且在放松警惕的时候被当地蛮荒人偷袭了。传感器技官与战术军官互相协调进行精确扫描，确认敌方战斗力。

options.en: Send a team down to retrieve the data

texts.en:
You order a small salvage team deployed.

Under the close watch of your operations chief, they access the $rdsm_target and exchange the new datacore for the old.
texts.zh:
你命令投放一小支打捞小组。

行动长官仔细观察着打捞小组进入 $rdsm_target，用新的核心替换了原有的那个。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

options.en: Consider a ground operation to retrieve the data
options.zh: 考虑地面作战来获取数据

options.en: Drop 10 units of supplies at a nearby location to distract the locals
options.zh: 在附近投下 10 单位补给，来分散当地人的注意力

texts.en:
You order a few cargo crates loaded with supplies then rigged with visual-audio-radio emergency beacons and disposable landing rockets.

It's an old trick when dealing with decivs, but it usually works. Whether they accept the supplies as payment, bribery, or simply relatively high tech goods in an environment largely cut off from interstellar commerce, the value of these crates is literally astronomical.

You watch a cluster of crates shrink to spots, then disappear into the face of $name.
texts.zh:
你调来了几箱补给，给它们装上了声光无线电三合一紧急信标，还有一次性着陆火箭。

这算是处理蛮荒人的常用手段，但一般都能起效。不管他们是把这些补给当成你的报酬、贿赂，还是单纯知道在这种基本和星际经贸无缘的环境里，这些补给算是罕有相对高科技的产物，这几箱东西总之对他们能算得上价值非凡。

你看着几个补给箱渐渐变成小点，最后消失在 $name 的地表。

texts.en:
"Drop telemetry reads successful surface contact," your sensors officer reports, who taps at their console then mumbles something into another comms channel. "Confirmed by $shipOrFleet instruments."

Tactical signals acknowledgement, then says "Mission is go."

The landing shuttles glitter with a burst of propulsion then drop in silent formation toward the surface. The cargo drop was close enough to the target zone to distract any decivs present, but far enough - hopefully - to clear or persuade away any active resistance.

Within minutes, shuttles report unimpeded landing. Salvor crews deploy immediately through the settling dust cloud, only lightly armed to ensure maximum operational speed.
texts.zh:
"遥测数据显示已成功建立地表联系。" 你的传感器技官报告道，他轻敲控制台，然后在另一个通讯频道低声说了些什么，"$shipOrFleet的仪器已对此进行了确认。"

战术信号得到了确认，随后传来指令："任务继续。"

在推进器的一阵闪光中，登陆穿梭机以静默的队形向地表降落。登陆仓投放位置距离目标区域足够近，足以分散所有在场蛮荒人的注意力，但也足够远 —— 希望如此 —— 以清除或劝退任何可能的主动抵抗。

几分钟后，穿梭机报告已顺利着陆。打捞小组迅速穿过逐渐散去的烟尘进行部署，他们仅携带了轻武器，以确保最大的行动速度。

texts.en:
The small salvage team accesses the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target, cutting through sealed locks and blasting weak points as needed. Their work is sloppy, even crude, compared to your ops chief's usual standards - intentionally so. The physical evidence of your crews' intrusion is meant to appear to be the work of local decivs' random plundering rather than a targeted job.

Objective found, your salvors swap out the specified data core and install the fake. They carefully create the appearance of random tampering, plundering a few obvious modular and interface components that would be of interest to cut-off decivs, then re-dust the scene.

From orbit, your sensors officer spots movement in nearby terrain; armed locals. The salvors perform a quick evac before they can bring heavy weapons to bear and, aside from a few light energy weapon burns on the shuttle plating, there's no harm done.
texts.zh:
打捞小组成功潜入了 $rdsm_megacorpName 的 $rdsm_target，他们破除了密码锁，并在必要时对薄弱点进行了爆破。与行动长官平日执行任务的严谨标准相比，这次行动显得颇为马虎，甚至有些粗鲁 —— 但这正是他们有意为之。这样做的目的是为了让船员们入侵的痕迹更像是当地蛮荒人随性掠夺的结果，而非有针对性的行动。

确认目标后，打捞人员迅速替换了指定的数据核心，并安装了伪造的数据核心。他们细心地制造出了随机破坏的假象，带走了一些会引起蛮荒人兴趣的模块和接口组件，然后重新布置了现场，覆盖灰尘以掩盖痕迹。

从轨道上，你的传感器技官报告附近地形中有移动痕迹；是本地武装力量。在他们架设重型武器之前，打捞小组迅速撤离。除了穿梭机外壳上留下几处轻型能量武器的灼烧痕迹外，并未受到任何伤害。

texts.en:
The planet below appears to lack any settlements or open comms transmissions. You have your comms officer do a broad transmission of the IFF codes, and a simple ping of approval is returned.

The source of the ping is an outcrop overlooking a plausibly natural-looking plateau. You couldn't ask for a more perfect site to land a shuttle, nor one more exposed to weapon emplacements which would be concealed in the surrounding bluffs.
texts.zh:
下方的行星似乎没有任何定居点或开放的通讯传输。你让通讯军官广播了 IFF 代码，随后收到了一个简短的批准回应。

回应信号源自一处俯瞰自然高原的岩脊。你找不到比这更完美的穿梭机降落地点了，但同样，这里也暴露在可能隐藏在周围悬崖上的武器阵地之下。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

options.en: Talk your way in, and out, of the secret outpost
options.zh: 发挥你的口才，潜入并撤离那个秘密据点

texts.en:
To ensure everything goes smoothly, you take personal command of the lead transport shuttle.

There's a mere flicker of targeting lasers and a sweep or two of radar. Nothing to worry about, you calmly assure your pilot, who looks to be breaking out in sweat.

Your landing is met by little more than a large, armored cargo-hatch opening from under an overhang; an invitation.
texts.zh:
为确保一切顺利，你亲自带领穿梭机出发。

只有微弱的指示激光照射和一两次雷达扫描，没什么可担心的。你平静地向你的飞行员保证，尽管他看起来有点汗流浃背了。

你们着陆时，只见一个巨大的装甲货物舱门从一处悬挑下方缓缓打开；仿佛是在邀请你们进入。

texts.en:
Your party is armed and armored, but respectfully - these are underworld criminals who wish to be considered dangerous - but not indecently. Over-icing the cake, as it were, would appear suspicious; there's a delicate balance to navigate when it comes to these things, you explain to your nervous crew. You take care not to mention the recessed autoturrets that have been tracking your shuttle.

Confidence is the word.
texts.zh:
你们的小队全副武装，但请注意 —— 你们是希望被视为危险人物的地下犯罪分子，但又不能太过张扬。就像给蛋糕加太多糖霜会显得可疑一样，在处理这些事情时需要把握微妙的平衡，你向紧张的船员们解释道。你谨慎的没有提及那些一直在追踪你们穿梭机的隐蔽自动炮塔。

信心是关键。

texts.en:
The local boss left in charge of this depressing cave has the pale, antsy look of an underling who has been cooped up for too long with little to do but gamble and use.

He wipes a greasy lock of hair from his forehead and looks at you suspiciously. His stinking underlings finger their short, brutish guns.

"You're not Skinny Diego," he says.

"I was told Diego was doing the pickup. Where's Diego?"
texts.zh:
负责看守这个阴郁洞穴的当地头目，面色苍白，眼神焦虑，看起来像一个被长期囚禁、除了赌博和嗑药外无事可做的喽啰。

他抹掉前额上油腻的一缕头发，用怀疑的眼光打量着你。他那些臭气熏天的小弟们则用手指摩挲着他们短小粗陋的武器。

"你不是 Skinny Diego，" 他说道。

"上面告诉我来接头的是 Diego。Diego 在哪里？"

options.en: Diego couldn't make it, friend. He told me to give you his regards. (lie)
options.zh: Diego 来不了了，朋友。他让我代他向你问好。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm afraid Diego had a little accident. Boss is getting me to fill in. (lie)
options.zh: Diego 遇到点小麻烦。头儿让我来代替他。 (说谎)

options.en: Diego and the boss had a disagreement, so now I'm your Diego. (lie)
options.zh: Diego 和老大闹翻了，所以现在我就是你要等的 Diego 了。 (说谎)

texts.en: "Diego said that?" His beady little eyes scrunch up, his hands tense. "Diego hates my guts. He'd never say that."
texts.zh: "Diego 是这么说的？" 他眯起眼睛，双手紧绷。"Diego 恨死我了。他绝不会这么说的。"

options.en: Between you and me, I think he meant it ironically, like.
options.zh: 这里就你和我，我觉得他在说反话，你懂吧。

texts.en:
"Yeah?" He licks his lips, taking a moment to revel in a growing anger.

"Diego can eat rads and burn in vacuum, for all I care. Think's he's too fancy to come out here and do a bit of grunt work? Just like Diego."

He jabs a finger at you, "You can tell him I said that, too. I don't even care."
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他舔了舔嘴唇，在逐渐升腾的愤怒中沉浸片刻。

"Diego 就算被辐射烤焦，在真空里烧成灰，我也不在乎。觉得自己太了不起，不肯到这儿来干点苦活？就像 Diego 一样。"

他用手指着你，"你也可以告诉他我是怎么说的。我压根不在乎。"

options.en: Gladly! It's about time someone told Diego how it is.
options.zh: 当然！是时候让 Diego 面对现实了。

texts.en:
"It is, isn't it," the man says slowly.

He looks at you with a new sense of self-confidence.

"You're not afraid to get your hands dirty, are you cap," he says with a gleam in his eye. Or maybe it's a pre-hangover glaze, judging from his shaky posture. "I had a good feeling about you as soon as I saw you weren't Diego."
texts.zh:
"确实如此，不是吗？" 这个男人缓缓说道。

他换了种欣赏的眼神看着你。

"你不怕亲自动手干脏活，对吧，老兄？" 他眼中闪烁着光芒。不过，从他摇摇晃晃的站姿来看，那也可能只是宿醉前的恍惚。"我一见你不是 Diego，就对你有好感了。"

options.en: Me, uh, too. Now then! There's work to do...
options.zh: 呃...我也是。那么现在！该干活了...

texts.en:
You manage to decline repeated offers to share a bottle of 'the good stuff' while the boss iterates Diego's many failings. You nod and agree in vague but enthusiastic terms, performing your emotional support role with aplomb.

Some time later, a polite, slightly embarrassed junior logistics technician knocks on the open doorway - there's no door - of the utility nook that passes for the boss's office to inform you that the cargo is fully loaded.

He insists on personally escorting you, a little unsteadily, to your shuttle's airlock and shakes your hand before you step inside. "It's people like you that make this job worth it, cap. Solid, trustworthy. Willing to step up."

The door seals with a thunk you feel through your boots; finally, relief.
texts.zh:
你巧妙地回绝了走私者老大一再提出的共饮 "佳酿" 的邀请，而他则反复诉说着 Diego 的种种不足。你含糊其辞却又不失热情地点头应和，完美地扮演了情感支持者的角色，从容不迫。

不多时，一名礼貌而又略显拘谨的年轻物流专员，在那充当老板办公室的狭小工具间前 —— 那里根本没有门可敲，只是象征性地做了个敲门的动作 —— 通知你货物已经装载完毕。

尽管脚步略显踉跄，他坚持要亲自将你护送至穿梭机的气闸，并在你踏入之前紧紧握住你的手。"正是有了像你这样的人，这份工作才变得有意义，舰长。你稳重、可靠，勇于担当。"

随着气闸门 "嘭" 地一声封闭，你脚下的震动清晰可感；终于，你松了一口气。

texts.en:
It's not quite the bloody job your contact $rsom_contactName had in mind, but such a shocking display of incompetence is sure to cause a shake-up in whichever criminal enterprise this lot is - or, soon, was - involved with.

And now you've got a hold full of hot $rsom_product to unload.
texts.zh:
这可不是你联络人 $rsom_contactName 心中所想的那份血腥差事，但如此令人震惊的无能表现，定会在这帮家伙所涉及的，或即将涉及的任何犯罪组织中引起轩然大波。

而现在，你手里有一大堆烫手的 $rsom_product 等待处理。

texts.en:
"An accident? How? Where?" The man's hands tense. "Diego never has accidents. He's careful."

A thought congeals, slowly but surely.

"Well. I suppose he's not that careful. But he's lucky, always lucky. What happened?"
texts.zh:
"一次意外？怎么发生的？在哪里？" 男人的手紧张地攥了起来，"Diego 从不会出意外。他很谨慎。"

一个念头似乎在他心中缓慢但坚定地凝聚起来。

"好吧。我想他也没那么谨慎。但他运气很好，总是很走运。到底发生了什么？"

options.en: Ever seen a cheap agrav plate overload? Should fail-safe. Unless...
options.zh: 你见过廉价的反重力装置过载的样子吗？通常它具备故障安全机制。除非...

texts.en:
"Unless..." the man looks at you, strung along on your words. He takes a few moments to pick up on your implication.

To help him understand, you give a concerned look and dart your eyes around. Then, in low words, you explain that perhaps it should be discussed later. 'Accidents' like that don't just happen without someone wanting them to happen, and who knows if there aren't more snakes in the organization? Someone must be making a move - but we can't let them know that we know, much less let them know we know they know we know.

The boss nods along, now looking at even his own crew suspiciously.
texts.zh:
"除非..." 男人紧盯着你，被你的话所吸引。他花了几秒钟的时间来理解你的言外之意。

为了帮助他理解，你投去了一个关切的眼神，并环顾四周。然后，你低声解释道，这件事应该稍后再讨论。像那样的 "意外" 不会无缘无故地发生，谁知道组织里还有没有更多的毒蛇呢？一定有人在暗中行动 —— 但我们不能让他们知道我们已经察觉，更不能让他们知道我们知道他们知道我们已经察觉。

走私者老大一边点头，一边开始连自己的手下也怀疑起来了。

options.en: Let's get the cargo loading. I'll fill you in.
options.zh: 先让我们装货。待会儿细说。

texts.en:
He takes you to a grubby office, a utility nook really, overlooking the main bay as your crews get to work loading the $rsom_product.

A bottle of something strong and cheap appears, and you do your part in pretending to drink it as you fill his head with paranoid half-truths built on details he reveals.
texts.zh:
他把你带到一间肮脏的办公室，更像一个杂物间，从这里可以俯瞰到主要港口，你的船员正在那里忙着装载那些 $rsom_product。

这时，一瓶廉价而烈性的酒出现了，你一边假装喝酒，一边根据他透露的细节，向他灌输一系列误导性的半真半假的信息。

texts.en:
Some time later, a polite, slightly embarrassed junior logistics technician from your crew gently knocks and informs you that the cargo is fully loaded.

You act as if you've had much more than you actually imbibed and make your excuses and promises as you pretend-stumble back to your transport shuttle.

Once the doors close, you stand up straight, dropping the act. The junior logistics technician does her best not to look too relieved.
texts.zh:
一段时间后，你手下一位礼貌而又略显拘谨的年轻物流专员轻轻敲门，告诉你货物已经全部装载完毕。

你装作自己已经喝得烂醉，边道歉边许诺，同时假装摇摇晃晃地走回你的运输穿梭机。

舱门一关闭，你立刻挺直身子，不再伪装。那名下级物流专员尽力不让自己显得太过放松。

texts.en:
"A disagreement?" The man looks more than shocked; appalled. "But Diego's his own brother, his blood. He'd never cut Diego out of a job. Never! Never ever."

He looks unsteady, physically unwell, as if what was solid hullplate turned out to be little more than ration-wrappings.

"What could be so terrible? Diego, Diego..." He shakes his head, almost in tears.
texts.zh:
"闹翻了？" 男人看起来不仅仅是震惊，简直是惊骇，"但 Diego 是他的亲兄弟，他的血亲。他绝不会把 Diego 从岗位上赶走。绝不会！永远也不会。"

他看上去身体不适，摇摇晃晃，就好像原本坚实的船体甲板突然变成了脆弱不堪的包装纸。

"到底发生了什么可怕的事情？Diego，Diego..." 他摇着头，几乎要哭出来了。

options.en: It's bad. Couldn't tell it... not without a drink.
options.zh: 糟透了。我实在说不出口...除非喝上一杯。

texts.en:
"Of course, of course," the boss says, putting a hand on your shoulder. Now that you can smell the metabolic byproducts - and spillage - of hard, bad liquor, you would suppose that he has a hangover to drink away.

"I've right forgot my welcome, haven't I. Come, come! I've got a bottle open. It's good stuff. Put your crew to work loading and we can talk about what happened. Stars above, Diego..." he shakes his head, wanting to disbelieve, but unable.
texts.zh:
"当然，当然，" 走私者老大说着，把手搭在你的肩上。此刻，你能闻到他身上因大量饮用劣质烈酒而散发的代谢废物和呕吐物的气味，你猜他可能是想用酒精来驱散宿醉。

"我竟然忘了好好招待你，真是失礼了。来，来！我这儿已经开了一瓶好酒。这可是上等货。让你的手下先去装货，我们可以聊聊发生了什么。天哪，Diego..." 他摇着脑袋，心里不愿相信，但又没法否认。

options.en: Order your crew to work. And gird your liver.
options.zh: 让你的手下开始干活，同时让你的肝做好战斗准备。

texts.en: A nearby hostile fleet is tracking your movements, making a ground operation impossible.
texts.zh: 附近的一支敌对舰队正在追踪你的动向，使你无法开展地面行动。

texts.en:
A flight of shuttles is deployed, armed lightly enough to show respect to the smugglers but without being outwardly conspicuous. What appears to be a motley logistics crew with token guards approach the armored doors of the hidden base, hauling their basic cargo-moving tools: robotic lifts and agrav-fitted pallets, the usual.

Upon entrance, at the signal, weapons-fire erupts from the entire party. False air tanks conceal light arms and single-shot anti-armor tubes; utility panniers are stuffed with grenades and miniature assault drones. All are loosed in a few seconds of blinding violence which catch the smugglers completely off-guard.

After the initial shock comes the grind, and your marines pay for lack of heavy armor as they face recessed auto-turrets and not more than a few heavily armed criminals hiding in the worm-tunnels which loop through and around the rotten stone.
texts.zh:
一组穿梭机被部署出去，它们只有轻量的武装，既表现出对走私者的尊重，又不至于太过显眼。一支看似由杂牌后勤人员和几名象征性的守卫组成的队伍，正朝着隐藏基地的装甲大门靠近，他们拖拽着基础的货物搬运工具：机器人升降机和装有反重力装置的托盘，这些都是再平常不过的东西。

一进入基地，接到信号后，整支队伍立即开火。伪装的氧气罐中藏着轻武器和单发反装甲炮；杂物袋里塞满了手榴弹和迷你攻击无人机。在短短几秒内，就发生了一场令人眼花缭乱的火力倾泻，走私者们完全措手不及。

最初的震惊过后，便是艰苦的鏖战，面对着隐蔽的自动炮塔，还有大量藏在蜿蜒曲折、遍布泥浆的虫穴中全副武装的犯罪分子，你的陆战队员因为缺乏重型装甲而付出了代价。

texts.en:
It was the bloody job your contact $rsom_contactName had in mind. Such a shocking display of incompetence is sure to cause a shake-up in whichever criminal enterprise this lot is - was, rather - involved with.

And now you've got a hold full of hot $rsom_product to unload.
texts.zh:
这正是你联系人 $rsom_contactName 心中所想的那份血腥差事。但如此令人震惊的无能表现，定会在这帮家伙所涉及的，或已经涉及的任何犯罪组织中引起轩然大波。

而现在，你手里有一大堆烫手的 $rsom_product 等待处理。

texts.en:
To ensure everything goes smoothly, you take personal command of the lead transport shuttle.

There's a mere flicker of targeting lasers and a sweep or two of radar. Nothing to worry about, you calmly assure your pilot, who looks to be breaking out in sweat.

Your landing is met by little more than a large, armored cargo-hatch opening from under an overhang; an invitation.
texts.zh:
为确保一切顺利，你亲自带领穿梭机出发。

只有微弱的指示激光照射和一两次雷达扫描，没什么可担心的。你平静地向你的飞行员保证，尽管他看起来有点汗流浃背了。

你们着陆时，只见一个巨大的装甲货物舱门从一处悬挑下方缓缓打开；仿佛是在邀请你们进入。

texts.en:
Your party is armed and armored, but respectfully - these are underworld criminals who wish to be considered dangerous - but not indecently. Over-icing the cake, as it were, would appear suspicious; there's a delicate balance to navigate when it comes to these things, you explain to your nervous crew. You take care not to mention the recessed autoturrets that have been tracking your shuttle.

Confidence is the word.
texts.zh:
你们的小队全副武装，但请注意 —— 你们是希望被视为危险人物的地下犯罪分子，但又不能太过张扬。就像给蛋糕加太多糖霜会显得可疑一样，在处理这些事情时需要把握微妙的平衡，你向紧张的船员们解释道。你谨慎的没有提及那些一直在追踪你们穿梭机的隐蔽自动炮塔。

信心是关键。

texts.en:
The local boss left in charge of this depressing cave has the pale, antsy look of an underling who has been cooped up for too long with little to do but gamble and use.

He wipes a greasy lock of hair from his forehead and looks at you suspiciously. His stinking underlings finger their short, brutish guns.

"You're not Skinny Diego," he says.

"I was told Diego was doing the pickup. Where's Diego?"
texts.zh:
负责看守这个阴郁洞穴的当地头目，面色苍白，眼神焦虑，看起来像一个被长期囚禁、除了赌博和嗑药外无事可做的喽啰。

他抹掉前额上油腻的一缕头发，用怀疑的眼光打量着你。他那些臭气熏天的小弟们则用手指摩挲着他们短小粗陋的武器。

"你不是 Skinny Diego，" 他说道。

"上面告诉我来接头的是 Diego。Diego 在哪里？"

options.en: Diego couldn't make it, friend. He told me to give you his regards. (lie)
options.zh: Diego 来不了了，朋友。他让我代他向你问好。 (说谎)

options.en: I'm afraid Diego had a little accident. Boss is getting me to fill in. (lie)
options.zh: Diego 遇到点小麻烦。头儿让我来代替他。 (说谎)

options.en: Diego and the boss had a disagreement, so now I'm your Diego. (lie)
options.zh: Diego 和老大闹翻了，所以现在我就是你要等的 Diego 了。 (说谎)

texts.en: "Diego said that?" His beady little eyes scrunch up, his hands tense. "Diego hates my guts. He'd never say that."
texts.zh: "Diego 是这么说的？" 他眯起眼睛，双手紧绷。"Diego 恨死我了。他绝不会这么说的。"

options.en: Between you and me, I think he meant it ironically, like.
options.zh: 这里就你和我，我觉得他在说反话，你懂吧。

texts.en:
"Yeah?" He licks his lips, taking a moment to revel in a growing anger.

"Diego can eat rads and burn in vacuum, for all I care. Think's he's too fancy to come out here and do a bit of grunt work? Just like Diego."

He jabs a finger at you, "You can tell him I said that, too. I don't even care."
texts.zh:
"是吗？"他舔了舔嘴唇，在逐渐升腾的愤怒中沉浸片刻。

"Diego 就算被辐射烤焦，在真空里烧成灰，我也不在乎。觉得自己太了不起，不肯到这儿来干点苦活？就像 Diego 一样。"

他用手指着你，"你也可以告诉他我是怎么说的。我压根不在乎。"

options.en: Gladly! It's about time someone told Diego how it is.
options.zh: 当然！是时候让 Diego 面对现实了。

texts.en:
"It is, isn't it," the man says slowly.

He looks at you with a new sense of self-confidence.

"You're not afraid to get your hands dirty, are you cap," he says with a gleam in his eye. Or maybe it's a pre-hangover glaze, judging from his shaky posture. "I had a good feeling about you as soon as I saw you weren't Diego."
texts.zh:
"确实如此，不是吗？" 这个男人缓缓说道。

他换了种欣赏的眼神看着你。

"你不怕亲自动手干脏活，对吧，老兄？" 他眼中闪烁着光芒。不过，从他摇摇晃晃的站姿来看，那也可能只是宿醉前的恍惚。"我一见你不是 Diego，就对你有好感了。"

options.en: Me, uh, too. Now then! There's work to do...
options.zh: 呃...我也是。那么现在！该干活了...

texts.en:
"An accident? How? Where?" The man's hands tense. "Diego never has accidents. He's careful."

A thought congeals, slowly but surely.

"Well. I suppose he's not that careful. But he's lucky, always lucky. What happened?"

"一次意外？怎么发生的？在哪里？" 男人的手紧张地攥了起来，"Diego 从不会出意外。他很谨慎。"

一个念头似乎在他心中缓慢但坚定地凝聚起来。

"好吧。我想他也没那么谨慎。但他运气很好，总是很走运。到底发生了什么？"

Someone must be making a move - but we can't let them know that we know, much less let them know we know they know we know.

texts.en:
You manage to decline repeated offers to share a bottle of 'the good stuff' while the boss iterates Diego's many failings. You nod and agree in vague but enthusiastic terms, performing your emotional support role with aplomb.

Some time later, a polite, slightly embarrassed junior logistics technician knocks on the open doorway - there's no door - of the utility nook that passes for the boss's office to inform you that the cargo is fully loaded.

He insists on personally escorting you, a little unsteadily, to your shuttle's airlock and shakes your hand before you step inside. "It's people like you that make this job worth it, cap. Solid, trustworthy. Willing to step up."

The door seals with a thunk you feel through your boots; finally, relief.
texts.zh:
你巧妙地回绝了走私者老大一再提出的共饮 "佳酿" 的邀请，而他则反复诉说着 Diego 的种种不足。你含糊其辞却又不失热情地点头应和，完美地扮演了情感支持者的角色，从容不迫。

不多时，一名礼貌而又略显拘谨的年轻物流专员，在那充当老板办公室的狭小工具间前 —— 那里根本没有门可敲，只是象征性地做了个敲门的动作 —— 通知你货物已经装载完毕。

尽管脚步略显踉跄，他坚持要亲自将你护送至穿梭机的气闸，并在你踏入之前紧紧握住你的手。"正是有了像你这样的人，这份工作才变得有意义，舰长。你稳重、可靠，勇于担当。"

随着气闸门 "嘭" 地一声封闭，你脚下的震动清晰可感；终于，你松了一口气。

texts.en:
It's not quite the bloody job your contact $rsom_contactName had in mind, but such a shocking display of incompetence is sure to cause a shake-up in whichever criminal enterprise this lot is - or, soon, was - involved with.

And now you've got a hold full of hot $rsom_product to unload.
