这可不是你联络人 $rsom_contactName 心中所想的那份血腥差事，但如此令人震惊的无能表现，定会在这帮家伙所涉及的，或即将涉及的任何犯罪组织中引起轩然大波。

而现在，你手里有一大堆烫手的 $rsom_product 等待处理。

texts.en:
You feel almost imperceptible vibrations as the assault shuttles return to your $shipOrFleet, their work complete. You listen for a moment to the open broad-comm channel; the line crackles and squeals with the last gasps of electronic warfare distorted through chaff and the warp of fresh plumes of charged particles. It's a familiar sound; you can almost smell it.

Tactical has casualty reports prepared for review. You acknowledge with a nod and shut off the comms.
texts.zh:
当突击穿梭机返回你的$shipOrFleet时，你感受到了几乎无法察觉的震动，看起来他们的工作已经完成。你听了一会儿开放的广播频道，在电子战余波的影响下，带电粒子在传输线路中的行进轨迹仍未恢复正常，通讯线路中时不时传来异响和尖啸。这种声音再熟悉不过了：听着它，你仿佛可以闻到线路烧焦的味道。

战术分析组已经总结好了伤亡报告。你点头示意，然后关闭了通讯。

texts.en:
"It's probably- I'm certain- I, I," Menes stutters, "The power will come back soon. Those rad-addled Olinadu contractors," he attempts a nervous laugh.

You feel the dull thuds, nearly subsonic, through the armored mass of the vault. Breaching charges for the first layer of defense. You know the big one will come soon, and where.

Menes is in a growing panic.
texts.zh:
"可能是 —— 我敢肯定 —— 我，我，" Menes 结巴道，"电力很快就会恢复的。都怪那些脑子被辐射照坏的 Olinadu 承包商。" 他试图挤出个紧张的笑容。

你感觉到，近乎次声波般低沉的撞击声透过保险库厚重的装甲传来。这是突破第一道保护层的爆破炸药。你知道更大的冲击就要来了，也知道会从哪里来。

Menes 越来越惊慌失措。

texts.en:
You feel almost imperceptible vibrations as the assault shuttles return to your $shipOrFleet, their work complete. You listen for a moment to the open broad-comm channel; the line crackles and squeals with the last gasps of electronic warfare distorted through chaff and the warp of fresh plumes of charged particles. It's a familiar sound; you can almost smell it.

Tactical has casualty reports prepared for review. You acknowledge with a nod and shut off the comms.
texts.zh:
当突击穿梭机返回你的$shipOrFleet时，你感受到了几乎无法察觉的震动，看起来他们的工作已经完成。你听了一会儿开放的广播频道，在电子战余波的影响下，带电粒子在传输线路中的行进轨迹仍未恢复正常，通讯线路中时不时传来异响和尖啸。这种声音再熟悉不过了：听着它，你仿佛可以闻到线路烧焦的味道。

战术分析组已经总结好了伤亡报告。你点头示意，然后关闭了通讯。

texts.en: The task is done to $dsp_personName's specifications, and whatever blackmail or intimidation it was intended to underline is surely moving forward.
texts.zh: 该任务已按照 $dsp_personName 的要求完成，无论那人打算开始向对方进行什么敲诈或恐吓，这下都应该有效得多了。

options.en: Perhaps, Menes, we should take cover...
options.zh: Menes，也许我们应该找个地方躲起来...

texts.en:
When the marines finally breach the vault proper, it is with overwhelming force of sound and light. No unprotected human can withstand this assault on the senses; you are blinded, shocked, and rendered immobile. All you can do is cling to the kernel of self at the center of a storm of pain.

* * *

The return is slow, an awakening from a terrible and drugged sleep to emergency medical personnel and Menes' somewhat tardy security teams in their gleaming armor.

You and Bornanew leave the compound among the other victims. Bandaged, bruised, head aching, ears ringing.
texts.zh:
当陆战队员最终攻破保险库本体时，随之而来的是排山倒海般的强光与巨响。没有未穿戴防护的人类能承受这种感官冲击；你瞬间被致盲，意识被震慑，动弹不得。在这场席卷一切的痛苦风暴中，你唯一能做的，就是死守住那一点残存的意识。

* * *

意识的回归很缓慢，仿佛从一场可怕的药物昏睡中醒来。你看到了急救人员和 Menes 那些姗姗来迟、身穿闪亮盔甲的安保团队。

你和 Bornanew 混在其他受害者中离开了庄园。他们身上缠满绷带，遍体鳞伤，头痛欲裂，耳鸣不止。

texts.en:
Hours later, after a series of transfers to obscure your movements from the heightened official surveillance, you step back onto your own shuttle - and the attentions of your personal medical team.

A chime on your TriPad confirms that the operation was a success. A holo of the simple work-glove that human beings fought and died over rotates mockingly.

"Evidence," Bornanew says, tired but alert. His eyes are alarmingly bloodshot. "The seed of schism and war. Now whence did this come?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你通过一系列转乘摆脱官方加强的监视，回到了自己的穿梭机上 —— 也回到了你私人医疗团队的照料下。

你的 TriPad 上响起一声提示音，确认行动成功。那个人类曾为之战斗、牺牲的，普通工作手套的全息影像嘲弄般地旋转着。

"证据，" Bornanew说道，他虽然疲惫但很警觉。他的眼睛布满了血丝，看起来很吓人。"分裂与战争的种子。这东西是从哪来的？"

options.en: I don't suppose we could ask Menes.
options.zh: 我们大概没法去问 Menes。

options.en: What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?
options.zh: 你对那个 Ulmus Pond 有什么看法？

texts.en:
"No," he manages a smile for just a moment. "I would suppose not."

He looks back down at the holo.
texts.zh:
"是啊，" 他勉强挤出一丝微笑。"我也这么想。"

他低头看向全息影像。

texts.en:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us much of this object," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By the truths found in the false glove, we may judge answers we receive from those we... ask." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church's nanoforge is on Asher. Canaan system. The techs there will submit to the authority I bear. Our inquiry will be secret."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
texts.zh:
"纳米锻炉工程师可以告诉我们这东西的信息，" 他说。"像谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。看看这只假手套里藏着什么真相，我们也许就能判断出我们从那些...被问过的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "问过" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会服从我所代表的授权。我们的调查会被保密。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线。"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内保密。"

options.en: We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes puts the pieces together here.
options.zh: 我们得在 Menes 搞清楚发生了什么之前，把事情实锤了。

texts.en:
Bornanew nods agreement.

The shuttle approaches your flagship and prepares to dock.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点头同意。

穿梭机靠近了你的旗舰，准备停泊。

texts.en:
Your comms officer intercepts you on the way to the medbay looking determined but apologetic.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. The local security authority has issued a blanket order for all fleets to stay in orbit pending an investigation into an, ah, attack against the demarchon of Olinadu."
texts.zh:
在去医务室的路上，你的通讯军官拦住了你，表情坚定但带着歉意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。本地安全部门发布了全面指令，要求所有舰队留在轨道上，等待对 Olinadu 统领遭遇的，呃，袭击事件的调查。"

options.en: We're not registered with traffic control, correct?
options.zh: 我们没有在交通管制那边登记过，对吧？

texts.en: "Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam," they reply. "However we can assume that the present higher state of alert will detect the $shipOrFleet's de-orbit burn."
texts.zh: "是的，$playerSirOrMadam，" 对方回答。"但是可想而知，在这样的高度戒备状态下，$shipOrFleet 进行离轨机动很容易被侦测到。"

options.en: Then we'd better go fast when we go.

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They salute and step back so the med tech can finish waving a scanner - the high-pitched hum just inside your hearing - in search of broken bones. $global.jethroName undergoes a similar procedure in the next bay.

Before the hour you are discharged with a smart stimpack strapped to your side, under your uniform jacket, to control the pain and keep you alert.

You're not out yet. You can easily see that the local authorities don't discover Menes' trinket if your $shipOrFleet is searched, but that search would waste valuable time and disrupt operations.
texts.zh:
"是，$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 他们敬了个礼，退后一步，好让医疗技师继续挥舞扫描仪检查是否有骨折 —— 那高频的嗡嗡声刚好在你的听力范围内。$global.jethroName 正在隔壁的隔间接受类似的检查。

在你出院前，他们给你在制服夹克内侧绑上了一个智能兴奋剂包，用来控制疼痛并保持清醒。

事情还没结束。你很清楚，就算你的$shipOrFleet被搜查，当局也找不到 Menes 的小玩意，但搜查会浪费宝贵的时间并干扰接下来的行动。

texts.en:
"A Pather agent," he says conclusively.

"We spoke briefly," he says. "In the aftermath. He insisted the medical team check him. Wasn't hurt."

Bornanew takes a deep breath, wincing. "But he slipped up. Heretical theology. Devil in the details. You can tell where one learned the Word, or, rather, a corruption of the Word, from the details."

"He may be connected, but first we should ask the glove." He looks back down at the holo.
texts.zh:
"一个左径特工。" 他断言道。

"事后我们简单聊了几句，" 他说。"他坚持要医疗队检查他。他根本没受伤。"

Bornanew 深吸一口气，厌恶般开口道。"但他露馅了。异端神学。魔鬼就藏在细节中。你可以从细节中分辨出一个人是在哪里学来的 圣言，或者说，学来的腐化版 圣言。"

"他可能和这事有关，但我们得先查查这只手套。" 他又低头看向全息影像。

texts.en: The task is done to $dsp_personName's specifications, and whatever blackmail or intimidation it was intended to underline is surely moving forward.
texts.zh: 该任务已按照 $dsp_personName 的要求完成，无论那人打算开始向对方进行什么敲诈或恐吓，这下都应该有效得多了。

texts.en:
$name fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out, and with that your mission parameters are fulfilled.

With a simple wave of your hand the tactical display collapses and winks out. The holomatrix snows and reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the very center.
texts.zh:
$name 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。当最后一个图标出现之后，你的任务完成了。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

texts.en:
$name fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out, and with that your mission parameters are fulfilled.

With a simple wave of your hand the tactical display collapses and winks out. The holomatrix snows and reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the very center.

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

texts.en:
$marketName fills your bridge tactical display, a spatter of hollowed icons representing dead targets. The last one blinks out. This should make the Warlord Kanta happy, if she is even capable of that emotion anymore.

You wave a hand to collapse the tactical display, and it winks out obediently. The holomatrix snows then reforms a navigational overview, your $shipOrFleet holding station in the center.
texts.zh:
$marketName 占满了你的舰桥战术显示界面，代表目标被击毁的空心图标不断飞溅而出。随着最后一个目标熄灭，这该能让军阀 Kanta 高兴了，如果她还能有那种感情的话。

你轻轻挥手，战术显示界面随之折叠关闭。四散的全息噪点随后重聚成了导航总览界面，你的$shipOrFleet正稳稳驻留在画面正中央。

texts.en:
The target is disheveled, and looks to have gone some time without sleep. They have one of those perfectly ordinary faces; just another tech, clerk, or laborer that passes by on the transport tube. All that trouble, for this?

"Thank you captain," they give a wan smile as your guards lead them to a secure compartment, "I'm expected home now, I'm sure."
texts.zh:
目标蓬头垢面，看起来已经有一段时间没有睡过觉了。对方相当的相貌平平；就像你平时不会多加留意的，从货运通道中经过的技术人员、职员或工人。弄得如此麻烦，就为了这么个人？

"谢谢你，舰长，" 当你的警卫把那人领到一个安全的舱室时，对方脸色苍白地笑了笑，"我敢笃定我现在想家想死了。"

texts.en: You have a meeting scheduled with a Mammonite to talk with a third party who might know something about Jethro Bornanew, but it is not yet the agreed upon time.
texts.zh: 你有一个日程安排，准备同一个玛门之仆一起，和某位可能了解 Jethro Bornanew 的人会面。但现在还没到约定的时间。

texts.en:
You approach the smiling patron, who turns and keeps their eyes firmly locked at a menu display on the wall while a somewhat fanciful concoction appears on the bar.

"There are so many options, $playerName," they say deliberately. "Not everyone wants the same thing. Some disagree quite strongly, but are too polite to say so out loud." Eyes flicker to the door, then to a holodisplay of some news item about the leading political cadre of $jabr_marketName.

"Perhaps you'd like what I'm having?" They take a long sip, "It comes at quite a price because there are others who want it very, very much as well. $jabr_storyCost credits."
texts.zh:
你走近那位面带微笑的顾客，对方转过身来，但眼睛依旧紧紧地盯着墙上展示的菜单，这时吧台上出现了一种有些奇特的饮品。

"可供选择的手段很多，$playerName，" 对方唐突而刻意地这么说道。"并非每个人的所求都完全一致的。有些人心中十分不满，但出于礼貌而没有大声说出来。" 对方的目光闪过了门口，然后投向了全息显示屏上有关 $jabr_marketName 上领导干部的新闻。

"也许你会喜欢我手上的东西？" 对方长长地啜饮了一口，"这东西挺贵的，因为还有其他人也非常想得到它。价格是 $jabr_storyCost 星币。"

options.en: Bribe the smiling patron to acquire the prisoner
options.zh: 贿赂微笑的顾客以获得囚犯

texts.en:
You hail the bartender, point, and order 'one of those'.

The patron's smile returns. "How embarrassing for our friends up there." A nod to the holodisplay.

You exchange cryptokeys to facilitate secure comms, and coordinate a pick-up point. The timeline is short, delivery is promised before the next workshift begins, and you are almost as surprised as the prisoner looks as they are shoved out of a shadowy maintenance hatch toward you, hands still tied. The patron leans through and gives you a nod before resealing the hatch.

You move quickly to leave before the civic observation net flags your identities.
texts.zh:
你叫来酒保，点了杯 '多选一'。

顾客的脸上又出现了微笑。向全息显示屏点了点头，"上面这位朋友可真尴尬。"

你在安全通讯频道中与设施安保人员对上了暗号，并协商接头地点。对方承诺在下一次轮班开始之前交付目标。没等多久，当双手仍然被绑着的囚犯被从阴暗的维修通道中推到你面前时，你几乎和他一样惊讶。那位顾客在舱门重新密封之前倾身向你点了点头。

你们在公民识别网络标记出身份之前迅速离开了。

The patron's smile returns. "How embarrassing for our friends up there." A nod to the holodisplay.

You exchange cryptokeys to facilitate secure comms, and coordinate a pick-up point. The timeline is short, delivery is promised before the next workshift begins, and you are almost as surprised as the prisoner looks as they are shoved out of a shadowy maintenance hatch toward you, hands still tied. The patron leans through and gives you a nod before resealing the hatch.

顾客的脸上又出现了微笑。向全息显示屏点了点头，"上面这位朋友可真尴尬。"

你在安全通讯频道中与设施安保人员对上了暗号，并协商接头地点。对方承诺在下一次轮班开始之前交付目标。没等多久，当双手仍然被绑着的囚犯被从阴暗的维修通道中推到你面前时，你几乎和他一样惊讶。那位顾客在舱门重新密封之前倾身向你点了点头。

你们在公民识别网络标记出身份之前迅速离开了。

texts.en: Your TriPad chimes, notifying you that your chief security officer has handed off the prisoner, now free. Perhaps.
texts.zh: 你 TriPad 的铃声响起，表明你的安全主管已经交出了囚犯，对方现在自由了，也许吧。

texts.en: Your $shipOrFleet was recently detected - or is currently being tracked by - a nearby fleet, and dropping off the item at the specified location is extremely inadvisable.
texts.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet最近刚被侦测到或者正在被跟踪，现在递交物品到指定位置是非常不明智的。

texts.en:
Your nav officer reports that your $shipOrFleet has arrived at the coordinates provided by $ddro_personName. The $ddro_thing is held gently in a cargo drone's manipulator arms, ready for deployment.

The go-button flashes softly on your command interface.
texts.zh:
你的领航军官报告道，你的$shipOrFleet已经到达由 $ddro_personName 提供的坐标位置。$ddro_thing 已经被小心地安置到了货运无人机的机械臂上，随时准备投放。

执行按钮在你的命令界面上轻轻地闪烁。

options.en: Drop it off in a stable orbit
options.zh: 把货投放到稳定轨道上

texts.en:
The bay doors open, and the cargo drone extends its arms. Then, gently, its manipulators release.

It is now done. Whatever 'it' is.
texts.zh:
舱门开启，货运无人机伸长它的机械臂，然后轻轻地松开了物品。

任务完成了，无论 "那东西" 是什么。

texts.en:
The bay doors open, and the cargo drone extends its arms. Then, gently, its manipulators release.

It is now done. Whatever 'it' is.
texts.zh:
舱门开启，货运无人机伸长它的机械臂，然后轻轻地松开了物品。

任务完成了，无论 "那东西" 是什么。

texts.en:
"I told you, I warned you," the scavenger sputters. "You had to- to try me after I told you. I told you! You're going to regret it"

The comm link is cut again before you can say anything. This scavenger is not much for two-way conversations.
texts.zh:
"我告诉过你，我警告过你。" 拾荒者语无伦次地说，"你得 —— 你得和我硬碰硬了。我告诉过你，我告诉过你的！你会后悔的。"

你还没来得及说话，通讯线路就又被切断了。看起来这个拾荒者的社交能力不太行。

texts.en:
"I told you to leave unless you wanted to have a very bad time," the merc says, annoyed and upset that you didn't listen. "Now I have to blast you because no one will take me seriously if I don't. And don't you start, you did this to yourself."

$HeOrShe cuts the comm link before you can reply.
texts.zh:
"我警告过你，不想受罪的话就立马离开，" 雇佣兵恼羞成怒地说道，似乎是由于你根本没把$HeOrShe的话听进去，"现在我不得不把你暴打一顿，否则以后就没人把我的话当回事了。记住，这是你自找的！"

$HeOrShe在你能做出答复之前切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: "We hear your request," $hisOrHer face is impassive. "And by sacred oath, we must deny it."
texts.zh: "我们听到了你的请求，" $hisOrHer的脸上毫无表情。"根据神圣的誓言，我们必须拒绝它。"

options.en: I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement.
options.zh: 我相信我们可以达成某种协议。

options.en: Then I shall attack and destroy your fleet.
options.zh: 那我就攻击并摧毁你的舰队。

options.en: This smug obstinacy is why no one likes you.
options.zh: 你这种傲慢固执的性格就是没人喜欢你的原因。

texts.en:
"Mayhap with an official of the Church," $heOrShe says, making a show of thinking it over. "My remit, however, allows only your submission or defeat."

$HeOrShe lifts $hisOrHer chin slightly.

"Choose."
texts.zh:
"也许对于教会的官员来说可以，" $heOrShe说，假装在思考这个问题。"但我的职责只允许你们投降或被击败。"

$HeOrShe微微抬起$hisOrHer的下巴。

"选吧。"

options.en: Your efforts, however noble, are undermining my authority. I would ask you to leave.
options.zh: 无论多么高尚，你们的行为都在削弱我的权威。我要求你们离开。

options.en: You are engaging in outright piracy and spreading insurrection. I demand you cease!
options.zh: 你们正在进行赤裸裸的海盗行为，并煽动叛乱。我要求你们立即停止！

options.en: I am of the Faith! How can the Faithful here be in danger, spiritual or otherwise?
options.zh: 我就是信徒！这里的信徒怎么可能会有精神上或者其他方面的危险？

options.en: I serve the Church! How can the Faithful here be in danger, spiritual or otherwise?
options.zh: 我正效力于教会！这里的信徒怎么可能会有精神上或者其他方面的危险？

options.en: I am of the Path of Ludd. With hammer and sword, I will smash your meddling fleet of heretics.
options.zh: 我遵循卢德之径。我将以锤与剑，粉碎你们这支多管闲事的异端舰队。

options.en: If you want $KOLT_target, you're going to have to pry it from my cold, dead hands.
options.zh: 如果你们想要 $KOLT_target，那就得从我的尸体上跨过去

options.en: You want $KOLT_target? You can have it.

texts.en: "We hear your request," $hisOrHer face is impassive. "And by sacred oath, we must deny it."
texts.zh: "我们听到了你的请求，" $hisOrHer的脸上毫无表情。"根据神圣的誓言，我们必须拒绝它。"

options.en: I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement.
options.zh: 我相信我们可以达成某种协议。

options.en: Then I shall attack and destroy your fleet.
options.zh: 那我就攻击并摧毁你的舰队。

options.en: This smug obstinacy is why no one likes you.
options.zh: 你这种傲慢固执的性格就是没人喜欢你的原因。

texts.en:
"So be it," the $post says. "We shall meet in battle. May you discover mercy in eternity that you knew not in life."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms-cutoff.
texts.zh:
"那就这样吧，" 这位 $post 说道，"我们将在战场上相见。愿你在死后的永恒世界里能找到你在生时未曾知晓的慈悲。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯

texts.en:
"Responding to such foolishness is beneath a Knight," the $post says, chin upturned. "May you discover a dignity in eternity that you know not now."

$HeOrShe reaches for the comms-cutoff.
texts.zh:
"回应这种蠢话远非骑士之义务。" $post 说着说着，扬起了下巴，"愿你在死后的永恒世界里能找到你现在仍不知晓的尊严。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯。

texts.en: "We hear your demand," $hisOrHer face is impassive. "We reject your accusations of piracy and insurrection. We are sworn by sacred oath to bring the Faithful into the protection of the Church of Galactic Redemption. Only death may release a Knight of Ludd from their sacred duty."
texts.zh: "我们听到了你们的要求，" $hisOrHer的脸上毫无表情。"我们拒绝你关于海盗行为和煽动叛乱的指控。我们曾立下神圣的誓言，要将信徒置于 银河救赎教会 的保护之下。只有死亡才能让卢德骑士们解脱他们的神圣职责。"

options.en: Let's not be hasty. I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement.
options.zh: 别急着下结论。我相信我们可以达成某种协议。
那就只有死亡一条路可走了。

options.en: This smug obstinacy is why no one likes you.
options.zh: 你这种自以为是的固执就是没人喜欢你的原因。

texts.en: "If you are of the Faith, $playerBrotherOrSister, then place your faith in the will of the Church of Galactic Redemption and surrender this world unto the authority which shepherds Ludd's word upon the galaxy."
texts.zh: "如果你也是信徒，$playerBrotherOrSister，那么就请相信 银河救赎教会 的意志，并将这个世界交给这个在银河系中传播卢德之言的权威方。"

texts.en: "If you truly serve the Church, my $playerBrotherOrSister, then place your faith in the will of the Church of Galactic Redemption and surrender this world unto the authority which shepherds Ludd's word upon the galaxy."
texts.zh: "如果你真的为教会效力，我的 $playerBrotherOrSister，那么就请相信 银河救赎教会 的意志，并将这个世界交给这个在银河系中传播卢德之言的权威方。"

texts.en: "It is you who is the heretic, $playerBrotherOrSister, and I shall pray for you," $heOrShe says stonily.
texts.zh: "你才是异教徒，$playerBrotherOrSister，我会为你祈祷的，" $heOrShe冷漠地说。

texts.en:
Your words catch the $post quite off guard, and $hisOrHer sense of pious superiority falters for a moment.

"You... really?" $HeOrShe says, then recovers. "I mean, if your heart is turned, then we would rejoice and claim $KOLT_target in Ludd's name for the Church of Galactic Redemption. Is this truly your desire?"
texts.zh:
你的话让 $post 感到十分意外，$hisOrHer那种自命不凡的虔诚感瞬间动摇了一下。

"你...真的吗？" $HeOrShe说道，然后恢复了常态。"我是说，如果你的心意已决，那么我们会很高兴以卢德的名义，为 银河救赎教会 占有 $KOLT_target。这真的是你渴望的吗？"

options.en: Yes, I wash my hands of $KOLT_target.
options.zh: 是的，我放弃对 $KOLT_target 的控制。

options.en: No, of course not. I'm not insane.

texts.en:
The Knights bows $hisOrHer head, hands together. "Thank Providence for this miracle, thank Ludd for carrying the word of God, thank the holy Pneuma that our quest is attained."

No thanks for you, of course.

Seconds are called in and arrangements made to between your chief administrative officers and clerks of the Church to handle the takeover. As you each give confirmations, you see a strange sight: genuine giddiness just hidden beneath the Knight's armor of self-serious martial piety.

And the deed is done - or, at least, initiated. The Church has much work to do to integrate $KOLT_target into its loose theocracy.
texts.zh:
骑士们双手合十，低头祷告："感谢天意，佑我达成奇迹；感谢卢德，遵循主之教诲；感谢圣灵，助我完成任务。"

当然，他们没有在感谢你。

你呼叫副官们开会，安排了你方首席行政官们与教会职员的接管事宜。在双方互相确认的同时，你也有了奇妙的发现：在骑士团自认为严肃的武装修行外表之下，实际上也藏着天真的一面。

于是，合约达成 —— 至少是开始达成，教会要想把 $KOLT_target 吸收进他们松散的神权政体里，还得花不少工夫。
